functions.definition:
select jsonb_build_object(
    'organizationId', a."tenant_id",
    'entryDate', a."disposed_on",
    'currency', a."currency",
    'reference', left(coalesce(a."tag" || ' ' || a."name", a."name"), 200),
    'memo', left('Disposal of ' || a."name", 500),
    'lines', jsonb_build_array(
      jsonb_build_object('role', 'bank', 'debit', a."disposal_amount"::text),
      jsonb_build_object('role', 'accumulated_depreciation', 'debit', q.total::text),
      jsonb_build_object('role', 'fixed_asset', 'credit', a."acquisition_cost"::text),
      jsonb_build_object('role', 'disposal_gain', 'credit', greatest(q.result, 0)::text),
      jsonb_build_object('role', 'disposal_loss', 'debit', greatest(-q.result, 0)::text))
  )
  from "better_supabase"."assets" a
  cross join lateral (
    select coalesce(sum(y."amount"), 0) as total,

    from "better_supabase"."asset_depreciations" y where y."asset_id" = a."id"
  ) q
  where a."id"::text = source_id and a."disposed_on" is not null and a."acquisition_cost" is not null

functions.name: accounting_balance_sheet
functions.definition:
with sums as (
    select y."account_id" as account, sum(y."debit") - sum(y."credit") as debit_balance
    from "better_supabase"."accounting_entry_lines" y join "better_supabase"."accounting_entries" z on z."id" = y."entry_id"
    where z."tenant_id" = accounting_balance_sheet.tenant and z."status" in ('posted', 'reversed')
      and y."dimensions" @> coalesce(accounting_balance_sheet.dimensions, '{}'::jsonb)
      and z."entry_date" <= coalesce(accounting_balance_sheet.as_of, current_date)
    group by y."account_id"
  ),
  kept as (
    select w.*, c.debit_balance from sums c join "better_supabase"."accounting_accounts" w on w."id" = c.account
    where c.debit_balance <> 0
  ),
  totals as (
    select
      coalesce(sum(w.debit_balance) filter (where w."type" = 'asset'), 0) as assets,
      coalesce(-sum(w.debit_balance) filter (where w."type" = 'liability'), 0) as liabilities,
      coalesce(-sum(w.debit_balance) filter (where w."type" = 'equity'), 0) as equity,
      coalesce(-sum(w.debit_balance) filter (where w."type" in ('income', 'expense')), 0) as earnings
    from kept w
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'asOf', coalesce(accounting_balance_sheet.as_of, current_date),
    'assets', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('accountId', w."id", 'code', w."code", 'name', w."name", 'type', w."type", 'subtype', w."subtype", 'amount', (w.debit_balance)::text) order by w."code") from kept w where w."type" = 'asset'), '[]'::jsonb),
    'liabilities', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('accountId', w."id", 'code', w."code", 'name', w."name", 'type', w."type", 'subtype', w."subtype", 'amount', (-w.debit_balance)::text) order by w."code") from kept w where w."type" = 'liability'), '[]'::jsonb),
    'equity', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('accountId', w."id", 'code', w."code", 'name', w."name", 'type', w."type", 'subtype', w."subtype", 'amount', (-w.debit_balance)::text) order by w."code") from kept w where w."type" = 'equity'), '[]'::jsonb),
    'currentEarnings', t.earnings::text,
    'totalAssets', t.assets::text,
    'totalLiabilities', t.liabilities::text,
    'totalEquity', (t.equity + t.earnings)::text,
    'balanced', t.assets = t.liabilities + t.equity + t.earnings
  )
  from totals t
functions.complete_statement:

functions.name: accounting_budget_vs_actual
functions.definition:
with budget as (
    select x.* from "better_supabase"."accounting_budgets" x where x."id" = accounting_budget_vs_actual.budget_id
  ),
  planned as (
    select y."account_id" as account, y."dimensions" as dimensions, sum(y."amount") as amount
    from "better_supabase"."accounting_budget_lines" y
    where y."budget_id" = accounting_budget_vs_actual.budget_id
      and (accounting_budget_vs_actual.period_number is null or y."period_number" = accounting_budget_vs_actual.period_number)
    group by y."account_id", y."dimensions"
  ),
  compared as (
    select q.account, q.dimensions, q.amount as budget, ac."code" as code, ac."name" as name, ac."type" as type,
      coalesce((
        select sum(case when ac."type" in ('liability', 'equity', 'income') then z."credit" - z."debit" else z."debit" - z."credit" end)
        from "better_supabase"."accounting_entry_lines" z
        join "better_supabase"."accounting_entries" w on w."id" = z."entry_id"
        join "better_supabase"."accounting_periods" v on v."id" = w."period_id"
        cross join budget g
        where z."account_id" = q.account and z."dimensions" @> q.dimensions
          and w."status" in ('posted', 'reversed') and w."source_type" is distinct from 'fiscal_year'
          and v."tenant_id" = g."tenant_id" and v."fiscal_year" = g."fiscal_year"
          and (accounting_budget_vs_actual.period_number is null or v."number" = accounting_budget_vs_actual.period_number)
      ), 0) as actual
    from planned q join "better_supabase"."accounting_accounts" ac on ac."id" = q.account
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'budgetId', g."id",
    'name', g."name",
    'fiscalYear', g."fiscal_year",
    'periodNumber', accounting_budget_vs_actual.period_number,
    'lines', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('accountId', c.account, 'code', c.code, 'name', c.name, 'type', c.type,
      'dimensions', c.dimensions, 'budget', c.budget::text, 'actual', c.actual::text, 'variance', (c.actual - c.budget)::text)
      order by c.code, c.dimensions::text) from compared c), '[]'::jsonb),
    'budget', coalesce((select sum(c.budget) from compared c), 0)::text,
    'actual', coalesce((select sum(c.actual) from compared c), 0)::text
  )
  from budget g
functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.accounting_budget_vs_actual(budget_id uuid, period_number integer DEFAULT NULL::integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with budget as (
    select x.* from "better_supabase"."accounting_budgets" x where x."id" = accounting_budget_vs_actual.budget_id
  ),
  planned as (
    select y."account_id" as account, y."dimensions" as dimensions, sum(y."amount") as amount
    from "better_supabase"."accounting_budget_lines" y
    where y."budget_id" = accounting_budget_vs_actual.budget_id
      and (accounting_budget_vs_actual.period_number is null or y."period_number" = accounting_budget_vs_actual.period_number)
    group by y."account_id", y."dimensions"
  ),
  compared as (
    select q.account, q.dimensions, q.amount as budget, ac."code" as code, ac."name" as name, ac."type" as type,
      coalesce((
        select sum(case when ac."type" in ('liability', 'equity', 'income') then z."credit" - z."debit" else z."debit" - z."credit" end)
        from "better_supabase"."accounting_entry_lines" z
        join "better_supabase"."accounting_entries" w on w."id" = z."entry_id"
        join "better_supabase"."accounting_periods" v on v."id" = w."period_id"
        cross join budget g
        where z."account_id" = q.account and z."dimensions" @> q.dimensions
          and w."status" in ('posted', 'reversed') and w."source_type" is distinct from 'fiscal_year'
          and v."tenant_id" = g."tenant_id" and v."fiscal_year" = g."fiscal_year"
          and (accounting_budget_vs_actual.period_number is null or v."number" = accounting_budget_vs_actual.period_number)
      ), 0) as actual
    from planned q join "better_supabase"."accounting_accounts" ac on ac."id" = q.account
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'budgetId', g."id",
    'name', g."name",
    'fiscalYear', g."fiscal_year",
    'periodNumber', accounting_budget_vs_actual.period_number,
    'lines', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('accountId', c.account, 'code', c.code, 'name', c.name, 'type', c.type,
      'dimensions', c.dimensions, 'budget', c.budget::text, 'actual', c.actual::text, 'variance', (c.actual - c.budget)::text)

functions.name: accounting_general_ledger
functions.definition:
with account as (
    select w.* from "better_supabase"."accounting_accounts" w where w."id" = accounting_general_ledger.account_id
  ),
  booked as (
    select y.*, z."entry_date" as entry_date, z."number" as entry_number, z."journal_id" as journal_id, z."memo" as memo
    from "better_supabase"."accounting_entry_lines" y join "better_supabase"."accounting_entries" z on z."id" = y."entry_id"
    where y."account_id" = accounting_general_ledger.account_id and z."status" in ('posted', 'reversed')
      and (accounting_general_ledger.until is null or z."entry_date" <= accounting_general_ledger.until)
  ),
  opening as (
    select coalesce(sum(b."debit" - b."credit"), 0) as amount from booked b
    where b.entry_date < accounting_general_ledger.since
  ),
  period as (
    select b.*, (select o.amount from opening o) + sum(b."debit" - b."credit") over (order by b.entry_date, b.entry_number, b."position", b."id") as balance
    from booked b
    where accounting_general_ledger.since is null or b.entry_date >= accounting_general_ledger.since
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'account', jsonb_build_object('id', w."id", 'code', w."code", 'name', w."name", 'type', w."type"),
    'opening', (select o.amount from opening o)::text,
    'lines', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('entryId', b."entry_id", 'number', b.entry_number, 'entryDate', b.entry_date, 'journalId', b.journal_id,
      'description', coalesce(b."description", b.memo), 'partyId', b."party_id", 'debit', b."debit"::text, 'credit', b."credit"::text, 'balance', b.balance::text)
      order by b.entry_date, b.entry_number, b."position", b."id") from period b), '[]'::jsonb),
    'closing', ((select o.amount from opening o) + coalesce((select sum(b."debit" - b."credit") from period b), 0))::text
  )
  from account w
functions.complete_statement:

functions.name: accounting_invoice_lines
functions.definition:
with inv as (
    select x."id" as id, x."tenant_id" as tenant, x."issued_on" as issued_on, x."currency" as currency,
      x."identifier" as identifier, x."title" as title, x."subtotal" as subtotal, x."tax_total" as tax_total,
      x."total" as total, x."company_id"::text as party, x."prices_include_tax" as inclusive,
      case when x."kind" = 'credit_note' then -1 else 1 end as sign
    from "better_supabase"."invoices" x
    where x."id"::text = source_id and x."status" not in ('draft', 'void')
  ),
  groups as (
    select l."tax_rate_bps" as rate, l."tax_code" as code, sum(round(l."quantity" * l."unit_amount") - round(round(l."quantity" * l."unit_amount") * l."discount_bps" / 10000.0)) as net,
      sum((round(l."quantity" * l."unit_amount") - round(round(l."quantity" * l."unit_amount") * l."discount_bps" / 10000.0)) * l."tax_rate_bps" / case when inv.inclusive then 10000.0 + l."tax_rate_bps" else 10000.0 end) as tax
    from "better_supabase"."invoice_lines" l cross join inv
    where l."parent_id" = inv.id and true
    group by 1, 2
  ),
  shares as (
    select g.rate, g.code,
      case when sum(g.net) over () = 0
        then case when row_number() over w = count(*) over () then inv.subtotal else 0 end
        else round(inv.subtotal * sum(g.net) over w / sum(g.net) over ()) - round(inv.subtotal * (sum(g.net) over w - g.net) / sum(g.net) over ())
      end as net,
      case when sum(g.tax) over () = 0
        then case when row_number() over w = count(*) over () then inv.tax_total else 0 end
        else round(inv.tax_total * sum(g.tax) over w / sum(g.tax) over ()) - round(inv.tax_total * (sum(g.tax) over w - g.tax) / sum(g.tax) over ())
      end as tax
    from groups g cross join inv
    window w as (order by g.rate, g.code nulls first rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'organizationId', inv.tenant,
    'entryDate', inv.issued_on,
    'currency', inv.currency,
    'reference', inv.identifier,
    'memo', inv.title,
    'lines', jsonb_build_array(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('role', 'receivable', 'debit', (inv.sign * inv.total)::text, 'partyId', inv.party)))
      || coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('role', 'revenue', 'credit', (inv.sign * s.net)::text, 'taxCode', s.code, 'taxRateBps', s.rate, 'partyId', inv.party))) from shares s where s.net <> 0), '[]'::jsonb)
      || coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('role', 'tax_payable', 'credit', (inv.sign * s.tax)::text, 'taxCode', s.code, 'taxRateBps', s.rate, 'partyId', inv.party))) from shares s where s.tax <> 0), '[]'::jsonb)
  )
  from inv
functions.complete_statement:

with sums as (
    select y."account_id" as account, sum(y."credit") - sum(y."debit") as credit_balance
    from "better_supabase"."accounting_entry_lines" y join "better_supabase"."accounting_entries" z on z."id" = y."entry_id"
    where z."tenant_id" = accounting_profit_and_loss.tenant and z."status" in ('posted', 'reversed')
      and y."dimensions" @> coalesce(accounting_profit_and_loss.dimensions, '{}'::jsonb)
      and z."source_type" is distinct from 'fiscal_year'
      and (accounting_profit_and_loss.since is null or z."entry_date" >= accounting_profit_and_loss.since)
      and (accounting_profit_and_loss.until is null or z."entry_date" <= accounting_profit_and_loss.until)
    group by y."account_id"
  ),
  kept as (
    select w.*, c.credit_balance from sums c join "better_supabase"."accounting_accounts" w on w."id" = c.account
    where w."type" in ('income', 'expense') and c.credit_balance <> 0
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'income', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('accountId', w."id", 'code', w."code", 'name', w."name", 'type', w."type", 'subtype', w."subtype", 'amount', (w.credit_balance)::text) order by w."code") from kept w where w."type" = 'income'), '[]'::jsonb),
    'expenses', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('accountId', w."id", 'code', w."code", 'name', w."name", 'type', w."type", 'subtype', w."subtype", 'amount', (-w.credit_balance)::text) order by w."code") from kept w where w."type" = 'expense'), '[]'::jsonb),

    'totalExpenses', coalesce((select -sum(w.credit_balance) from kept w where w."type" = 'expense'), 0)::text,
    'netIncome', coalesce((select sum(w.credit_balance) from kept w), 0)::text
  )

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.accounting_sync_dimension_value(tenant uuid, dimension_key text, dimension_name text, code text, value_name text, archived boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS void

 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
declare

begin
  insert into "better_supabase"."accounting_dimensions" ("tenant_id", "key", "name")
  values (accounting_sync_dimension_value.tenant, accounting_sync_dimension_value.dimension_key, accounting_sync_dimension_value.dimension_name)

  insert into "better_supabase"."accounting_dimension_values" as y ("tenant_id", "dimension_id", "code", "name", "archived_at")
  values (accounting_sync_dimension_value.tenant, v_dimension, accounting_sync_dimension_value.code, left(accounting_sync_dimension_value.value_name, 200),
    case when accounting_sync_dimension_value.archived then now() end)
  on conflict ("dimension_id", "code") do update
    set "name" = excluded."name",
      "archived_at" = case when accounting_sync_dimension_value.archived then coalesce(y."archived_at", now()) end;
end;

functions.name: accounting_tax_report
functions.definition:
with booked as (
    select y."tax_code_id" as tax_code, y."account_id" as account, y."credit" - y."debit" as net
    from "better_supabase"."accounting_entry_lines" y join "better_supabase"."accounting_entries" z on z."id" = y."entry_id"
    where z."tenant_id" = accounting_tax_report.tenant and z."status" in ('posted', 'reversed')
      and y."tax_code_id" is not null
      and z."entry_date" >= accounting_tax_report.since and z."entry_date" <= accounting_tax_report.until
  ),
  codes as (
    select w."id" as id, w."code" as code, w."name" as name, w."kind" as kind,
      w."rate_bps" as rate_bps, w."report_boxes" as boxes,
      (case when w."kind" = 'sales' then 1 else -1 end) * coalesce(sum(b.net) filter (where b.account <> w."account_id"), 0) as base,
      (case when w."kind" = 'sales' then 1 else -1 end) * coalesce(sum(b.net) filter (where b.account = w."account_id"), 0) as tax
    from booked b join "better_supabase"."accounting_tax_codes" w on w."id" = b.tax_code
    group by w."id"
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'organizationId', accounting_tax_report.tenant,
    'since', accounting_tax_report.since,
    'until', accounting_tax_report.until,
    'currency', (select st."functional_currency" from "better_supabase"."accounting_settings" st where st."tenant_id" = accounting_tax_report.tenant),
    'codes', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('taxCodeId', c.id, 'code', c.code, 'name', c.name, 'kind', c.kind,
      'rateBps', c.rate_bps, 'reportBoxes', to_jsonb(c.boxes), 'base', c.base::text, 'tax', c.tax::text) order by c.code) from codes c), '[]'::jsonb),
    'boxes', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('box', x.box, 'base', x.base::text, 'tax', x.tax::text) order by x.box)
      from (select q.box, sum(c.base) as base, sum(c.tax) as tax from codes c cross join unnest(c.boxes) q(box) group by q.box) x), '[]'::jsonb),
    'salesTax', coalesce((select sum(c.tax) from codes c where c.kind = 'sales'), 0)::text,
    'purchaseTax', coalesce((select sum(c.tax) from codes c where c.kind = 'purchase'), 0)::text,
    'netTax', coalesce((select sum(case when c.kind = 'sales' then c.tax else -c.tax end) from codes c), 0)::text
  )

functions.definition:
#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  v_row "better_supabase"."ai_cache_entries"%rowtype;
begin
  if ai_cache_set.ttl is null or ai_cache_set.ttl < 1 then
    raise exception 'ttl must be at least one second' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'AI_CACHE_INVALID';
  end if;
  insert into "better_supabase"."ai_cache_entries" ("key", "organization_id", "kind", "model", "value", "expires_at")
  values (ai_cache_set.key, ai_cache_set.tenant, coalesce(ai_cache_set.kind, 'generate'), ai_cache_set.model, ai_cache_set.value,
    now() + make_interval(secs => least(ai_cache_set.ttl, 604800)))
  on conflict ("key") do update set
    "organization_id" = excluded."organization_id",
    "kind" = excluded."kind",
    "model" = excluded."model",
    "value" = excluded."value",
    "hits" = 0,
    "created_at" = now(),
    "last_hit_at" = null,
    "expires_at" = excluded."expires_at"
  returning * into v_row;
  return jsonb_build_object('key', v_row."key", 'organization_id', v_row."organization_id", 'kind', v_row."kind", 'model', v_row."model", 'value', v_row."value", 'hits', v_row."hits", 'created_at', v_row."created_at", 'last_hit_at', v_row."last_hit_at", 'expires_at', v_row."expires_at") - 'value';
end;

functions.definition:
with recursive up as (
    select x.*, 0 as depth from "better_supabase"."ai_messages" x
    where x."chat_id" = ai_message_path_of.chat and x."id" = ai_message_path_of.leaf
    union all
    select x.*, up.depth + 1 from "better_supabase"."ai_messages" x
    join up on x."chat_id" = up."chat_id" and x."id" = up."parent_id"
    where up.depth < 10000
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object('id', up."id", 'parent_id', up."parent_id", 'author_id', up."author_id", 'role', up."role", 'parts', up."parts", 'metadata', up."metadata", 'format', up."format", 'native', case when ai_message_path_of.include_native then up."native" end, 'model', up."model", 'status', up."status", 'created_at', up."created_at") || jsonb_build_object(
      'sibling_count', (select count(*) from "better_supabase"."ai_messages" sb where sb."chat_id" = up."chat_id" and sb."parent_id" is not distinct from up."parent_id"),
      'sibling_index', (select count(*) from "better_supabase"."ai_messages" sb where sb."chat_id" = up."chat_id" and sb."parent_id" is not distinct from up."parent_id" and sb."seq" < up."seq")
    )
    order by up.depth desc
  ), '[]'::jsonb)
  from up;

    select x.*, 0 as depth from "better_supabase"."ai_messages" x
    where x."chat_id" = ai_message_path_of.chat and x."id" = ai_message_path_of.leaf
    union all
    select x.*, up.depth + 1 from "better_supabase"."ai_messages" x
    join up on x."chat_id" = up."chat_id" and x."id" = up."parent_id"
    where up.depth < 10000
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(

    summary => 'Observation amended',
    tenant => (v_row."tenant_id")::uuid,
    metadata => jsonb_build_object('organizationId', v_row."tenant_id", 'observationId', v_row."id", 'definitionKey', v_def."key", 'subjectType', v_row."subject_type", 'subjectId', v_row."subject_id", 'replacesId', v_old."id", 'reason', v_reason)
  );
  declare
    v_hook regprocedure := to_regprocedure('"public"."after_observation_amend"(uuid)');
  begin
    if v_hook is not null then
      execute format('select %s($1::uuid)', v_hook::oid::regproc)
        using v_row."id";
    end if;
  end;
  return jsonb_build_object('id', v_row."id", 'organizationId', v_row."tenant_id", 'definitionId', v_row."definition_id", 'definitionKey', v_def."key", 'title', v_def."title", 'valueType', v_def."value_type", 'unit', v_def."unit", 'subjectType', v_row."subject_type", 'subjectId', v_row."subject_id", 'observedAt', v_row."observed_at", 'value', case v_def."value_type"
      when 'boolean' then to_jsonb(v_row."value_code" = 'true')
      when 'code' then to_jsonb(v_row."value_code")
      when 'text' then to_jsonb(v_row."value_text")
      when 'components' then v_row."components"
      else to_jsonb(v_row."value_number")
    end, 'flag', v_row."flag", 'status', v_row."status", 'replacesId', v_row."replaces_id", 'reason', v_row."reason", 'method', v_row."method", 'device', v_row."device", 'source', v_row."source", 'externalId', v_row."external_id", 'submissionId', v_row."submission_id", 'performerId', v_row."performer_id", 'note', v_row."note", 'createdAt', v_row."created_at");
end;
$function$

functions.definition:
declare
  v_job "better_supabase"."job_openings";
  v_row "better_supabase"."applications";
  v_type text := coalesce(apply_to_job.candidate ->> 'type', 'person');
  v_id text := apply_to_job.candidate ->> 'id';
begin
  if not (better_supabase.actor_may_write()) then
    raise exception 'This session is read-only' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'ACTOR_READ_ONLY';
  end if;
  select * into v_job from "better_supabase"."job_openings" x where x."id" = apply_to_job.job;
  if v_job."id" is null or not ((auth.role() = 'service_role') or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_job."tenant_id", 'hiring.write'), false)) then
    raise exception 'no such job you can add applications to' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'JOB_OPENING_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  if v_job."status" <> 'open' then
    raise exception 'the job isn''t open' using errcode = '55000', hint = 'JOB_OPENING_NOT_OPEN';
  end if;
  if v_id is null or not (case v_type
      when 'message' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."messages" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'conversation' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."conversations" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'channel' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."channels" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'company' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."companies" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'person' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."people" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'deal' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."deals" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'course' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."courses" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'post' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."posts" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'activity' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."activities" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'quote' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."quotes" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'work_item' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_items" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'employee' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."employees" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'invoice' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."invoices" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'ledger_account' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."ledger_accounts" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'product' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."products" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'product_variant' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."product_variants" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'order' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."orders" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'calendar_event' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."calendar_events" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'booking' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."bookings" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'asset' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."assets" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'asset_location' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."asset_locations" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'lease' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."leases" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'expense_report' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."expense_reports" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'expense_line' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."expense_lines" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'donation_fund' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."donation_funds" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'work_order' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_orders" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'shipment' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."shipments" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'contract' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."contracts" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'control' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."controls" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'compliance_policy' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."compliance_policies" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'qualification_type' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."qualification_types" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'risk' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."risks" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'case' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."cases" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'inspection' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."inspections" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'inspection_program' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."inspection_programs" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'inspection_finding' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."inspection_findings" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'form' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."forms" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'production_order' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."production_orders" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'work_center' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_centers" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'care_plan' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."care_plans" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'incident' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."incidents" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'content_entry' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."content_entries" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'document' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."documents" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'customer' then exists (select 1 from "public"."customers" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."organization_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'drive_node' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'application' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."applications" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'change_request' then exists (select 1 from "public"."change_requests" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."organization_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'project' then exists (select 1 from "public"."projects" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."organization_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'task' then exists (select 1 from "public"."tasks" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."organization_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      else false
    end and "better_supabase"."can_subject"(v_type, v_id, 'read')) then
    raise exception 'the candidate is unknown or not readable in this organization' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'HIRING_CANDIDATE_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  select * into v_row from "better_supabase"."applications" x
  where x."job_id" = v_job."id" and x."candidate_type" = v_type and x."candidate_id" = v_id;
  if v_row."id" is not null then
    return to_jsonb(v_row);
  end if;
  insert into "better_supabase"."applications" ("tenant_id", "job_id", "candidate_type", "candidate_id", "source", "owner_user_id")
  values (v_job."tenant_id", v_job."id", v_type, v_id, nullif(trim(apply_to_job.source), ''), coalesce(apply_to_job.owner, auth.uid()))
  returning * into v_row;
  perform "better_supabase".emit_event('application.created', jsonb_build_object('organizationId', v_row."tenant_id", 'applicationId', v_row."id", 'subjectType', 'application', 'subjectId', v_row."id"::text, 'jobId', v_row."job_id", 'candidateType', v_row."candidate_type", 'candidateId', v_row."candidate_id"), 'applications/' || v_row."id"::text, (v_row."tenant_id"::text)::text, null, 'better-supabase/hiring');
  return to_jsonb(v_row);
end;

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_job "better_supabase"."job_openings";

begin
  if not (better_supabase.actor_may_write()) then

  end if;
  select * into v_job from "better_supabase"."job_openings" x where x."id" = apply_to_job.job;
  if v_job."id" is null or not ((auth.role() = 'service_role') or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_job."tenant_id", 'hiring.write'), false)) then

  end if;
  if v_job."status" <> 'open' then
    raise exception 'the job isn''t open' using errcode = '55000', hint = 'JOB_OPENING_NOT_OPEN';
  end if;
  if v_id is null or not (case v_type
      when 'message' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."messages" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'conversation' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."conversations" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)

      when 'deal' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."deals" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)

      when 'activity' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."activities" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'quote' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."quotes" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'work_item' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_items" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'employee' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."employees" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'invoice' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."invoices" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'ledger_account' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."ledger_accounts" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'product' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."products" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'product_variant' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."product_variants" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'order' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."orders" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'calendar_event' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."calendar_events" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)
      when 'booking' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."bookings" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)

      when 'inspection_finding' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."inspection_findings" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)

      when 'drive_node' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" s where s."id" = (v_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_job."tenant_id"::text)

      else false

  insert into "better_supabase"."applications" ("tenant_id", "job_id", "candidate_type", "candidate_id", "source", "owner_user_id")
  values (v_job."tenant_id", v_job."id", v_type, v_id, nullif(trim(apply_to_job.source), ''), coalesce(apply_to_job.owner, auth.uid()))

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.approve_timesheet(timesheet_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_sheet "better_supabase"."timesheets"%rowtype;
begin
  update "better_supabase"."timesheets" s set "approved_at" = now()
    where s."id" = approve_timesheet.timesheet_id and s."approved_at" is null
    returning * into v_sheet;
  if found then
    perform "better_supabase".emit_event('timesheet.approved', jsonb_build_object('organizationId', v_sheet."tenant_id", 'id', v_sheet."id", 'userId', v_sheet."user_id", 'week', v_sheet."week", 'approvalId', v_sheet."approval_id"), 'timesheets/' || v_sheet."id"::text, (v_sheet."tenant_id")::text, null, 'better-supabase/time-tracking');
  perform better_supabase.audit_event(
    event_type => 'timesheet.approved',
    category => 'data',
    target_type => 'timesheet',
    record_id => v_sheet."id"::text,
    summary => 'approved a timesheet' || ' for the week of ' || v_sheet."week"::text,
    tenant => (v_sheet."tenant_id")::uuid,
    metadata => jsonb_build_object('organizationId', v_sheet."tenant_id", 'id', v_sheet."id", 'userId', v_sheet."user_id", 'week', v_sheet."week", 'approvalId', v_sheet."approval_id")
  );
  end if;
end;

functions.name: attachment_object_allowed
functions.definition:
select exists (
    select 1 from "better_supabase"."attachments" a
    where a."bucket" = attachment_object_allowed.bucket and a."object_path" = any (array[attachment_object_allowed.path, regexp_replace(attachment_object_allowed.path, '-v[0-9]+$', '')]) and (case when a."version" > 1 then a."object_path" || '-v' || a."version"::text else a."object_path" end) = attachment_object_allowed.path
      and case attachment_object_allowed.action
        when 'insert' then a."status" = 'pending' and a."uploaded_at" is null and a."uploaded_by" = auth.uid()
        when 'select' then (a."status" in ('pending', 'clean', 'failed') and (coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', a."organization_id", 'attachments.read'), false) or ((a."organization_id")::text, (a."subject_type")::text, (a."subject_id")::text) in (select g.tenant, g.subject_type, g.subject_id from better_supabase.portal_subjects('read') g)))
          or a."uploaded_by" = auth.uid() or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', a."organization_id", 'attachments.manage'), false)
        when 'delete' then a."uploaded_by" = auth.uid() or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', a."organization_id", 'attachments.manage'), false)
        else false
      end
  ) or exists (
    select 1 from "better_supabase"."attachment_versions" v
    join "better_supabase"."attachments" a on a."id" = v."attachment_id"
    where v."bucket" = attachment_object_allowed.bucket and v."object_path" = attachment_object_allowed.path
      and case attachment_object_allowed.action
        when 'select' then (v."status" in ('pending', 'clean', 'failed') and (coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', a."organization_id", 'attachments.read'), false) or ((a."organization_id")::text, (a."subject_type")::text, (a."subject_id")::text) in (select g.tenant, g.subject_type, g.subject_id from better_supabase.portal_subjects('read') g)))
          or v."uploaded_by" = auth.uid() or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', a."organization_id", 'attachments.manage'), false)
        when 'delete' then a."uploaded_by" = auth.uid() or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', a."organization_id", 'attachments.manage'), false)
        else false
      end
  )
functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.attachment_object_allowed(bucket text, path text, action text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$

functions.definition:
declare
  existing text;
  entry_id "better_supabase"."audit_events"."id"%type;
begin
  if restricted is not null or ip is not null or user_agent is not null or session_id is not null then
    raise exception 'audit_event got restricted details, and the audit module has no restricted table'
      using errcode = '22023', hint = 'Set blocks.audit.options.restricted to true.';
  end if;
  actor_id := coalesce(actor_id, auth.uid());
  if idempotency_key is not null then
    perform pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(pg_catalog.hashtext('better_supabase.audit_event'), pg_catalog.hashtext(coalesce(tenant::text, '') || ':' || idempotency_key));
    select l."id"::text into existing
    from "better_supabase"."audit_events" l
    where l."idempotency_key" = audit_event_trusted.idempotency_key
      and l."organization_id" is not distinct from audit_event_trusted.tenant
    limit 1;
    if existing is not null then
      return existing;
    end if;
  end if;
  insert into "better_supabase"."audit_events" ("table_name", "record_id", "op", "actor_id", "actor_role", "organization_id", "impersonated_by", "impersonation_reason", "support_session_id", "event_type", "category", "outcome", "source", "target_type", "metadata", "idempotency_key", "actor_kind", "actor_label", "tenant_label", "target_label", "summary", "request_id", "correlation_id", "scope")
  values (
    null,
    record_id,
    'event',
    actor_id,
    coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'role', current_user),
    tenant,
    coalesce(audit_event_trusted.impersonated_by, case when auth.jwt() -> 'act' ->> 'sub' ~ '^[0-9a-f-]{36}$' then (auth.jwt() -> 'act' ->> 'sub')::uuid end),
    coalesce(audit_event_trusted.impersonation_reason, auth.jwt() -> 'act' ->> 'reason'),
    coalesce(audit_event_trusted.support_session, case when auth.jwt() -> 'act' ->> 'session_id' ~ '^[0-9a-f-]{36}$' then (auth.jwt() -> 'act' ->> 'session_id')::uuid end),
    event_type,
    coalesce(category, 'system'),
    coalesce(outcome, 'success'),
    coalesce(source, 'app'),
    target_type,
    coalesce(metadata, '{}'),
    idempotency_key,
    coalesce(actor_kind, case
      when coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'role', '') = 'service_role' then 'service'
      when auth.jwt() -> 'act' ->> 'kind' = 'support' then 'support'
      when auth.jwt() -> 'act' is not null then 'impersonation'
      when auth.jwt() ->> 'client_id' is not null then 'oauth-client'
      when auth.uid() is not null then 'user'
      else 'system'
    end),
    coalesce(actor_label, coalesce(auth.jwt() -> 'user_metadata' ->> 'full_name', auth.jwt() ->> 'email')),
    (select o."name"::text from "public"."organizations" o where o."id" = tenant),
    target_label,
    summary,
    coalesce(better_supabase.request_id_or_null(request_id), coalesce(better_supabase.request_id_or_null(current_setting('better_supabase.request_id', true)), better_supabase.request_id_or_null(better_supabase.request_header('x-request-id')))),
    coalesce(better_supabase.request_id_or_null(correlation_id), coalesce(better_supabase.request_id_or_null(current_setting('better_supabase.correlation_id', true)), better_supabase.request_id_or_null(better_supabase.request_header('x-correlation-id')))),
    coalesce(audit_event_trusted.scope, case when tenant is null then 'platform' else 'tenant' end)
  )
  returning "id" into entry_id;
  return entry_id::text;
end;

functions.name: audit_revert_source
functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.audit_revert_source(entries text[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  found_entries jsonb;
begin
  if cardinality(audit_revert_source.entries) > 1000 then
    raise exception 'revert at most 1000 entries at once' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'AUDIT_REVERT_TOO_MANY';
  end if;
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', l."id"::text,
      'table', to_regclass(quote_ident(split_part(l."table_name", '.', 1)) || '.' || quote_ident(split_part(l."table_name", '.', 2)))::text,
      'op', l."op",
      'old', l."old_record",
      'new', l."new_record",
      'changed', to_jsonb(l."changed"),
      'keys', to_jsonb(coalesce(
        (select a."key_columns" from "better_supabase"."audited_tables" a where a."target" = to_regclass(quote_ident(split_part(l."table_name", '.', 1)) || '.' || quote_ident(split_part(l."table_name", '.', 2)))),
        (select array_agg(att.attname::text order by k.ord)
         from pg_catalog.pg_index i
         cross join lateral unnest(i.indkey) with ordinality k(attnum, ord)
         join pg_catalog.pg_attribute att on att.attrelid = i.indrelid and att.attnum = k.attnum
         where i.indrelid = to_regclass(quote_ident(split_part(l."table_name", '.', 1)) || '.' || quote_ident(split_part(l."table_name", '.', 2))) and i.indisprimary)
      ))
    ) order by l."occurred_at" desc, l."id" desc), '[]'::jsonb)
  into found_entries
  from "better_supabase"."audit_events" l
  
  where l."id"::text = any (audit_revert_source.entries)
    and (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin')
      or (l."organization_id" is not null and coalesce(better_supabase.member_can(auth.uid(), l."organization_id", 'audit.revert'), false)));
  if jsonb_array_length(found_entries) <> cardinality(array(select distinct e from unnest(audit_revert_source.entries) e)) then
    raise exception 'an entry is missing or not yours to revert' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'AUDIT_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  return found_entries;
end;
$function$

functions.name: audit_schema
functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.audit_schema(schema_name text, tenant_column text, exempt text[] DEFAULT '{}'::text[])
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  registered integer := 0;
  target regclass;
begin
  for target in
    select format('%I.%I', n.nspname, c.relname)::regclass
    from pg_catalog.pg_class c
    join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
    where n.nspname = schema_name
      and c.relkind in ('r', 'p')
      and not c.relispartition
      and exists (
        select 1 from pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
        where a.attrelid = c.oid and a.attname = audit_schema.tenant_column and a.attnum > 0 and not a.attisdropped
      )
      and not exists (select 1 from unnest(exempt) e where c.relname like e)
      and not exists (
        select 1 from pg_catalog.pg_trigger t where t.tgrelid = c.oid and t.tgname = 'bsb_audit'
      )
    order by c.relname
  loop
    perform better_supabase.audit(target);
    registered := registered + 1;
  end loop;
  return registered;
end;
$function$

functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.bom_where_used(variant_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_tenant uuid := (select cv."tenant_id" from "better_supabase"."product_variants" cv where cv."id" = bom_where_used.variant_id);
begin
  if v_tenant is null or not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or (v_tenant is not null and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_tenant, 'manufacturing.read'), false))) then
    raise exception 'no such bill of materials' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'BOM_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  return coalesce((with recursive used(bom, variant, version, status, quantity, level, path) as (
    select x."id", x."variant_id", x."version", x."status", y."quantity", 1, array[y."variant_id", x."variant_id"]
    from "better_supabase"."bom_components" y join "better_supabase"."boms" x on x."id" = y."bom_id"
    where y."variant_id" = bom_where_used.variant_id and x."status" <> 'archived'
    union all
    select x."id", x."variant_id", x."version", x."status", y."quantity", used.level + 1, used.path || x."variant_id"
    from used
    join "better_supabase"."bom_components" y on y."variant_id" = used.variant
    join "better_supabase"."boms" x on x."id" = y."bom_id" and x."status" = 'active'
    where used.status = 'active' and used.level < 20 and not (x."variant_id" = any (used.path))
  )
  select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('level', u.level, 'bomId', u.bom, 'variantId', u.variant, 'version', u.version,
    'status', u.status, 'quantity', u.quantity::text) order by u.level, u.variant, u.version desc) from used u), '[]'::jsonb);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.bsb_valid_iban(value text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case
    when value !~ '^[A-Z]{2}[0-9]{2}[A-Z0-9]{11,30}$' then false
    else (
      select string_agg(case when ascii(c.ch) between 65 and 90 then (ascii(c.ch) - 55)::text else c.ch end, '' order by c.n)
      from regexp_split_to_table(substr(value, 5) || substr(value, 1, 4), '') with ordinality as c(ch, n)
    )::numeric % 97 = 1
  end
$function$

functions.name: calendar_busy_blocks
functions.definition:
#variable_conflict use_column
begin
  return query
  with sources as (
    select m.u as user_id, e."id" as event_id
    from unnest(calendar_busy_blocks.user_ids) m (u)
    join "better_supabase"."calendars" k on k."tenant_id" = calendar_busy_blocks.tenant and k."owner_type" = 'user' and k."owner_id" = m.u::text
    join "better_supabase"."calendar_events" e on e."calendar_id" = k."id"
    union
    select a."user_id" as user_id, e."id" as event_id
    from "better_supabase"."calendar_attendees" a
    join "better_supabase"."calendar_events" e on (e."id" = a."event_id" or e."recurrence_id" = a."event_id")
    where a."tenant_id" = calendar_busy_blocks.tenant
      and a."user_id" = any (calendar_busy_blocks.user_ids)
      and a."response" <> 'declined'
      and not exists (
        select 1 from "better_supabase"."calendar_attendees" d
        where d."event_id" = e."id" and d."user_id" = a."user_id" and d."response" = 'declined'
      )
  ),
  candidates as (
    select distinct s.user_id, e."id" as event_id, e."kind" as kind, e."starts_at" as starts_at, e."ends_at" as ends_at,
      e."tz" as tz, e."rrule" as rrule, e."recurrence_id" as recurrence, e."exdates" as exdates, (e."kind" <> 'event' and e."auto_decline") as declines
    from sources s
    join "better_supabase"."calendar_events" e on e."id" = s.event_id
    where e."tenant_id" = calendar_busy_blocks.tenant
      and e."status" <> 'cancelled'
      and e."transparency" <> 'transparent'
      and e."starts_at" < calendar_busy_blocks.range_end
  )
  select c.user_id, c.kind, c.starts_at, c.ends_at, c.event_id, c.declines
  from candidates c
  where c.rrule is null and c.starts_at < calendar_busy_blocks.range_end and c.ends_at > calendar_busy_blocks.range_start
  union all
  select c.user_id, c.kind, s.at, s.at + (c.ends_at - c.starts_at), c.event_id, c.declines
  from candidates c
  cross join lateral "better_supabase"."calendar_rule_starts"(c.starts_at, c.tz, c.rrule, calendar_busy_blocks.range_start - (c.ends_at - c.starts_at), calendar_busy_blocks.range_end) s (at)
  where c.rrule is not null and c.recurrence is null
    and c.starts_at < calendar_busy_blocks.range_end
    and s.at + (c.ends_at - c.starts_at) > calendar_busy_blocks.range_start
    and not (s.at = any (c.exdates))
    and not exists (
      select 1 from "better_supabase"."calendar_events" o
      where o."recurrence_id" = c.event_id and o."original_start" = s.at
    );
end;

functions.name: can_assign_as
functions.definition:
select member is not null
    and exists (
      select 1 from "public"."memberships" m
      where m."organization_id" = can_assign_as.tenant and m."user_id" = can_assign_as.member
    )
      and exists (
        select 1 from "better_supabase"."roles" r
        where r."id"::text = can_assign_as.role and r."scope"::text = 'tenant'
      )
    and not exists (
      select 1
        from (
          select r."id" as "role", can_assign_as.tenant as "organization_id"
          from "better_supabase"."roles" r
          where r."id"::text = can_assign_as.role
        ) m
        cross join "better_supabase"."permissions" p
        cross join lateral (select p."key" as key) k
        where coalesce(
      (select bool_and(o."granted") from "better_supabase"."permission_overrides" o
        where o."organization_id" = m."organization_id"
          and o."role_id" = m."role"
          and o."permission_id" = p."id"),
      exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."role_permissions" rp where rp."role_id" = m."role" and rp."permission_id" = p."id")
    )
        and not coalesce(better_supabase.member_can(can_assign_as.member, can_assign_as.tenant, k.key), false)
    )

    )
      and exists (
        select 1 from "better_supabase"."roles" r
        where r."id"::text = can_assign_as.role and r."scope"::text = 'tenant'
      )
    and not exists (
      select 1
        from (
          select r."id" as "role", can_assign_as.tenant as "organization_id"
          from "better_supabase"."roles" r
          where r."id"::text = can_assign_as.role
        ) m
        cross join "better_supabase"."permissions" p
        cross join lateral (select p."key" as key) k

      (select bool_and(o."granted") from "better_supabase"."permission_overrides" o
        where o."organization_id" = m."organization_id"

          when 'write' then coalesce(better_supabase.can_user(can_subject_for.member, 'tenant', s."tenant_id", 'manufacturing.manage'), false)
          else false
        end
      );
    when 'care_plan' then
      return exists (
        select 1 from "better_supabase"."care_plans" s
        where s."id" = (can_subject_for.subject_id)::uuid
          and case can_subject_for.action
          when 'read' then coalesce(better_supabase.can_user(can_subject_for.member, 'tenant', s."tenant_id", 'care_plans.read'), false)
          when 'write' then coalesce(better_supabase.can_user(can_subject_for.member, 'tenant', s."tenant_id", 'care_plans.write'), false)
          else false
        end
      );
    when 'incident' then
      return exists (
        select 1 from "better_supabase"."incidents" s
        where s."id" = (can_subject_for.subject_id)::uuid
          and case can_subject_for.action
          when 'read' then coalesce(better_supabase.can_user(can_subject_for.member, 'tenant', s."tenant_id", 'incidents.read'), false)
          when 'write' then coalesce(better_supabase.can_user(can_subject_for.member, 'tenant', s."tenant_id", 'incidents.write'), false)
          else false
        end
      );
    when 'content_entry' then
      return exists (
        select 1 from "better_supabase"."content_entries" s
        where s."id" = (can_subject_for.subject_id)::uuid
          and case can_subject_for.action
          when 'read' then coalesce(better_supabase.can_user(can_subject_for.member, 'tenant', s."tenant_id", 'content.read'), false)
          when 'write' then coalesce(better_supabase.can_user(can_subject_for.member, 'tenant', s."tenant_id", 'content.write'), false)
          else false
        end
      );
    when 'document' then
      return exists (
        select 1 from "better_supabase"."documents" s
        where s."id" = (can_subject_for.subject_id)::uuid
          and case can_subject_for.action
          when 'read' then coalesce(better_supabase.can_user(can_subject_for.member, 'tenant', s."tenant_id", 'documents.read'), false)
          when 'write' then coalesce(better_supabase.can_user(can_subject_for.member, 'tenant', s."tenant_id", 'documents.write'), false)
          else false
        end
      );
    when 'customer' then
      return exists (
        select 1 from "public"."customers" s
        where s."id" = (can_subject_for.subject_id)::uuid and s."archived_at" is null
          and case can_subject_for.action
          when 'read' then (coalesce(better_supabase.can_user(can_subject_for.member, 'tenant', s."organization_id", 'customers.read'), false) or exists (
            select 1 from "better_supabase"."subject_members" m
            where m."subject_type" = 'customer'
              and m."subject_id" = s."id"::text
              and m."tenant_id" = s."organization_id"
              and (m."user_id" = can_subject_for.member or (m."team_id" is not null and exists (
          select 1 from "better_supabase"."team_members" tm
          where tm."team_id" = m."team_id"
            and tm."user_id" = can_subject_for.member)))
        and (m."starts_on" is null or m."starts_on" <= current_date)
        and (m."ends_on" is null or m."ends_on" >= current_date)
        and (m."ends_at" is null or m."ends_at" > now())))
          when 'write' then (coalesce(better_supabase.can_user(can_subject_for.member, 'tenant', s."organization_id", 'customers.write'), false) or exists (
            select 1 from "better_supabase"."subject_members" m
            where m."subject_type" = 'customer'
              and m."subject_id" = s."id"::text
              and m."tenant_id" = s."organization_id"
              and (m."user_id" = can_subject_for.member or (m."team_id" is not null and exists (
          select 1 from "better_supabase"."team_members" tm
          where tm."team_id" = m."team_id"
            and tm."user_id" = can_subject_for.member)))
        and (m."starts_on" is null or m."starts_on" <= current_date)
        and (m."ends_on" is null or m."ends_on" >= current_date)
        and (m."ends_at" is null or m."ends_at" > now())))
          else false
        end
      );
    when 'drive_node' then
      return exists (
        select 1 from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" s
        where s."id" = (can_subject_for.subject_id)::uuid and s."deleted_at" is null
          and case can_subject_for.action
          when 'read' then (false or exists (
            select 1 from "better_supabase"."subject_members" m
            where m."subject_type" = 'drive_node'
              and m."subject_id" = s."id"::text
              and m."tenant_id" = s."tenant_id"
              and (m."user_id" = can_subject_for.member or (m."team_id" is not null and exists (
          select 1 from "better_supabase"."team_members" tm
          where tm."team_id" = m."team_id"
            and tm."user_id" = can_subject_for.member)))
        and (m."starts_on" is null or m."starts_on" <= current_date)
        and (m."ends_on" is null or m."ends_on" >= current_date)
        and (m."ends_at" is null or m."ends_at" > now())))
          when 'write' then coalesce(better_supabase.can_user(can_subject_for.member, 'tenant', s."tenant_id", 'drive.manage'), false)
          when 'comment' then false
          when 'fields' then false
          else false
        end
      );
    when 'application' then
      return exists (
        select 1 from "better_supabase"."applications" s
        where s."id" = (can_subject_for.subject_id)::uuid
          and case can_subject_for.action
          when 'read' then coalesce(better_supabase.can_user(can_subject_for.member, 'tenant', s."tenant_id", 'hiring.read'), false)
          when 'write' then coalesce(better_supabase.can_user(can_subject_for.member, 'tenant', s."tenant_id", 'hiring.write'), false)
          else false
        end
      );
    when 'change_request' then
      return exists (
        select 1 from "public"."change_requests" s
        where s."id" = (can_subject_for.subject_id)::uuid
          and false
      );
    when 'project' then
      return exists (
        select 1 from "public"."projects" s
        where s."id" = (can_subject_for.subject_id)::uuid and s."deleted_at" is null
          and false
      );
    when 'task' then
      return exists (
        select 1 from "public"."tasks" s
        where s."id" = (can_subject_for.subject_id)::uuid
          and false
      );
    else
      return false;
  end case;
  return false;
exception
  when feature_not_supported then
    return false;
end;
$function$

functions.definition:
select case
    when jwt is null then true
    when jsonb_typeof(cap) = 'array'
      and not exists (
        select 1 from jsonb_array_elements_text(cap) c(key)
        where better_supabase.permission_matches(c.key, cap_allows.permission)
      ) then false
    when coalesce(jwt ->> 'client_id', '') = ''
      and (jwt -> 'act' is null
        or (jsonb_typeof(jwt -> 'act') = 'object'
          and jwt -> 'act' ->> 'kind' in ('support', 'impersonation'))) then true
    else exists (
      select 1
      from unnest(case jsonb_typeof(jwt -> 'scope')
          when 'string' then regexp_split_to_array(btrim(jwt ->> 'scope'), '\s+')
          when 'array' then array(select jsonb_array_elements_text(jwt -> 'scope'))
          else '{}'::text[]
        end) s(scope)
      cross join lateral unnest(better_supabase.scope_permissions(s.scope)) k(key)
      where s.scope <> ''
        and better_supabase.permission_matches(k.key, cap_allows.permission)
    )
  end
  from (select auth.jwt() as jwt) as token
  cross join lateral (
    select coalesce(jwt -> 'bsb_permission_cap', jwt -> 'bs_permission_cap') as cap
  ) as capped

functions.definition:
select coalesce(jsonb_agg(item order by slug collate "C"), '[]'::jsonb)
  from (
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'id', p."id",
      'slug', p."slug",
      'status', p."status",
      'kind', p."kind",
      'locale', (case when $2 = any ('{en}'::text[]) then $2 when split_part($2, '-', 1) = any ('{en}'::text[]) then split_part($2, '-', 1) else 'en' end),
      'title', coalesce(t."title", p."title"),
      'description', coalesce(t."description", p."description"),
      'listedAt', l."listed_at"
    ) as item, p."slug" as slug
    from "better_supabase"."catalog_channel_products" l
    join "better_supabase"."products" p on p."id" = l."product_id"
    left join "better_supabase"."product_translations" t on t."product_id" = p."id" and t."locale" = (case when $2 = any ('{en}'::text[]) then $2 when split_part($2, '-', 1) = any ('{en}'::text[]) then split_part($2, '-', 1) else 'en' end)
    where l."channel_id" = $1
      and ($4 is null or p."slug" collate "C" > $4 collate "C")
    order by p."slug" collate "C"
    limit least(greatest(coalesce($3, 100), 1), 500)
  ) items

AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
declare

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.chat_state_append_to_list(prefix text, key text, value jsonb, max_length integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, ttl_ms integer DEFAULT NULL::integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_expires timestamptz := case when ttl_ms is null or ttl_ms <= 0 then null else clock_timestamp() + make_interval(secs => ttl_ms / 1000.0) end;
begin
  insert into "better_supabase"."chat_state_lists" ("key_prefix", "list_key", "value", "expires_at")
  values (prefix, key, value, v_expires);
  if max_length is not null and max_length > 0 then
    delete from "better_supabase"."chat_state_lists" l
    where l."key_prefix" = chat_state_append_to_list.prefix and l."list_key" = chat_state_append_to_list.key
      and l."id" < (
        select k."id" from "better_supabase"."chat_state_lists" k
        where k."key_prefix" = chat_state_append_to_list.prefix and k."list_key" = chat_state_append_to_list.key
        order by k."id" desc
        offset max_length - 1 limit 1
      );
  end if;
  update "better_supabase"."chat_state_lists" l set "expires_at" = v_expires
  where l."key_prefix" = chat_state_append_to_list.prefix and l."list_key" = chat_state_append_to_list.key
    and l."expires_at" is distinct from v_expires;
end;

functions.name: claim_notification_deliveries
functions.definition:
declare
  claimed jsonb;
begin
  -- A delivery whose lease ran out on its last attempt lost its worker.
  update "better_supabase"."notification_deliveries" d
  set "status" = 'failed', "error" = 'The lease ran out on the last attempt'
  where d."channel" = claim_notification_deliveries.channel
    and d."status" = 'pending'
    and d."attempts" >= greatest(1, coalesce(claim_notification_deliveries.max_attempts, 5))
    and d."attempted_at" < now() - claim_notification_deliveries.lease;

  with picked as (
    select d."id" as id from "better_supabase"."notification_deliveries" d
    where d."channel" = claim_notification_deliveries.channel
      and d."status" = 'pending'
      and d."next_attempt_at" <= now()
      and (d."attempted_at" is null or d."attempted_at" < now() - claim_notification_deliveries.lease)
    order by d."created_at"
    limit claim_notification_deliveries.max_items
    for update skip locked
  ), leased as (
    update "better_supabase"."notification_deliveries" d set "attempted_at" = now(), "attempts" = d."attempts" + 1
    from picked where d."id" = picked.id
    returning d.*
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'delivery_id', l."id",
    'channel', l."channel",
    'attempts', l."attempts",
    'user_id', rc."user_id",
    'email', u.email,
    'locale', pr."locale"::text,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.claim_notification_deliveries(channel text, max_items integer DEFAULT 50, lease interval DEFAULT '00:05:00'::interval, max_attempts integer DEFAULT 5)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  claimed jsonb;
begin
  -- A delivery whose lease ran out on its last attempt lost its worker.
  update "better_supabase"."notification_deliveries" d
  set "status" = 'failed', "error" = 'The lease ran out on the last attempt'
  where d."channel" = claim_notification_deliveries.channel
    and d."status" = 'pending'
    and d."attempts" >= greatest(1, coalesce(claim_notification_deliveries.max_attempts, 5))
    and d."attempted_at" < now() - claim_notification_deliveries.lease;

  with picked as (
    select d."id" as id from "better_supabase"."notification_deliveries" d
    where d."channel" = claim_notification_deliveries.channel
      and d."status" = 'pending'
      and d."next_attempt_at" <= now()
      and (d."attempted_at" is null or d."attempted_at" < now() - claim_notification_deliveries.lease)
    order by d."created_at"
    limit claim_notification_deliveries.max_items
    for update skip locked
  ), leased as (
    update "better_supabase"."notification_deliveries" d set "attempted_at" = now(), "attempts" = d."attempts" + 1
    from picked where d."id" = picked.id
    returning d.*
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'delivery_id', l."id",
    'channel', l."channel",
    'attempts', l."attempts",
    'user_id', rc."user_id",
    'email', u.email,
    'locale', pr."locale"::text,
    'notification', jsonb_build_object('id', rc."id", 'event_id', ev."id", 'type', ev."type", 'data', ev."data", 'created_at', rc."created_at", 'read_at', rc."read_at", 'tenant', ev."organization_id", 'actor_id', ev."actor_id", 'subject_type', ev."subject_type", 'subject_id', ev."subject_id", 'subject_label', ev."subject_label", 'summary', ev."summary", 'action_path', ev."action_path", 'actions', ev."actions", 'priority', ev."priority", 'resolved_at', rc."resolved_at", 'resolution', rc."resolution"),
    'suppressed', s."reason"
  )), '[]') into claimed
  from leased l
  join "better_supabase"."notification_recipients" rc on rc."id" = l."recipient_id"
  join "better_supabase"."notification_events" ev on ev."id" = rc."event_id"
  left join auth.users u on u.id = rc."user_id"
  left join "better_supabase"."profiles" pr on pr."id" = rc."user_id"
  left join "better_supabase"."notification_suppressions" s on s."channel" = l."channel" and s."address" = lower(u.email);
  return claimed;
end;
$function$

declare

    order by v."available_at", v."created_at"

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.client_notes_reveal(ids uuid[])
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, diagnosis text, birth_date date)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  v_service boolean := coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin');
  v_read record;
begin
  if (select auth.uid()) is null and not v_service then
    raise exception 'only signed-in users and the service role reveal client_notes' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'APP_REVEAL_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  if coalesce(cardinality(client_notes_reveal.ids), 0) > 500 then
    raise exception 'reveal at most 500 rows of client_notes per call' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'APP_REVEAL_TOO_MANY';
  end if;
  for v_read in
    select t."organization_id" as tenant, jsonb_agg(t.id order by t.id) as ids
    from "public"."client_notes" t
    where t.id = any (client_notes_reveal.ids) and (v_service or ("organization_id" in (select better_supabase.member_organization_ids()) and (select better_supabase.session_active())))
    group by 1
  loop
    perform better_supabase.audit_event(
    event_type => 'client_notes.viewed',
    category => 'read',
    target_type => 'client_notes',
    record_id => case when jsonb_array_length(v_read.ids) = 1 then v_read.ids ->> 0 end,
    summary => 'Revealed ' || jsonb_array_length(v_read.ids)::text || ' ' || 'client_notes' || ' record(s)',
    tenant => (v_read.tenant)::uuid,
    metadata => jsonb_build_object('ids', v_read.ids, 'columns', '["diagnosis","birth_date"]'::jsonb)
  );
  end loop;
  return query
    with r as materialized (
      select t.id, 'tenant:' || (t."organization_id")::text as bsb_owner, t."diagnosis", t."birth_date"
      from "public"."client_notes" t
      where t.id = any (client_notes_reveal.ids) and (v_service or ("organization_id" in (select better_supabase.member_organization_ids()) and (select better_supabase.session_active())))
    ),
    k as materialized (
      select o.bsb_owner, "better_supabase"."field_key"(o.bsb_owner, false) as bsb_key
      from (select distinct r.bsb_owner from r) o
    )
    select r.id, ("better_supabase"."field_open"(k.bsb_key, r."diagnosis"))::text, ("better_supabase"."field_open"(k.bsb_key, r."birth_date"))::date
    from r join k on k.bsb_owner = r.bsb_owner;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.complete_push_receipts(receipts jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_count integer;
  v_events jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
begin
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin')) then
    raise exception 'only the service role reads push tickets' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'PUSH_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  if jsonb_typeof(complete_push_receipts.receipts) <> 'array' or jsonb_array_length(complete_push_receipts.receipts) > 1000 then
    raise exception 'pass at most 1000 receipts' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'PUSH_TOO_MANY';
  end if;
  -- The delivery's provider message id is Expo's first ticket id, so every
  -- receipt of the delivery records its event on that message, once per
  -- ticket. The events stored now come back for the client to emit.
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(e.recorded || jsonb_build_object('provider_event_id', e.event_id)), '[]'::jsonb)
  into v_events
  from (
    select "better_supabase"."record_delivery_event"(
      'expo',
      d."provider_message_id",
      case when r ->> 'status' = 'ok' then 'delivered' else 'bounced' end,
      'expo-receipt:' || (r ->> 'id'),
      now(),
      jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('token', x."token", 'error', r ->> 'error', 'message', r ->> 'message')),
      false
    ) as recorded, 'expo-receipt:' || (r ->> 'id') as event_id
    from "better_supabase"."push_tickets" x
    join "better_supabase"."notification_deliveries" d on d."id" = x."delivery_id"
    cross join jsonb_array_elements(complete_push_receipts.receipts) r
    where x."ticket_id" = r ->> 'id'
      and x."checked_at" is null
      and d."provider_message_id" is not null
  ) e
  where coalesce((e.recorded ->> 'recorded')::boolean, false);
  update "better_supabase"."push_tickets" x set
    "status" = case when r ->> 'status' = 'ok' then 'ok' else 'error' end,
    "error" = case when r ->> 'status' = 'ok' then null else coalesce(r ->> 'error', 'Unknown') end,
    "checked_at" = now()
  from jsonb_array_elements(complete_push_receipts.receipts) r
  where x."ticket_id" = r ->> 'id'
    and x."checked_at" is null;
  get diagnostics v_count = row_count;
  return jsonb_build_object('updated', v_count, 'events', v_events);
end;
$function$

select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'frameworkId', w."id", 'key', w."key", 'name', w."name", 'version', w."version",
    'total', coalesce(r.total, 0), 'passing', coalesce(r.passing, 0), 'failing', coalesce(r.failing, 0),
    'notStarted', coalesce(r.not_started, 0), 'notApplicable', coalesce(r.not_applicable, 0),
    'overdueTasks', (select count(*) from "better_supabase"."evidence_tasks" ot join "better_supabase"."controls" oc on oc."id" = ot."control_id" where oc."framework_id" = w."id" and (ot."active" and ot."due_on" < current_date))
  ) order by w."name"), '[]'::jsonb)
  from "better_supabase"."control_frameworks" w
  left join lateral (
    select count(*) as total,
      count(*) filter (where s.status = 'passing') as passing,
      count(*) filter (where s.status = 'failing') as failing,
      count(*) filter (where s.status = 'not_started') as not_started,
      count(*) filter (where s.status = 'not_applicable') as not_applicable
    from (select case
    when not y."applicable" then 'not_applicable'
    when exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."evidence_tasks" st where st."control_id" = y."id" and (st."active" and st."due_on" < current_date)) then 'failing'
    when exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."control_evidence" se where se."control_id" = y."id" and (se."valid_until" is null or se."valid_until" >= current_date)) then 'passing'
    when exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."control_evidence" se where se."control_id" = y."id") then 'failing'
    else 'not_started'
  end as status from "better_supabase"."controls" y where y."framework_id" = w."id") s
  ) r on true
  where w."tenant_id" = control_posture.tenant
    and (control_posture.framework_id is null or w."id" = control_posture.framework_id)

    when exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."evidence_tasks" st where st."control_id" = y."id" and (st."active" and st."due_on" < current_date)) then 'failing'
    when exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."control_evidence" se where se."control_id" = y."id" and (se."valid_until" is null or se."valid_until" >= current_date)) then 'passing'
    when exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."control_evidence" se where se."control_id" = y."id") then 'failing'
    else 'not_started'
  end as status from "better_supabase"."controls" y where y."framework_id" = w."id") s
  ) r on true
  where w."tenant_id" = control_posture.tenant
    and (control_posture.framework_id is null or w."id" = control_posture.framework_id)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.create_channel(tenant uuid, name text, attrs jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, members uuid[] DEFAULT '{}'::uuid[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_name text := lower(trim(create_channel.name));
  v_visibility text := coalesce(create_channel.attrs ->> 'visibility', 'public');
  v_conv jsonb;
  v_ch "better_supabase"."channels";
  v_c "better_supabase"."conversations";
begin
  if not (better_supabase.actor_may_write()) then
    raise exception 'This session is read-only' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'ACTOR_READ_ONLY';
  end if;
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_channel.tenant, 'channels.create'), false)) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to create channels here' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'CHANNELS_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  if v_name is null or v_name !~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,79}$' then
    raise exception 'a channel name is 1 to 80 lowercase letters, digits, - or _, starting with a letter or digit' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'CHANNELS_NAME_INVALID';
  end if;
  if v_visibility not in ('public', 'private') then
    raise exception 'a channel is public or private' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'CHANNELS_VISIBILITY_INVALID';
  end if;
  if (nullif(create_channel.attrs ->> 'subjectType', '') is null) <> (nullif(create_channel.attrs ->> 'subjectId', '') is null) then
    raise exception 'a linked record needs subjectType and subjectId' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'CHANNELS_SUBJECT_INVALID';
  end if;
  if nullif(create_channel.attrs ->> 'subjectType', '') is not null
    and not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or coalesce("better_supabase"."can_subject"(create_channel.attrs ->> 'subjectType', create_channel.attrs ->> 'subjectId', 'read'), false)) then
    raise exception 'no such record you can read' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'CHANNELS_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  if coalesce((case (create_channel.attrs ->> 'subjectType')
      when 'message' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."messages" s where s."id" = ((create_channel.attrs ->> 'subjectId'))::uuid)
      when 'conversation' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."conversations" s where s."id" = ((create_channel.attrs ->> 'subjectId'))::uuid)
      when 'channel' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."channels" s where s."id" = ((create_channel.attrs ->> 'subjectId'))::uuid)
      when 'company' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."companies" s where s."id" = ((create_channel.attrs ->> 'subjectId'))::uuid)
      when 'person' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."people" s where s."id" = ((create_channel.attrs ->> 'subjectId'))::uuid)
      when 'deal' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."deals" s where s."id" = ((create_channel.attrs ->> 'subjectId'))::uuid)
      when 'course' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."courses" s where s."id" = ((create_channel.attrs ->> 'subjectId'))::uuid)
      when 'post' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."posts" s where s."id" = ((create_channel.attrs ->> 'subjectId'))::uuid)
      when 'activity' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."activities" s where s."id" = ((create_channel.attrs ->> 'subjectId'))::uuid)
      when 'quote' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."quotes" s where s."id" = ((create_channel.attrs ->> 'subjectId'))::uuid)
      when 'work_item' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."work_items" s where s."id" = ((create_channel.attrs ->> 'subjectId'))::uuid)
      when 'employee' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."employees" s where s."id" = ((create_channel.attrs ->> 'subjectId'))::uuid)
      when 'invoice' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."invoices" s where s."id" = ((create_channel.attrs ->> 'subjectId'))::uuid)
      when 'ledger_account' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."ledger_accounts" s where s."id" = ((create_channel.attrs ->> 'subjectId'))::uuid)
      when 'product' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."products" s where s."id" = ((create_channel.attrs ->> 'subjectId'))::uuid)
      when 'product_variant' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."product_variants" s where s."id" = ((create_channel.attrs ->> 'subjectId'))::uuid)
      when 'order' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."orders" s where s."id" = ((create_channel.attrs ->> 'subjectId'))::uuid)
      when 'calendar_event' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."calendar_events" s where s."id" = ((create_channel.attrs ->> 'subjectId'))::uuid)
      when 'booking' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."bookings" s where s."id" = ((create_channel.attrs ->> 'subjectId'))::uuid)
