      when 'ledger_account' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."ledger_accounts" s where s."id" = (v_company_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_deal.tenant::text)
      when 'product' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."products" s where s."id" = (v_company_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_deal.tenant::text)
      when 'product_variant' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."product_variants" s where s."id" = (v_company_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_deal.tenant::text)
      when 'order' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."orders" s where s."id" = (v_company_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_deal.tenant::text)
      when 'calendar_event' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."calendar_events" s where s."id" = (v_company_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_deal.tenant::text)

      when 'shipment' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."shipments" s where s."id" = (v_company_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_deal.tenant::text)

  end;
  perform pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(pg_catalog.hashtextextended(create_deal.tenant::text || ':deal', 0));

  v_identifier := 'DEAL-' || v_seq::text;
  begin
    insert into "better_supabase"."deals" ("tenant_id", "number", "identifier", "name", "company_type", "company_id", "owner_user_id", "motion", "priority", "product", "seats", "amount", "existing_amount", "currency", "value_period", "pipeline_id", "stage_id", "probability", "forecast_category", "expected_close_on", "next_step", "next_at", "next_kind", "flags", "source", "note", "created_by")

      trim(create_deal.attrs ->> 'name'),

      (create_deal.attrs ->> 'stageId')::uuid,
      (create_deal.attrs ->> 'probability')::smallint,
      create_deal.attrs ->> 'forecast',
      (create_deal.attrs ->> 'closeOn')::date,
      create_deal.attrs ->> 'nextStep',

      create_deal.attrs ->> 'nextKind',

      create_deal.attrs ->> 'note',
      auth.uid())
    returning * into v_row;
  exception when check_violation or invalid_text_representation or datetime_field_overflow or numeric_value_out_of_range then
    raise exception 'a deal field has an invalid value' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'DEAL_ATTRS_INVALID';
  end;
  v_deal := v_row."id";
  if v_row."motion" is not null and not (v_row."motion" = any ('{new_logo,expansion,renewal}'::text[])) then
    raise exception 'unknown motion' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'DEAL_MOTION_INVALID';
  end if;
  if v_row."priority" is not null and not (v_row."priority" = any ('{hot,warm,cold}'::text[])) then
    raise exception 'unknown priority' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'DEAL_PRIORITY_INVALID';
  end if;
  if create_deal.contacts is not null then
    perform "better_supabase"."set_deal_contacts"(v_deal, create_deal.contacts);
  end if;
  perform "better_supabase".emit_event('deal.created', jsonb_build_object('organizationId', create_deal.tenant, 'dealId', v_deal, 'subjectType', 'deal', 'subjectId', v_deal::text, 'name', v_row."name"), 'deals/' || v_deal::text, (create_deal.tenant::text)::text, null, 'better-supabase/deals');
  declare
    v_hook regprocedure := to_regprocedure('"public"."after_deal_create"(uuid)');
  begin
    if v_hook is not null then
      execute format('select %s($1::uuid)', v_hook::oid::regproc)
        using v_deal;
    end if;
  end;
  return (select to_jsonb(x) || jsonb_build_object('number', x."number"::text, 'amount', x."amount"::text, 'existing_amount', x."existing_amount"::text, 'list_total', x."list_total"::text, 'discount_total', x."discount_total"::text, 'subtotal', x."subtotal"::text, 'tax_total', x."tax_total"::text, 'total', x."total"::text) || jsonb_build_object(
      'contacts', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('type', ck."contact_type", 'id', ck."contact_id", 'role', ck."role", 'primary', ck."is_primary") order by ck."is_primary" desc, ck."contact_id") from "better_supabase"."deal_contacts" ck where ck."deal_id" = x."id"), '[]'::jsonb),
      'members', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('userId', cm."user_id", 'role', cm."role") order by cm."user_id") from "better_supabase"."deal_members" cm where cm."deal_id" = x."id"), '[]'::jsonb)) from "better_supabase"."deals" x where x."id" = v_deal);
end;

  begin

    values (create_invoice.tenant, trim(create_invoice.attrs ->> 'title'),
      case when v_company_id is null then null else v_company_type end, v_company_id,
      case when v_contact_id is null then null else v_contact_type end, v_contact_id,

      'overdue', x."status" in ('issued', 'partially_paid') and x."due_on" < current_date,
      'lines', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('description', il."description", 'quantity', il."quantity", 'unitAmount', il."unit_amount"::text, 'discountBps', il."discount_bps", 'taxRateBps', il."tax_rate_bps", 'taxCode', il."tax_code") order by il."position") from "better_supabase"."invoice_lines" il where il."parent_id" = x."id"), '[]'::jsonb),
      'payments', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', y."id", 'amount', (-e."amount")::text, 'paidAt', y."effective_at", 'method', y."metadata" ->> 'method', 'reference', y."metadata" ->> 'reference', 'note', y."metadata" ->> 'note', 'recordedBy', y."actor_id") order by y."effective_at", y."created_at")
        from "better_supabase"."ledger_entries" e join "better_supabase"."ledger_transactions" y on y."id" = e."transaction_id"
        where e."account_id" = (select a."id" from "better_supabase"."ledger_accounts" a where a."tenant_id" = x."tenant_id" and a."code" = 'invoice:' || x."id"::text)), '[]'::jsonb)) from "better_supabase"."invoices" x where x."id" = v_row."id");
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.create_knowledge_document(tenant uuid, title text, scope text DEFAULT 'user'::text, scope_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, file_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, source text DEFAULT NULL::text, metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, owner uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, collection_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, subject_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, subject_id text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_owner uuid := case when coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') then create_knowledge_document.owner else auth.uid() end;
  v_scope_id uuid := create_knowledge_document.scope_id;
  v_row "better_supabase"."knowledge_documents"%rowtype;
begin
  if not (better_supabase.actor_may_write()) then
    raise exception 'This session is read-only' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'ACTOR_READ_ONLY';
  end if;
  if not coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') and (auth.uid() is null or create_knowledge_document.tenant is null or not coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_knowledge_document.tenant, 'knowledge.write'), false)) then
    raise exception 'you may not add knowledge here' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'KNOWLEDGE_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  if create_knowledge_document.tenant is null then
    v_owner := null;
  end if;
  if create_knowledge_document.collection_id is not null and not exists (
    select 1 from "better_supabase"."knowledge_collections" kc
    where kc."id" = create_knowledge_document.collection_id
      and (kc."organization_id" is null or kc."organization_id" = create_knowledge_document.tenant)
      and "better_supabase"."knowledge_collection_readable"(kc."id")
  ) then
    raise exception 'collection % not found', create_knowledge_document.collection_id using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'KNOWLEDGE_COLLECTION_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  if create_knowledge_document.scope in ('organization', 'agent') and not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_knowledge_document.tenant, 'knowledge.manage'), false)) then
    raise exception 'only admins add % knowledge', create_knowledge_document.scope using errcode = '42501', hint = 'KNOWLEDGE_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  if create_knowledge_document.scope = 'user' then
    v_scope_id := coalesce(v_scope_id, v_owner);
    if v_scope_id is null or v_scope_id is distinct from v_owner then
      raise exception 'user knowledge belongs to its owner' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'KNOWLEDGE_SCOPE';
    end if;
  end if;
  if create_knowledge_document.scope is null
    or create_knowledge_document.scope not in ('organization', 'agent', 'project', 'chat', 'user', 'subject')
    or (create_knowledge_document.scope in ('organization', 'subject')) <> (v_scope_id is null) then
    raise exception '% knowledge needs %', create_knowledge_document.scope, case when create_knowledge_document.scope in ('organization', 'subject') then 'no scope_id' else 'a scope_id' end using errcode = '22023', hint = 'KNOWLEDGE_SCOPE';
  end if;
  if (create_knowledge_document.scope = 'subject') <> (create_knowledge_document.subject_type is not null and create_knowledge_document.subject_id is not null)
    or (create_knowledge_document.scope <> 'subject' and (create_knowledge_document.subject_type is not null or create_knowledge_document.subject_id is not null)) then
    raise exception 'subject knowledge needs subject_type and subject_id, and other scopes neither' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'KNOWLEDGE_DOCUMENT_INVALID';
  end if;
  if create_knowledge_document.scope = 'subject' and not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or case create_knowledge_document.subject_type
    when 'message' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."messages" s where s."id" = (create_knowledge_document.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_knowledge_document.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_knowledge_document.tenant, 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'conversation' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."conversations" s where s."id" = (create_knowledge_document.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_knowledge_document.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_knowledge_document.tenant, 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'channel' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."channels" s where s."id" = (create_knowledge_document.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_knowledge_document.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_knowledge_document.tenant, 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'company' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."companies" s where s."id" = (create_knowledge_document.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_knowledge_document.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_knowledge_document.tenant, 'contacts.read'), false)
    when 'person' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."people" s where s."id" = (create_knowledge_document.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_knowledge_document.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_knowledge_document.tenant, 'contacts.read'), false)
    when 'deal' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."deals" s where s."id" = (create_knowledge_document.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_knowledge_document.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_knowledge_document.tenant, 'deals.read'), false)
    when 'course' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."courses" s where s."id" = (create_knowledge_document.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_knowledge_document.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_knowledge_document.tenant, 'courses.read'), false)
    when 'post' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."posts" s where s."id" = (create_knowledge_document.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_knowledge_document.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_knowledge_document.tenant, 'posts.read'), false)
    when 'activity' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."activities" s where s."id" = (create_knowledge_document.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_knowledge_document.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_knowledge_document.tenant, 'activities.read'), false)
    when 'quote' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."quotes" s where s."id" = (create_knowledge_document.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_knowledge_document.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_knowledge_document.tenant, 'quotes.read'), false)
    when 'work_item' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_items" s where s."id" = (create_knowledge_document.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_knowledge_document.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_knowledge_document.tenant, 'tasks.read'), false)
    when 'employee' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."employees" s where s."id" = (create_knowledge_document.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_knowledge_document.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_knowledge_document.tenant, 'employees.read'), false)
    when 'invoice' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."invoices" s where s."id" = (create_knowledge_document.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_knowledge_document.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_knowledge_document.tenant, 'invoices.read'), false)
    when 'ledger_account' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."ledger_accounts" s where s."id" = (create_knowledge_document.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_knowledge_document.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_knowledge_document.tenant, 'ledger.read'), false)
    when 'product' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."products" s where s."id" = (create_knowledge_document.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_knowledge_document.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_knowledge_document.tenant, 'catalog.read'), false)

    when 'incident' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."incidents" s where s."id" = (create_knowledge_document.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_knowledge_document.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_knowledge_document.tenant, 'incidents.read'), false)
    when 'content_entry' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."content_entries" s where s."id" = (create_knowledge_document.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_knowledge_document.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_knowledge_document.tenant, 'content.read'), false)
    when 'document' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."documents" s where s."id" = (create_knowledge_document.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_knowledge_document.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_knowledge_document.tenant, 'documents.read'), false)
    when 'customer' then exists (select 1 from "public"."customers" s where s."id" = (create_knowledge_document.subject_id)::uuid and s."organization_id" = create_knowledge_document.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_knowledge_document.tenant, 'customers.read'), false)
    when 'drive_node' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" s where s."id" = (create_knowledge_document.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_knowledge_document.tenant and (coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_knowledge_document.tenant, 'drive.read'), false) and coalesce("better_supabase"."drive_node_readable"(s."id"), false)))
    when 'application' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."applications" s where s."id" = (create_knowledge_document.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_knowledge_document.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_knowledge_document.tenant, 'hiring.read'), false)
    when 'change_request' then exists (select 1 from "public"."change_requests" s where s."id" = (create_knowledge_document.subject_id)::uuid and s."organization_id" = create_knowledge_document.tenant)

    when 'task' then exists (select 1 from "public"."tasks" s where s."id" = (create_knowledge_document.subject_id)::uuid and s."organization_id" = create_knowledge_document.tenant)
    else false
  end) then
    raise exception 'record %:% not found', create_knowledge_document.subject_type, create_knowledge_document.subject_id using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'KNOWLEDGE_DOCUMENT_SUBJECT_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  if create_knowledge_document.scope = 'chat' and not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or (v_scope_id is not null and "better_supabase"."ai_chat_can_read"(v_scope_id))) then
    raise exception 'chat % not found', v_scope_id using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'AI_CHAT_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  if file_id is not null and not exists (
    select 1 from "better_supabase"."ai_files" x
    where x."id" = create_knowledge_document.file_id
      and x."organization_id" = create_knowledge_document.tenant
      and x."status" = 'ready'
      and (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or x."owner_id" = auth.uid() or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_knowledge_document.tenant, 'knowledge.manage'), false))
  ) then
    raise exception 'file % not found', file_id using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'AI_FILE_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  insert into "better_supabase"."knowledge_documents" ("organization_id", "owner_id", "scope", "scope_id", "file_id", "title", "collection_id", "source", "metadata", "subject_type", "subject_id")
  values (create_knowledge_document.tenant, v_owner, create_knowledge_document.scope, v_scope_id, create_knowledge_document.file_id, create_knowledge_document.title, create_knowledge_document.collection_id, create_knowledge_document.source, coalesce(create_knowledge_document.metadata, '{}'), create_knowledge_document.subject_type, create_knowledge_document.subject_id)
  returning * into v_row;
  return jsonb_build_object('id', v_row."id", 'organization_id', v_row."organization_id", 'owner_id', v_row."owner_id", 'scope', v_row."scope", 'scope_id', v_row."scope_id", 'file_id', v_row."file_id", 'title', v_row."title", 'source', v_row."source", 'metadata', v_row."metadata", 'status', v_row."status", 'error', v_row."error", 'chunk_count', v_row."chunk_count", 'embedding_model', v_row."embedding_model", 'collection_id', v_row."collection_id", 'subject_type', v_row."subject_type", 'subject_id', v_row."subject_id", 'created_at', v_row."created_at", 'updated_at', v_row."updated_at");
end;

functions.identity_argument_types: tenant uuid, title text, scope text, scope_id uuid, file_id uuid, source text, metadata jsonb, owner uuid, collection_id uuid, subject_type text, subject_id text

functions.name: create_lease
functions.definition:
#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  v_row "better_supabase"."leases"%rowtype;
  v_unit text;
begin
  if not (better_supabase.actor_may_write()) then
    raise exception 'This session is read-only' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'ACTOR_READ_ONLY';
  end if;
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_lease.tenant, 'leases.manage'), false)) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to manage leases' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'LEASES_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  select u."name" into v_unit from "better_supabase"."assets" u
    where u."id" = create_lease.unit_id and u."tenant_id" = create_lease.tenant and u."retired_at" is null;
  if not found then
    raise exception 'the unit is unknown, retired or not in this organization' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'LEASE_UNIT_INVALID';
  end if;
  if create_lease.party_type is null or create_lease.party_id is null
    or not (case create_lease.party_type
      when 'message' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."messages" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'conversation' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."conversations" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'channel' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."channels" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'company' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."companies" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'person' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."people" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'deal' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."deals" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'course' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."courses" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'post' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."posts" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'activity' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."activities" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'quote' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."quotes" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'work_item' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_items" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'employee' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."employees" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'invoice' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."invoices" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'ledger_account' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."ledger_accounts" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'product' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."products" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'product_variant' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."product_variants" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'order' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."orders" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'calendar_event' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."calendar_events" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'booking' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."bookings" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'asset' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."assets" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'asset_location' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."asset_locations" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'lease' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."leases" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'expense_report' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."expense_reports" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'expense_line' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."expense_lines" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'donation_fund' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."donation_funds" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'work_order' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_orders" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'shipment' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."shipments" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'contract' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."contracts" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'control' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."controls" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'compliance_policy' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."compliance_policies" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'qualification_type' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."qualification_types" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'risk' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."risks" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'case' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."cases" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'inspection' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."inspections" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'inspection_program' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."inspection_programs" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'inspection_finding' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."inspection_findings" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'form' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."forms" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'production_order' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."production_orders" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'work_center' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_centers" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'care_plan' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."care_plans" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'incident' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."incidents" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'content_entry' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."content_entries" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'document' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."documents" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'customer' then exists (select 1 from "public"."customers" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."organization_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'drive_node' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'application' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."applications" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'change_request' then exists (select 1 from "public"."change_requests" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."organization_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'project' then exists (select 1 from "public"."projects" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."organization_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      when 'task' then exists (select 1 from "public"."tasks" s where s."id" = (create_lease.party_id)::uuid and s."organization_id"::text = create_lease.tenant::text)
      else false
    end and "better_supabase"."can_subject"(create_lease.party_type, create_lease.party_id, 'read')) then
    raise exception 'the party is unknown or not in this organization' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'LEASE_PARTY_INVALID';
  end if;
  if create_lease.starts_on is null then
    raise exception 'a lease needs starts_on' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'LEASE_TERMS_INVALID';
  end if;
  if create_lease.ends_on is not null and create_lease.ends_on <= create_lease.starts_on then
    raise exception 'ends_on must be after starts_on' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'LEASE_TERMS_INVALID';
  end if;
  if create_lease.rent is null or create_lease.rent <= 0 then
    raise exception 'rent is more than zero minor units' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'LEASE_TERMS_INVALID';
  end if;
  if create_lease.currency is null or create_lease.currency !~ '^[A-Z]{3}$' then
    raise exception 'currency must be a three-letter currency code' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'LEASE_TERMS_INVALID';
  end if;
  if coalesce(create_lease.frequency, 'monthly') not in ('weekly', 'monthly', 'quarterly', 'yearly') then
    raise exception 'frequency is weekly, monthly, quarterly or yearly' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'LEASE_TERMS_INVALID';
  end if;
  if coalesce(create_lease.deposit, 0) < 0 then
    raise exception 'a deposit is zero or more minor units' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'LEASE_TERMS_INVALID';
  end if;
  insert into "better_supabase"."leases" ("tenant_id", "unit_id", "party_type", "party_id", "title", "starts_on", "ends_on",

    when 'work_center' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_centers" s where s."id" = (create_share_link.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_share_link.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_share_link.tenant, 'manufacturing.read'), false)
    when 'care_plan' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."care_plans" s where s."id" = (create_share_link.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_share_link.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_share_link.tenant, 'care_plans.read'), false)
    when 'incident' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."incidents" s where s."id" = (create_share_link.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_share_link.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_share_link.tenant, 'incidents.read'), false)
    when 'content_entry' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."content_entries" s where s."id" = (create_share_link.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_share_link.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_share_link.tenant, 'content.read'), false)
    when 'document' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."documents" s where s."id" = (create_share_link.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_share_link.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_share_link.tenant, 'documents.read'), false)
    when 'customer' then exists (select 1 from "public"."customers" s where s."id" = (create_share_link.subject_id)::uuid and s."organization_id" = create_share_link.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_share_link.tenant, 'customers.read'), false)
    when 'application' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."applications" s where s."id" = (create_share_link.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_share_link.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_share_link.tenant, 'hiring.read'), false)
    when 'change_request' then exists (select 1 from "public"."change_requests" s where s."id" = (create_share_link.subject_id)::uuid and s."organization_id" = create_share_link.tenant)
    when 'project' then exists (select 1 from "public"."projects" s where s."id" = (create_share_link.subject_id)::uuid and s."organization_id" = create_share_link.tenant)
    when 'task' then exists (select 1 from "public"."tasks" s where s."id" = (create_share_link.subject_id)::uuid and s."organization_id" = create_share_link.tenant)
    else null
  end
  end;
    if v_subject_ok is null then
      raise exception 'this subject type can''t be shared' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'SHARE_SUBJECT_UNKNOWN';
    end if;
    if not v_subject_ok then
      raise exception 'the subject does not exist in this organization' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'SHARE_SUBJECT_NOT_FOUND';
    end if;
  end if;
  if create_share_link.version_id is not null then
    declare
      v_version jsonb := "better_supabase"."get_version"(create_share_link.version_id);
    begin
      if v_version ->> 'subjectType' is distinct from create_share_link.subject_type
        or v_version ->> 'subjectId' is distinct from create_share_link.subject_id then
        raise exception 'the version belongs to another subject' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'SHARE_VERSION_INVALID';
      end if;
    end;
  end if;
  if create_share_link.subject_type in ('calendar') then
    update "better_supabase"."share_links" x set "revoked_at" = now()
    where x."tenant_id" = create_share_link.tenant and x."subject_type" = create_share_link.subject_type
      and x."subject_id" = create_share_link.subject_id and x."created_by" is not distinct from auth.uid() and x."revoked_at" is null;
  end if;
  if create_share_link.password is not null then
    v_password_hash := extensions.crypt(create_share_link.password, extensions.gen_salt('bf'));
  end if;
  insert into "better_supabase"."share_links" ("tenant_id", "subject_type", "subject_id", "token_hash", "role", "expires_at", "max_uses", "created_by", "version_id", "password_hash", "download_allowed")
  values (create_share_link.tenant, create_share_link.subject_type, create_share_link.subject_id, encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(v_token, 'utf8'), 'sha256'), 'hex'), coalesce(create_share_link.role, 'view'), create_share_link.expires_at, create_share_link.max_uses, auth.uid(), create_share_link.version_id, v_password_hash, coalesce(create_share_link.download_allowed, true))
  returning "id" into v_id;
  perform "better_supabase".emit_event('share_link.created', jsonb_build_object('organizationId', create_share_link.tenant, 'id', v_id, 'subjectType', create_share_link.subject_type, 'subjectId', create_share_link.subject_id), 'share-links/' || v_id::text, (create_share_link.tenant)::text, null, 'better-supabase/share-links');
  return jsonb_build_object('id', v_id, 'token', v_token);
end;

functions.name: create_shipment
functions.definition:
#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  v_ship "better_supabase"."shipments"%rowtype;
begin
  if not (better_supabase.actor_may_write()) then
    raise exception 'This session is read-only' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'ACTOR_READ_ONLY';
  end if;
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_shipment.tenant, 'shipments.manage'), false)) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to manage shipments' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'SHIPMENT_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  if not coalesce((jsonb_typeof(create_shipment.from_address) = 'object' and coalesce(create_shipment.from_address ->> 'country', '') ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$' and length(btrim(coalesce(create_shipment.from_address ->> 'line1', ''))) >= 1 and length(btrim(coalesce(create_shipment.from_address ->> 'city', ''))) >= 1 and length(create_shipment.from_address::text) <= 4000) and (jsonb_typeof(create_shipment.to_address) = 'object' and coalesce(create_shipment.to_address ->> 'country', '') ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$' and length(btrim(coalesce(create_shipment.to_address ->> 'line1', ''))) >= 1 and length(btrim(coalesce(create_shipment.to_address ->> 'city', ''))) >= 1 and length(create_shipment.to_address::text) <= 4000), false) then
    raise exception 'each address needs line1, city and a two-letter country' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'SHIPMENT_ADDRESS_INVALID';
  end if;
  if jsonb_typeof(create_shipment.packages) is distinct from 'array'
    or jsonb_array_length(create_shipment.packages) < 1
    or jsonb_array_length(create_shipment.packages) > 50 then
    raise exception 'a shipment holds 1 to 50 packages' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'SHIPMENT_EMPTY';
  end if;
  if (create_shipment.subject_type is null) <> (create_shipment.subject_id is null) then
    raise exception 'pass both subject_type and subject_id, or neither' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'SHIPMENT_SUBJECT_INVALID';
  end if;
  if create_shipment.subject_type is not null
    and (case create_shipment.subject_type
      when 'message' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."messages" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'conversation' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."conversations" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'channel' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."channels" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'company' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."companies" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'person' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."people" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'deal' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."deals" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'course' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."courses" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'post' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."posts" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'activity' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."activities" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'quote' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."quotes" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'work_item' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."work_items" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'employee' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."employees" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'invoice' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."invoices" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'ledger_account' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."ledger_accounts" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'product' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."products" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'product_variant' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."product_variants" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'order' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."orders" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'calendar_event' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."calendar_events" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'booking' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."bookings" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'asset' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."assets" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'asset_location' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."asset_locations" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'lease' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."leases" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'expense_report' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."expense_reports" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'expense_line' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."expense_lines" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'donation_fund' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."donation_funds" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'work_order' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."work_orders" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'shipment' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."shipments" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'contract' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."contracts" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'control' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."controls" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'compliance_policy' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."compliance_policies" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'qualification_type' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."qualification_types" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'risk' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."risks" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'case' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."cases" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'inspection' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."inspections" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'inspection_program' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."inspection_programs" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'inspection_finding' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."inspection_findings" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'form' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."forms" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'production_order' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."production_orders" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'work_center' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."work_centers" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'care_plan' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."care_plans" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'incident' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."incidents" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'content_entry' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."content_entries" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'document' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."documents" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'customer' then (select s."organization_id"::text from "public"."customers" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'drive_node' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'application' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."applications" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'change_request' then (select s."organization_id"::text from "public"."change_requests" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'project' then (select s."organization_id"::text from "public"."projects" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'task' then (select s."organization_id"::text from "public"."tasks" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      else null::text
    end) is distinct from create_shipment.tenant::text then
    raise exception 'the record does not exist in this organization' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'SHIPMENT_SUBJECT_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  if create_shipment.from_location_id is not null and not exists (
    select 1 from "better_supabase"."asset_locations" l
    where l."id" = create_shipment.from_location_id and l."tenant_id" = create_shipment.tenant
  ) then
    raise exception 'the location does not exist in this organization' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'SHIPMENT_LOCATION_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  begin
    insert into "better_supabase"."shipments" ("tenant_id", "reference", "from_address", "to_address", "from_location_id", "subject_type", "subject_id", "created_by")
    values (create_shipment.tenant,
      coalesce(nullif(btrim(create_shipment.reference), ''), 'SHP-' || upper(substr(md5(gen_random_uuid()::text), 1, 10))),
      create_shipment.from_address, create_shipment.to_address, create_shipment.from_location_id,
      create_shipment.subject_type, create_shipment.subject_id, auth.uid())
    returning * into v_ship;
  exception when check_violation then
    raise exception 'a shipment reference has 1 to 100 characters' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'SHIPMENT_INVALID';
  end;
  begin
    insert into "better_supabase"."shipment_packages" ("tenant_id", "shipment_id", "position", "weight_grams", "length_mm", "width_mm", "height_mm", "reference")
    select v_ship."tenant_id", v_ship."id", k.position,
      (k.item ->> 'weightGrams')::integer, (k.item ->> 'lengthMm')::integer, (k.item ->> 'widthMm')::integer, (k.item ->> 'heightMm')::integer,
      nullif(k.item ->> 'reference', '')
    from jsonb_array_elements(create_shipment.packages) with ordinality as k(item, position);
  exception when check_violation or not_null_violation or invalid_text_representation or numeric_value_out_of_range then

 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  v_ship "better_supabase"."shipments"%rowtype;
begin
  if not (better_supabase.actor_may_write()) then
    raise exception 'This session is read-only' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'ACTOR_READ_ONLY';
  end if;
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_shipment.tenant, 'shipments.manage'), false)) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to manage shipments' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'SHIPMENT_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  if not coalesce((jsonb_typeof(create_shipment.from_address) = 'object' and coalesce(create_shipment.from_address ->> 'country', '') ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$' and length(btrim(coalesce(create_shipment.from_address ->> 'line1', ''))) >= 1 and length(btrim(coalesce(create_shipment.from_address ->> 'city', ''))) >= 1 and length(create_shipment.from_address::text) <= 4000) and (jsonb_typeof(create_shipment.to_address) = 'object' and coalesce(create_shipment.to_address ->> 'country', '') ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$' and length(btrim(coalesce(create_shipment.to_address ->> 'line1', ''))) >= 1 and length(btrim(coalesce(create_shipment.to_address ->> 'city', ''))) >= 1 and length(create_shipment.to_address::text) <= 4000), false) then
    raise exception 'each address needs line1, city and a two-letter country' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'SHIPMENT_ADDRESS_INVALID';
  end if;
  if jsonb_typeof(create_shipment.packages) is distinct from 'array'
    or jsonb_array_length(create_shipment.packages) < 1
    or jsonb_array_length(create_shipment.packages) > 50 then
    raise exception 'a shipment holds 1 to 50 packages' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'SHIPMENT_EMPTY';
  end if;
  if (create_shipment.subject_type is null) <> (create_shipment.subject_id is null) then
    raise exception 'pass both subject_type and subject_id, or neither' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'SHIPMENT_SUBJECT_INVALID';
  end if;

      when 'course' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."courses" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'post' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."posts" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'activity' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."activities" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'quote' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."quotes" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'work_item' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."work_items" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'employee' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."employees" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'invoice' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."invoices" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'ledger_account' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."ledger_accounts" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'product' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."products" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'product_variant' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."product_variants" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'order' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."orders" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'calendar_event' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."calendar_events" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'booking' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."bookings" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'asset' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."assets" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'asset_location' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."asset_locations" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)

      when 'risk' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."risks" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'case' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."cases" s where s."id" = (create_shipment.subject_id)::uuid)

  begin
    insert into "better_supabase"."shipments" ("tenant_id", "reference", "from_address", "to_address", "from_location_id", "subject_type", "subject_id", "created_by")
    values (create_shipment.tenant,

  end if;

  values (create_signature_request.tenant, create_signature_request.subject_type, create_signature_request.subject_id, v_version, v_hash, create_signature_request.signers, create_signature_request.sign_order, create_signature_request.approval_request_id, nullif(trim(create_signature_request.message), ''), create_signature_request.meaning, auth.uid())
  returning * into v_row;
  perform "better_supabase".emit_event('signature_request.requested', jsonb_build_object('organizationId', v_row."tenant_id", 'subjectType', v_row."subject_type", 'subjectId', v_row."subject_id", 'id', v_row."id", 'versionId', v_row."version_id"), 'signature-requests/' || v_row."id"::text, (v_row."tenant_id")::text, null, 'better-supabase/signatures');
  perform better_supabase.audit_event(
    event_type => 'signature_request.requested',
    category => 'data',
    target_type => 'signature_request',
    record_id => v_row."id"::text,
    summary => 'requested signatures on ' || v_row."subject_type" || ' ' || v_row."subject_id",
    tenant => (v_row."tenant_id")::uuid,
    metadata => jsonb_build_object('organizationId', v_row."tenant_id", 'subjectType', v_row."subject_type", 'subjectId', v_row."subject_id", 'id', v_row."id", 'versionId', v_row."version_id")
  );
  declare
    v_hook regprocedure := to_regprocedure('"public"."after_signature_request"(uuid)');
  begin
    if v_hook is not null then
      execute format('select %s($1::uuid)', v_hook::oid::regproc)
        using v_row."id";
    end if;
  end;
  return jsonb_build_object('id', v_row."id", 'organizationId', v_row."tenant_id", 'subjectType', v_row."subject_type", 'subjectId', v_row."subject_id", 'versionId', v_row."version_id", 'contentHash', v_row."content_hash", 'signers', to_jsonb(v_row."signers"), 'order', v_row."sign_order", 'status', v_row."status", 'approvalRequestId', v_row."approval_request_id", 'message', v_row."message", 'meaning', v_row."meaning", 'requestedBy', v_row."requested_by", 'createdAt', v_row."created_at", 'completedAt', v_row."completed_at");
end;

    when 'production_order' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."production_orders" s where s."id" = (create_signature_request.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_signature_request.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_signature_request.tenant, 'manufacturing.read'), false)
    when 'work_center' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_centers" s where s."id" = (create_signature_request.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_signature_request.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_signature_request.tenant, 'manufacturing.read'), false)
    when 'care_plan' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."care_plans" s where s."id" = (create_signature_request.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_signature_request.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_signature_request.tenant, 'care_plans.read'), false)
    when 'incident' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."incidents" s where s."id" = (create_signature_request.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_signature_request.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_signature_request.tenant, 'incidents.read'), false)
    when 'content_entry' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."content_entries" s where s."id" = (create_signature_request.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_signature_request.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_signature_request.tenant, 'content.read'), false)
    when 'document' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."documents" s where s."id" = (create_signature_request.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_signature_request.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_signature_request.tenant, 'documents.read'), false)
    when 'customer' then exists (select 1 from "public"."customers" s where s."id" = (create_signature_request.subject_id)::uuid and s."organization_id" = create_signature_request.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_signature_request.tenant, 'customers.read'), false)
    when 'drive_node' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" s where s."id" = (create_signature_request.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_signature_request.tenant and (coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_signature_request.tenant, 'drive.read'), false) and coalesce("better_supabase"."drive_node_readable"(s."id"), false)))
    when 'application' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."applications" s where s."id" = (create_signature_request.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = create_signature_request.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', create_signature_request.tenant, 'hiring.read'), false)
    when 'change_request' then exists (select 1 from "public"."change_requests" s where s."id" = (create_signature_request.subject_id)::uuid and s."organization_id" = create_signature_request.tenant)
    when 'project' then exists (select 1 from "public"."projects" s where s."id" = (create_signature_request.subject_id)::uuid and s."organization_id" = create_signature_request.tenant)
    when 'task' then exists (select 1 from "public"."tasks" s where s."id" = (create_signature_request.subject_id)::uuid and s."organization_id" = create_signature_request.tenant)
    else false
  end)) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to request signatures on this record' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'SIGNATURE_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  if create_signature_request.meaning is not null and create_signature_request.meaning not in ('authored', 'reviewed', 'approved', 'released', 'acknowledged', 'agreed') then
    raise exception 'meaning must be one of authored, reviewed, approved, released, acknowledged, agreed' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'SIGNATURE_REQUEST_MEANING_UNKNOWN';
  end if;
  if create_signature_request.sign_order not in ('parallel', 'sequential') then
    raise exception 'sign_order must be parallel or sequential' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'SIGNATURE_ORDER_INVALID';
  end if;
  if coalesce(cardinality(create_signature_request.signers), 0) not between 1 and 20
    or array_position(create_signature_request.signers, null) is not null
    or (select count(distinct x) from unnest(create_signature_request.signers) x) <> cardinality(create_signature_request.signers) then
    raise exception 'name between 1 and 20 different signers' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'SIGNATURE_SIGNERS_INVALID';
  end if;
  if exists (
    select 1 from unnest(create_signature_request.signers) x
    where not exists (
      select 1 from "public"."memberships" m
      where m."organization_id" = create_signature_request.tenant and m."user_id" = x
    )
  ) then
    raise exception 'every signer must be a member of the organization' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'SIGNATURE_SIGNERS_INVALID';
  end if;
  if create_signature_request.approval_request_id is not null and not exists (
    select 1 from "better_supabase"."approval_requests" a
    where a."id" = create_signature_request.approval_request_id
      and a."tenant_id" = create_signature_request.tenant
      and a."subject_type" = create_signature_request.subject_type
      and a."subject_id" = create_signature_request.subject_id
  ) then
    raise exception 'the approval request isn''t for this record' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'SIGNATURE_APPROVAL_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  if v_version is null then
    v_version := ("better_supabase"."snapshot_version"(create_signature_request.tenant, create_signature_request.subject_type, create_signature_request.subject_id) ->> 'id')::uuid;
  end if;
  select x."content_hash" into v_hash
    from "better_supabase"."versions" x
    where x."id" = v_version
      and x."tenant_id" = create_signature_request.tenant
      and x."subject_type" = create_signature_request.subject_type
      and x."subject_id" = create_signature_request.subject_id;
  if v_hash is null then
    raise exception 'the version isn''t a version of this record' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'SIGNATURE_VERSION_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  declare
    v_hook regprocedure := to_regprocedure('"public"."before_signature_request"(uuid, text, text, uuid)');
  begin
    if v_hook is not null then
      execute format('select %s($1::uuid, $2::text, $3::text, $4::uuid)', v_hook::oid::regproc)
        using create_signature_request.tenant, create_signature_request.subject_type, create_signature_request.subject_id, v_version;
    end if;
  end;
  update "better_supabase"."versions" x set "frozen" = true where x."id" = v_version and not x."frozen";
  insert into "better_supabase"."signature_requests" ("tenant_id", "subject_type", "subject_id", "version_id", "content_hash", "signers", "sign_order", "approval_request_id", "message", "meaning", "requested_by")
  values (create_signature_request.tenant, create_signature_request.subject_type, create_signature_request.subject_id, v_version, v_hash, create_signature_request.signers, create_signature_request.sign_order, create_signature_request.approval_request_id, nullif(trim(create_signature_request.message), ''), create_signature_request.meaning, auth.uid())
  returning * into v_row;
  perform "better_supabase".emit_event('signature_request.requested', jsonb_build_object('organizationId', v_row."tenant_id", 'subjectType', v_row."subject_type", 'subjectId', v_row."subject_id", 'id', v_row."id", 'versionId', v_row."version_id"), 'signature-requests/' || v_row."id"::text, (v_row."tenant_id")::text, null, 'better-supabase/signatures');
  perform better_supabase.audit_event(
    event_type => 'signature_request.requested',
    category => 'data',
    target_type => 'signature_request',
    record_id => v_row."id"::text,
    summary => 'requested signatures on ' || v_row."subject_type" || ' ' || v_row."subject_id",
    tenant => (v_row."tenant_id")::uuid,
    metadata => jsonb_build_object('organizationId', v_row."tenant_id", 'subjectType', v_row."subject_type", 'subjectId', v_row."subject_id", 'id', v_row."id", 'versionId', v_row."version_id")
  );
  declare
    v_hook regprocedure := to_regprocedure('"public"."after_signature_request"(uuid)');
  begin
    if v_hook is not null then
      execute format('select %s($1::uuid)', v_hook::oid::regproc)
        using v_row."id";
    end if;
  end;
  return jsonb_build_object('id', v_row."id", 'organizationId', v_row."tenant_id", 'subjectType', v_row."subject_type", 'subjectId', v_row."subject_id", 'versionId', v_row."version_id", 'contentHash', v_row."content_hash", 'signers', to_jsonb(v_row."signers"), 'order', v_row."sign_order", 'status', v_row."status", 'approvalRequestId', v_row."approval_request_id", 'message', v_row."message", 'meaning', v_row."meaning", 'requestedBy', v_row."requested_by", 'createdAt', v_row."created_at", 'completedAt', v_row."completed_at");
end;
$function$

functions.name: create_workflow_schedule
functions.definition:
#variable_conflict use_variable
declare
  v_row "better_supabase"."workflow_schedules"%rowtype;
begin
  if not (better_supabase.actor_may_write()) then
    raise exception 'This session is read-only' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'ACTOR_READ_ONLY';
  end if;
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or (tenant is not null and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', tenant, 'workflows.manage'), false))) then
    raise exception 'You may not schedule workflows here' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'WORKFLOW_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  insert into "better_supabase"."workflow_schedules" as x ("tenant_id", "name", "workflow", "input", "cron", "timezone", "next_run_at", "created_by")
  values (tenant, name, workflow, coalesce(payload -> 'input', '[]'::jsonb), cron, coalesce(timezone, 'UTC'), next_run, (select auth.uid()))
  on conflict on constraint workflow_schedules_tenant_name_key do update set
    "workflow" = excluded."workflow",
    "input" = excluded."input",
    "cron" = excluded."cron",
    "timezone" = excluded."timezone",
    "next_run_at" = excluded."next_run_at",
    "locked_until" = null
  returning * into v_row;
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'id', v_row."id",
    'tenant', v_row."tenant_id",
    'name', v_row."name",
    'workflow', v_row."workflow",
    'input', v_row."input",
    'cron', v_row."cron",
    'timezone', v_row."timezone",
    'nextRunAt', v_row."next_run_at",
    'lastRunAt', v_row."last_run_at",
    'paused', v_row."paused",
    'createdBy', v_row."created_by",
    'createdAt', v_row."created_at"
  );
end;

-- Files sit under <export id>/, so the primary key finds the one export.
  select exists (
    select 1 from "better_supabase"."data_exports" x
    where x."id" = case when split_part(path, '/', 1) ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' then split_part(path, '/', 1)::uuid end
      and x."bucket" = 'data-exports'
      and x."status" = 'ready'
      and (x."expires_at" is null or x."expires_at" > now())
      and path = any (x."files")
      and (x."requested_by" = auth.uid() or (x."organization_id" is not null and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', x."organization_id", 'data_lifecycle.export'), false)))
  )

functions.name: data_lifecycle_tables
functions.definition:
select t.subject, t.name, t.tbl, t.col, t.purge,
    t.omit || array(
      select a.attname::text
      from pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
      where a.attrelid = to_regclass(t.tbl)
        and a.attnum > 0
        and not a.attisdropped
        and a.attname ~* 'token|secret|_hash|password|api_key|license_key'
        and a.attname <> t.col
        and not a.attname = any(t.omit)
      order by a.attnum
    ) as omit,
    t.exported
  from (
  select * from (values
    ('user', 'better_supabase.audit_events', '"better_supabase"."audit_events"', 'actor_id', false, array['old_record', 'new_record', 'impersonated_by', 'impersonation_reason', 'support_session_id']::text[], true),

    ('user', 'better_supabase.notification_suppressions', '"better_supabase"."notification_suppressions"', 'user_id', true, '{}'::text[], true),
    ('user', 'better_supabase.user_settings', '"better_supabase"."user_settings"', 'user_id', true, '{}'::text[], true),
    ('user', 'better_supabase.usage_history', '"better_supabase"."usage_history"', 'actor_id', true, '{}'::text[], true),

    ('user', 'better_supabase.drive_drives', '"better_supabase"."drive_drives"', 'owner_id', true, '{}'::text[], true),

    ('user', 'better_supabase.guests', '"better_supabase"."guests"', 'user_id', true, '{}'::text[], true),
    ('user', 'better_supabase.attachments', '"better_supabase"."attachments"', 'uploaded_by', true, '{}'::text[], true),
    ('user', 'better_supabase.attachment_versions', '"better_supabase"."attachment_versions"', 'uploaded_by', true, '{}'::text[], true),
    ('user', 'better_supabase.scim_users', '"better_supabase"."scim_users"', 'user_id', true, '{}'::text[], true),
    ('user', 'better_supabase.enrollment_programs', '"better_supabase"."enrollment_programs"', 'created_by', true, '{}'::text[], true),
    ('user', 'better_supabase.enrollments', '"better_supabase"."enrollments"', 'user_id', true, '{}'::text[], true),
    ('user', 'better_supabase.waitlist_entries', '"better_supabase"."waitlist_entries"', 'user_id', true, '{}'::text[], true),
    ('user', 'better_supabase.invite_code_redemptions', '"better_supabase"."invite_code_redemptions"', 'user_id', true, '{}'::text[], true),

  select t.subject, t.name, t.tbl, t.col, t.purge,
    t.omit || array(
      select a.attname::text
      from pg_catalog.pg_attribute a

        and a.attnum > 0
        and not a.attisdropped

functions.name: deal_forecast
functions.definition:
with scoped as (
    select * from "better_supabase"."deals" x
    where x."tenant_id" = deal_forecast.tenant
      and x."currency" = upper(deal_forecast.currency)
      and x."archived_at" is null
      and (deal_forecast.pipeline is null or x."pipeline_id" = deal_forecast.pipeline)
      and (deal_forecast.owner is null or x."owner_user_id" = deal_forecast.owner)
  ),
  totals as (
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'won', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'won' and x."closed_at"::date >= deal_forecast.since and x."closed_at"::date <= deal_forecast.until), 0)::text,
      'commit', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."forecast_category" is distinct from 'omit' and x."expected_close_on" >= deal_forecast.since and x."expected_close_on" <= deal_forecast.until and x."forecast_category" = 'commit'), 0)::text,
      'bestCase', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."forecast_category" is distinct from 'omit' and x."expected_close_on" >= deal_forecast.since and x."expected_close_on" <= deal_forecast.until and x."forecast_category" = 'best_case'), 0)::text,
      'pipeline', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."forecast_category" is distinct from 'omit' and x."expected_close_on" >= deal_forecast.since and x."expected_close_on" <= deal_forecast.until and x."forecast_category" = 'pipeline'), 0)::text,
      'notCalled', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."forecast_category" is distinct from 'omit' and x."expected_close_on" >= deal_forecast.since and x."expected_close_on" <= deal_forecast.until and x."forecast_category" is null), 0)::text,
      'omit', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."expected_close_on" >= deal_forecast.since and x."expected_close_on" <= deal_forecast.until and x."forecast_category" = 'omit'), 0)::text,
      'later', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."forecast_category" is distinct from 'omit' and x."expected_close_on" > deal_forecast.until), 0)::text
    ) as sums
    from scoped x
  ),
  owners as (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(o.value order by o.owner_id), '[]'::jsonb) as list
    from (
      select x."owner_user_id" as owner_id, jsonb_build_object('ownerId', x."owner_user_id", 
      'won', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'won' and x."closed_at"::date >= deal_forecast.since and x."closed_at"::date <= deal_forecast.until), 0)::text,
      'commit', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."forecast_category" is distinct from 'omit' and x."expected_close_on" >= deal_forecast.since and x."expected_close_on" <= deal_forecast.until and x."forecast_category" = 'commit'), 0)::text,
      'bestCase', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."forecast_category" is distinct from 'omit' and x."expected_close_on" >= deal_forecast.since and x."expected_close_on" <= deal_forecast.until and x."forecast_category" = 'best_case'), 0)::text,
      'pipeline', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."forecast_category" is distinct from 'omit' and x."expected_close_on" >= deal_forecast.since and x."expected_close_on" <= deal_forecast.until and x."forecast_category" = 'pipeline'), 0)::text,
      'notCalled', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."forecast_category" is distinct from 'omit' and x."expected_close_on" >= deal_forecast.since and x."expected_close_on" <= deal_forecast.until and x."forecast_category" is null), 0)::text,
      'omit', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."expected_close_on" >= deal_forecast.since and x."expected_close_on" <= deal_forecast.until and x."forecast_category" = 'omit'), 0)::text,
      'later', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."forecast_category" is distinct from 'omit' and x."expected_close_on" > deal_forecast.until), 0)::text
      ) as value
      from scoped x group by x."owner_user_id"
    ) o
  )
  select totals.sums || jsonb_build_object(
    'currency', upper(deal_forecast.currency),
    'target', deal_forecast.target::text,
    'attainment', case when coalesce(deal_forecast.target, 0) = 0 then null
      else round(((totals.sums ->> 'won')::numeric + (totals.sums ->> 'commit')::numeric) / deal_forecast.target, 4) end,
    'gap', case when deal_forecast.target is null then null
      else greatest(deal_forecast.target - (totals.sums ->> 'won')::bigint - (totals.sums ->> 'commit')::bigint, 0)::text end,
    'owners', owners.list)
  from totals, owners;

      'won', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'won' and x."closed_at"::date >= deal_forecast.since and x."closed_at"::date <= deal_forecast.until), 0)::text,
      'commit', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."forecast_category" is distinct from 'omit' and x."expected_close_on" >= deal_forecast.since and x."expected_close_on" <= deal_forecast.until and x."forecast_category" = 'commit'), 0)::text,
      'bestCase', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."forecast_category" is distinct from 'omit' and x."expected_close_on" >= deal_forecast.since and x."expected_close_on" <= deal_forecast.until and x."forecast_category" = 'best_case'), 0)::text,
      'pipeline', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."forecast_category" is distinct from 'omit' and x."expected_close_on" >= deal_forecast.since and x."expected_close_on" <= deal_forecast.until and x."forecast_category" = 'pipeline'), 0)::text,
      'notCalled', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."forecast_category" is distinct from 'omit' and x."expected_close_on" >= deal_forecast.since and x."expected_close_on" <= deal_forecast.until and x."forecast_category" is null), 0)::text,
      'omit', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."expected_close_on" >= deal_forecast.since and x."expected_close_on" <= deal_forecast.until and x."forecast_category" = 'omit'), 0)::text,
      'later', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."forecast_category" is distinct from 'omit' and x."expected_close_on" > deal_forecast.until), 0)::text
    ) as sums
    from scoped x
  ),
  owners as (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(o.value order by o.owner_id), '[]'::jsonb) as list
    from (
      select x."owner_user_id" as owner_id, jsonb_build_object('ownerId', x."owner_user_id", 
      'won', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'won' and x."closed_at"::date >= deal_forecast.since and x."closed_at"::date <= deal_forecast.until), 0)::text,
      'commit', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."forecast_category" is distinct from 'omit' and x."expected_close_on" >= deal_forecast.since and x."expected_close_on" <= deal_forecast.until and x."forecast_category" = 'commit'), 0)::text,
      'bestCase', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."forecast_category" is distinct from 'omit' and x."expected_close_on" >= deal_forecast.since and x."expected_close_on" <= deal_forecast.until and x."forecast_category" = 'best_case'), 0)::text,
      'pipeline', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."forecast_category" is distinct from 'omit' and x."expected_close_on" >= deal_forecast.since and x."expected_close_on" <= deal_forecast.until and x."forecast_category" = 'pipeline'), 0)::text,
      'notCalled', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."forecast_category" is distinct from 'omit' and x."expected_close_on" >= deal_forecast.since and x."expected_close_on" <= deal_forecast.until and x."forecast_category" is null), 0)::text,
      'omit', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."expected_close_on" >= deal_forecast.since and x."expected_close_on" <= deal_forecast.until and x."forecast_category" = 'omit'), 0)::text,
      'later', coalesce(sum(x."amount") filter (where x."outcome" = 'open' and x."forecast_category" is distinct from 'omit' and x."expected_close_on" > deal_forecast.until), 0)::text
      ) as value
      from scoped x group by x."owner_user_id"
    ) o
  )
  select totals.sums || jsonb_build_object(
    'currency', upper(deal_forecast.currency),
    'target', deal_forecast.target::text,
    'attainment', case when coalesce(deal_forecast.target, 0) = 0 then null
      else round(((totals.sums ->> 'won')::numeric + (totals.sums ->> 'commit')::numeric) / deal_forecast.target, 4) end,
    'gap', case when deal_forecast.target is null then null
      else greatest(deal_forecast.target - (totals.sums ->> 'won')::bigint - (totals.sums ->> 'commit')::bigint, 0)::text end,
    'owners', owners.list)
  from totals, owners;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.deal_health(pipeline uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  return (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'dealId', x."id", 'identifier', x."identifier", 'name', x."name",
    'daysInStage', (extract(epoch from now() - coalesce(x."stage_entered_at", x."created_at")) / 86400)::integer,
    'rotting', st."rotting_after_days" is not null and now() - coalesce(x."stage_entered_at", x."created_at") > make_interval(days => st."rotting_after_days"),
    'slipped', x."push_count" > 0 or x."expected_close_on" < current_date,
    'noNextStep', x."next_at" is null and ne.e is null,
    'overdue', coalesce((x."next_at" < now() or coalesce((ne.e ->> 'overdue')::boolean, false)), false)
  ) order by x."expected_close_on", x."id"), '[]'::jsonb)
  from "better_supabase"."deals" x
  left join "better_supabase"."pipeline_stages" st on st."id" = x."stage_id"
  left join lateral (select "better_supabase"."next_activity"('deal', x."id"::text) as e) ne on true

    when 'company' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."companies" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'contacts.read'), false)
    when 'person' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."people" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'contacts.read'), false)
    when 'deal' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."deals" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'deals.read'), false)
    when 'course' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."courses" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'courses.read'), false)
    when 'post' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."posts" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'posts.read'), false)
    when 'activity' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."activities" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'activities.read'), false)
    when 'quote' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."quotes" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'quotes.read'), false)
    when 'work_item' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_items" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'tasks.read'), false)
