    when 'calendar_event' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."calendar_events" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'calendar.read'), false)
    when 'booking' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."bookings" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'bookings.read'), false)
    when 'asset' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."assets" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'assets.read'), false)
    when 'asset_location' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."asset_locations" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'assets.read'), false)
    when 'lease' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."leases" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'leases.read'), false)
    when 'expense_report' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."expense_reports" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'expenses.read'), false)
    when 'expense_line' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."expense_lines" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'expenses.read'), false)
    when 'donation_fund' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."donation_funds" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'donations.read'), false)
    when 'work_order' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_orders" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'dispatch.read'), false)
    when 'shipment' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."shipments" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'shipments.read'), false)
    when 'contract' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."contracts" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'contracts.read'), false)
    when 'control' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."controls" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'compliance.read'), false)
    when 'compliance_policy' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."compliance_policies" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'compliance.read'), false)
    when 'qualification_type' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."qualification_types" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'qualifications.read'), false)

    when 'inspection_program' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."inspection_programs" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'inspections.read'), false)
    when 'inspection_finding' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."inspection_findings" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'inspections.read'), false)
    when 'form' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."forms" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'forms.read'), false)
    when 'production_order' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."production_orders" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'manufacturing.read'), false)
    when 'work_center' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_centers" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'manufacturing.read'), false)
    when 'care_plan' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."care_plans" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'care_plans.read'), false)
    when 'incident' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."incidents" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'incidents.read'), false)
    when 'content_entry' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."content_entries" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'content.read'), false)

    when 'project' then exists (select 1 from "public"."projects" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."organization_id" = v_doc."tenant_id")
    when 'task' then exists (select 1 from "public"."tasks" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."organization_id" = v_doc."tenant_id")
    else false
  end) or coalesce(v_suggestion."created_by" = auth.uid(), false)) then
    raise exception 'suggestion not found' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'DOCUMENT_SUGGESTION_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  if decide_document_suggestion.decision is null or decide_document_suggestion.decision not in ('accepted', 'rejected', 'withdrawn') then
    raise exception 'decide with accepted, rejected or withdrawn' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'DOCUMENT_SUGGESTION_INVALID';
  end if;
  if decide_document_suggestion.decision = 'withdrawn' then
    if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or coalesce(v_suggestion."created_by" = auth.uid(), false)) then
      raise exception 'only the author can withdraw a suggestion' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'DOCUMENT_FORBIDDEN';
    end if;
  elsif not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or (coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'documents.write'), false) and case v_doc."subject_type"
    when 'message' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."messages" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'conversation' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."conversations" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'channel' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."channels" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'company' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."companies" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'contacts.read'), false)

    when 'application' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'hiring.write'), false)

  perform better_supabase.audit_event(

    tenant => (v_doc."tenant_id")::uuid,

    target_type => 'document',
    record_id => v_doc."id"::text,
    tenant => (v_doc."tenant_id")::uuid,
    metadata => jsonb_build_object('organizationId', v_doc."tenant_id"::text, 'subjectType', v_doc."subject_type", 'subjectId', v_doc."subject_id", 'id', v_doc."id", 'name', v_doc."name", 'suggestionId', v_suggestion."id", 'authorId', v_suggestion."created_by", 'status', v_suggestion."status")

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.decide_document_suggestion(suggestion_id uuid, decision text, note text DEFAULT NULL::text)

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  v_doc "better_supabase"."documents"%rowtype;
  v_suggestion "better_supabase"."document_suggestions"%rowtype;
  v_seq bigint;
  v_since bigint;
begin
  if not (better_supabase.actor_may_write()) then
    raise exception 'This session is read-only' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'ACTOR_READ_ONLY';
  end if;
  select * into v_suggestion from "better_supabase"."document_suggestions" x where x."id" = decide_document_suggestion.suggestion_id for update;
  if found then
    select * into v_doc from "better_supabase"."documents" d where d."id" = v_suggestion."document_id";
  end if;
  if v_suggestion."id" is null or not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or (coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'documents.read'), false) and case v_doc."subject_type"
    when 'message' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."messages" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'conversation' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."conversations" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'channel' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."channels" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'company' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."companies" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'contacts.read'), false)

      insert into "better_supabase"."pipelines" ("tenant_id", "subject_type", "scope_id", "key", "name", "is_default")
      values (default_pipeline.tenant, default_pipeline.subject_type, default_pipeline.scope_id, 'default', 'Default', true)
      on conflict do nothing
      returning "id" into v_id;
      if v_id is null then
        return "better_supabase"."default_pipeline"(default_pipeline.tenant, default_pipeline.subject_type, default_pipeline.scope_id);
      end if;
      insert into "better_supabase"."pipeline_stages" ("tenant_id", "pipeline_id", "key", "system_key", "name", "category", "outcome", "probability", "rank")
      select default_pipeline.tenant, v_id, x.key, x.key, x.name, x.category, x.outcome, x.probability, x.rank
      from (values
          ('reported', 'Reported', 'open', 'open', null::smallint, '8'),
          ('investigating', 'Investigating', 'open', 'open', null::smallint, 'G'),
          ('acting', 'Acting', 'open', 'open', null::smallint, 'O'),
          ('verifying', 'Verifying', 'open', 'open', null::smallint, 'W'),

      ) x(key, name, category, outcome, probability, rank);
    else

  end case;

end;

functions.definition:
select better_supabase.raise_actor_readonly() where not (better_supabase.actor_may_write());

  with rc as (
    update "better_supabase"."notification_recipients" rc
    set "dismissed_at" = now(), "read_at" = coalesce(rc."read_at", now())
    where rc."user_id" = auth.uid()
      and rc."dismissed_at" is null
      and rc."id" = any(dismiss_notifications.ids)
    returning rc.*
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'count', count(*),
    'items', coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', rc."id", 'event_id', ev."id", 'type', ev."type", 'data', ev."data", 'created_at', rc."created_at", 'read_at', rc."read_at", 'tenant', ev."organization_id", 'actor_id', ev."actor_id", 'subject_type', ev."subject_type", 'subject_id', ev."subject_id", 'subject_label', ev."subject_label", 'summary', ev."summary", 'action_path', ev."action_path", 'actions', ev."actions", 'priority', ev."priority", 'resolved_at', rc."resolved_at", 'resolution', rc."resolution") order by rc."created_at" desc, rc."id" desc) filter (where rc."user_id" = auth.uid()), '[]')
  )
  from rc
  join "better_supabase"."notification_events" ev on ev."id" = rc."event_id"

functions.name: documents_to_compact
functions.definition:
select coalesce(array_agg(t.document_id), '{}'::uuid[]) from (
  select x."document_id" as document_id
  from "better_supabase"."document_updates" x
  left join "better_supabase"."document_snapshots" y on y."document_id" = x."document_id"
  where x."seq" > coalesce(y."seq", 0)
  group by x."document_id"
  having count(*) >= greatest(coalesce(documents_to_compact.min_updates, 1), 1)

  limit greatest(coalesce(documents_to_compact.max_documents, 50), 1)
  ) t

functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.drive_bin(tenant uuid, page_size integer DEFAULT 50, before timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
begin
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', drive_bin.tenant, 'drive.read'), false)) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to read this organization''s drive' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'DRIVE_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  return (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', b.item_id, 'batchId', b.batch_id, 'count', b.n, 'trashedBy', b.trashed_by, 'trashedAt', b.trashed_at, 'purgeAfter', b.purge_after, 'node', b.node) order by b.trashed_at desc, b.item_id), '[]'::jsonb)
    from (
      select i."id" as item_id, i."batch_id" as batch_id, i."trashed_by" as trashed_by, i."trashed_at" as trashed_at, i."purge_after" as purge_after,
        (select count(*) from "better_supabase"."trash_items" c where c."batch_id" = i."batch_id")::integer as n,
        "better_supabase"."drive_node_json"(x) as node
      from "better_supabase"."trash_items" i
      join "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" x on x."id"::text = i."subject_id"
      where i."tenant_id" = drive_bin.tenant and i."subject_type" = 'drive_node' and i."depth" = 0
        and (drive_bin.before is null or i."trashed_at" < drive_bin.before)
        and (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or "better_supabase"."drive_can"(x."id", 'editor'))
      order by i."trashed_at" desc, i."id"
      limit least(greatest(coalesce(drive_bin.page_size, 50), 1), 200)
    ) b
  );
end;
$function$
functions.argument_types: tenant uuid, page_size integer DEFAULT 50, before timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.drive_documents(tenant uuid, filters jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
begin
  if jsonb_typeof(coalesce(drive_documents.filters, '{}'::jsonb)) <> 'object' then
    raise exception 'filters must be an object' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'DRIVE_DOCUMENT_FILTER_INVALID';
  end if;
  return coalesce((
    select jsonb_agg(("better_supabase"."drive_node_json"(x) || jsonb_build_object('role', "better_supabase"."drive_role"((x)."id"), 'readOnly', (coalesce((x)."source"::text, 'internal') not in ('internal', 'request') or false), 'held', "better_supabase"."drive_node_held"((x)."id"), 'downloadable', "better_supabase"."drive_can_download"((x)."id"))) order by x."document_number")
    from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" x
    where x."tenant_id" = drive_documents.tenant and x."document_status" is not null and x."deleted_at" is null
      and (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or "better_supabase"."drive_can"(x."id", 'viewer'))
      and (drive_documents.filters ->> 'type' is null or x."document_type" = drive_documents.filters ->> 'type')
      and (drive_documents.filters ->> 'status' is null or x."document_status" = drive_documents.filters ->> 'status')
      and (drive_documents.filters ->> 'ownerId' is null or x."document_owner_id"::text = drive_documents.filters ->> 'ownerId')
      and (coalesce((drive_documents.filters ->> 'reviewDue')::boolean, false) = false
        or (x."document_status" = 'effective' and x."next_review_on" <= current_date))
      and (coalesce(drive_documents.filters ->> 'search', '') = ''
        or x."document_number" ilike '%' || (drive_documents.filters ->> 'search') || '%'
        or x."name" ilike '%' || (drive_documents.filters ->> 'search') || '%')
  ), '[]'::jsonb);
end;
$function$

functions.name: drive_labeled
functions.definition:
select coalesce(jsonb_agg(t.node order by t.ord), '[]'::jsonb) from (
    select ("better_supabase"."drive_node_json"(x) || jsonb_build_object('role', "better_supabase"."drive_role"((x)."id"), 'readOnly', (coalesce((x)."source"::text, 'internal') not in ('internal', 'request') or false), 'held', "better_supabase"."drive_node_held"((x)."id"), 'downloadable', "better_supabase"."drive_can_download"((x)."id"))) as node, row_number() over (order by (x."kind" = 'folder') desc, x."rank", lower(x."name"), x."id") as ord
    from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" x
    where x."tenant_id" = drive_labeled.tenant and x."deleted_at" is null
      and exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."taggings" lg where lg."subject_type" = 'drive_node' and lg."subject_id" = x."id"::text and lg."tag_id" = drive_labeled.tag)
      and (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or "better_supabase"."drive_can"(x."id", 'viewer'))
    order by (x."kind" = 'folder') desc, x."rank", lower(x."name"), x."id"
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(drive_labeled.page_size, 50), 1), 200)
  ) t

    select ("better_supabase"."drive_node_json"(x) || jsonb_build_object('role', "better_supabase"."drive_role"((x)."id"), 'readOnly', (coalesce((x)."source"::text, 'internal') not in ('internal', 'request') or false), 'held', "better_supabase"."drive_node_held"((x)."id"), 'downloadable', "better_supabase"."drive_can_download"((x)."id"))) || jsonb_build_object('starredAt', s."starred_at", 'openedAt', s."last_opened_at") as node,

      and "better_supabase"."drive_can"(x."id", 'viewer')
    order by marked_at desc
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(drive_marked.page_size, 50), 1), 200)

functions.name: drive_object_allowed
functions.definition:
select case when drive_object_allowed.path like '_previews/%' then
    drive_object_allowed.action = 'select'
      and split_part(drive_object_allowed.path, '/', 3) ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      and "better_supabase"."drive_can"(split_part(drive_object_allowed.path, '/', 3)::uuid, 'viewer') and "better_supabase"."drive_document_readable"(split_part(drive_object_allowed.path, '/', 3)::uuid, (select pn."attachment_id" from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" pn where pn."id"::text = split_part(drive_object_allowed.path, '/', 3)))
  else coalesce((
    select case
      when f."subject_type" is distinct from 'drive_node' then true
      when f."subject_id" !~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' then false
      when drive_object_allowed.action = 'select' then "better_supabase"."drive_can_download"(f."subject_id"::uuid) and "better_supabase"."drive_document_readable"(f."subject_id"::uuid, f."id")
      else "better_supabase"."drive_node_writable"(f."subject_id"::uuid) or "better_supabase"."drive_uploaded_own"(f."subject_id"::uuid)
    end
    from "better_supabase"."attachments" f
    where f."bucket" = drive_object_allowed.bucket and f."object_path" = drive_object_allowed.path
  ), true) end
functions.complete_statement:

functions.definition:
with orphans as (
    select f."id" as id from "better_supabase"."attachments" f
    where f."subject_type" = 'drive_node'
      and f."created_at" < now() - interval '1 day'
      and not exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" x where x."attachment_id" = f."id")
      and not exists (
        select 1 from "better_supabase"."versions" r
        where r."subject_type" = 'drive_node' and r."subject_id" = f."subject_id"
          and r."content" ->> 'attachmentId' = f."id"::text
      )
    order by f."created_at"
    limit greatest(coalesce(drive_prune.max_objects, 100), 1)
  ), removed as (
    delete from "better_supabase"."attachments" f using orphans o where f."id" = o.id
    returning f."bucket" as bucket, f."object_path" as path, f."uploaded_at" as uploaded_at
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('bucket', r.bucket, 'path', r.path)) filter (where r.uploaded_at is not null), '[]'::jsonb) from removed r

    select f."id" as id from "better_supabase"."attachments" f
    where f."subject_type" = 'drive_node'
      and f."created_at" < now() - interval '1 day'
      and not exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" x where x."attachment_id" = f."id")
      and not exists (
        select 1 from "better_supabase"."versions" r
        where r."subject_type" = 'drive_node' and r."subject_id" = f."subject_id"
          and r."content" ->> 'attachmentId' = f."id"::text
      )
    order by f."created_at"
    limit greatest(coalesce(drive_prune.max_objects, 100), 1)
  ), removed as (
    delete from "better_supabase"."attachments" f using orphans o where f."id" = o.id
    returning f."bucket" as bucket, f."object_path" as path, f."uploaded_at" as uploaded_at
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('bucket', r.bucket, 'path', r.path)) filter (where r.uploaded_at is not null), '[]'::jsonb) from removed r

select x."id" from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" x
  where coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin')
    or (auth.uid() is not null
      and x."tenant_id" in (select better_supabase.tenant_ids_with('drive.read'))
      and (x."tenant_id" in (select better_supabase.tenant_ids_with('drive.manage'))))

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.drive_shared(tenant uuid, page_size integer DEFAULT 100)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
begin
  return (
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(("better_supabase"."drive_node_json"(c.r) || jsonb_build_object('role', "better_supabase"."drive_role"((c.r)."id"), 'readOnly', (coalesce((c.r)."source"::text, 'internal') not in ('internal', 'request') or false), 'held', "better_supabase"."drive_node_held"((c.r)."id"), 'downloadable', "better_supabase"."drive_can_download"((c.r)."id"))) order by (c.r)."name", (c.r)."id"), '[]'::jsonb)
  from (
    select x as r from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" x
    where x."tenant_id" = drive_shared.tenant and x."deleted_at" is null
      and auth.uid() is not null
      and exists (
        select 1 from "better_supabase"."drive_grants" dg
        where dg."node_id" = x."id" and (dg."expires_at" is null or dg."expires_at" > now())
          and ((dg."principal_type" = 'user' and dg."principal_id" = auth.uid()::text)
      or (dg."principal_type" = 'team' and exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."team_members" tm where tm."team_id"::text = dg."principal_id"::text and tm."user_id" = auth.uid()))
      or (dg."principal_type" = 'role' and exists (select 1 from "public"."memberships" mr where mr."organization_id" = x."tenant_id" and mr."user_id" = auth.uid() and mr."role"::text = dg."principal_id")))
      )
      and (x."parent_id" is null or not "better_supabase"."drive_can"(x."parent_id", 'viewer'))
      and "better_supabase"."drive_can"(x."id", 'viewer')
    order by x."name", x."id"
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(drive_shared.page_size, 100), 1), 500)
  ) c
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.drop_acknowledgement_assignment(tenant uuid, subject_type text, subject_id text, principal_type text, principal_id text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  v_row "better_supabase"."acknowledgement_assignments"%rowtype;
begin
  delete from "better_supabase"."acknowledgement_assignments" x
  where x."tenant_id" = drop_acknowledgement_assignment.tenant
    and x."subject_type" = drop_acknowledgement_assignment.subject_type
    and x."subject_id" = drop_acknowledgement_assignment.subject_id
    and x."principal_type" = drop_acknowledgement_assignment.principal_type
    and x."principal_id" = drop_acknowledgement_assignment.principal_id
  returning * into v_row;
  if not found then
    return false;
  end if;
  perform "better_supabase".emit_event('acknowledgement_assignment.deleted', jsonb_build_object('organizationId', v_row."tenant_id", 'subjectType', v_row."subject_type", 'subjectId', v_row."subject_id", 'assignmentId', v_row."id", 'principalType', v_row."principal_type", 'principalId', v_row."principal_id"), 'acknowledgement-assignments/' || v_row."id"::text, (v_row."tenant_id")::text, null, 'better-supabase/acknowledgements');
  perform better_supabase.audit_event(
    event_type => 'acknowledgement_assignment.deleted',
    category => 'data',
    target_type => 'acknowledgement_assignment',
    record_id => v_row."id"::text,
    summary => 'removed the acknowledgement assignment of ' || v_row."principal_type" || ' ' || v_row."principal_id" || ' on ' || v_row."subject_type" || ' ' || v_row."subject_id",
    tenant => (v_row."tenant_id")::uuid,
    metadata => jsonb_build_object('organizationId', v_row."tenant_id", 'subjectType', v_row."subject_type", 'subjectId', v_row."subject_id", 'assignmentId', v_row."id", 'principalType', v_row."principal_type", 'principalId', v_row."principal_id")
  );
  return true;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.due_ai_batches(batch integer DEFAULT 20, lease_seconds integer DEFAULT 300)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_rows jsonb;
begin
  with due as (
    select y."id" from "better_supabase"."ai_batches" y
    where (y."status" = 'pending' or not y."results_saved") and y."next_poll_at" <= now()
    order by y."next_poll_at"
    limit least(greatest(due_ai_batches.batch, 1), 200)
    for update skip locked
  ), claimed as (
    update "better_supabase"."ai_batches" x set
      "polls" = x."polls" + 1,
      "next_poll_at" = now() + make_interval(secs => greatest(due_ai_batches.lease_seconds, 1)),
      "updated_at" = now()
    from due where x."id" = due."id"
    returning x.*
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', claimed."id", 'organization_id', claimed."organization_id", 'user_id', claimed."user_id", 'provider', claimed."provider", 'reference', claimed."reference", 'status', claimed."status", 'raw_status', claimed."raw_status", 'item_count', claimed."item_count", 'counts', claimed."counts", 'error', claimed."error", 'metadata', claimed."metadata", 'results_saved', claimed."results_saved", 'polls', claimed."polls", 'next_poll_at', claimed."next_poll_at", 'expires_at', claimed."expires_at", 'completed_at', claimed."completed_at", 'created_at', claimed."created_at", 'updated_at', claimed."updated_at")), '[]') into v_rows from claimed;
  return v_rows;
end;
$function$

declare

  select * into v_application from "better_supabase"."applications" x where x."id" = employee_from_application.application;

functions.name: enrichment_due
functions.definition:
select coalesce(jsonb_agg(z.target order by z.fetched_at nulls first, z.id), '[]'::jsonb)
  from (
    select * from (
      select jsonb_build_object('kind', 'company', 'organizationId', x."tenant_id", 'subjectType', 'company', 'subjectId', x."id", 'name', x."name", 'domain', x."domain", 'website', x."website") as target, y."fetched_at" as fetched_at, x."id" as id
    from "better_supabase"."companies" x
    left join "better_supabase"."enrichments" y on y."company_id" = x."id" and y."provider" = enrichment_due.provider
    where x."archived_at" is null
      and (enrichment_due.subject_type is null or enrichment_due.subject_type = 'company')
      and (x."domain" is not null or x."website" is not null)
      and (y."fetched_at" is null or y."fetched_at" < now() - coalesce(enrichment_due.stale_after, interval '30 days'))
      union all
      select jsonb_build_object('kind', 'person', 'organizationId', x."tenant_id", 'subjectType', 'person', 'subjectId', x."id", 'name', x."name", 'email', x."email", 'phone', x."phone", 'title', x."title", 'companyDomain', (
    select c."domain" from "better_supabase"."company_people" l
    join "better_supabase"."companies" c on c."id" = l."company_id"
    where l."person_id" = x."id" and c."archived_at" is null
    order by l."is_primary" desc, l."created_at"
    limit 1)) as target, y."fetched_at" as fetched_at, x."id" as id
    from "better_supabase"."people" x
    left join "better_supabase"."enrichments" y on y."person_id" = x."id" and y."provider" = enrichment_due.provider
    where x."archived_at" is null
      and (enrichment_due.subject_type is null or enrichment_due.subject_type = 'person')
      and x."email" is not null
      and (y."fetched_at" is null or y."fetched_at" < now() - coalesce(enrichment_due.stale_after, interval '30 days'))
    ) w
    order by w.fetched_at nulls first, w.id
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(enrichment_due.max_count, 25), 1), 500)
  ) z

    'startsAt', x."starts_at", 'endsAt', x."ends_at",

      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('step', y."step", 'assignee', case when y."assignee_role" is not null then jsonb_build_object('role', y."assignee_role") when y."assignee_user_id" is not null then jsonb_build_object('userId', y."assignee_user_id") end, 'dueAt', y."due_at", 'completedAt', y."completed_at")) order by array_position(x."steps", y."step"), y."step")
      from "better_supabase"."enrollment_steps" y
      where y."enrollment_id" = x."id"
        and (y."assignee_role" is not null or y."assignee_user_id" is not null or y."due_at" is not null)
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  )
  from "better_supabase"."enrollments" x

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.escalate_approvals(max_requests integer DEFAULT 200)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_req "better_supabase"."approval_requests"%rowtype;
  v_count integer := 0;
begin
  for v_req in
    select * from "better_supabase"."approval_requests" r
    where r."status" = 'pending'
      and (r."expires_at" is null or r."expires_at" > now())
      and r."policy" -> 'steps' -> r."step" ? 'escalateAfter'
      and not coalesce((r."policy" -> 'steps' -> r."step" ->> 'escalated')::boolean, false)
      and coalesce((
        select max(x."created_at") from "better_supabase"."approval_decisions" x
        where x."request_id" = r."id" and x."step" = r."step" - 1
      ), r."created_at") + (r."policy" -> 'steps' -> r."step" ->> 'escalateAfter')::interval <= now()
    order by r."created_at"
    limit greatest(coalesce(escalate_approvals.max_requests, 200), 1)
    for update skip locked
  loop
    update "better_supabase"."approval_requests" r set "policy" = jsonb_set(r."policy", array['steps', (r."step")::text, 'escalated'], 'true'::jsonb)
    where r."id" = v_req."id"
    returning * into v_req;
    perform "better_supabase".emit_event('approval.escalated', jsonb_build_object('organizationId', v_req."tenant_id"::text, 'subjectType', v_req."subject_type", 'subjectId', v_req."subject_id", 'id', v_req."id", 'action', v_req."action", 'status', v_req."status", 'step', v_req."step"), 'approval-requests/' || v_req."id"::text, (v_req."tenant_id")::text, null, 'better-supabase/approvals');
  perform better_supabase.audit_event(
    event_type => 'approval.escalated',
    category => 'data',
    target_type => 'approval_request',
    record_id => v_req."id"::text,
    summary => 'escalated' || ' ' || v_req."action" || ' on ' || v_req."subject_type" || ' ' || v_req."subject_id",
    tenant => (v_req."tenant_id")::uuid,
    metadata => jsonb_build_object('organizationId', v_req."tenant_id"::text, 'subjectType', v_req."subject_type", 'subjectId', v_req."subject_id", 'id', v_req."id", 'action', v_req."action", 'status', v_req."status", 'step', v_req."step")
  );
    perform "better_supabase"."approval_notify"(v_req."id", 'escalated');
    v_count := v_count + 1;
  end loop;
  return v_count;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.explode_bom(variant_id uuid, quantity numeric)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_tenant uuid := (select cv."tenant_id" from "better_supabase"."product_variants" cv where cv."id" = explode_bom.variant_id);
  v_lines jsonb;
begin
  if v_tenant is null or not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or (v_tenant is not null and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_tenant, 'manufacturing.read'), false))) then
    raise exception 'no such bill of materials' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'BOM_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  if explode_bom.quantity is null or explode_bom.quantity <= 0 then
    raise exception 'the quantity must be more than zero' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'BOM_INVALID';
  end if;
  if not exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."boms" x where x."variant_id" = explode_bom.variant_id and x."status" = 'active') then
    raise exception 'the variant has no active bill of materials' using errcode = '55000', hint = 'BOM_NOT_ACTIVE';
  end if;
  with recursive tree(variant, parent, bom, quantity, level, path) as (
    select y."variant_id", x."variant_id", x."id",
      explode_bom.quantity * y."quantity" / x."quantity" * (1 + y."scrap_bps" / 10000.0), 1,
      array[x."variant_id", y."variant_id"]
    from "better_supabase"."boms" x join "better_supabase"."bom_components" y on y."bom_id" = x."id"
    where x."variant_id" = explode_bom.variant_id and x."status" = 'active'
    union all
    select y."variant_id", x."variant_id", x."id",
      tree.quantity * y."quantity" / x."quantity" * (1 + y."scrap_bps" / 10000.0), tree.level + 1,
      tree.path || y."variant_id"
    from tree
    join "better_supabase"."boms" x on x."variant_id" = tree.variant and x."status" = 'active'
    join "better_supabase"."bom_components" y on y."bom_id" = x."id"
    where tree.level < 20 and not (y."variant_id" = any (tree.path))
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('level', t.level, 'variantId', t.variant, 'parentVariantId', t.parent, 'bomId', t.bom,
      'quantity', "better_supabase"."production_quantity"(t.variant, t.quantity)::text,
      'made', exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."boms" z where z."variant_id" = t.variant and z."status" = 'active'))
    order by t.path), '[]'::jsonb)
  into v_lines from tree t;
  return jsonb_build_object('variantId', explode_bom.variant_id, 'quantity', explode_bom.quantity::text, 'lines', v_lines,
    'materials', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('variantId', m.variant, 'quantity', m.quantity::text) order by m.variant)
      from (select (e ->> 'variantId')::uuid as variant, sum((e ->> 'quantity')::numeric) as quantity
        from jsonb_array_elements(v_lines) e where not (e ->> 'made')::boolean group by 1) m), '[]'::jsonb));
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.finish_ai_sandbox_stop(id uuid, stopped boolean, error text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_row "better_supabase"."ai_sandboxes"%rowtype;
begin
  update "better_supabase"."ai_sandboxes" x set
    "status" = case when finish_ai_sandbox_stop.stopped then 'stopped' else 'running' end,
    "stopped_at" = case when finish_ai_sandbox_stop.stopped then now() else null end,
    "error" = left(finish_ai_sandbox_stop.error, 4000),
    "updated_at" = now()
  where x."id" = finish_ai_sandbox_stop.id and x."status" = 'stopping'
  returning x.* into v_row;
  if not found then
    return false;
  end if;
  if finish_ai_sandbox_stop.stopped and v_row."harness_id" is not null then
    update "better_supabase"."ai_harness_sessions" z set "status" = 'stopped', "updated_at" = now()
    where z."chat_id" = v_row."chat_id" and z."harness_id" = v_row."harness_id"
      and z."status" in ('active', 'idle')
      and not exists (
        select 1 from "better_supabase"."ai_sandboxes" y
        where y."chat_id" = v_row."chat_id" and y."harness_id" = v_row."harness_id" and y."status" <> 'stopped'
      );
  end if;
  return true;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.forecast_changes(from_snapshot uuid, to_snapshot uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_from "better_supabase"."forecast_snapshots";
  v_to "better_supabase"."forecast_snapshots";
begin
  select * into v_from from "better_supabase"."forecast_snapshots" x where x."id" = forecast_changes.from_snapshot;
  select * into v_to from "better_supabase"."forecast_snapshots" x where x."id" = forecast_changes.to_snapshot;
  if v_from."id" is null or v_to."id" is null
    or not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_from."tenant_id", 'forecasts.read'), false)) or not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_to."tenant_id", 'forecasts.read'), false)) then
    raise exception 'No forecast snapshot you can read has this id' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'FORECAST_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  if v_from."tenant_id" <> v_to."tenant_id" or v_from."currency" <> v_to."currency" then
    raise exception 'Both snapshots must be of one organization and currency' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'FORECAST_MISMATCH';
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'from', jsonb_build_object('id', v_from."id", 'organizationId', v_from."tenant_id", 'pipelineId', v_from."pipeline_id", 'since', v_from."period_start", 'until', v_from."period_end", 'currency', v_from."currency", 'target', v_from."target"::text, 'totals', v_from."totals", 'dealCount', v_from."deal_count", 'takenBy', v_from."taken_by", 'takenAt', v_from."taken_at"),
    'to', jsonb_build_object('id', v_to."id", 'organizationId', v_to."tenant_id", 'pipelineId', v_to."pipeline_id", 'since', v_to."period_start", 'until', v_to."period_end", 'currency', v_to."currency", 'target', v_to."target"::text, 'totals', v_to."totals", 'dealCount', v_to."deal_count", 'takenBy', v_to."taken_by", 'takenAt', v_to."taken_at"),
    'deals', (
      select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'dealId', coalesce(b."deal_id", a."deal_id"),
        'name', coalesce(b."name", a."name"),
        'change', case
      when a."deal_id" is null then 'added'
      when b."deal_id" is null then 'removed'
      when a."outcome" = 'open' and b."outcome" = 'won' then 'won'
      when a."outcome" = 'open' and b."outcome" = 'lost' then 'lost'
      else 'changed'
    end,
        'before', case when a."deal_id" is null then null else jsonb_build_object('dealId', a."deal_id", 'name', a."name", 'ownerId', a."owner_user_id", 'stageId', a."stage_id", 'forecast', a."forecast_category"::text, 'outcome', a."outcome"::text, 'amount', a."amount"::text, 'closeOn', a."expected_close_on", 'closedAt', a."closed_at") end,
        'after', case when b."deal_id" is null then null else jsonb_build_object('dealId', b."deal_id", 'name', b."name", 'ownerId', b."owner_user_id", 'stageId', b."stage_id", 'forecast', b."forecast_category"::text, 'outcome', b."outcome"::text, 'amount', b."amount"::text, 'closeOn', b."expected_close_on", 'closedAt', b."closed_at") end
      ) order by coalesce(b."amount", a."amount") desc, coalesce(b."deal_id", a."deal_id")), '[]'::jsonb)
      from (select * from "better_supabase"."forecast_snapshot_deals" where "snapshot_id" = v_from."id") a
      full join (select * from "better_supabase"."forecast_snapshot_deals" where "snapshot_id" = v_to."id") b on b."deal_id" = a."deal_id"
      where a."deal_id" is null or b."deal_id" is null
      or a."amount" <> b."amount"
      or a."outcome" <> b."outcome"
      or a."forecast_category" is distinct from b."forecast_category"
      or a."stage_id" is distinct from b."stage_id"
      or a."expected_close_on" is distinct from b."expected_close_on"
      or a."owner_user_id" is distinct from b."owner_user_id"
    ));
end;
$function$

functions.definition:
declare
  v_type text := field ->> 'type';
  -- required only asks for the key, so an empty answer needs its own floor.
  v_floor jsonb := case when field -> 'required' = 'true'::jsonb then '1'::jsonb end;
  v_values jsonb;
  v_out jsonb;
begin
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(o.value -> 'value' order by o.ord), '[]'::jsonb) into v_values
    from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(field -> 'options', '[]'::jsonb)) with ordinality as o(value, ord);
  v_out := case v_type
    when 'text' then jsonb_build_object('type', 'string', 'maxLength', coalesce(field -> 'maxLength', '500'::jsonb))
      || jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('minLength', coalesce(field -> 'minLength', v_floor), 'pattern', field -> 'pattern'))
    when 'textarea' then jsonb_build_object('type', 'string', 'maxLength', coalesce(field -> 'maxLength', '10000'::jsonb))
      || jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('minLength', coalesce(field -> 'minLength', v_floor), 'pattern', field -> 'pattern'))
    when 'email' then jsonb_build_object('type', 'string', 'format', 'email', 'maxLength', 320)
    when 'url' then jsonb_build_object('type', 'string', 'format', 'uri', 'maxLength', 2000)
    when 'number' then jsonb_build_object('type', 'number') || jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('minimum', field -> 'min', 'maximum', field -> 'max'))
    when 'integer' then jsonb_build_object('type', 'integer') || jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('minimum', field -> 'min', 'maximum', field -> 'max'))
    when 'date' then '{"type": "string", "format": "date"}'::jsonb
    when 'bool' then '{"type": "boolean"}'::jsonb
    when 'consent' then '{"type": "boolean", "const": true}'::jsonb
    when 'option' then jsonb_build_object('type', 'string', 'enum', v_values)
    when 'multi' then jsonb_build_object('type', 'array', 'items', jsonb_build_object('type', 'string', 'enum', v_values), 'uniqueItems', true)
      || jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('minItems', coalesce(field -> 'min', v_floor), 'maxItems', field -> 'max'))
    when 'nps' then '{"type": "integer", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 10}'::jsonb
    else '{}'::jsonb
  end;
  return v_out || jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('title', field -> 'label', 'description', field -> 'help'));
end;

functions.name: get_approval
functions.definition:
declare
  v_req "better_supabase"."approval_requests"%rowtype;
begin
  select * into v_req from "better_supabase"."approval_requests" r where r."id" = get_approval.request_id;
  if not found then
    raise exception 'approval request not found' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'APPROVAL_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or coalesce(v_req."requested_by" = auth.uid(), false) or "better_supabase"."approval_eligible"(v_req."id")
    or (coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'approvals.read'), false) and (not v_req."subject_type" in ('ai_tool_approval') and (v_req."subject_type" in ('access_request', 'timesheet', 'expense_report', 'content_entry', 'care_plan_action') or (case when v_req."subject_type" = 'drive_node' then coalesce(case when v_req."subject_id" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' then "better_supabase"."drive_can"((v_req."subject_id")::uuid, 'viewer') end, false) else case v_req."subject_type"
    when 'message' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."messages" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'conversation' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."conversations" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'channel' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."channels" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'company' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."companies" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'contacts.read'), false)
    when 'person' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."people" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'contacts.read'), false)
    when 'deal' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."deals" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'deals.read'), false)
    when 'course' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."courses" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'courses.read'), false)
    when 'post' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."posts" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'posts.read'), false)
    when 'activity' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."activities" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'activities.read'), false)
    when 'quote' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."quotes" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'quotes.read'), false)
    when 'work_item' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_items" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'tasks.read'), false)
    when 'employee' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."employees" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'employees.read'), false)
    when 'invoice' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."invoices" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'invoices.read'), false)
    when 'ledger_account' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."ledger_accounts" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'ledger.read'), false)
    when 'product' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."products" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'catalog.read'), false)

    when 'booking' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."bookings" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'bookings.read'), false)

    when 'lease' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."leases" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'leases.read'), false)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.get_asset_location(location_id uuid)

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  v_row "better_supabase"."asset_locations"%rowtype;
begin
  select * into v_row from "better_supabase"."asset_locations" x where x."id" = get_asset_location.location_id;
  if not found or not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'assets.read'), false)) then
    raise exception 'location not found' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'ASSETS_LOCATION_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('id', v_row."id", 'organizationId', v_row."tenant_id", 'parentId', v_row."parent_id", 'kind', v_row."kind", 'name', v_row."name", 'code', v_row."code", 'address', v_row."address", 'latitude', v_row."latitude", 'longitude', v_row."longitude", 'area', extensions.st_asgeojson(v_row.area::extensions.geometry)::jsonb, 'metadata', v_row."metadata", 'archivedAt', v_row."archived_at", 'createdAt', v_row."created_at", 'updatedAt', v_row."updated_at") || jsonb_build_object(
    'path', coalesce((
    with recursive up as (
      select y."id" as id, y."parent_id" as parent, y."kind" as kind, y."name" as name, 0 as depth from "better_supabase"."asset_locations" y where y."id" = v_row."id"
      union all
      select y."id", y."parent_id", y."kind", y."name", up.depth + 1 from "better_supabase"."asset_locations" y join up on y."id" = up.parent where up.depth < 64
    )
    select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', up.id, 'kind', up.kind, 'name', up.name) order by up.depth desc) from up
  ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'locations', (select count(*)::integer from "better_supabase"."asset_locations" y where y."parent_id" = v_row."id" and y."archived_at" is null),
    'assets', (select count(*)::integer from "better_supabase"."assets" y where y."location_id" = v_row."id" and y."status" <> 'retired'));
end;

    when 'deal' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."deals" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'deals.read'), false)
    when 'course' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."courses" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'courses.read'), false)
    when 'post' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."posts" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'posts.read'), false)
    when 'activity' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."activities" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'activities.read'), false)
    when 'quote' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."quotes" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'quotes.read'), false)
    when 'work_item' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_items" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'tasks.read'), false)

    when 'product_variant' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."product_variants" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'catalog.read'), false)
    when 'order' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."orders" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'orders.read'), false)
    when 'calendar_event' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."calendar_events" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'calendar.read'), false)

    when 'asset' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."assets" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'assets.read'), false)
    when 'asset_location' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."asset_locations" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'assets.read'), false)
    when 'lease' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."leases" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'leases.read'), false)
    when 'expense_report' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."expense_reports" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'expenses.read'), false)
    when 'expense_line' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."expense_lines" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'expenses.read'), false)
    when 'donation_fund' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."donation_funds" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'donations.read'), false)
    when 'work_order' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_orders" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'dispatch.read'), false)
    when 'shipment' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."shipments" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'shipments.read'), false)
    when 'contract' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."contracts" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'contracts.read'), false)
    when 'control' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."controls" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'compliance.read'), false)
    when 'compliance_policy' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."compliance_policies" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'compliance.read'), false)
    when 'qualification_type' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."qualification_types" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'qualifications.read'), false)
    when 'risk' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."risks" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'risks.read'), false)
    when 'case' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."cases" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'cases.read'), false)
    when 'inspection' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."inspections" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'inspections.read'), false)
    when 'inspection_program' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."inspection_programs" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'inspections.read'), false)
    when 'inspection_finding' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."inspection_findings" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'inspections.read'), false)
    when 'form' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."forms" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'forms.read'), false)
    when 'production_order' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."production_orders" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'manufacturing.read'), false)
    when 'work_center' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_centers" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'manufacturing.read'), false)
    when 'care_plan' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."care_plans" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'care_plans.read'), false)
    when 'incident' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."incidents" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'incidents.read'), false)
    when 'content_entry' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."content_entries" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'content.read'), false)
    when 'document' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."documents" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'documents.read'), false)
    when 'customer' then exists (select 1 from "public"."customers" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."organization_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'customers.read'), false)
    when 'drive_node' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id" and (coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'drive.read'), false) and coalesce("better_supabase"."drive_node_readable"(s."id"), false)))
    when 'application' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."applications" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'hiring.read'), false)
    when 'change_request' then exists (select 1 from "public"."change_requests" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."organization_id" = v_doc."tenant_id")
    when 'project' then exists (select 1 from "public"."projects" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."organization_id" = v_doc."tenant_id")
    when 'task' then exists (select 1 from "public"."tasks" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."organization_id" = v_doc."tenant_id")
    else false
  end)) then
    raise exception 'document not found' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  select x."content" ->> 'state' into v_state from "better_supabase"."versions" x
  where x."id" = get_document_version.version_id
    and x."subject_type" = 'document' and x."subject_id" = v_doc."id"::text;
  if v_state is null then
    raise exception 'version not found' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'DOCUMENT_VERSION_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  return v_state;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.get_inspection(inspection_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_variable
declare
  v_row "better_supabase"."inspections";
begin
  select * into v_row from "better_supabase"."inspections" x where x."id" = get_inspection.inspection_id;
  if not found or not ((coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or (v_row."tenant_id" is not null and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'inspections.read'), false))) or "better_supabase"."inspection_role"(v_row."id") is not null) then
    raise exception 'no such inspection' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'INSPECTION_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('id', v_row."id", 'organizationId', v_row."tenant_id", 'programId', v_row."program_id", 'number', v_row."number", 'kind', v_row."kind", 'title', v_row."title", 'scope', v_row."scope", 'criteria', v_row."criteria", 'auditee', case when v_row."auditee_type" is null then null else jsonb_build_object('type', v_row."auditee_type", 'id', v_row."auditee_id") end, 'leadId', v_row."lead_id", 'plannedStart', v_row."planned_start", 'plannedEnd', v_row."planned_end", 'startedAt', v_row."started_at", 'completedAt', v_row."completed_at", 'closedAt', v_row."closed_at", 'status', v_row."status", 'checklistFormId', v_row."checklist_form_id", 'checklistSubmissionId', v_row."checklist_submission_id", 'summary', v_row."summary", 'createdBy', v_row."created_by", 'createdAt', v_row."created_at", 'updatedAt', v_row."updated_at") || jsonb_build_object(
    'members', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('userId', y."user_id", 'role', y."role", 'createdAt', y."created_at")
        order by case y."role" when 'lead' then 0 when 'auditor' then 1 when 'auditee' then 2 else 3 end, y."created_at")
      from "better_supabase"."inspection_members" y where y."tenant_id" = v_row."tenant_id" and y."inspection_id" = v_row."id"
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'findings', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', y."id", 'organizationId', y."tenant_id", 'inspectionId', y."inspection_id", 'number', y."number", 'type', y."type", 'title', y."title", 'description', y."description", 'clause', y."clause", 'controlId', y."control_id", 'evidence', y."evidence", 'caseId', y."case_id", 'needsCase', y."type" = any (array['major_nonconformity', 'minor_nonconformity']::text[]), 'createdBy', y."created_by", 'createdAt', y."created_at", 'updatedAt', y."updated_at") order by y."number")
      from "better_supabase"."inspection_findings" y where y."tenant_id" = v_row."tenant_id" and y."inspection_id" = v_row."id"
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'checklist', case when v_row."checklist_form_id" is null then null else jsonb_build_object(
      'formId', v_row."checklist_form_id",
      'submissionId', v_row."checklist_submission_id",
      'status', (select y."status" from "better_supabase"."form_submissions" y where y."id" = v_row."checklist_submission_id")
    ) end,
    'assessedControls', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', c.id, 'title', "better_supabase"."subject_title"('control', c.id)) order by c.id)
      from (
        select y."control_id"::text as id from "better_supabase"."inspection_findings" y
        where y."tenant_id" = v_row."tenant_id" and y."inspection_id" = v_row."id" and y."control_id" is not null
      union
      select y."target_id" from "better_supabase"."relations" y
      where y."tenant_id" = v_row."tenant_id" and y."kind" = 'assesses'
        and y."source_type" = 'inspection' and y."source_id" = v_row."id"::text
        and y."target_type" = 'control'
      ) c
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  );
end;
$function$

functions.name: get_production_order
functions.definition:
declare
  v_row "better_supabase"."production_orders";
begin
  select * into v_row from "better_supabase"."production_orders" x where x."id" = get_production_order.order_id;
  if not found or not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or (v_row."tenant_id" is not null and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'manufacturing.read'), false))) then
    raise exception 'no such production order' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'PRODUCTION_ORDER_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  return (jsonb_build_object('id', v_row."id", 'organizationId', v_row."tenant_id", 'number', v_row."number", 'variantId', v_row."variant_id", 'bomId', v_row."bom_id", 'quantity', v_row."quantity"::text, 'locationId', v_row."location_id", 'dueOn', v_row."due_on", 'status', v_row."status", 'producedQuantity', v_row."produced_quantity"::text, 'scrapQuantity', v_row."scrap_quantity"::text, 'outputLotId', v_row."output_lot_id", 'materialCost', v_row."material_cost"::text, 'laborCost', v_row."labor_cost"::text, 'currency', v_row."currency", 'note', v_row."note", 'releasedAt', v_row."released_at", 'startedAt', v_row."started_at", 'completedAt', v_row."completed_at", 'canceledAt', v_row."canceled_at", 'createdBy', v_row."created_by", 'createdAt', v_row."created_at", 'updatedAt', v_row."updated_at") || jsonb_build_object(
    'operations', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', y."id", 'orderId', y."order_id", 'operationId', y."operation_id", 'sequence', y."sequence", 'workCenterId', y."work_center_id", 'title', y."title", 'plannedMinutes', y."planned_minutes"::text, 'status', y."status", 'startedAt', y."started_at", 'finishedAt', y."finished_at", 'operatorId', y."operator_id", 'minutes', y."minutes"::text, 'inspectionId', y."inspection_id") order by y."sequence")
      from "better_supabase"."production_order_operations" y where y."order_id" = v_row."id"), '[]'::jsonb),
    'components', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('componentId', y."id", 'variantId', y."variant_id",
        'quantity', "better_supabase"."production_quantity"(y."variant_id", y."quantity" * v_row."quantity" / x."quantity" * (1 + y."scrap_bps" / 10000.0))::text,
        'allocated', coalesce(al."allocated", 0)::text, 'backordered', coalesce(al."backordered", 0)::text,
        'consumed', coalesce((select sum(z."quantity") from "better_supabase"."production_consumptions" z
          where z."order_id" = v_row."id" and z."variant_id" = y."variant_id"), 0)::text)
      order by y."position", y."id")
      from "better_supabase"."boms" x join "better_supabase"."bom_components" y on y."bom_id" = x."id"
      left join "better_supabase"."stock_allocations" al on al."tenant_id" = v_row."tenant_id"
        and al."document_type" = 'production_order' and al."document_id" = v_row."id"::text
        and al."line_id" = y."id"::text and al."status" = 'open'
      where x."id" = v_row."bom_id"), '[]'::jsonb),
    'consumptions', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', z."id", 'variantId', z."variant_id", 'lotId', z."lot_id",
        'serial', z."serial", 'quantity', z."quantity"::text, 'cost', z."cost"::text, 'currency', z."currency",
        'movementId', z."movement_id", 'createdAt', z."created_at") order by z."created_at", z."id")
      from "better_supabase"."production_consumptions" z where z."order_id" = v_row."id"), '[]'::jsonb)));
end;
functions.complete_statement:

begin
  select * into v_req from "better_supabase"."signature_requests" x where x."id" = get_signature_request.request_id;

  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or coalesce(auth.uid() = any (v_req."signers"), false) or (coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'signatures.read'), false) and case v_req."subject_type"
    when 'message' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."messages" s where s."id" = (v_req."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_req."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_req."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)

        when 'deals.won_count' then (select count(*) from "better_supabase"."deals" d where d."tenant_id" = x."tenant_id" and d."outcome" = 'won' and d."closed_at"::date between x."period_start" and x."period_end"

      when 'qualification_type' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."qualification_types" s where s."id" = (grant_guest_access.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'risk' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."risks" s where s."id" = (grant_guest_access.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'case' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."cases" s where s."id" = (grant_guest_access.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'inspection' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."inspections" s where s."id" = (grant_guest_access.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'inspection_program' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."inspection_programs" s where s."id" = (grant_guest_access.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'inspection_finding' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."inspection_findings" s where s."id" = (grant_guest_access.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'form' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."forms" s where s."id" = (grant_guest_access.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'production_order' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."production_orders" s where s."id" = (grant_guest_access.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'work_center' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."work_centers" s where s."id" = (grant_guest_access.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'care_plan' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."care_plans" s where s."id" = (grant_guest_access.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'incident' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."incidents" s where s."id" = (grant_guest_access.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'content_entry' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."content_entries" s where s."id" = (grant_guest_access.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'document' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."documents" s where s."id" = (grant_guest_access.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'customer' then (select s."organization_id"::text from "public"."customers" s where s."id" = (grant_guest_access.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'drive_node' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" s where s."id" = (grant_guest_access.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'application' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."applications" s where s."id" = (grant_guest_access.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'change_request' then (select s."organization_id"::text from "public"."change_requests" s where s."id" = (grant_guest_access.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'project' then (select s."organization_id"::text from "public"."projects" s where s."id" = (grant_guest_access.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'task' then (select s."organization_id"::text from "public"."tasks" s where s."id" = (grant_guest_access.subject_id)::uuid)
      else null::text
    end)
    end) is distinct from v_guest."tenant_id"::text then
    raise exception 'the record does not exist in this organization' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'GUEST_SUBJECT_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  insert into "better_supabase"."guest_grants" as y ("tenant_id", "guest_id", "subject_type", "subject_id", "actions", "granted_by", "expires_at")
  values (v_guest."tenant_id", v_guest."id", grant_guest_access.subject_type, grant_guest_access.subject_id, v_actions, auth.uid(), grant_guest_access.expires_at)
  on conflict ("guest_id", "subject_type", "subject_id") do update set
    "actions" = excluded."actions",
    "granted_by" = excluded."granted_by",
    "expires_at" = excluded."expires_at",
    "updated_at" = now()
  returning * into v_row;
  perform "better_supabase".emit_event('guest_grant.created', jsonb_build_object('organizationId', v_row."tenant_id"::text, 'id', v_row."id", 'guestId', v_row."guest_id", 'subjectType', v_row."subject_type", 'subjectId', v_row."subject_id", 'actions', to_jsonb(v_row."actions")), 'guest-grants/' || v_row."id"::text, (v_row."tenant_id")::text, null, 'better-supabase/guests');
  perform better_supabase.audit_event(
    event_type => 'guest_grant.created',
    category => 'access',
    target_type => 'guest_grant',
    record_id => v_row."id"::text,
    summary => 'granted guest access to ' || v_row."subject_type" || '/' || v_row."subject_id",
    tenant => (v_row."tenant_id")::uuid,
    metadata => jsonb_build_object('organizationId', v_row."tenant_id"::text, 'id', v_row."id", 'guestId', v_row."guest_id", 'subjectType', v_row."subject_type", 'subjectId', v_row."subject_id", 'actions', to_jsonb(v_row."actions"))
  );
  return jsonb_build_object('id', v_row."id", 'organizationId', v_row."tenant_id"::text, 'guestId', v_row."guest_id", 'subjectType', v_row."subject_type", 'subjectId', v_row."subject_id", 'actions', to_jsonb(v_row."actions"), 'grantedBy', v_row."granted_by", 'expiresAt', v_row."expires_at", 'createdAt', v_row."created_at", 'updatedAt', v_row."updated_at");
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.idle_ai_sandboxes(batch integer DEFAULT 50, lease_seconds integer DEFAULT 300)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_rows jsonb;
begin
  with due as (
    select y."id" from "better_supabase"."ai_sandboxes" y
    where ((y."status" = 'running' and (y."last_used_at" + make_interval(secs => y."idle_seconds") <= now() or y."expires_at" <= now()))
       or (y."status" = 'stopping' and y."updated_at" <= now() - make_interval(secs => greatest(idle_ai_sandboxes.lease_seconds, 1))))
      and not exists (
        select 1 from "better_supabase"."ai_harness_sessions" z
        where z."chat_id" = y."chat_id" and z."harness_id" = y."harness_id" and z."locked_until" > now()
      )
    order by y."last_used_at"
    limit least(greatest(idle_ai_sandboxes.batch, 1), 500)
    for update skip locked
  ), claimed as (
    update "better_supabase"."ai_sandboxes" x set "status" = 'stopping', "updated_at" = now()
    from due where x."id" = due."id"
    returning x.*
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', claimed."id", 'organization_id', claimed."organization_id", 'user_id', claimed."user_id", 'chat_id', claimed."chat_id", 'harness_id', claimed."harness_id", 'provider', claimed."provider", 'sandbox_id', claimed."sandbox_id", 'container_id', claimed."container_id", 'status', claimed."status", 'metadata', claimed."metadata", 'idle_seconds', claimed."idle_seconds", 'error', claimed."error", 'last_used_at', claimed."last_used_at", 'expires_at', claimed."expires_at", 'stopped_at', claimed."stopped_at", 'created_at', claimed."created_at", 'updated_at', claimed."updated_at")), '[]') into v_rows from claimed;
  return v_rows;
end;
$function$
functions.argument_types: batch integer DEFAULT 50, lease_seconds integer DEFAULT 300

begin

  insert into "better_supabase"."message_record_mentions" ("tenant_id", "message_id", "conversation_id", "subject_type", "subject_id", "created_at")
  select m."tenant_id", m."id", m."conversation_id", r.subject_type, r.subject_id, m."sent_at"

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.index_record_mentions(message uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  delete from "better_supabase"."message_record_mentions" x where x."message_id" = index_record_mentions.message;
  insert into "better_supabase"."message_record_mentions" ("tenant_id", "message_id", "conversation_id", "subject_type", "subject_id", "created_at")
  select m."tenant_id", m."id", m."conversation_id", r.subject_type, r.subject_id, m."sent_at"
  from "better_supabase"."messages" m

    from jsonb_array_elements("better_supabase"."parse_mentions"(m."body") -> 'subjects') s
    where s ->> 'type' = any ("better_supabase"."subject_types"())

  ) r
  where m."id" = index_record_mentions.message

  on conflict do nothing;

functions.definition:
declare
  preview jsonb;
  invitation uuid;
begin
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'status', case
    when i."accepted_at" is not null then 'accepted'
    when i."declined_at" is not null then 'declined'
    when i."revoked_at" is not null then 'revoked'
    when i."expires_at" < now() then 'expired'
    else 'pending'
  end,
    'email', i."email",
    'role', i."role",
    'tenant', i."organization_id",
    'expires_at', i."expires_at",
    'organization', (select jsonb_build_object('id', o."id", 'name', o."name")
      from "public"."organizations" o where o."id" = i."organization_id"),
    'prefill', '{}'::jsonb
  ), i."id"
  into preview, invitation
  from "better_supabase"."invitations" i
  where i."token_hash" = encode(extensions.digest(invitation_preview.token, 'sha256'), 'hex');
  if preview is null then
    select jsonb_build_object(
    'status', case
    when i."accepted_at" is not null then 'accepted'
    when i."declined_at" is not null then 'declined'
    when i."revoked_at" is not null then 'revoked'
    when i."expires_at" < now() then 'expired'
    else 'pending'
  end,
    'email', i."email",
    'role', i."role",
    'tenant', null,
    'expires_at', i."expires_at",
    'organization', null,
    'prefill', '{}'::jsonb
  ), i."id"
    into preview, invitation
    from "better_supabase"."platform_invitations" i
    where i."token_hash" = encode(extensions.digest(invitation_preview.token, 'sha256'), 'hex');
  end if;
  if preview is not null then
    preview := preview || "better_supabase"."invitation_extra"(invitation);
  end if;
  return preview;
end;
