functions.name: invoice_from_time
functions.definition:
declare
  v_scope jsonb := coalesce(invoice_from_time.scope, '{}'::jsonb);
  v_currency text := upper(invoice_from_time.attrs ->> 'currency');
  v_currencies text[];
  v_unrated integer;
  v_lines jsonb;
  v_entries jsonb;
  v_total bigint;
  v_invoice jsonb;
begin
  if not (better_supabase.actor_may_write()) then
    raise exception 'This session is read-only' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'ACTOR_READ_ONLY';
  end if;
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', invoice_from_time.tenant, 'billable_time.invoice'), false)) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to invoice time' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'BILLABLE_TIME_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  if invoice_from_time.group_by not in ('subject', 'member', 'entry') then
    raise exception 'group_by is subject, member or entry' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'BILLABLE_TIME_GROUPING_INVALID';
  end if;
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('billable_time:' || invoice_from_time.tenant::text, 0));
  select count(*) filter (where u.rate is null), array_agg(distinct u.currency) filter (where u.rate is not null)
    into v_unrated, v_currencies
  from (
    select x."id" as id, x."user_id" as user_id, x."subject_type" as subject_type, x."subject_id" as subject_id,
      x."started_at" as started_at, x."note" as note, extract(epoch from x."ended_at" - x."started_at") as seconds,
      coalesce(x."rate", card.rate) as rate, coalesce(x."rate_currency", card.currency) as currency
    from "better_supabase"."time_entries" x
    left join lateral (
      select c."rate" as rate, c."currency"::text as currency
      from "better_supabase"."time_rates" c
      where c."tenant_id" = x."tenant_id"
        and (c."user_id" is null or c."user_id" = x."user_id")
        and (c."subject_type" is null or (c."subject_type" = x."subject_type" and c."subject_id" = x."subject_id"))
        and c."effective_from" <= (x."started_at" at time zone 'UTC')::date
      order by (c."subject_type" is not null) desc, (c."user_id" is not null) desc, c."effective_from" desc
      limit 1
    ) card on x."rate" is null
    where x."tenant_id" = invoice_from_time.tenant
      and x."billable" and x."ended_at" is not null
      and not exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."time_invoice_entries" d where d."entry_id" = x."id")
      and (v_scope -> 'subject' is null or (x."subject_type" = v_scope -> 'subject' ->> 'type' and x."subject_id" = v_scope -> 'subject' ->> 'id'))
      and (v_scope ->> 'userId' is null or x."user_id" = (v_scope ->> 'userId')::uuid)
      and (v_scope ->> 'starts' is null or x."started_at" >= (v_scope ->> 'starts')::timestamptz)
      and (v_scope ->> 'ends' is null or x."started_at" < (v_scope ->> 'ends')::timestamptz)
      and (v_scope -> 'entryIds' is null or x."id"::text in (select jsonb_array_elements_text(v_scope -> 'entryIds')))) u;
  if v_unrated > 0 then
    raise exception 'some billable entries have no rate; set one on the entry or the rate card' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'TIME_RATE_MISSING';
  end if;
  if v_currency is null then
    if coalesce(array_length(v_currencies, 1), 0) > 1 then
      raise exception 'the entries are billed in several currencies; name one' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'BILLABLE_TIME_CURRENCIES';
    end if;
    v_currency := v_currencies[1];
  end if;
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('description', l.description, 'quantity', l.quantity, 'unitAmount', l.rate::text) order by l.first_at), '[]'::jsonb),
    coalesce(jsonb_agg(l.entry_ids), '[]'::jsonb),
    coalesce(sum(round(l.quantity * l.rate)), 0)::bigint
    into v_lines, v_entries, v_total
  from (
    select min(u.started_at) as first_at, u.currency, u.rate,
      round(sum(u.seconds) / 3600.0, 4) as quantity,
      jsonb_agg(u.id order by u.started_at, u.id) as entry_ids,
      case when invoice_from_time.group_by = 'entry' then min(u.user_id::text) end as user_text,
      case when invoice_from_time.group_by = 'member' then min(u.user_id::text) end as member_text,
      min(u.subject_type) as subject_type, min(u.subject_id) as subject_id,
      case
        when invoice_from_time.group_by = 'entry' then coalesce(min(u.note), 'Time on ' || to_char(min(u.started_at) at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD'))
        when min(u.subject_type) is null then 'Time'
        else 'Time on ' || min(u.subject_type) || ' ' || min(u.subject_id)
      end as description
    from (
    select x."id" as id, x."user_id" as user_id, x."subject_type" as subject_type, x."subject_id" as subject_id,
      x."started_at" as started_at, x."note" as note, extract(epoch from x."ended_at" - x."started_at") as seconds,
      coalesce(x."rate", card.rate) as rate, coalesce(x."rate_currency", card.currency) as currency
    from "better_supabase"."time_entries" x
    left join lateral (
      select c."rate" as rate, c."currency"::text as currency
      from "better_supabase"."time_rates" c
      where c."tenant_id" = x."tenant_id"
        and (c."user_id" is null or c."user_id" = x."user_id")
        and (c."subject_type" is null or (c."subject_type" = x."subject_type" and c."subject_id" = x."subject_id"))
        and c."effective_from" <= (x."started_at" at time zone 'UTC')::date
      order by (c."subject_type" is not null) desc, (c."user_id" is not null) desc, c."effective_from" desc
      limit 1
    ) card on x."rate" is null
    where x."tenant_id" = invoice_from_time.tenant
      and x."billable" and x."ended_at" is not null
      and not exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."time_invoice_entries" d where d."entry_id" = x."id")
      and (v_scope -> 'subject' is null or (x."subject_type" = v_scope -> 'subject' ->> 'type' and x."subject_id" = v_scope -> 'subject' ->> 'id'))
      and (v_scope ->> 'userId' is null or x."user_id" = (v_scope ->> 'userId')::uuid)
      and (v_scope ->> 'starts' is null or x."started_at" >= (v_scope ->> 'starts')::timestamptz)
      and (v_scope ->> 'ends' is null or x."started_at" < (v_scope ->> 'ends')::timestamptz)
      and (v_scope -> 'entryIds' is null or x."id"::text in (select jsonb_array_elements_text(v_scope -> 'entryIds')))) u
    where u.rate is not null
    group by u.currency, u.rate, u.subject_type, u.subject_id,
      case when invoice_from_time.group_by in ('member', 'entry') then u.user_id end,
      case when invoice_from_time.group_by = 'entry' then u.id end
    having round(sum(u.seconds) / 3600.0, 4) > 0) l
  where l.currency = v_currency;
  if jsonb_array_length(v_lines) = 0 then
    raise exception 'no unbilled billable time matches' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'BILLABLE_TIME_EMPTY';
  end if;
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.value order by x.value), '[]'::jsonb) into v_entries
  from jsonb_array_elements(v_entries) g, jsonb_array_elements(g.value) x;
  v_invoice := "better_supabase"."create_invoice"(invoice_from_time.tenant,
    (coalesce(invoice_from_time.attrs, '{}'::jsonb) - 'origin') || jsonb_build_object('currency', v_currency,
      'title', coalesce(nullif(trim(invoice_from_time.attrs ->> 'title'), ''), 'Time')), v_lines);
  insert into "better_supabase"."time_invoice_entries" ("entry_id", "tenant_id", "invoice_id", "rate", "currency", "seconds")
  select u.id, invoice_from_time.tenant, (v_invoice ->> 'id')::uuid, u.rate, u.currency, round(u.seconds)::bigint
  from (
    select x."id" as id, x."user_id" as user_id, x."subject_type" as subject_type, x."subject_id" as subject_id,
      x."started_at" as started_at, x."note" as note, extract(epoch from x."ended_at" - x."started_at") as seconds,
      coalesce(x."rate", card.rate) as rate, coalesce(x."rate_currency", card.currency) as currency
    from "better_supabase"."time_entries" x
    left join lateral (
      select c."rate" as rate, c."currency"::text as currency
      from "better_supabase"."time_rates" c
      where c."tenant_id" = x."tenant_id"
        and (c."user_id" is null or c."user_id" = x."user_id")
        and (c."subject_type" is null or (c."subject_type" = x."subject_type" and c."subject_id" = x."subject_id"))
        and c."effective_from" <= (x."started_at" at time zone 'UTC')::date
      order by (c."subject_type" is not null) desc, (c."user_id" is not null) desc, c."effective_from" desc
      limit 1
    ) card on x."rate" is null
    where x."tenant_id" = invoice_from_time.tenant
      and x."billable" and x."ended_at" is not null
      and not exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."time_invoice_entries" d where d."entry_id" = x."id")
      and (v_scope -> 'subject' is null or (x."subject_type" = v_scope -> 'subject' ->> 'type' and x."subject_id" = v_scope -> 'subject' ->> 'id'))
      and (v_scope ->> 'userId' is null or x."user_id" = (v_scope ->> 'userId')::uuid)
      and (v_scope ->> 'starts' is null or x."started_at" >= (v_scope ->> 'starts')::timestamptz)
      and (v_scope ->> 'ends' is null or x."started_at" < (v_scope ->> 'ends')::timestamptz)
      and (v_scope -> 'entryIds' is null or x."id"::text in (select jsonb_array_elements_text(v_scope -> 'entryIds')))) u
  where u.id::text in (select jsonb_array_elements_text(v_entries));
  perform "better_supabase".emit_event('time_entry.invoiced', jsonb_build_object('organizationId', invoice_from_time.tenant, 'invoiceId', v_invoice ->> 'id', 'entryIds', v_entries, 'currency', v_currency, 'total', v_total::text), 'invoices/' || (v_invoice ->> 'id'), (invoice_from_time.tenant::text)::text, null, 'better-supabase/billable-time');
  perform better_supabase.audit_event(
    event_type => 'time_entry.invoiced',
    category => 'billing',
    target_type => 'invoice',
    record_id => v_invoice ->> 'id',
    summary => 'invoiced time',
    tenant => (invoice_from_time.tenant::text)::uuid,
    metadata => jsonb_build_object('organizationId', invoice_from_time.tenant, 'invoiceId', v_invoice ->> 'id', 'entryIds', v_entries, 'currency', v_currency, 'total', v_total::text)
  );
  return jsonb_build_object('invoiceId', v_invoice ->> 'id', 'currency', v_currency, 'total', v_total::text, 'entryIds', v_entries);
end;

  v_invoice := "better_supabase"."create_invoice"(invoice_from_time.tenant,
    (coalesce(invoice_from_time.attrs, '{}'::jsonb) - 'origin') || jsonb_build_object('currency', v_currency,
      'title', coalesce(nullif(trim(invoice_from_time.attrs ->> 'title'), ''), 'Time')), v_lines);
  insert into "better_supabase"."time_invoice_entries" ("entry_id", "tenant_id", "invoice_id", "rate", "currency", "seconds")
  select u.id, invoice_from_time.tenant, (v_invoice ->> 'id')::uuid, u.rate, u.currency, round(u.seconds)::bigint
  from (
    select x."id" as id, x."user_id" as user_id, x."subject_type" as subject_type, x."subject_id" as subject_id,
      x."started_at" as started_at, x."note" as note, extract(epoch from x."ended_at" - x."started_at") as seconds,
      coalesce(x."rate", card.rate) as rate, coalesce(x."rate_currency", card.currency) as currency
    from "better_supabase"."time_entries" x
    left join lateral (
      select c."rate" as rate, c."currency"::text as currency
      from "better_supabase"."time_rates" c
      where c."tenant_id" = x."tenant_id"
        and (c."user_id" is null or c."user_id" = x."user_id")
        and (c."subject_type" is null or (c."subject_type" = x."subject_type" and c."subject_id" = x."subject_id"))
        and c."effective_from" <= (x."started_at" at time zone 'UTC')::date
      order by (c."subject_type" is not null) desc, (c."user_id" is not null) desc, c."effective_from" desc
      limit 1
    ) card on x."rate" is null
    where x."tenant_id" = invoice_from_time.tenant
      and x."billable" and x."ended_at" is not null
      and not exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."time_invoice_entries" d where d."entry_id" = x."id")
      and (v_scope -> 'subject' is null or (x."subject_type" = v_scope -> 'subject' ->> 'type' and x."subject_id" = v_scope -> 'subject' ->> 'id'))
      and (v_scope ->> 'userId' is null or x."user_id" = (v_scope ->> 'userId')::uuid)
      and (v_scope ->> 'starts' is null or x."started_at" >= (v_scope ->> 'starts')::timestamptz)
      and (v_scope ->> 'ends' is null or x."started_at" < (v_scope ->> 'ends')::timestamptz)
      and (v_scope -> 'entryIds' is null or x."id"::text in (select jsonb_array_elements_text(v_scope -> 'entryIds')))) u
  where u.id::text in (select jsonb_array_elements_text(v_entries));
  perform "better_supabase".emit_event('time_entry.invoiced', jsonb_build_object('organizationId', invoice_from_time.tenant, 'invoiceId', v_invoice ->> 'id', 'entryIds', v_entries, 'currency', v_currency, 'total', v_total::text), 'invoices/' || (v_invoice ->> 'id'), (invoice_from_time.tenant::text)::text, null, 'better-supabase/billable-time');
  perform better_supabase.audit_event(
    event_type => 'time_entry.invoiced',
    category => 'billing',
    target_type => 'invoice',
    record_id => v_invoice ->> 'id',
    summary => 'invoiced time',
    tenant => (invoice_from_time.tenant::text)::uuid,
    metadata => jsonb_build_object('organizationId', invoice_from_time.tenant, 'invoiceId', v_invoice ->> 'id', 'entryIds', v_entries, 'currency', v_currency, 'total', v_total::text)
  );
  return jsonb_build_object('invoiceId', v_invoice ->> 'id', 'currency', v_currency, 'total', v_total::text, 'entryIds', v_entries);
end;
$function$

 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER

begin

  return exists (
    select 1 from "better_supabase"."subject_members" m

      and (m."user_id" = auth.uid() or (m."team_id" is not null and m."team_id" in (select "better_supabase"."team_ids_of"(auth.uid()))))
        and (m."starts_on" is null or m."starts_on" <= current_date)
        and (m."ends_on" is null or m."ends_on" >= current_date)
        and (m."ends_at" is null or m."ends_at" > now())
  );
end;

functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.issue_pass(tenant uuid, kind text DEFAULT 'ticket'::text, holder_user uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, holder_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, holder_email text DEFAULT NULL::text, subject_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, subject_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, booking_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, resource_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, uses_allowed integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, valid_from timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, valid_until timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  v_row "better_supabase"."passes"%rowtype;
  v_resource uuid := issue_pass.resource_id;
  v_until timestamptz := issue_pass.valid_until;
  v_booking "better_supabase"."bookings"%rowtype;
begin
  if not (better_supabase.actor_may_write()) then
    raise exception 'This session is read-only' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'ACTOR_READ_ONLY';
  end if;
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', issue_pass.tenant, 'passes.manage'), false)) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to issue passes' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'PASS_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  if (issue_pass.subject_type is null) <> (issue_pass.subject_id is null) then
    raise exception 'pass both subject_type and subject_id, or neither' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'PASS_SUBJECT_INVALID';
  end if;
  if issue_pass.subject_type is not null
    and (case issue_pass.subject_type
      when 'message' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."messages" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'conversation' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."conversations" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'channel' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."channels" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'company' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."companies" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'person' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."people" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'deal' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."deals" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'course' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."courses" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'post' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."posts" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'activity' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."activities" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'quote' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."quotes" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'work_item' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."work_items" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'employee' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."employees" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'invoice' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."invoices" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'ledger_account' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."ledger_accounts" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'product' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."products" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'product_variant' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."product_variants" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'order' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."orders" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'calendar_event' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."calendar_events" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'booking' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."bookings" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'asset' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."assets" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'asset_location' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."asset_locations" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'lease' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."leases" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'expense_report' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."expense_reports" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'expense_line' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."expense_lines" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'donation_fund' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."donation_funds" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'work_order' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."work_orders" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'shipment' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."shipments" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'contract' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."contracts" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'control' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."controls" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'compliance_policy' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."compliance_policies" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'qualification_type' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."qualification_types" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'risk' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."risks" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'case' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."cases" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'inspection' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."inspections" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'inspection_program' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."inspection_programs" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'inspection_finding' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."inspection_findings" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'form' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."forms" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'production_order' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."production_orders" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'work_center' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."work_centers" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'care_plan' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."care_plans" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'incident' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."incidents" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'content_entry' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."content_entries" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'document' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."documents" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'customer' then (select s."organization_id"::text from "public"."customers" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'drive_node' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'application' then (select s."tenant_id"::text from "better_supabase"."applications" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'change_request' then (select s."organization_id"::text from "public"."change_requests" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'project' then (select s."organization_id"::text from "public"."projects" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      when 'task' then (select s."organization_id"::text from "public"."tasks" s where s."id" = (issue_pass.subject_id)::uuid)
      else null::text
    end) is distinct from issue_pass.tenant::text then
    raise exception 'the record does not exist in this organization' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'PASS_SUBJECT_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  if issue_pass.holder_user is not null and not exists (select 1 from auth.users u where u.id = issue_pass.holder_user) then
    raise exception 'the holder does not exist' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'PASS_HOLDER_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  if issue_pass.booking_id is not null then
    select * into v_booking from "better_supabase"."bookings" bk
      where bk."id" = issue_pass.booking_id and bk."tenant_id" = issue_pass.tenant;
    if not found then
      raise exception 'the booking does not exist in this organization' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'PASS_BOOKING_NOT_FOUND';
    end if;
    if v_booking."status" = 'cancelled' then
      raise exception 'the booking is cancelled' using errcode = '55000', hint = 'PASS_BOOKING_CANCELLED';
    end if;
    if issue_pass.resource_id is not null and issue_pass.resource_id <> v_booking."resource_id" then
      raise exception 'the booking is for another resource' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'PASS_RESOURCE_MISMATCH';
    end if;
    v_resource := v_booking."resource_id";
    v_until := coalesce(v_until, upper(v_booking."during"));
  elsif issue_pass.resource_id is not null then
    if not exists (
      select 1 from "better_supabase"."booking_resources" rs
      where rs."id" = issue_pass.resource_id and rs."tenant_id" = issue_pass.tenant
    ) then
      raise exception 'the resource does not exist in this organization' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'PASS_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND';
    end if;
  end if;
  if v_until is not null and v_until <= coalesce(issue_pass.valid_from, now()) then
    raise exception 'valid_until must be after valid_from and in the future' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'PASS_VALIDITY_INVALID';
  end if;
  insert into "better_supabase"."passes" ("tenant_id", "kind", "holder_user_id", "holder_name", "holder_email", "subject_type", "subject_id", "booking_id", "resource_id", "uses_allowed", "valid_from", "valid_until", "nonce", "issued_by")
  values (issue_pass.tenant, coalesce(issue_pass.kind, 'ticket'), issue_pass.holder_user, issue_pass.holder_name, lower(btrim(issue_pass.holder_email)),
    issue_pass.subject_type, issue_pass.subject_id, issue_pass.booking_id, v_resource,
    case when issue_pass.booking_id is not null then coalesce(issue_pass.uses_allowed, 1) else issue_pass.uses_allowed end,
    coalesce(issue_pass.valid_from, now()), v_until, encode(extensions.gen_random_bytes(16), 'hex'), auth.uid())
  returning * into v_row;
  perform "better_supabase".emit_event('pass.issued', jsonb_build_object('organizationId', v_row."tenant_id"::text, 'id', v_row."id", 'kind', v_row."kind", 'holderUserId', v_row."holder_user_id", 'bookingId', v_row."booking_id"), 'passes/' || v_row."id"::text, (v_row."tenant_id")::text, null, 'better-supabase/passes');
  perform better_supabase.audit_event(
    event_type => 'pass.issued',
    category => 'access',
    target_type => 'pass',
    record_id => v_row."id"::text,
    summary => 'issued pass ' || v_row."kind",
    tenant => (v_row."tenant_id")::uuid,
    metadata => jsonb_build_object('organizationId', v_row."tenant_id"::text, 'id', v_row."id", 'kind', v_row."kind", 'holderUserId', v_row."holder_user_id", 'bookingId', v_row."booking_id")
  );
  return jsonb_build_object('id', v_row."id", 'organizationId', v_row."tenant_id"::text, 'kind', v_row."kind", 'holderUserId', v_row."holder_user_id", 'holderName', v_row."holder_name", 'holderEmail', v_row."holder_email", 'subjectType', v_row."subject_type", 'subjectId', v_row."subject_id", 'bookingId', v_row."booking_id", 'resourceId', v_row."resource_id", 'usesAllowed', v_row."uses_allowed", 'uses', v_row."uses", 'validFrom', v_row."valid_from", 'validUntil', v_row."valid_until", 'status', v_row."status", 'issuedBy', v_row."issued_by", 'createdAt', v_row."created_at", 'updatedAt', v_row."updated_at", 'revokedAt', v_row."revoked_at") || jsonb_build_object('nonce', v_row."nonce");
end;
$function$

functions.name: kitchen_queue
functions.definition:
select coalesce(jsonb_agg(ticket order by ticket ->> 'sentAt', ticket ->> 'orderId'), '[]'::jsonb)
  from (
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'orderId', o."id",
      'number', o."number",
      'sentAt', min(p."queued_at"),
      'lines', jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('lineId', p."order_line_id", 'orderId', p."order_id", 'stationId', p."station_id", 'title', l."title", 'sku', l."sku", 'quantity', l."quantity", 'position', l."position", 'state', p."state", 'note', p."note", 'queuedAt', p."queued_at", 'startedAt', p."started_at", 'readyAt', p."ready_at", 'servedAt', p."served_at") order by l."position", l."id")
    ) as ticket
    from "better_supabase"."order_line_preparations" p
    join "better_supabase"."order_lines" l on l."id" = p."order_line_id"
    join "better_supabase"."orders" o on o."id" = p."order_id"
    where p."tenant_id" = kitchen_queue.tenant
      and (kitchen_queue.station is null or p."station_id" = kitchen_queue.station)
      and p."state" = any (coalesce(kitchen_queue.states, array['queued', 'preparing', 'ready']))
    group by o."id", o."number"
    order by min(p."queued_at"), o."id"
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(kitchen_queue.page_size, 100), 1), 500)
  ) tickets
functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.kitchen_queue(tenant uuid, station uuid, states text[], page_size integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(ticket order by ticket ->> 'sentAt', ticket ->> 'orderId'), '[]'::jsonb)
  from (
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'orderId', o."id",
      'number', o."number",
      'sentAt', min(p."queued_at"),
      'lines', jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('lineId', p."order_line_id", 'orderId', p."order_id", 'stationId', p."station_id", 'title', l."title", 'sku', l."sku", 'quantity', l."quantity", 'position', l."position", 'state', p."state", 'note', p."note", 'queuedAt', p."queued_at", 'startedAt', p."started_at", 'readyAt', p."ready_at", 'servedAt', p."served_at") order by l."position", l."id")
    ) as ticket
    from "better_supabase"."order_line_preparations" p
    join "better_supabase"."order_lines" l on l."id" = p."order_line_id"
    join "better_supabase"."orders" o on o."id" = p."order_id"
    where p."tenant_id" = kitchen_queue.tenant
      and (kitchen_queue.station is null or p."station_id" = kitchen_queue.station)
      and p."state" = any (coalesce(kitchen_queue.states, array['queued', 'preparing', 'ready']))
    group by o."id", o."number"
    order by min(p."queued_at"), o."id"
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(kitchen_queue.page_size, 100), 1), 500)
  ) tickets
$function$

functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.knowledge_search(tenant uuid, query_embedding vector DEFAULT NULL::vector, query_text text DEFAULT NULL::text, scopes jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb, k integer DEFAULT 8, filter jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb, collections uuid[] DEFAULT NULL::uuid[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  previous_scan text := current_setting('hnsw.iterative_scan', true);
  v_candidates integer := least(greatest(knowledge_search.k, 1) * 4, 400);
  v_scopes jsonb := case when jsonb_typeof(knowledge_search.scopes) = 'object' then knowledge_search.scopes -> 'items' else knowledge_search.scopes end;
  v_rows jsonb;
begin
  perform set_config('hnsw.iterative_scan', 'relaxed_order', true);
  with docs as materialized (
    select x."id" as id, x."title" as title, coalesce((select kc."priority" from "better_supabase"."knowledge_collections" kc where kc."id" = x."collection_id"), 0) as priority from "better_supabase"."knowledge_documents" x
    where (x."organization_id" = knowledge_search.tenant or x."organization_id" is null)
      and (x."collection_id" is null or exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."knowledge_collections" kc where kc."id" = x."collection_id" and kc."visibility" <> 'disabled'))
      and (knowledge_search.collections is null or x."collection_id" = any(knowledge_search.collections))
      and (v_scopes is null or exists (
        select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(v_scopes) s
        where s.value ->> 'scope' = x."scope"
          and (s.value ->> 'scope' = 'subject' or s.value ->> 'id' is null or (s.value ->> 'id')::uuid = x."scope_id")
          and (s.value ->> 'scope' <> 'subject' or ((s.value ->> 'type' is null or s.value ->> 'type' = x."subject_type") and (s.value ->> 'id' is null or s.value ->> 'id' = x."subject_id")))
      ))
      and (knowledge_search.filter is null or x."metadata" @> knowledge_search.filter)
  ),
  vector_hits as materialized (
    select t."document_id" as document_id, t."idx" as idx, t."embedding" operator(extensions.<=>) knowledge_search.query_embedding as distance
    from "better_supabase"."knowledge_chunks" t
    where knowledge_search.query_embedding is not null and t."embedding" is not null
      and t."document_id" in (select docs.id from docs)
    order by t."embedding" operator(extensions.<=>) knowledge_search.query_embedding
    limit v_candidates
  ),
  vector_ranked as (
    select h.document_id, h.idx, row_number() over (order by h.distance) as rank from vector_hits h
  ),
  text_hits as materialized (
    select t."document_id" as document_id, t."idx" as idx, ts_rank_cd(t."tsv", q) as text_score
    from "better_supabase"."knowledge_chunks" t, websearch_to_tsquery('simple'::regconfig, knowledge_search.query_text) q
    where knowledge_search.query_text is not null and t."tsv" @@ q
      and t."document_id" in (select docs.id from docs)
    order by text_score desc
    limit v_candidates
  ),
  text_ranked as (
    select x.document_id, x.idx, row_number() over (order by x.text_score desc) as rank from text_hits x
  ),
  fused as (
    select coalesce(v.document_id, x.document_id) as document_id, coalesce(v.idx, x.idx) as idx,
      coalesce(1.0 / (60 + v.rank), 0) + coalesce(1.0 / (60 + x.rank), 0) as score
    from vector_ranked v full join text_ranked x on x.document_id = v.document_id and x.idx = v.idx
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('document_id', r.document_id, 'idx', r.idx, 'content', r.content, 'metadata', r.metadata, 'title', r.title, 'score', r.score) order by r.priority desc, r.score desc, r.document_id, r.idx), '[]')
  into v_rows
  from (
    select f.document_id, f.idx, t."content" as content, t."metadata" as metadata, docs.title, docs.priority, f.score
    from fused f
    join "better_supabase"."knowledge_chunks" t on t."document_id" = f.document_id and t."idx" = f.idx
    join docs on docs.id = f.document_id
    order by docs.priority desc, f.score desc, f.document_id, f.idx
    limit least(greatest(knowledge_search.k, 1), 100)
  ) r;
  perform set_config('hnsw.iterative_scan', coalesce(previous_scan, 'off'), true);
  return v_rows;
end;
$function$

functions.definition:
with recursive g as (
    select (select v."graph" from "better_supabase"."workflow_versions" v where v."id" = lifecycle_graph.version_id) as graph
  ),
  nodes as (
    select n.value ->> 'id' as id, n.value ->> 'kind' as kind,
      case when jsonb_typeof(n.value -> 'config' -> 'stage') = 'string' then n.value -> 'config' ->> 'stage' end as stage,
      case when jsonb_typeof(n.value -> 'config' -> 'returnsTo') = 'array' then n.value -> 'config' -> 'returnsTo' else '[]'::jsonb end as back,
      n.ord
    from g, jsonb_array_elements(case when jsonb_typeof(g.graph -> 'nodes') = 'array' then g.graph -> 'nodes' else '[]'::jsonb end) with ordinality n (value, ord)
  ),
  edges as (
    select e.value ->> 'source' as source, e.value ->> 'target' as target
    from g, jsonb_array_elements(case when jsonb_typeof(g.graph -> 'edges') = 'array' then g.graph -> 'edges' else '[]'::jsonb end) e (value)
  ),
  walk (origin, node, depth) as (
    select o.id, e.target, 1
    from nodes o join edges e on e.source = o.id
    where o.stage is not null or o.kind = 'trigger'
    union
    select w.origin, e.target, w.depth + 1
    from walk w
    join nodes m on m.id = w.node and m.stage is null
    join edges e on e.source = w.node
    where w.depth < 100
  ),
  reached as (
    select o.kind as origin_kind, o.stage as from_stage, t.stage as to_stage, min(w.depth) as depth, min(t.ord) as ord
    from walk w
    join nodes o on o.id = w.origin
    join nodes t on t.id = w.node
    where t.stage is not null
    group by o.kind, o.stage, t.stage
  ),
  stages as (
    select n.stage, min(n.ord) as ord from nodes n where n.stage is not null group by n.stage
  ),
  moves as (
    select r.from_stage, r.to_stage from reached r
    where r.from_stage is not null and r.from_stage <> r.to_stage
    union
    select n.stage, b.value #>> '{}'
    from nodes n, jsonb_array_elements(n.back) b (value)
    where n.stage is not null and jsonb_typeof(b.value) = 'string'
      and b.value #>> '{}' <> n.stage
      and exists (select 1 from stages s where s.stage = b.value #>> '{}')
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'initial', coalesce(
      (select n.stage from nodes n where n.kind = 'trigger' and n.stage is not null order by n.ord limit 1),
      (select r.to_stage from reached r where r.origin_kind = 'trigger' and r.from_stage is null order by r.depth, r.ord limit 1),
      (select s.stage from stages s order by s.ord limit 1)),
    'order', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(s.stage order by s.ord) from stages s), '[]'::jsonb),
    'transitions', coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(m.from_stage, m.targets)
      from (select x.from_stage, jsonb_agg(distinct x.to_stage order by x.to_stage) as targets from moves x group by x.from_stage) m), '{}'::jsonb))
  from g
  where g.graph is not null

  ),
  edges as (

    from g, jsonb_array_elements(case when jsonb_typeof(g.graph -> 'edges') = 'array' then g.graph -> 'edges' else '[]'::jsonb end) e (value)
  ),
  walk (origin, node, depth) as (
    select o.id, e.target, 1
    from nodes o join edges e on e.source = o.id
    where o.stage is not null or o.kind = 'trigger'
    union
    select w.origin, e.target, w.depth + 1
    from walk w
    join nodes m on m.id = w.node and m.stage is null
    join edges e on e.source = w.node
    where w.depth < 100
  ),
  reached as (
    select o.kind as origin_kind, o.stage as from_stage, t.stage as to_stage, min(w.depth) as depth, min(t.ord) as ord
    from walk w
    join nodes o on o.id = w.origin
    join nodes t on t.id = w.node
    where t.stage is not null
    group by o.kind, o.stage, t.stage
  ),
  stages as (
    select n.stage, min(n.ord) as ord from nodes n where n.stage is not null group by n.stage
  ),
  moves as (
    select r.from_stage, r.to_stage from reached r
    where r.from_stage is not null and r.from_stage <> r.to_stage
    union
    select n.stage, b.value #>> '{}'
    from nodes n, jsonb_array_elements(n.back) b (value)
    where n.stage is not null and jsonb_typeof(b.value) = 'string'
      and b.value #>> '{}' <> n.stage
      and exists (select 1 from stages s where s.stage = b.value #>> '{}')
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'initial', coalesce(
      (select n.stage from nodes n where n.kind = 'trigger' and n.stage is not null order by n.ord limit 1),
      (select r.to_stage from reached r where r.origin_kind = 'trigger' and r.from_stage is null order by r.depth, r.ord limit 1),
      (select s.stage from stages s order by s.ord limit 1)),
    'order', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(s.stage order by s.ord) from stages s), '[]'::jsonb),
    'transitions', coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(m.from_stage, m.targets)
      from (select x.from_stage, jsonb_agg(distinct x.to_stage order by x.to_stage) as targets from moves x group by x.from_stage) m), '{}'::jsonb))
  from g

functions.definition:
select coalesce(jsonb_agg(item order by created desc), '[]'::jsonb)
  from (
    select jsonb_build_object('id', r."id", 'organizationId', r."tenant_id", 'userId', r."user_id", 'role', r."role", 'target', r."target", 'subjectType', r."subject_type", 'subjectId', r."subject_id", 'action', r."action", 'emergency', r."emergency", 'review', case when r."reviewed_at" is null then null else jsonb_build_object('verdict', r."review_verdict", 'note', r."review_note", 'reviewedBy', r."reviewed_by", 'reviewedAt', r."reviewed_at") end, 'previousRole', r."previous_role", 'reason', r."reason", 'duration', r."duration"::text, 'status', case when r."ended_at" is not null then 'ended' when r."granted_at" is not null then 'granted' else coalesce(x."status", 'pending') end, 'approvalId', r."approval_id", 'grantedAt', r."granted_at", 'expiresAt', r."expires_at", 'endedAt', r."ended_at", 'createdAt', r."created_at") as item, r."created_at" as created
    from "better_supabase"."access_requests" r
    left join "better_supabase"."approval_requests" x on x."id" = r."approval_id"
    where r."tenant_id" = list_access_requests.tenant
      and (r."user_id" = auth.uid() or (not list_access_requests.mine and (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', list_access_requests.tenant, 'access_requests.read'), false))))
      and (list_access_requests.status is null or case when r."ended_at" is not null then 'ended' when r."granted_at" is not null then 'granted' else coalesce(x."status", 'pending') end = list_access_requests.status)
      and (list_access_requests.before is null or r."created_at" < list_access_requests.before)
    order by r."created_at" desc
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(list_access_requests.page_size, 50), 1), 200)
  ) items

    select jsonb_build_object('id', r."id", 'organizationId', r."tenant_id", 'userId', r."user_id", 'role', r."role", 'target', r."target", 'subjectType', r."subject_type", 'subjectId', r."subject_id", 'action', r."action", 'emergency', r."emergency", 'review', case when r."reviewed_at" is null then null else jsonb_build_object('verdict', r."review_verdict", 'note', r."review_note", 'reviewedBy', r."reviewed_by", 'reviewedAt', r."reviewed_at") end, 'previousRole', r."previous_role", 'reason', r."reason", 'duration', r."duration"::text, 'status', case when r."ended_at" is not null then 'ended' when r."granted_at" is not null then 'granted' else coalesce(x."status", 'pending') end, 'approvalId', r."approval_id", 'grantedAt', r."granted_at", 'expiresAt', r."expires_at", 'endedAt', r."ended_at", 'createdAt', r."created_at") as item, r."created_at" as created
    from "better_supabase"."access_requests" r
    left join "better_supabase"."approval_requests" x on x."id" = r."approval_id"
    where r."tenant_id" = list_access_requests.tenant
      and (r."user_id" = auth.uid() or (not list_access_requests.mine and (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', list_access_requests.tenant, 'access_requests.read'), false))))
      and (list_access_requests.status is null or case when r."ended_at" is not null then 'ended' when r."granted_at" is not null then 'granted' else coalesce(x."status", 'pending') end = list_access_requests.status)
      and (list_access_requests.before is null or r."created_at" < list_access_requests.before)
    order by r."created_at" desc
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(list_access_requests.page_size, 50), 1), 200)
  ) items
$function$
functions.argument_types: tenant uuid, status text DEFAULT NULL::text, mine boolean DEFAULT false, page_size integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, before timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone

functions.name: list_acknowledgement_assignments
list_activity
functions.definition:
declare
  v_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(list_activity.max_rows, 50), 1), 500);
  v_rows jsonb;
  v_table text;
begin
  if list_activity.subject_id is not null and list_activity.subject_type = any ('{message,conversation,channel,company,person,deal,course,post,activity,quote,work_item,employee,invoice,ledger_account,product,product_variant,order,calendar_event,booking,asset,asset_location,lease,expense_report,expense_line,donation_fund,work_order,shipment,contract,control,compliance_policy,qualification_type,risk,case,inspection,inspection_program,inspection_finding,form,production_order,work_center,care_plan,incident,content_entry,document,customer,drive_node,application,change_request,project,task}'::text[])
    and not "better_supabase"."activity_subject_readable"(list_activity.subject_type, list_activity.subject_id) then
    return '[]'::jsonb;
  end if;
  if list_activity.subject_id is not null then
    v_table := case list_activity.subject_type
      when 'message' then 'better_supabase.messages'
      when 'conversation' then 'better_supabase.conversations'
      when 'channel' then 'better_supabase.channels'
      when 'company' then 'better_supabase.companies'
      when 'person' then 'better_supabase.people'
      when 'deal' then 'better_supabase.deals'
      when 'course' then 'better_supabase.courses'
      when 'post' then 'better_supabase.posts'
      when 'activity' then 'better_supabase.activities'
      when 'quote' then 'better_supabase.quotes'
      when 'work_item' then 'better_supabase.work_items'
      when 'employee' then 'better_supabase.employees'
      when 'invoice' then 'better_supabase.invoices'
      when 'ledger_account' then 'better_supabase.ledger_accounts'
      when 'product' then 'better_supabase.products'
      when 'product_variant' then 'better_supabase.product_variants'
      when 'order' then 'better_supabase.orders'
      when 'calendar_event' then 'better_supabase.calendar_events'
      when 'booking' then 'better_supabase.bookings'
      when 'asset' then 'better_supabase.assets'
      when 'asset_location' then 'better_supabase.asset_locations'
      when 'lease' then 'better_supabase.leases'
      when 'expense_report' then 'better_supabase.expense_reports'
      when 'expense_line' then 'better_supabase.expense_lines'
      when 'donation_fund' then 'better_supabase.donation_funds'
      when 'work_order' then 'better_supabase.work_orders'
      when 'shipment' then 'better_supabase.shipments'
      when 'contract' then 'better_supabase.contracts'
      when 'control' then 'better_supabase.controls'
      when 'compliance_policy' then 'better_supabase.compliance_policies'
      when 'qualification_type' then 'better_supabase.qualification_types'
      when 'risk' then 'better_supabase.risks'
      when 'case' then 'better_supabase.cases'
      when 'inspection' then 'better_supabase.inspections'
      when 'inspection_program' then 'better_supabase.inspection_programs'
      when 'inspection_finding' then 'better_supabase.inspection_findings'
      when 'form' then 'better_supabase.forms'
      when 'production_order' then 'better_supabase.production_orders'
      when 'work_center' then 'better_supabase.work_centers'
      when 'care_plan' then 'better_supabase.care_plans'
      when 'incident' then 'better_supabase.incidents'
      when 'content_entry' then 'better_supabase.content_entries'
      when 'document' then 'better_supabase.documents'
      when 'customer' then 'public.customers'
      when 'drive_node' then 'better_supabase.drive_nodes'
      when 'application' then 'better_supabase.applications'
      when 'change_request' then 'public.change_requests'
      when 'project' then 'public.projects'
      when 'task' then 'public.tasks'
    end;
  end if;
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.entry order by x.at desc, x.id desc), '[]'::jsonb)
  into v_rows
  from (
    select u.entry, u.at, u.id from (
    (select to_jsonb(y.*) || jsonb_build_object('source', 'event') as entry,
      y."occurred_at" as at, y."id"::text as id
    from "better_supabase"."timeline_entries" y
    where y."organization_id" = list_activity.tenant
      and (list_activity.sources is null or 'event' = any (list_activity.sources))
      and (list_activity.subject_type is null or y."subject_type" = list_activity.subject_type)
      and (list_activity.subject_id is null or y."subject_id" = list_activity.subject_id)
      and (list_activity.before is null or y."occurred_at" < list_activity.before)
      and not ((y."type" = 'status.changed' and list_activity.subject_id is not null
      and list_activity.subject_type = any ('{message,conversation,channel,company,person,deal,course,post,activity,quote,work_item,employee,invoice,ledger_account,product,product_variant,order,calendar_event,booking,asset,asset_location,lease,expense_report,expense_line,donation_fund,work_order,shipment,contract,control,compliance_policy,qualification_type,risk,case,inspection,inspection_program,inspection_finding,form,production_order,work_center,care_plan,incident,content_entry,document,customer,drive_node,application,change_request,project,task}'::text[])
      and list_activity.subject_type = any ('{work_item,change_request,drive_node}'::text[])
      and (list_activity.sources is null or 'transition' = any (list_activity.sources)))
        or (y."type" in ('message.sent', 'comment.posted') and list_activity.subject_id is not null
      and list_activity.subject_type = any ('{message,conversation,channel,company,person,deal,course,post,activity,quote,work_item,employee,invoice,ledger_account,product,product_variant,order,calendar_event,booking,asset,asset_location,lease,expense_report,expense_line,donation_fund,work_order,shipment,contract,control,compliance_policy,qualification_type,risk,case,inspection,inspection_program,inspection_finding,form,production_order,work_center,care_plan,incident,content_entry,document,customer,drive_node,application,change_request,project,task}'::text[])
      and (list_activity.sources is null or 'message' = any (list_activity.sources))))
    order by y."occurred_at" desc, y."id" desc
    limit v_limit)
    union all
    (select jsonb_build_object('id', l."id"::text, 'organization_id', l."organization_id", 'event_id', null::text, 'type', coalesce(l."event_type", 'audit.' || l."op"), 'actor_id', l."actor_id", 'subject_type', list_activity.subject_type, 'subject_id', list_activity.subject_id, 'summary', l."summary", 'data', jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('op', l."op", 'changed', to_jsonb(l."changed"), 'table', l."table_name")), 'occurred_at', l."occurred_at", 'source', 'audit') as entry,
      l."occurred_at" as at, l."id"::text as id
    from "better_supabase"."audit_events" l
    where v_table is not null
      and (list_activity.sources is null or 'audit' = any (list_activity.sources))
      and l."table_name" = v_table
      and l."record_id" = list_activity.subject_id
      and l."organization_id" = list_activity.tenant
      and (list_activity.before is null or l."occurred_at" < list_activity.before)
    order by l."occurred_at" desc, l."id" desc
    limit v_limit)
    union all
    (select jsonb_build_object('id', r."id"::text, 'organization_id', r."tenant_id", 'event_id', null::text, 'type', 'run.' || r."status", 'actor_id', r."actor_id", 'subject_type', list_activity.subject_type, 'subject_id', list_activity.subject_id, 'summary', null::text, 'data', jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('runId', r."id", 'definition', r."definition", 'engine', r."engine", 'status', r."status", 'mode', r."mode", 'error', r."error"::text, 'completedAt', r."completed_at")), 'occurred_at', r."created_at", 'source', 'run') as entry,
      r."created_at" as at, r."id"::text as id
    from "better_supabase"."workflow_runs" r
    where list_activity.subject_id is not null
      and list_activity.subject_type = any ('{message,conversation,channel,company,person,deal,course,post,activity,quote,work_item,employee,invoice,ledger_account,product,product_variant,order,calendar_event,booking,asset,asset_location,lease,expense_report,expense_line,donation_fund,work_order,shipment,contract,control,compliance_policy,qualification_type,risk,case,inspection,inspection_program,inspection_finding,form,production_order,work_center,care_plan,incident,content_entry,document,customer,drive_node,application,change_request,project,task}'::text[])
      and (list_activity.sources is null or 'run' = any (list_activity.sources))
      and r."tenant_id" = list_activity.tenant
      and r."subject_type" = list_activity.subject_type
      and r."subject_id" = list_activity.subject_id
      and (list_activity.before is null or r."created_at" < list_activity.before)
    order by r."created_at" desc, r."id" desc
    limit v_limit)
    union all

    from "better_supabase"."boms" x where x."tenant_id" = list_boms.tenant
      and (list_boms.variant is null or x."variant_id" = list_boms.variant)), '[]'::jsonb);
end;

  from "better_supabase"."calendar_events" e
  where e."calendar_id" = any (list_calendar_events.calendar_ids)
    and e."starts_at" < list_calendar_events.range_end
    and (
      (e."rrule" is null and e."recurrence_id" is null and e."ends_at" > list_calendar_events.range_start)
      or e."rrule" is not null
      or (e."recurrence_id" is not null and (e."ends_at" > list_calendar_events.range_start or e."original_start" >= list_calendar_events.range_start - interval '1 year'))
    )

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.list_companies(tenant uuid, search text, lifecycle text, owner uuid, after_name text, after_id uuid, page_size integer, role text DEFAULT NULL::text, supplier_status text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_like text := '%' || replace(replace(replace(coalesce(list_companies.search, ''), '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%';
begin
  return coalesce((
    select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) || jsonb_build_object('roles', p."roles", 'payment_terms_days', p."payment_terms_days", 'credit_currency', p."credit_currency", 'credit_limit', p."credit_limit"::text, 'supplier_status', p."supplier_status") order by lower(p."name"), p."id")
    from (
      select x.* from "better_supabase"."companies" x
      where x."tenant_id" = list_companies.tenant
        and x."archived_at" is null
        and (list_companies.search is null or x."name" ilike v_like or x."domain" ilike v_like)
        and (list_companies.lifecycle is null or x."lifecycle" = list_companies.lifecycle)
        and (list_companies.owner is null or x."owner_user_id" = list_companies.owner)
        and (list_companies.role is null or list_companies.role = any (x."roles"))
        and (list_companies.supplier_status is null or x."supplier_status" = list_companies.supplier_status)
        and (list_companies.after_name is null or (lower(x."name"), x."id") > (lower(list_companies.after_name), list_companies.after_id))
      order by lower(x."name"), x."id"
      limit least(greatest(coalesce(list_companies.page_size, 50), 1), 200)
    ) p
  ), '[]'::jsonb);
end;
$function$

functions.name: list_controls
functions.definition:
select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.doc order by x.framework, x.code), '[]'::jsonb)
  from (
    select y."framework_id" as framework, y."code" as code, jsonb_build_object('id', y."id", 'organizationId', y."tenant_id", 'frameworkId', y."framework_id", 'code', y."code", 'title', y."title", 'description', y."description", 'ownerId', y."owner_id", 'applicable', y."applicable", 'source', y."source", 'jurisdiction', y."jurisdiction", 'status', case
    when not y."applicable" then 'not_applicable'
    when exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."evidence_tasks" st where st."control_id" = y."id" and (st."active" and st."due_on" < current_date)) then 'failing'
    when exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."control_evidence" se where se."control_id" = y."id" and (se."valid_until" is null or se."valid_until" >= current_date)) then 'passing'
    when exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."control_evidence" se where se."control_id" = y."id") then 'failing'
    else 'not_started'
  end, 'createdAt', y."created_at", 'updatedAt', y."updated_at") as doc
    from "better_supabase"."controls" y
    where y."tenant_id" = list_controls.tenant
      and (list_controls.framework_id is null or y."framework_id" = list_controls.framework_id)
      and (list_controls.owner_id is null or y."owner_id" = list_controls.owner_id)
      and (list_controls.status is null or case
    when not y."applicable" then 'not_applicable'
    when exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."evidence_tasks" st where st."control_id" = y."id" and (st."active" and st."due_on" < current_date)) then 'failing'
    when exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."control_evidence" se where se."control_id" = y."id" and (se."valid_until" is null or se."valid_until" >= current_date)) then 'passing'
    when exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."control_evidence" se where se."control_id" = y."id") then 'failing'
    else 'not_started'
  end = list_controls.status)
    order by y."framework_id", y."code"
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(list_controls.page_size, 200), 1), 1000)
  ) x

functions.name: list_conversations
functions.definition:
select coalesce(jsonb_agg(
    to_jsonb(c) || jsonb_build_object(
      'unread', u.unread,
      'mentions', u.mentions,
      'lastReadAt', k."last_read_at",
      'notify', k."notify"
    ) order by c."last_message_at" desc nulls last, c."id"), '[]'::jsonb)
  from (
    select c.* from "better_supabase"."conversations" c
    join "better_supabase"."conversation_members" k on k."conversation_id" = c."id" and k."user_id" = auth.uid()
    where c."tenant_id" = list_conversations.tenant
      and (list_conversations.kinds is null and c."kind" <> 'inbox' or c."kind" = any (list_conversations.kinds))
    order by c."last_message_at" desc nulls last, c."id"
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(list_conversations.max_rows, 100), 1), 500)
  ) c
  join "better_supabase"."conversation_members" k on k."conversation_id" = c."id" and k."user_id" = auth.uid()
  cross join lateral (
    select count(*) as unread,
      count(*) filter (where auth.uid() = any (m."mentions") or m."mention_scope" is not null) as mentions
    from "better_supabase"."messages" m
    where m."conversation_id" = c."id"
      and (m."thread_id" is null or m."broadcast")
      and m."sent_at" > coalesce(k."last_read_at", '-infinity'::timestamptz)
      and m."deleted_at" is null
      and m."author_id" is distinct from auth.uid()
  ) u
functions.complete_statement:

functions.name: list_document_suggestions
functions.definition:
#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  v_doc "better_supabase"."documents"%rowtype;
begin
  select * into v_doc from "better_supabase"."documents" d where d."id" = list_document_suggestions.document_id;
  if not found or not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or (coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'documents.read'), false) and case v_doc."subject_type"
    when 'message' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."messages" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'conversation' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."conversations" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'channel' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."channels" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'company' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."companies" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'contacts.read'), false)
    when 'person' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."people" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'contacts.read'), false)

    when 'content_entry' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."content_entries" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'content.read'), false)
    when 'document' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."documents" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'documents.read'), false)
    when 'customer' then exists (select 1 from "public"."customers" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."organization_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'customers.read'), false)
    when 'drive_node' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id" and (coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'drive.read'), false) and coalesce("better_supabase"."drive_node_readable"(s."id"), false)))
    when 'application' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."applications" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'hiring.read'), false)
    when 'change_request' then exists (select 1 from "public"."change_requests" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."organization_id" = v_doc."tenant_id")
    when 'project' then exists (select 1 from "public"."projects" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."organization_id" = v_doc."tenant_id")
    when 'task' then exists (select 1 from "public"."tasks" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."organization_id" = v_doc."tenant_id")
    else false
  end)) then
    raise exception 'document not found' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  return (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', x."id", 'number', x."number", 'label', x."label", 'source', x."source", 'frozen', x."frozen", 'createdBy', x."created_by", 'createdAt', x."created_at") order by x."number" desc), '[]'::jsonb)
    from "better_supabase"."versions" x
    where x."subject_type" = 'document' and x."subject_id" = v_doc."id"::text
  );
end;
$function$

begin
  return (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg("better_supabase"."inbox_conversation_json"(page."id") || jsonb_build_object('unread', page.unread) order by page."last_message_at" desc, page."id" desc), '[]'::jsonb)
    from (
      select v."id", v."last_message_at",
        v."last_message_at" > coalesce((select k."last_read_at" from "better_supabase"."conversation_members" k where k."conversation_id" = v."id" and k."user_id" = (select auth.uid())), '-infinity'::timestamptz) as unread
      from "better_supabase"."inbox_conversations" v
      where (list_inbox_conversations.tenant is null or v."tenant_id" = list_inbox_conversations.tenant)
        and (filter ->> 'inbox_id' is null or v."inbox_id" = (filter ->> 'inbox_id')::uuid)
        and (coalesce(filter ->> 'status', 'open') = 'all' or v."status" = coalesce(filter ->> 'status', 'open'))
        and (case filter ->> 'assignee'
          when 'me' then v."assignee_id" = (select auth.uid())
          when 'unassigned' then v."assignee_id" is null
          else filter ->> 'assignee' is null or v."assignee_id" = (filter ->> 'assignee')::uuid end)
        and (filter ->> 'team_id' is null or v."team_id" = (filter ->> 'team_id')::uuid)
        and (filter ->> 'contact_id' is null or v."contact_id" = (filter ->> 'contact_id')::uuid)
        and (nullif(filter ->> 'search', '') is null
          or v."subject" ilike '%' || (filter ->> 'search') || '%'
          or v."last_message_preview" ilike '%' || (filter ->> 'search') || '%'
          or "better_supabase"."inbox_contact_json"(v."id") ->> 'name' ilike '%' || (filter ->> 'search') || '%'
          or "better_supabase"."inbox_contact_json"(v."id") ->> 'email' ilike '%' || (filter ->> 'search') || '%')
        and (filter -> 'before' is null
          or (v."last_message_at", v."id") < ((filter -> 'before' ->> 'last_message_at')::timestamptz, (filter -> 'before' ->> 'id')::uuid))
      order by v."last_message_at" desc, v."id" desc
      limit least(greatest(coalesce((filter ->> 'limit')::integer, 50), 1), 200)
    ) page
  );
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.list_inbox_messages(conversation uuid, before timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, max integer DEFAULT 50, after timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not "better_supabase"."inbox_conversation_allowed"(list_inbox_messages.conversation::text) then
    return '[]'::jsonb;
  end if;
  return "better_supabase"."inbox_messages_json"(array(
    select m."id" from "better_supabase"."messages" m
    where m."conversation_id" = list_inbox_messages.conversation
      and m."sent_at" is not null
      and (list_inbox_messages.before is null or m."sent_at" < list_inbox_messages.before)
      and (list_inbox_messages.after is null or m."sent_at" > list_inbox_messages.after)
      and (m."kind" = 'message' or "better_supabase"."inbox_note_readable"(list_inbox_messages.conversation))
    order by
      case when list_inbox_messages.after is null then m."sent_at" end desc,
      case when list_inbox_messages.after is null then m."id" end desc,
      m."sent_at", m."id"
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(list_inbox_messages.max, 50), 1), 200)
  ));
end;

functions.definition:
select coalesce(jsonb_agg(row_json order by started desc, id desc), '[]'::jsonb)
  from (
    select jsonb_build_object('id', x."id", 'organizationId', x."tenant_id", 'title', x."title", 'description', x."description", 'severity', x."severity", 'status', x."status", 'public', x."public", 'commanderId', x."commander_id", 'startedAt', x."started_at", 'resolvedAt', x."resolved_at", 'createdBy', x."created_by", 'createdAt', x."created_at", 'updatedAt', x."updated_at", 'impacts', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('componentId', im."component_id", 'name', ic."name", 'impact', im."impact") order by ic."position", ic."name"), '[]'::jsonb) from "better_supabase"."incident_impacts" im join "better_supabase"."incident_status_components" ic on ic."id" = im."component_id" where im."incident_id" = x."id")) as row_json, x."started_at" as started, x."id" as id
    from "better_supabase"."incidents" x
    where x."tenant_id" = list_incidents.tenant
      and (list_incidents.status is null
        or (list_incidents.status = 'open' and x."status" <> 'resolved')
        or (list_incidents.status = 'resolved' and x."status" = 'resolved'))
      and (list_incidents.severity is null or x."severity" = list_incidents.severity)
      and (list_incidents.component_id is null or exists (
        select 1 from "better_supabase"."incident_impacts" y where y."incident_id" = x."id" and y."component_id" = list_incidents.component_id
      ))
      and (list_incidents.before is null or x."started_at" < list_incidents.before)
    order by x."started_at" desc, x."id" desc
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(list_incidents.page_size, 50), 1), 200)
  ) page

    select jsonb_build_object('id', x."id", 'organizationId', x."tenant_id", 'title', x."title", 'description', x."description", 'severity', x."severity", 'status', x."status", 'public', x."public", 'commanderId', x."commander_id", 'startedAt', x."started_at", 'resolvedAt', x."resolved_at", 'createdBy', x."created_by", 'createdAt', x."created_at", 'updatedAt', x."updated_at", 'impacts', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('componentId', im."component_id", 'name', ic."name", 'impact', im."impact") order by ic."position", ic."name"), '[]'::jsonb) from "better_supabase"."incident_impacts" im join "better_supabase"."incident_status_components" ic on ic."id" = im."component_id" where im."incident_id" = x."id")) as row_json, x."started_at" as started, x."id" as id
    from "better_supabase"."incidents" x
    where x."tenant_id" = list_incidents.tenant
      and (list_incidents.status is null

        or (list_incidents.status = 'resolved' and x."status" = 'resolved'))
      and (list_incidents.severity is null or x."severity" = list_incidents.severity)
      and (list_incidents.component_id is null or exists (
        select 1 from "better_supabase"."incident_impacts" y where y."incident_id" = x."id" and y."component_id" = list_incidents.component_id
      ))
      and (list_incidents.before is null or x."started_at" < list_incidents.before)
    order by x."started_at" desc, x."id" desc
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(list_incidents.page_size, 50), 1), 200)
  ) page
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.list_my_acknowledgements(tenant uuid, pending_only boolean DEFAULT true)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_me uuid := auth.uid();
begin
  if v_me is null or not exists (
    select 1 from "public"."memberships" m where m."organization_id" = list_my_acknowledgements.tenant and m."user_id" = v_me
  ) then
    raise exception 'not a member of this organization' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'ACKNOWLEDGEMENT_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  return (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'organizationId', list_my_acknowledgements.tenant,
      'subjectType', z.subject_type,
      'subjectId', z.subject_id,
      'subjectTitle', "better_supabase"."subject_title"(z.subject_type, z.subject_id),
      'versionId', z.version_id,
      'dueOn', z.due_on,
      'overdue', k."id" is null and z.due_on is not null and z.due_on < current_date,
      'acknowledgedAt', k."acknowledged_at"
    ) order by k."id" is not null, z.due_on nulls last, z.subject_type, z.subject_id), '[]'::jsonb)
    from (
      select y.subject_type, y.subject_id, y.version_id,
        ((select vv."created_at" from "better_supabase"."versions" vv where vv."id" = y.version_id))::date + y.due_in_days as due_on
      from (
        select q.subject_type, q.subject_id, q.due_in_days,
          "better_supabase"."current_acknowledgement_version"(list_my_acknowledgements.tenant, q.subject_type, q.subject_id) as version_id
        from (
          select x."subject_type" as subject_type, x."subject_id" as subject_id, min(x."due_in_days") as due_in_days
          from "better_supabase"."acknowledgement_assignments" x
          join "public"."memberships" m on m."organization_id" = x."tenant_id" and m."user_id" = v_me
          where x."tenant_id" = list_my_acknowledgements.tenant and ((x."principal_type" = 'user' and x."principal_id" = m."user_id"::text)
      or (x."principal_type" = 'role' and x."principal_id" in ('*', (select r."key" from "better_supabase"."roles" r where r."id" = m."role")))
      or (x."principal_type" = 'team' and exists (
        select 1 from "better_supabase"."team_members" tm
        where tm."tenant_id" = m."organization_id"
          and tm."user_id" = m."user_id"
          and tm."team_id"::text = x."principal_id"
      )))
          group by x."subject_type", x."subject_id"
        ) q
        where case q.subject_type
    when 'compliance_policy' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."compliance_policies" s where s."id" = (q.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = list_my_acknowledgements.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', list_my_acknowledgements.tenant, 'compliance.read'), false)
    when 'drive_node' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" s where s."id" = (q.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = list_my_acknowledgements.tenant and (coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', list_my_acknowledgements.tenant, 'drive.read'), false) and coalesce("better_supabase"."drive_node_readable"(s."id"), false)))
    else false
  end
      ) y
      where y.version_id is not null
    ) z
    left join "better_supabase"."acknowledgements" k on k."subject_type" = z.subject_type and k."subject_id" = z.subject_id
      and k."version_id" = z.version_id and k."user_id" = v_me
    where not coalesce(list_my_acknowledgements.pending_only, true) or k."id" is null
  );
end;
$function$
functions.argument_types: tenant uuid, pending_only boolean DEFAULT true

functions.definition:
select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.item order by x.created_at desc, x.id desc), '[]')
  from (
    select jsonb_build_object('id', rc."id", 'event_id', ev."id", 'type', ev."type", 'data', ev."data", 'created_at', rc."created_at", 'read_at', rc."read_at", 'tenant', ev."organization_id", 'actor_id', ev."actor_id", 'subject_type', ev."subject_type", 'subject_id', ev."subject_id", 'subject_label', ev."subject_label", 'summary', ev."summary", 'action_path', ev."action_path", 'actions', ev."actions", 'priority', ev."priority", 'resolved_at', rc."resolved_at", 'resolution', rc."resolution") as item, rc."created_at" as created_at, rc."id" as id
    from "better_supabase"."notification_recipients" rc
    join "better_supabase"."notification_events" ev on ev."id" = rc."event_id"
    where rc."user_id" = auth.uid()
      and case when coalesce(list_notifications.status, 'all') = 'settled' then (rc."resolved_at" is not null or rc."dismissed_at" is not null) when list_notifications.dismissed is null then true else (rc."dismissed_at" is not null) = list_notifications.dismissed end
      and (list_notifications.read is null or (rc."read_at" is not null) = list_notifications.read)
      and (list_notifications.resolved is null or (rc."resolved_at" is not null) = list_notifications.resolved)
      and (list_notifications.tenant is null or rc."organization_id" = list_notifications.tenant)
      and (list_notifications.types is null or ev."type" = any(list_notifications.types))
      and (list_notifications.subject_types is null or ev."subject_type" = any(list_notifications.subject_types))
      and (list_notifications.search is null or btrim(list_notifications.search) = '' or concat_ws(' ', ev."summary", ev."subject_label", ev."type") ilike '%' || replace(replace(replace(btrim(list_notifications.search), chr(92), chr(92) || chr(92)), '%', chr(92) || '%'), '_', chr(92) || '_') || '%')
      and case coalesce(list_notifications.status, 'all')
        when 'unread' then rc."read_at" is null
        when 'read' then rc."read_at" is not null
        when 'unresolved' then rc."resolved_at" is null
        else true
      end
      and (
        list_notifications.before is null
        or (rc."created_at", rc."id") < (list_notifications.before, coalesce(list_notifications.before_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid))
      )
    order by rc."created_at" desc, rc."id" desc
    limit least(coalesce(list_notifications.max_items, 50), 200)
  ) x

 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_like text := '%' || replace(replace(replace(coalesce(list_people.search, ''), '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%';
begin
  return coalesce((
    select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) || jsonb_build_object('roles', p."roles", 'payment_terms_days', p."payment_terms_days", 'credit_currency', p."credit_currency", 'credit_limit', p."credit_limit"::text, 'supplier_status', p."supplier_status") order by lower(p."name"), p."id")
    from (
      select x.* from "better_supabase"."people" x
      where x."tenant_id" = list_people.tenant
        and x."archived_at" is null
        and (list_people.search is null or x."name" ilike v_like or x."email" ilike v_like)
        and (list_people.lifecycle is null or x."lifecycle" = list_people.lifecycle)
        and (list_people.owner is null or x."owner_user_id" = list_people.owner)
        and (list_people.role is null or list_people.role = any (x."roles"))
        and (list_people.supplier_status is null or x."supplier_status" = list_people.supplier_status)
        and (list_people.after_name is null or (lower(x."name"), x."id") > (lower(list_people.after_name), list_people.after_id))
      order by lower(x."name"), x."id"
      limit least(greatest(coalesce(list_people.page_size, 50), 1), 200)
    ) p
  ), '[]'::jsonb);
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.list_posts(tenant uuid, filter jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_variable
declare
  v_filter jsonb := coalesce(list_posts.filter, '{}'::jsonb);
  v_sort text := coalesce(v_filter ->> 'sort', 'active');
begin
  if v_sort not in ('active', 'new', 'top') then
    raise exception 'sort is active, new or top' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'POST_INVALID';
  end if;
  return (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(e.row order by e.n), '[]'::jsonb)
    from (
      select jsonb_build_object('id', x."id", 'organizationId', x."tenant_id", 'boardId', x."board_id", 'authorId', x."author_id", 'mine', coalesce(x."author_id" = (select auth.uid()), false), 'title', x."title", 'body', x."body", 'status', x."status", 'moderation', x."moderation_status", 'pinnedAt', x."pinned_at", 'lockedAt', x."locked_at", 'mergedIntoId', x."merged_into_id", 'replyCount', x."reply_count", 'lastActivityAt', x."last_activity_at", 'createdAt', x."created_at", 'updatedAt', x."updated_at") || jsonb_build_object('votes', jsonb_build_object('score', coalesce(s."score", 0), 'up', coalesce(s."up", 0), 'down', coalesce(s."down", 0), 'vote', coalesce((
      select r."value" from "better_supabase"."reactions" r
      where r."tenant_id" = x."tenant_id" and r."subject_type" = 'post'
        and r."subject_id" = x."id"::text and r."kind" = 'vote'
        and r."user_id" = (select auth.uid())
    ), 0))) as row,
        row_number() over (order by
          case when v_sort = 'active' then x."pinned_at" end desc nulls last,
          case when v_sort = 'top' then coalesce(s."score", 0) end desc,
          case when v_sort = 'active' then x."last_activity_at" end desc,
          x."created_at" desc, x."id") as n
      from "better_supabase"."posts" x
      left join "better_supabase"."reaction_scores" s on s."tenant_id" = x."tenant_id" and s."subject_type" = 'post' and s."subject_id" = x."id"::text
      where x."tenant_id" = list_posts.tenant
        and (v_filter ->> 'boardId' is null or x."board_id" = (v_filter ->> 'boardId')::uuid)
        and (v_filter ->> 'status' is null or x."status" = v_filter ->> 'status')
        and (v_filter ->> 'authorId' is null or x."author_id" = (v_filter ->> 'authorId')::uuid)
        and (coalesce((v_filter ->> 'merged')::boolean, false) or x."merged_into_id" is null)
      order by n
      limit least(greatest(coalesce((v_filter ->> 'limit')::integer, 50), 1), 200)
      offset greatest(coalesce((v_filter ->> 'offset')::integer, 0), 0)
    ) e
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.list_roles(tenant uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or coalesce(better_supabase.member_can(auth.uid(), list_roles.tenant, 'members.read'), false)) then
    raise exception 'Not allowed to read roles' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'PERMISSIONS_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  return coalesce((
    select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', r."id",
      'key', r."key",
      'members', (select count(*) from "public"."memberships" mm where mm."organization_id" = list_roles.tenant and mm."role" = r."id"),
      'default_permissions', coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(p."key" order by p."key")
        from "better_supabase"."role_permissions" x join "better_supabase"."permissions" p on p."id" = x."permission_id"
        where x."role_id" = r."id"
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'permissions', coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(p."key" order by p."key")
        from "better_supabase"."permissions" p
        where coalesce(
          (select bool_and(ov."granted") from "better_supabase"."permission_overrides" ov
            where ov."organization_id" = list_roles.tenant and ov."role_id" = r."id" and ov."permission_id" = p."id"),
          exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."role_permissions" x where x."role_id" = r."id" and x."permission_id" = p."id")
        )
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'overrides', coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('permission', p."key", 'granted', ov."granted") order by p."key")
        from "better_supabase"."permission_overrides" ov join "better_supabase"."permissions" p on p."id" = ov."permission_id"
        where ov."organization_id" = list_roles.tenant and ov."role_id" = r."id"
      ), '[]'::jsonb)
    ) order by r."key")
    from "better_supabase"."roles" r
    where true and r."scope"::text = 'tenant'
  ), '[]'::jsonb);
end;
$function$

begin
  select * into v_row from "better_supabase"."segments" x where x."id" = list_segment_members.segment;

    when 'message' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)
