    when 'company' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'contacts.read'), false)
    when 'person' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'contacts.read'), false)
    when 'deal' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'deals.read'), false)
    when 'course' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'courses.read'), false)
    when 'post' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'posts.read'), false)

    when 'invoice' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'invoices.read'), false)
    when 'ledger_account' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'ledger.read'), false)
    when 'product' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'catalog.read'), false)
    when 'product_variant' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'catalog.read'), false)
    when 'order' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'orders.read'), false)

    when 'asset' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'assets.read'), false)
    when 'asset_location' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'assets.read'), false)
    when 'lease' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'leases.read'), false)
    when 'expense_report' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'expenses.read'), false)
    when 'expense_line' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'expenses.read'), false)
    when 'donation_fund' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'donations.read'), false)
    when 'work_order' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'dispatch.read'), false)
    when 'shipment' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'shipments.read'), false)
    when 'contract' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'contracts.read'), false)
    when 'control' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'compliance.read'), false)
    when 'compliance_policy' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'compliance.read'), false)
    when 'qualification_type' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'qualifications.read'), false)
    when 'risk' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'risks.read'), false)
    when 'case' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'cases.read'), false)
    when 'inspection' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'inspections.read'), false)
    when 'inspection_program' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'inspections.read'), false)
    when 'inspection_finding' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'inspections.read'), false)
    when 'form' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_row."tenant_id", 'forms.read'), false)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.list_shipments(tenant uuid, status text DEFAULT NULL::text, subject_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, subject_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, carrier text DEFAULT NULL::text, before timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, page_size integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
begin
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', list_shipments.tenant, 'shipments.read'), false)) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to read shipments' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'SHIPMENT_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  return (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(z.item order by z.created desc, z.id desc), '[]'::jsonb)
    from (
      select jsonb_build_object('id', x."id", 'organizationId', x."tenant_id"::text, 'reference', x."reference", 'status', x."status", 'from', x."from_address", 'to', x."to_address", 'fromLocationId', x."from_location_id", 'subjectType', x."subject_type", 'subjectId', x."subject_id", 'carrier', x."carrier", 'service', x."service", 'trackingNumber', x."tracking_number", 'trackingUrl', x."tracking_url", 'labelId', x."label_id", 'labelUrl', x."label_url", 'labelFormat', x."label_format", 'labelCost', x."label_cost"::text, 'currency', x."currency", 'labeledAt', x."labeled_at", 'deliveredAt', x."delivered_at", 'cancelledAt', x."cancelled_at", 'createdBy', x."created_by", 'createdAt', x."created_at", 'updatedAt', x."updated_at", 'packages', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', pk."id", 'position', pk."position", 'weightGrams', pk."weight_grams", 'lengthMm', pk."length_mm", 'widthMm', pk."width_mm", 'heightMm', pk."height_mm", 'reference', pk."reference") order by pk."position"), '[]'::jsonb) from "better_supabase"."shipment_packages" pk where pk."shipment_id" = x."id"), 'lines', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', sl."id", 'position', sl."position", 'direction', sl."direction",
    'variantId', sl."variant_id", 'locationId', sl."location_id", 'quantity', sl."quantity"::text, 'allocationId', sl."allocation_id",
    'detail', sl."detail", 'disposition', sl."disposition", 'movementId', sl."movement_id", 'movedAt', sl."moved_at")
    order by sl."position"), '[]'::jsonb) from "better_supabase"."shipment_lines" sl where sl."shipment_id" = x."id")) as item, x."created_at" as created, x."id" as id
      from "better_supabase"."shipments" x
      where x."tenant_id" = list_shipments.tenant
        and (list_shipments.status is null or x."status" = list_shipments.status)
        and (list_shipments.subject_type is null or (x."subject_type" = list_shipments.subject_type and x."subject_id" = list_shipments.subject_id))
        and (list_shipments.carrier is null or x."carrier" = list_shipments.carrier)
        and (list_shipments.before is null or x."created_at" < list_shipments.before)
      order by x."created_at" desc, x."id" desc
      limit least(greatest(coalesce(list_shipments.page_size, 50), 1), 500)
    ) z
  );
end;
$function$

  from (
    select x.*, (select count(*) from "better_supabase"."trash_items" b where b."batch_id" = x."batch_id")::integer as n
    from "better_supabase"."trash_items" x
    where x."tenant_id" = list_trash.tenant
      and x."depth" = 0
      and (list_trash.subject_type is null or x."subject_type" = list_trash.subject_type)

    order by x."trashed_at" desc, x."id"
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(list_trash.page_size, 50), 1), 200)
  ) t;
  return v_rows;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.list_versions(tenant uuid, subject_type text, subject_id text, page_size integer DEFAULT 50, before integer DEFAULT NULL::integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_rows jsonb;
begin
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or (coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', list_versions.tenant, 'versions.read'), false) and case list_versions.subject_type
    when 'project' then exists (select 1 from "public"."projects" s where s."id" = (list_versions.subject_id)::uuid and s."organization_id" = list_versions.tenant)
    when 'customer' then exists (select 1 from "public"."customers" s where s."id" = (list_versions.subject_id)::uuid and s."organization_id" = list_versions.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', list_versions.tenant, 'customers.read'), false)
    else false
  end and list_versions.subject_type <> 'ai_document')) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to read these versions' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'VERSION_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', v."id", 'number', v."number", 'label', v."label", 'source', v."source", 'frozen', v."frozen", 'contentHash', v."content_hash", 'storagePath', v."storage_path", 'subjectType', v."subject_type", 'subjectId', v."subject_id", 'createdBy', v."created_by", 'createdAt', v."created_at") order by v."number" desc), '[]'::jsonb) into v_rows
  from (
    select * from "better_supabase"."versions" x
    where x."tenant_id" = list_versions.tenant
      and x."subject_type" = list_versions.subject_type
      and x."subject_id" = list_versions.subject_id
      and (list_versions.before is null or x."number" < list_versions.before)
    order by x."number" desc
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(list_versions.page_size, 50), 1), 200)
  ) v;
  return v_rows;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.lot_genealogy(lot_id uuid, direction text DEFAULT 'down'::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_tenant uuid;
begin
  select x."tenant_id" into v_tenant from "better_supabase"."stock_lots" x where x."id" = lot_genealogy.lot_id;
  if v_tenant is null or not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or (v_tenant is not null and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_tenant, 'manufacturing.read'), false))) then
    raise exception 'no such lot' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'INVENTORY_LOT_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  if lot_genealogy.direction is null or lot_genealogy.direction not in ('up', 'down') then
    raise exception 'direction is up or down' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'PRODUCTION_ORDER_INVALID';
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('lotId', lot_genealogy.lot_id, 'direction', lot_genealogy.direction,
    'lots', coalesce((with recursive tree(lot, from_lot, order_id, quantity, level, path) as (
      select case when lot_genealogy.direction = 'down' then y."child_lot_id" else y."parent_lot_id" end, lot_genealogy.lot_id,
        y."order_id", y."quantity", 1, array[lot_genealogy.lot_id]
      from "better_supabase"."stock_lot_links" y
      where (lot_genealogy.direction = 'down' and y."parent_lot_id" = lot_genealogy.lot_id)
        or (lot_genealogy.direction = 'up' and y."child_lot_id" = lot_genealogy.lot_id)
      union all
      select case when lot_genealogy.direction = 'down' then y."child_lot_id" else y."parent_lot_id" end, tree.lot,
        y."order_id", y."quantity", tree.level + 1, tree.path || tree.lot
      from tree join "better_supabase"."stock_lot_links" y
        on (lot_genealogy.direction = 'down' and y."parent_lot_id" = tree.lot)
        or (lot_genealogy.direction = 'up' and y."child_lot_id" = tree.lot)
      where tree.level < 20 and not (tree.lot = any (tree.path))
    )
    select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('lotId', l."id", 'code', l."code", 'variantId', l."variant_id", 'expiresOn', l."expires_on") || jsonb_build_object('level', t.level, 'fromLotId', t.from_lot, 'orderId', t.order_id,
      'quantity', t.quantity::text) order by t.level, l."code")
    from tree t join "better_supabase"."stock_lots" l on l."id" = t.lot), '[]'::jsonb));
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.lot_recall(lot_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_tenant uuid;
  v_lots uuid[];
begin
  select x."tenant_id" into v_tenant from "better_supabase"."stock_lots" x where x."id" = lot_recall.lot_id;
  if v_tenant is null or not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or (v_tenant is not null and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_tenant, 'manufacturing.read'), false))) then
    raise exception 'no such lot' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'INVENTORY_LOT_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  with recursive up(lot, level, path) as (
    select lot_recall.lot_id, 0, array[lot_recall.lot_id]
    union all
    select y."parent_lot_id", up.level + 1, up.path || y."parent_lot_id"
    from up join "better_supabase"."stock_lot_links" y on y."child_lot_id" = up.lot
    where up.level < 20 and not (y."parent_lot_id" = any (up.path))
  )
  select array_agg(distinct up.lot) into v_lots from up;
  return jsonb_build_object('lotId', lot_recall.lot_id,
    'lots', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('lotId', l."id", 'code', l."code", 'variantId', l."variant_id", 'expiresOn', l."expires_on") order by l."code") from "better_supabase"."stock_lots" l where l."id" = any (v_lots)), '[]'::jsonb),
    'stock', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('lotId', y."lot_id", 'variantId', y."variant_id", 'locationId', y."location_id",
        'binId', y."bin_id", 'onHand', y."on_hand"::text) order by y."lot_id", y."location_id")
      from "better_supabase"."stock_buckets" y where y."lot_id" = any (v_lots) and y."on_hand" > 0), '[]'::jsonb),
    'documents', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('referenceType', d.reference_type, 'referenceId', d.reference_id,
        'lotId', d.lot, 'variantId', d.variant, 'quantity', d.quantity::text, 'at', d.at) order by d.at, d.reference_id)
      from (select t."reference_type" as reference_type, t."reference_id" as reference_id,
          (y."metadata" ->> 'lotId')::uuid as lot, (y."metadata" ->> 'variantId')::uuid as variant,
          sum(-e."amount" / power(10::numeric, y."scale")) as quantity, min(t."effective_at") as at
        from "better_supabase"."ledger_transactions" t
        join "better_supabase"."ledger_entries" e on e."transaction_id" = t."id"
        join "better_supabase"."ledger_accounts" y on y."id" = e."account_id" and y."kind" = 'stock'
        where t."tenant_id" = v_tenant and t."kind" in ('stock.sale', 'stock.transfer_out') and t."reference_id" is not null
          and (y."metadata" ->> 'lotId')::uuid = any (v_lots)
        group by 1, 2, 3, 4
        having sum(-e."amount") > 0) d), '[]'::jsonb),
    'orders', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('orderId', o."id", 'number', o."number", 'status', o."status",
        'variantId', o."variant_id", 'outputLotId', o."output_lot_id") order by o."number")
      from "better_supabase"."production_orders" o where o."status" <> 'canceled'
        and exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."production_consumptions" z where z."order_id" = o."id" and z."lot_id" = any (v_lots))), '[]'::jsonb));
end;
$function$

with recursive tree as (
    select x.*, 0 as depth from "better_supabase"."maintenance_requests" x where x."id" = maintenance_request_tree.root
    union all
    select y.*, tree.depth + 1 from "better_supabase"."maintenance_requests" y join tree on y."parent_id" = tree."id"
    where tree.depth < 100 and y."archived_at" is null
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id', tree."id", 'parentId', tree."parent_id", 'identifier', tree."identifier", 'title', tree."title",
    'state', tree."state", 'startAt', tree."start_at", 'endAt', tree."end_at", 'dueAt', tree."due_at",
    'locked', tree."locked", 'depth', tree.depth,
    'progress', coalesce(tree."progress", (
      select case when count(*) filter (where ch."state" <> 'canceled') = 0 then
          case tree."state" when 'completed' then 100 else 0 end
        else round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where ch."state" = 'completed') / count(*) filter (where ch."state" <> 'canceled'))::integer end
      from "better_supabase"."maintenance_requests" ch where ch."parent_id" = tree."id" and ch."archived_at" is null))
  ) order by tree.depth, tree."rank" collate "C", tree."id"), '[]'::jsonb)
  from tree

  perform "better_supabase".emit_event('observation.error_marked', jsonb_build_object('organizationId', v_row."tenant_id", 'observationId', v_row."id", 'definitionKey', v_def."key", 'subjectType', v_row."subject_type", 'subjectId', v_row."subject_id", 'reason', v_reason), 'observations/' || v_row."id"::text, (v_row."tenant_id")::text, null, 'better-supabase/observations');
  perform better_supabase.audit_event(
    event_type => 'observation.error_marked',
    category => 'data',
    target_type => 'observation',
    record_id => v_row."id"::text,
    target_label => v_def."title",
    summary => 'Observation marked entered in error',
    tenant => (v_row."tenant_id")::uuid,
    metadata => jsonb_build_object('organizationId', v_row."tenant_id", 'observationId', v_row."id", 'definitionKey', v_def."key", 'subjectType', v_row."subject_type", 'subjectId', v_row."subject_id", 'reason', v_reason)
  );
  declare
    v_hook regprocedure := to_regprocedure('"public"."after_observation_mark_error"(uuid)');
  begin
    if v_hook is not null then
      execute format('select %s($1::uuid)', v_hook::oid::regproc)
        using v_row."id";
    end if;
  end;
  return jsonb_build_object('id', v_row."id", 'organizationId', v_row."tenant_id", 'definitionId', v_row."definition_id", 'definitionKey', v_def."key", 'title', v_def."title", 'valueType', v_def."value_type", 'unit', v_def."unit", 'subjectType', v_row."subject_type", 'subjectId', v_row."subject_id", 'observedAt', v_row."observed_at", 'value', case v_def."value_type"
      when 'boolean' then to_jsonb(v_row."value_code" = 'true')
      when 'code' then to_jsonb(v_row."value_code")
      when 'text' then to_jsonb(v_row."value_text")
      when 'components' then v_row."components"
      else to_jsonb(v_row."value_number")
    end, 'flag', v_row."flag", 'status', v_row."status", 'replacesId', v_row."replaces_id", 'reason', v_row."reason", 'method', v_row."method", 'device', v_row."device", 'source', v_row."source", 'externalId', v_row."external_id", 'submissionId', v_row."submission_id", 'performerId', v_row."performer_id", 'note', v_row."note", 'createdAt', v_row."created_at");
end;
$function$

functions.name: match_mail_thread
functions.definition:
declare
  v_thread uuid := match_mail_thread.thread;
  v_tenant uuid;
  v_own text;
  v_addresses text[];
begin
  select x."tenant_id", k."address" into v_tenant, v_own
  from "better_supabase"."mail_threads" x join "better_supabase"."mail_accounts" k on k."id" = x."account_id"
  where x."id" = v_thread;
  select coalesce(array_agg(distinct v.address), '{}') into v_addresses
  from "better_supabase"."mail_messages" y
  cross join lateral unnest(array[y."from_address"] || y."to_addresses" || y."cc_addresses") as v(address)
  where y."thread_id" = v_thread and v.address is not null and v.address <> v_own;
  insert into "better_supabase"."mail_thread_subjects" ("tenant_id", "thread_id", "subject_type", "subject_id")
  select v_tenant, v_thread, 'person', p."id"::text
  from "better_supabase"."people" p
  where p."tenant_id" = v_tenant and p."archived_at" is null
    and lower(p."email") = any (v_addresses)
  on conflict do nothing;
  insert into "better_supabase"."mail_thread_subjects" ("tenant_id", "thread_id", "subject_type", "subject_id")
  select v_tenant, v_thread, 'company', cp."company_id"::text
  from "better_supabase"."company_people" cp
  join "better_supabase"."people" p on p."id" = cp."person_id"
  where p."tenant_id" = v_tenant and p."archived_at" is null
    and lower(p."email") = any (v_addresses)
  on conflict do nothing;
  insert into "better_supabase"."mail_thread_subjects" ("tenant_id", "thread_id", "subject_type", "subject_id")
  select v_tenant, v_thread, 'company', c."id"::text
  from "better_supabase"."companies" c
  where c."tenant_id" = v_tenant and c."archived_at" is null
    and c."domain" is not null
    and lower(c."domain") = any (select split_part(x, '@', 2) from unnest(v_addresses) x)
  on conflict do nothing;
end;

declare

begin
  for v_fn in
    select p.oid::regproc
    from pg_catalog.pg_proc p
    join pg_catalog.pg_description d on d.objoid = p.oid and d.classoid = 'pg_catalog.pg_proc'::regclass and d.objsubid = 0
    where d.description = 'better-supabase:subject-merge'
      -- Only the owner's functions, so a marked function in a schema another
      -- role can write to never runs with this function's rights.
      and p.proowner = (select r.oid from pg_catalog.pg_roles r where r.rolname = current_user)
    order by p.oid::regproc::text
  loop
    execute format('select %s($1, $2, $3)', v_fn) using subject_table, keep, drop;
  end loop;
end;

AS $function$
  with page_rows as (
    select m.* from "better_supabase"."messages" m where m."id" = any (messaging_messages_json.ids)
  ),
  a as (select "better_supabase"."message_authors"(messaging_messages_json.ids) as authors),
  f as (
    select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(g.id, g.files), '{}'::jsonb) as files
    from (
      select a."subject_id" as id, jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', a."id", 'name', a."name", 'mimeType', a."mime_type", 'size', a."size", 'status', a."status") order by a."created_at", a."id") as files
      from "better_supabase"."attachments" a
      where a."subject_type" = 'message'
        and a."subject_id" = any (array(select x::text from unnest(messaging_messages_json.ids) x))
        and a."status" <> 'infected'
      group by a."subject_id"
    ) g
  ),
  r as (
    select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(g.tenant, "better_supabase"."reaction_summary"(g.tenant, 'message', g.ids)), '{}'::jsonb) as reactions
    from (
      select m."tenant_id" as tenant, array_agg(m."id"::text) as ids from page_rows m group by m."tenant_id"
    ) g
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) || jsonb_build_object('author', a.authors -> x.id::text) || jsonb_build_object('attachments', coalesce(f.files -> x.id::text, '[]'::jsonb)) || jsonb_build_object('reactions', coalesce(r.reactions -> x."tenant_id"::text -> x.id::text, '[]'::jsonb)) order by coalesce(x."sent_at", x."scheduled_for", x."created_at"), x."id"), '[]'::jsonb)
  from page_rows x, a, f, r
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.moderation_queue(tenant uuid, status text DEFAULT NULL::text, subject_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, page_size integer DEFAULT 50, before timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  v_rows jsonb;
begin
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', moderation_queue.tenant, 'moderation.read'), false)) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to read the moderation queue' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'MODERATION_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(q.item order by q.updated desc, q.id desc), '[]'::jsonb) into v_rows
  from (
    select jsonb_build_object('id', x."id", 'organizationId', x."tenant_id", 'subjectType', x."subject_type", 'subjectId', x."subject_id", 'authorId', x."author_id", 'status', x."status", 'openReports', x."open_reports", 'reason', x."reason", 'decidedBy', x."decided_by", 'decidedAt', x."decided_at", 'createdAt', x."created_at", 'updatedAt', x."updated_at") as item, x."updated_at" as updated, x."id" as id
    from "better_supabase"."moderation_items" x
    where x."tenant_id" = moderation_queue.tenant
      and (case when moderation_queue.status is null then x."status" = 'pending' or x."open_reports" > 0 else x."status" = moderation_queue.status end)
      and (moderation_queue.subject_type is null or x."subject_type" = moderation_queue.subject_type)
      and (moderation_queue.before is null or x."updated_at" < moderation_queue.before)
    order by x."updated_at" desc, x."id" desc
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(moderation_queue.page_size, 50), 1), 200)
  ) q;
  return v_rows;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.my_subjects(tenant uuid, subject_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, page_size integer DEFAULT 100, cursor text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_me uuid := auth.uid();
  v_size integer := least(greatest(coalesce(my_subjects.page_size, 100), 1), 200);
  v_after_type text := split_part(my_subjects.cursor, ':', 1);
  v_after_id text := substr(my_subjects.cursor, length(split_part(my_subjects.cursor, ':', 1)) + 2);
  v_items jsonb;
  v_count integer;
begin
  if v_me is null then
    return jsonb_build_object('items', '[]'::jsonb, 'nextCursor', null);
  end if;
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'subjectType', p.subject_type, 'subjectId', p.subject_id,
      'organizationId', p.tenant, 'roles', p.roles, 'endsOn', p.ends_on,
      'emergency', p.emergency,
      'title', "better_supabase"."subject_title"(p.subject_type, p.subject_id),
      'url', "better_supabase"."subject_url"(p.subject_type, p.subject_id))
    order by p.subject_type, p.subject_id), '[]'::jsonb), count(*)
  into v_items, v_count
  from (
    select m."subject_type" as subject_type, m."subject_id" as subject_id,
      min(m."tenant_id"::text) as tenant,
      jsonb_agg(distinct m."role") as roles,
      case when bool_or(m."ends_on" is null) then null else max(m."ends_on") end as ends_on,
      bool_or(m."emergency") as emergency
    from "better_supabase"."subject_members" m
    where m."tenant_id" = my_subjects.tenant
      and (my_subjects.subject_type is null or m."subject_type" = my_subjects.subject_type)
      and (my_subjects.cursor is null
        or (m."subject_type", m."subject_id") > (v_after_type, v_after_id))
      and (m."user_id" = v_me or (m."team_id" is not null and m."team_id" in (select "better_supabase"."team_ids_of"(v_me))))
        and (m."starts_on" is null or m."starts_on" <= current_date)
        and (m."ends_on" is null or m."ends_on" >= current_date)
        and (m."ends_at" is null or m."ends_at" > now())
    group by m."subject_type", m."subject_id"
    order by m."subject_type", m."subject_id"
    limit v_size
  ) p;
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'items', v_items,
    'nextCursor', case when v_count = v_size
      then (v_items -> -1 ->> 'subjectType') || ':' || (v_items -> -1 ->> 'subjectId')
      else null end);
end;
$function$
functions.argument_types: tenant uuid, subject_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, page_size integer DEFAULT 100, cursor text DEFAULT NULL::text
functions.identity_argument_types: tenant uuid, subject_type text, page_size integer, cursor text

functions.name: my_work
functions.definition:
declare
  v_me uuid := auth.uid();
begin
  if v_me is null then
    return '[]'::jsonb;
  end if;
  return (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'kind', w.kind,
      'subject', jsonb_build_object('type', w.subject_type, 'id', w.subject_id),
      'ref', w.ref,
      'title', coalesce(w.title, "better_supabase"."subject_title"(w.subject_type, w.subject_id)),
      'url', "better_supabase"."subject_url"(w.subject_type, w.subject_id),
      'at', w.at
    ) order by w.at desc nulls last, w.kind, w.ref), '[]'::jsonb)
    from (
      select * from (
    select 'mention'::text, c."subject_type"::text, c."subject_id"::text, m."id"::text, null::text,
      m."sent_at"
    from "better_supabase"."messages" m
    join "better_supabase"."conversations" c on c."id" = m."conversation_id" and c."kind" = 'subject'
    where v_me = any (m."mentions")
      and m."deleted_at" is null
      and m."sent_at" > now() - interval '30 days'
      and (my_work.tenant is null or m."tenant_id" = my_work.tenant)
    union all
    select 'reminder'::text, d.subject_type, d.subject_id, d.reminder::text, null::text, d.at
    from "better_supabase"."my_reminders_due"(my_work.tenant) d
    where "better_supabase"."can_subject"(d.subject_type, d.subject_id, 'read')
    union all
    select 'approval'::text, r."subject_type"::text, r."subject_id"::text, r."id"::text, null::text,
      r."created_at"
    from "better_supabase"."approval_requests" r
    where r."status" = 'pending'
      and (r."expires_at" is null or r."expires_at" > now())
      and (my_work.tenant is null or r."tenant_id" = my_work.tenant)
      and "better_supabase"."approval_eligible"(r."id")
    union all
    select 'assigned'::text, 'work_item'::text, i."id"::text, i."id"::text, i."title"::text,
      coalesce(i."due_at", a."created_at")
    from "better_supabase"."work_item_assignees" a
    join "better_supabase"."work_items" i on i."id" = a."work_item_id"
    where a."user_id" = v_me
      and i."state" not in ('completed', 'canceled')
      and i."archived_at" is null
      and (my_work.tenant is null or i."tenant_id" = my_work.tenant)
    union all
    select 'assigned'::text, 'maintenance_request'::text, i."id"::text, i."id"::text, i."title"::text,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.my_work(tenant uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, page_size integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_me uuid := auth.uid();
begin
  if v_me is null then
    return '[]'::jsonb;
  end if;
  return (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'kind', w.kind,
      'subject', jsonb_build_object('type', w.subject_type, 'id', w.subject_id),
      'ref', w.ref,
      'title', coalesce(w.title, "better_supabase"."subject_title"(w.subject_type, w.subject_id)),
      'url', "better_supabase"."subject_url"(w.subject_type, w.subject_id),
      'at', w.at
    ) order by w.at desc nulls last, w.kind, w.ref), '[]'::jsonb)
    from (
      select * from (
    select 'mention'::text, c."subject_type"::text, c."subject_id"::text, m."id"::text, null::text,
      m."sent_at"
    from "better_supabase"."messages" m
    join "better_supabase"."conversations" c on c."id" = m."conversation_id" and c."kind" = 'subject'
    where v_me = any (m."mentions")
      and m."deleted_at" is null
      and m."sent_at" > now() - interval '30 days'
      and (my_work.tenant is null or m."tenant_id" = my_work.tenant)
    union all
    select 'reminder'::text, d.subject_type, d.subject_id, d.reminder::text, null::text, d.at
    from "better_supabase"."my_reminders_due"(my_work.tenant) d
    where "better_supabase"."can_subject"(d.subject_type, d.subject_id, 'read')
    union all
    select 'approval'::text, r."subject_type"::text, r."subject_id"::text, r."id"::text, null::text,
      r."created_at"
    from "better_supabase"."approval_requests" r
    where r."status" = 'pending'
      and (r."expires_at" is null or r."expires_at" > now())
      and (my_work.tenant is null or r."tenant_id" = my_work.tenant)
      and "better_supabase"."approval_eligible"(r."id")
    union all
    select 'assigned'::text, 'work_item'::text, i."id"::text, i."id"::text, i."title"::text,
      coalesce(i."due_at", a."created_at")
    from "better_supabase"."work_item_assignees" a
    join "better_supabase"."work_items" i on i."id" = a."work_item_id"
    where a."user_id" = v_me
      and i."state" not in ('completed', 'canceled')
      and i."archived_at" is null
      and (my_work.tenant is null or i."tenant_id" = my_work.tenant)
    union all
    select 'assigned'::text, 'maintenance_request'::text, i."id"::text, i."id"::text, i."title"::text,
      coalesce(i."due_at", a."created_at")
    from "better_supabase"."maintenance_request_assignees" a
    join "better_supabase"."maintenance_requests" i on i."id" = a."maintenance_request_id"
    where a."user_id" = v_me
      and i."state" not in ('completed', 'canceled')
      and i."archived_at" is null
      and (my_work.tenant is null or i."tenant_id" = my_work.tenant)
    union all
    select 'sla'::text, k."subject_type"::text, k."subject_id"::text, k."id"::text, null::text,
      k."due_at"
    from "better_supabase"."sla_clocks" k
    where k."subject_type" = 'work_item'
      and k."warned_at" is not null
      and k."met_at" is null
      and (my_work.tenant is null or k."tenant_id" = my_work.tenant)
      and exists (
        select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_item_assignees" a
        where a."work_item_id"::text = k."subject_id"::text
          and a."user_id" = v_me)
    union all
    select 'owned'::text, 'case'::text, c."id"::text, c."number"::text, c."title"::text,
      coalesce(c."due_on"::timestamptz, c."created_at")
    from "better_supabase"."cases" c
    where c."owner_id" = v_me
      and c."status" = 'open'
      and c."archived_at" is null
      and (my_work.tenant is null or c."tenant_id" = my_work.tenant)
      ) u (kind, subject_type, subject_id, ref, title, at)
      order by u.at desc nulls last, u.kind, u.ref
      limit least(greatest(coalesce(my_work.page_size, 50), 1), 200)
    ) w
  );
end;

    when 'drive_node' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'drive.manage'), false)
    when 'application' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'hiring.write'), false)
    else true
  end)) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to name versions of this document' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'DOCUMENT_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  select x."frozen" into v_frozen from "better_supabase"."versions" x
  where x."id" = name_document_version.version_id
    and x."subject_type" = 'document' and x."subject_id" = v_doc."id"::text
  for update;
  if v_frozen is null then
    raise exception 'version not found' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'DOCUMENT_VERSION_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  if v_frozen then
    raise exception 'a frozen version keeps its name' using errcode = '55000', hint = 'DOCUMENT_VERSION_FROZEN';
  end if;
  update "better_supabase"."versions" x set "label" = nullif(trim(name_document_version.label), '')
  where x."id" = name_document_version.version_id;
  return true;
end;
$function$

functions.name: notification_page
functions.definition:
with matched as (
    select jsonb_build_object('id', rc."id", 'event_id', ev."id", 'type', ev."type", 'data', ev."data", 'created_at', rc."created_at", 'read_at', rc."read_at", 'tenant', ev."organization_id", 'actor_id', ev."actor_id", 'subject_type', ev."subject_type", 'subject_id', ev."subject_id", 'subject_label', ev."subject_label", 'summary', ev."summary", 'action_path', ev."action_path", 'actions', ev."actions", 'priority', ev."priority", 'resolved_at', rc."resolved_at", 'resolution', rc."resolution") as item, rc."created_at" as created_at, rc."id" as id
    from "better_supabase"."notification_recipients" rc
    join "better_supabase"."notification_events" ev on ev."id" = rc."event_id"
    where rc."user_id" = auth.uid()
      and case when coalesce(notification_page.status, 'all') = 'settled' then (rc."resolved_at" is not null or rc."dismissed_at" is not null) when notification_page.dismissed is null then true else (rc."dismissed_at" is not null) = notification_page.dismissed end
      and (notification_page.read is null or (rc."read_at" is not null) = notification_page.read)
      and (notification_page.resolved is null or (rc."resolved_at" is not null) = notification_page.resolved)
      and (notification_page.tenant is null or rc."organization_id" = notification_page.tenant)
      and (notification_page.types is null or ev."type" = any(notification_page.types))
      and (notification_page.subject_types is null or ev."subject_type" = any(notification_page.subject_types))
      and (notification_page.search is null or btrim(notification_page.search) = '' or concat_ws(' ', ev."summary", ev."subject_label", ev."type") ilike '%' || replace(replace(replace(btrim(notification_page.search), chr(92), chr(92) || chr(92)), '%', chr(92) || '%'), '_', chr(92) || '_') || '%')
      and case coalesce(notification_page.status, 'all')
        when 'unread' then rc."read_at" is null
        when 'read' then rc."read_at" is not null
        when 'unresolved' then rc."resolved_at" is null
        else true
      end
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'items', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(p.item order by p.created_at desc, p.id desc)
      from (
        select m.item, m.created_at, m.id from matched m
        order by m.created_at desc, m.id desc
        offset greatest(coalesce(notification_page.skip, 0), 0)
        limit least(greatest(coalesce(notification_page.max_items, 50), 1), 200)
      ) p
    ), '[]'),
    'total', (select count(*) from matched)
  )

    from "better_supabase"."notification_recipients" rc
    join "better_supabase"."notification_events" ev on ev."id" = rc."event_id"
    where rc."user_id" = auth.uid()
      and case when coalesce(notification_page.status, 'all') = 'settled' then (rc."resolved_at" is not null or rc."dismissed_at" is not null) when notification_page.dismissed is null then true else (rc."dismissed_at" is not null) = notification_page.dismissed end
      and (notification_page.read is null or (rc."read_at" is not null) = notification_page.read)
      and (notification_page.resolved is null or (rc."resolved_at" is not null) = notification_page.resolved)
      and (notification_page.tenant is null or rc."organization_id" = notification_page.tenant)
      and (notification_page.types is null or ev."type" = any(notification_page.types))
      and (notification_page.subject_types is null or ev."subject_type" = any(notification_page.subject_types))
      and (notification_page.search is null or btrim(notification_page.search) = '' or concat_ws(' ', ev."summary", ev."subject_label", ev."type") ilike '%' || replace(replace(replace(btrim(notification_page.search), chr(92), chr(92) || chr(92)), '%', chr(92) || '%'), '_', chr(92) || '_') || '%')
      and case coalesce(notification_page.status, 'all')
        when 'unread' then rc."read_at" is null
        when 'read' then rc."read_at" is not null

      end

  select jsonb_build_object(
    'items', coalesce((

        select m.item, m.created_at, m.id from matched m
        order by m.created_at desc, m.id desc

  )

declare
  v_format text;
begin
  v_format := case p_entity
    when 'drive_document' then 'DOC-{n:5}'
    when 'drive_document_sop' then 'SOP-{n:4}'
    when 'donation_receipt' then 'R-{n}'
    when 'risk' then 'RSK-{n:4}'
    when 'case' then '{yyyy}-{n:4}'
    when 'inspection' then 'AUD-{yyyy}-{n:3}'
    when 'production_order' then 'MO-{yyyy}-{n:4}'
    else null
  end;
  return v_format;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.observation_series(subject_type text, subject_id text, definition_key text, since timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, until timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, bucket text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if observation_series.bucket is not null and observation_series.bucket not in ('hour', 'day', 'week', 'month') then
    raise exception 'bucket is one of hour, day, week, month' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'OBSERVATION_INVALID';
  end if;
  if observation_series.since is not null and observation_series.until is not null and observation_series.since > observation_series.until then
    raise exception 'since is before until' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'OBSERVATION_INVALID';
  end if;
  if observation_series.bucket is null then
    return (
      select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', x."id", 'observedAt', x."observed_at", 'value', case y."value_type"
      when 'boolean' then to_jsonb(x."value_code" = 'true')
      when 'code' then to_jsonb(x."value_code")
      when 'text' then to_jsonb(x."value_text")
      when 'components' then x."components"
      else to_jsonb(x."value_number")
    end, 'flag', x."flag") order by x."observed_at"), '[]'::jsonb)
      from "better_supabase"."observations" x
      join "better_supabase"."observation_definitions" y on y."id" = x."definition_id"
      where x."subject_type" = observation_series.subject_type
        and x."subject_id" = observation_series.subject_id
        and y."key" = observation_series.definition_key
        and x."status" = 'final'
        and (observation_series.since is null or x."observed_at" >= observation_series.since)
        and (observation_series.until is null or x."observed_at" < observation_series.until)
    );
  end if;
  return (
    with points as (
      select date_trunc(observation_series.bucket, x."observed_at", 'UTC') as b, x."value_number" as n, x."components" as c
      from "better_supabase"."observations" x
      join "better_supabase"."observation_definitions" y on y."id" = x."definition_id"
      where x."subject_type" = observation_series.subject_type
        and x."subject_id" = observation_series.subject_id
        and y."key" = observation_series.definition_key
        and x."status" = 'final'
        and (observation_series.since is null or x."observed_at" >= observation_series.since)
        and (observation_series.until is null or x."observed_at" < observation_series.until)
    ),
    parts as (
      select p.b, e.key, min(e.value::numeric) as lo, max(e.value::numeric) as hi, round(avg(e.value::numeric), 4) as mean
      from points p
      cross join lateral jsonb_each_text(coalesce(p.c, '{}'::jsonb)) e
      group by p.b, e.key
    )
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'bucket', g.b,
      'count', g.total,
      'min', g.lo,
      'max', g.hi,
      'avg', g.mean,
      'components', coalesce((
        select jsonb_object_agg(q.key, jsonb_build_object('min', q.lo, 'max', q.hi, 'avg', q.mean))
        from parts q where q.b = g.b
      ), '{}'::jsonb)
    ) order by g.b), '[]'::jsonb)
    from (
      select p.b, count(*) as total, min(p.n) as lo, max(p.n) as hi, round(avg(p.n), 4) as mean
      from points p
      group by p.b
    ) g
  );
end;

 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_read boolean := (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or (open_enrollment_steps.tenant is not null and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', open_enrollment_steps.tenant, 'enrollments.read'), false)));
begin
  if not v_read and auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'not allowed to read enrollments' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'ENROLLMENTS_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  return coalesce((
    select jsonb_agg(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', o.row_id, 'organizationId', o.scope_id, 'program', o.program,
      'subjectType', o.subject_type, 'subjectId', o.subject_id, 'step', o.step, 'title', o.title,
      'assignee', o.assignee, 'dueAt', o.due_at
    )) order by o.due_at nulls last, o.row_id, o.step)
    from (
      select x."id" as row_id, x."tenant_id" as scope_id, x."program" as program,
        x."subject_type" as subject_type, x."subject_id" as subject_id, y."step" as step,
        case when y."assignee_role" is not null then jsonb_build_object('role', y."assignee_role") when y."assignee_user_id" is not null then jsonb_build_object('userId', y."assignee_user_id") end as assignee, y."due_at" as due_at,
        (select t.value ->> 'title' from "better_supabase"."enrollment_programs" q, jsonb_array_elements(q."steps") as t(value)
          where q."tenant_id" = x."tenant_id" and q."key" = x."program" and t.value ->> 'id' = y."step" limit 1) as title
      from "better_supabase"."enrollment_steps" y
      join "better_supabase"."enrollments" x on x."id" = y."enrollment_id"
      where y."tenant_id" = open_enrollment_steps.tenant and x."tenant_id" = open_enrollment_steps.tenant
        and y."completed_at" is null and x."status" = 'active'
        -- A sequence's open step is its next run, which its runner takes.
        and x."program" not like 'sequence:%'
        and (v_read or y."assignee_user_id" = auth.uid())
        and (open_enrollment_steps.assignee_role is null or y."assignee_role" = open_enrollment_steps.assignee_role)
        and (open_enrollment_steps.assignee_user is null or y."assignee_user_id" = open_enrollment_steps.assignee_user)
        and (open_enrollment_steps.due_before is null or y."due_at" < open_enrollment_steps.due_before)
      order by y."due_at" nulls last, x."id", y."step"
      limit least(greatest(coalesce(open_enrollment_steps.page_size, 50), 1), 200)
    ) o
  ), '[]'::jsonb);
end;

      when 'incident' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."incidents" s where s."id" = (open_gift.donor_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = open_gift.tenant::text)
      when 'content_entry' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."content_entries" s where s."id" = (open_gift.donor_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = open_gift.tenant::text)
      when 'document' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."documents" s where s."id" = (open_gift.donor_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = open_gift.tenant::text)
      when 'customer' then exists (select 1 from "public"."customers" s where s."id" = (open_gift.donor_id)::uuid and s."organization_id"::text = open_gift.tenant::text)
      when 'drive_node' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" s where s."id" = (open_gift.donor_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = open_gift.tenant::text)
      when 'application' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."applications" s where s."id" = (open_gift.donor_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = open_gift.tenant::text)
      when 'change_request' then exists (select 1 from "public"."change_requests" s where s."id" = (open_gift.donor_id)::uuid and s."organization_id"::text = open_gift.tenant::text)
      when 'project' then exists (select 1 from "public"."projects" s where s."id" = (open_gift.donor_id)::uuid and s."organization_id"::text = open_gift.tenant::text)
      when 'task' then exists (select 1 from "public"."tasks" s where s."id" = (open_gift.donor_id)::uuid and s."organization_id"::text = open_gift.tenant::text)
      else false
    end and "better_supabase"."can_subject"(open_gift.donor_type, open_gift.donor_id, 'read')) then
    raise exception 'the donor is unknown or not in this organization' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'DONATION_DONOR_INVALID';
  end if;
  if open_gift.amount is null or open_gift.amount <= 0 then
    raise exception 'an amount is more than zero minor units' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'DONATION_AMOUNT_INVALID';
  end if;
  if open_gift.currency is null or open_gift.currency !~ '^[A-Z]{3}$' then
    raise exception 'currency must be a three-letter currency code' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'DONATION_AMOUNT_INVALID';
  end if;
  if open_gift.fund_id is not null and not exists (
    select 1 from "better_supabase"."donation_funds" y where y."id" = open_gift.fund_id and y."tenant_id" = open_gift.tenant and y."archived_at" is null
  ) then
    raise exception 'the fund is unknown, archived or not in this organization' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'DONATION_FUND_INVALID';
  end if;
  if open_gift.pledge_id is not null and (open_gift.period_start is null or not exists (
    select 1 from "better_supabase"."pledges" y where y."id" = open_gift.pledge_id and y."tenant_id" = open_gift.tenant
      and y."donor_type" = open_gift.donor_type and y."donor_id" = open_gift.donor_id and y."currency" = open_gift.currency
  )) then
    raise exception 'the pledge is unknown, another donor''s or in another currency, or the period is missing' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'DONATION_PLEDGE_INVALID';
  end if;
  insert into "better_supabase"."donations" ("tenant_id", "donor_type", "donor_id", "fund_id", "pledge_id", "period_start", "amount",
    "currency", "method", "provider", "note", "created_by")
  values (open_gift.tenant, open_gift.donor_type, open_gift.donor_id, open_gift.fund_id, open_gift.pledge_id,
    case when open_gift.pledge_id is null then null else open_gift.period_start end, open_gift.amount, open_gift.currency,
    'card', open_gift.provider, nullif(trim(open_gift.note), ''), auth.uid())
  on conflict ("pledge_id", "period_start") do nothing
  returning * into v_row;
  if v_row."id" is null then
    select * into v_row from "better_supabase"."donations" x where x."pledge_id" = open_gift.pledge_id and x."period_start" = open_gift.period_start;
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('id', v_row."id", 'organizationId', v_row."tenant_id", 'donorType', v_row."donor_type", 'donorId', v_row."donor_id", 'fundId', v_row."fund_id", 'pledgeId', v_row."pledge_id", 'periodStart', v_row."period_start", 'amount', v_row."amount"::text, 'currency', v_row."currency", 'receivedOn', v_row."received_on", 'method', v_row."method", 'status', v_row."status", 'provider', v_row."provider", 'paymentReference', v_row."payment_reference", 'transactionId', v_row."transaction_id", 'refundTransactionId', v_row."refund_transaction_id", 'receiptId', v_row."receipt_id", 'note', v_row."note", 'createdBy', v_row."created_by", 'createdAt', v_row."created_at", 'updatedAt', v_row."updated_at");
end;

functions.name: order_board
functions.definition:
select coalesce(jsonb_agg(card order by card ->> 'sentAt', card ->> 'orderId'), '[]'::jsonb)
  from (
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'orderId', o."id",
      'number', o."number",
      'customerId', o."customer_id",
      'status', o."status",
      'state', (array['queued', 'preparing', 'ready', 'served'])[min(array_position(array['queued', 'preparing', 'ready', 'served'], p."state"))],
      'sentAt', min(p."queued_at"),
      'readyAt', case when bool_and(p."ready_at" is not null) then max(p."ready_at") end,
      'servedAt', case when bool_and(p."served_at" is not null) then max(p."served_at") end,
      'counts', jsonb_build_object(
        'queued', count(*) filter (where p."state" = 'queued'),
        'preparing', count(*) filter (where p."state" = 'preparing'),
        'ready', count(*) filter (where p."state" = 'ready'),
        'served', count(*) filter (where p."state" = 'served')
      )
    ) as card
    from "better_supabase"."order_line_preparations" p
    join "better_supabase"."orders" o on o."id" = p."order_id"
    where p."tenant_id" = order_board.tenant
    group by o."id", o."number", o."customer_id", o."status"
    having min(p."queued_at") >= coalesce(order_board.since, now() - interval '1 day')
    order by min(p."queued_at"), o."id"
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(order_board.page_size, 200), 1), 1000)
  ) cards

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.order_board(tenant uuid, since timestamp with time zone, page_size integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(card order by card ->> 'sentAt', card ->> 'orderId'), '[]'::jsonb)
  from (
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'orderId', o."id",
      'number', o."number",
      'customerId', o."customer_id",
      'status', o."status",
      'state', (array['queued', 'preparing', 'ready', 'served'])[min(array_position(array['queued', 'preparing', 'ready', 'served'], p."state"))],
      'sentAt', min(p."queued_at"),
      'readyAt', case when bool_and(p."ready_at" is not null) then max(p."ready_at") end,
      'servedAt', case when bool_and(p."served_at" is not null) then max(p."served_at") end,
      'counts', jsonb_build_object(
        'queued', count(*) filter (where p."state" = 'queued'),
        'preparing', count(*) filter (where p."state" = 'preparing'),
        'ready', count(*) filter (where p."state" = 'ready'),
        'served', count(*) filter (where p."state" = 'served')
      )
    ) as card
    from "better_supabase"."order_line_preparations" p
    join "better_supabase"."orders" o on o."id" = p."order_id"
    where p."tenant_id" = order_board.tenant
    group by o."id", o."number", o."customer_id", o."status"
    having min(p."queued_at") >= coalesce(order_board.since, now() - interval '1 day')
    order by min(p."queued_at"), o."id"
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(order_board.page_size, 200), 1), 1000)

functions.definition:
select jsonb_build_object(
    'id', x."id", 'organizationId', x."tenant_id", 'number', x."number", 'cartId', x."cart_id",
    'customerId', x."customer_id", 'email', x."email", 'status', x."status", 'currency', x."currency",
    'subtotal', x."subtotal"::text, 'discountTotal', x."discount_total"::text,
    'shippingTotal', x."shipping_total"::text, 'taxTotal', x."tax_total"::text, 'total', x."total"::text,
    'paidTotal', x."paid_total"::text, 'refundedTotal', x."refunded_total"::text, 'taxInclusive', x."tax_inclusive",
    'shippingAddress', x."shipping_address", 'billingAddress', x."billing_address", 'shipping', x."shipping",
    'promotions', x."promotions", 'tax', x."tax", 'taxTransaction', x."tax_transaction",
    'invoiceNumber', x."invoice_number", 'invoicedAt', x."invoiced_at", 'placedAt', x."placed_at",
    'paidAt', x."paid_at", 'fulfilledAt', x."fulfilled_at", 'completedAt', x."completed_at",
    'cancelledAt', x."cancelled_at", 'cancelReason', x."cancel_reason",
    'lines', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', l."id", 'variantId', l."variant_id", 'productId', l."product_id", 'sku', l."sku",
        'title', l."title", 'quantity', l."quantity", 'unitAmount', l."unit_amount"::text,
        'subtotal', l."subtotal"::text, 'discount', l."discount"::text, 'tax', l."tax"::text,
        'total', l."total"::text, 'requiresShipping', l."requires_shipping", 'locationId', l."location_id",
        'reservationId', l."reservation_id", 'fulfilled', l."quantity_fulfilled", 'returned', l."quantity_returned",
        'backordered', l."backordered") order by l."position")
      from "better_supabase"."order_lines" l where l."order_id" = x."id"), '[]'::jsonb),
    'payments', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', y."id", 'provider', y."provider", 'reference', y."reference", 'status', y."status",
        'amount', y."amount"::text, 'captured', y."captured"::text, 'refunded', y."refunded"::text,
        'createdAt', y."created_at") order by y."created_at")
      from "better_supabase"."order_payments" y where y."order_id" = x."id"), '[]'::jsonb),
    'fulfillments', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', y."id", 'status', y."status", 'locationId', y."location_id", 'carrier', y."carrier",
        'trackingNumber', y."tracking_number", 'trackingUrl', y."tracking_url", 'createdAt', y."created_at",
        'shippedAt', y."shipped_at", 'deliveredAt', y."delivered_at",
        'lines', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('lineId', z."order_line_id", 'quantity', z."quantity"))
          from "better_supabase"."order_fulfillment_lines" z where z."fulfillment_id" = y."id"), '[]'::jsonb)) order by y."created_at")
      from "better_supabase"."order_fulfillments" y where y."order_id" = x."id"), '[]'::jsonb),
    'returns', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', y."id", 'status', y."status", 'reason', y."reason", 'createdAt', y."created_at",
        'receivedAt', y."received_at",
        'lines', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('lineId', z."order_line_id", 'quantity', z."quantity"))
          from "better_supabase"."order_return_lines" z where z."return_id" = y."id"), '[]'::jsonb)) order by y."created_at")
      from "better_supabase"."order_returns" y where y."order_id" = x."id"), '[]'::jsonb),
    'refunds', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', y."id", 'paymentId', y."payment_id", 'returnId', y."return_id", 'amount', y."amount"::text,
        'status', y."status", 'reason', y."reason", 'providerReference', y."provider_reference",
        'createdAt', y."created_at", 'completedAt', y."completed_at") order by y."created_at")
      from "better_supabase"."order_refunds" y where y."order_id" = x."id"), '[]'::jsonb))
  from "better_supabase"."orders" x where x."id" = p_order

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.order_transition(p_order uuid, p_to text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_from text;
begin
  select x."status" into v_from from "better_supabase"."orders" x where x."id" = p_order for update;
  if v_from = p_to then
    return v_from;
  end if;
  if not (case v_from
    when 'pending_payment' then p_to = any ('{paid,cancelled}'::text[])
    when 'confirmed' then p_to = any ('{paid,fulfilled,cancelled}'::text[])
    when 'paid' then p_to = any ('{fulfilled,refunded}'::text[])
    when 'fulfilled' then p_to = any ('{paid,completed,refunded}'::text[])
    when 'completed' then p_to = any ('{refunded}'::text[])
    when 'cancelled' then p_to = any ('{}'::text[])
    when 'refunded' then p_to = any ('{}'::text[])
    else false end) then
    raise exception 'the order can''t move to this status' using errcode = '55000', hint = 'ORDERS_TRANSITION_INVALID';
  end if;
  update "better_supabase"."orders" x set "status" = p_to, "updated_at" = now(),
    "paid_at" = case when p_to = 'paid' then coalesce(x."paid_at", now()) else x."paid_at" end,
    "fulfilled_at" = case when p_to = 'fulfilled' then now() when p_to = 'paid' then null else x."fulfilled_at" end,
    "completed_at" = case when p_to = 'completed' then now() else x."completed_at" end,
    "cancelled_at" = case when p_to = 'cancelled' then now() else x."cancelled_at" end
  where x."id" = p_order;
  return v_from;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.org_chart(tenant uuid, root uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not ((auth.role() = 'service_role') or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', org_chart.tenant, 'employees.read'), false) or (org_chart.root is not null and exists (
    with recursive up (id, manager) as (
      select u."id", u."manager_id" from "better_supabase"."employees" u where u."id" = org_chart.root
      union
      select u."id", u."manager_id" from "better_supabase"."employees" u join up on u."id" = up.manager
    )
    select 1 from up join "better_supabase"."employees" me on me."id" = up.id where me."user_id" = auth.uid()))) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to read the org chart' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'EMPLOYEE_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  return (
    with recursive tree (id, depth, path) as (
      select x."id", 0, array[lower(x."name"), x."id"::text]
      from "better_supabase"."employees" x
      where x."tenant_id" = org_chart.tenant and x."status" <> 'offboarded'
        and case when org_chart.root is null then x."manager_id" is null else x."id" = org_chart.root end
      union all
      select c."id", tree.depth + 1, tree.path || array[lower(c."name"), c."id"::text]
      from "better_supabase"."employees" c join tree on c."manager_id" = tree.id
      where c."status" <> 'offboarded' and tree.depth < 100
    )
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) || jsonb_build_object('depth', tree.depth, 'direct_reports', (select count(*) from "better_supabase"."employees" r where r."manager_id" = x."id" and r."status" <> 'offboarded')) order by tree.path), '[]'::jsonb)
    from tree join "better_supabase"."employees" x on x."id" = tree.id
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.outbox_claim(consumer text, owner text, max_events integer DEFAULT 100, lease interval DEFAULT '00:01:00'::interval)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_variable
declare
  c "better_supabase"."outbox_consumers";
  events jsonb;
begin
  update "better_supabase"."outbox_consumers" k
  set "lease_owner" = owner, "lease_until" = now() + lease, "updated_at" = now()
  where k."name" = consumer
    and (k."lease_until" is null or k."lease_until" < now() or k."lease_owner" = owner)
    and (k."retry_at" is null or k."retry_at" <= now())
  returning k.* into c;
  if not found then
    if not exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."outbox_consumers" k where k."name" = consumer) then
      raise exception 'Unknown outbox consumer %', consumer using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'OUTBOX_UNKNOWN_CONSUMER';
    end if;
    return '[]';
  end if;
  select jsonb_agg(x.event order by x.n) into events
  from (
    select jsonb_build_object(
    'position', e."position",
    'id', e."id",
    'type', e."type",
    'payload', e."payload",
    'created_at', e."created_at",
    'source', e."source",
    'subject', e."subject",
    'tenant', e."organization_id",
    'key', e."key",
    'actor_id', e."actor_id"
  ) as event, row_number() over (order by e."xid", e."position") as n
    from "better_supabase"."outbox_events" e
    where (e."xid", e."position") > (c."cursor_xid", c."cursor_position")
      and e."xid" < pg_snapshot_xmin(pg_current_snapshot())
      and (c."types" is null or exists (
        select 1 from unnest(c."types") p
        where p = '*' or p = e."type"
          or (right(p, 2) = '.*' and starts_with(e."type", left(p, -1)))
      ))
    order by e."xid", e."position"
    limit case when c."attempts" > 0 then 1 else max_events end
  ) x;
  if events is null then
    update "better_supabase"."outbox_consumers" k
    set ("cursor_xid", "cursor_position") = (
      select e."xid", e."position" from "better_supabase"."outbox_events" e
      where (e."xid", e."position") > (c."cursor_xid", c."cursor_position") and e."xid" < pg_snapshot_xmin(pg_current_snapshot())
      order by e."xid" desc, e."position" desc
      limit 1
    )
    where k."name" = consumer
      and exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."outbox_events" e where (e."xid", e."position") > (c."cursor_xid", c."cursor_position") and e."xid" < pg_snapshot_xmin(pg_current_snapshot()));
  end if;
  return coalesce(events, '[]');
end;
$function$
functions.argument_types: consumer text, owner text, max_events integer DEFAULT 100, lease interval DEFAULT '00:01:00'::interval
functions.identity_argument_types: consumer text, owner text, max_events integer, lease interval

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.outbox_fail(consumer text, owner text, failed bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint, error text DEFAULT NULL::text, max_attempts integer DEFAULT 10, max_backoff interval DEFAULT '00:10:00'::interval)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_variable
declare
  c "better_supabase"."outbox_consumers";
begin
  update "better_supabase"."outbox_consumers" k
  set "attempts" = k."attempts" + 1, "last_error" = left(error, 4000),
    "lease_owner" = null, "lease_until" = null, "updated_at" = now()
  where k."name" = consumer and k."lease_owner" = owner
  returning k.* into c;
  if not found then
    return null;
  end if;
  if failed is not null and c."attempts" >= greatest(coalesce(max_attempts, 10), 1) then
    insert into "better_supabase"."outbox_dead_letters" ("consumer", "position", "event_id", "type", "event", "attempts", "error")
    select consumer, e."position", e."id"::text, e."type", jsonb_build_object(
    'position', e."position",
    'id', e."id",
    'type', e."type",
    'payload', e."payload",
    'created_at', e."created_at",
    'source', e."source",
    'subject', e."subject",
    'tenant', e."organization_id",
    'key', e."key",
    'actor_id', e."actor_id"
  ), c."attempts", c."last_error"
    from "better_supabase"."outbox_events" e
    where e."position" = failed and (e."xid", e."position") > (c."cursor_xid", c."cursor_position")
    on conflict do nothing;
    update "better_supabase"."outbox_consumers" k
    set ("cursor_xid", "cursor_position") = (
        select e."xid", e."position" from "better_supabase"."outbox_events" e where e."position" = failed
      ),
      "attempts" = 0, "retry_at" = null
    where k."name" = consumer
      and exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."outbox_events" e where e."position" = failed and (e."xid", e."position") > (k."cursor_xid", k."cursor_position"));
    if found then
      return 'dead';
    end if;
  end if;
  update "better_supabase"."outbox_consumers" k
  set "retry_at" = now() + least(
    coalesce(max_backoff, '10 minutes'),
    interval '1 second' * power(2, least(c."attempts", 20))
  )
  where k."name" = consumer;
  return 'retrying';
end;
$function$
functions.argument_types: consumer text, owner text, failed bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint, error text DEFAULT NULL::text, max_attempts integer DEFAULT 10, max_backoff interval DEFAULT '00:10:00'::interval
functions.identity_argument_types: consumer text, owner text, failed bigint, error text, max_attempts integer, max_backoff interval

 RETURNS boolean

 SECURITY DEFINER

AS $function$

begin
  if not (better_supabase.actor_may_write()) then

        with rows as (
          select r."stage_id" as stage_id, r."currency"::text as currency, r."amount"::bigint as amount,
            r."amount" * coalesce(r."probability", st."probability", 0) / 100.0 as weighted

          join "better_supabase"."pipeline_stages" st on st."id" = r."stage_id"

        sums as (
          select stage_id, jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('currency', currency, 'amount', amount::text, 'weighted', round(weighted)::bigint::text) order by currency) as totals
          from (select stage_id, currency, coalesce(sum(amount), 0) as amount, coalesce(sum(weighted), 0) as weighted from rows where currency is not null group by stage_id, currency) x
          group by stage_id
        )
        select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'stageId', st."id", 'key', st."key", 'name', st."name", 'color', st."color",
          'category', st."category", 'outcome', st."outcome", 'probability', st."probability",

        from "better_supabase"."pipeline_stages" st

        left join sums m on m.stage_id = st."id"

          from "better_supabase"."work_items" r

        left join sums m on m.stage_id = st."id"
        where st."pipeline_id" = pipeline_board.pipeline and st."archived_at" is null

        ),

          from "better_supabase"."applications" r
          join "better_supabase"."pipeline_stages" st on st."id" = r."stage_id"
          where r."pipeline_id" = pipeline_board.pipeline and (pipeline_board.owner is null or r."owner_user_id" = pipeline_board.owner)
        ),
        counts as (select stage_id, count(*) as n from rows group by stage_id),
        sums as (
          select stage_id, jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('currency', currency, 'amount', amount::text, 'weighted', round(weighted)::bigint::text) order by currency) as totals
          from (select stage_id, currency, coalesce(sum(amount), 0) as amount, coalesce(sum(weighted), 0) as weighted from rows where currency is not null group by stage_id, currency) x

          'category', st."category", 'outcome', st."outcome", 'probability', st."probability",

        ) order by st."rank" collate "C"), '[]'::jsonb)
        from "better_supabase"."pipeline_stages" st

        left join sums m on m.stage_id = st."id"
        where st."pipeline_id" = pipeline_board.pipeline and st."archived_at" is null

    when 'case' then
      return (
        with rows as (
          select r."stage_id" as stage_id, null::text as currency, null::bigint as amount, null::numeric as weighted
          from "better_supabase"."cases" r
          join "better_supabase"."pipeline_stages" st on st."id" = r."stage_id"
          where r."pipeline_id" = pipeline_board.pipeline and r."archived_at" is null
        ),
        counts as (select stage_id, count(*) as n from rows group by stage_id),
        sums as (
          select stage_id, jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('currency', currency, 'amount', amount::text, 'weighted', round(weighted)::bigint::text) order by currency) as totals
          from (select stage_id, currency, coalesce(sum(amount), 0) as amount, coalesce(sum(weighted), 0) as weighted from rows where currency is not null group by stage_id, currency) x
          group by stage_id
        )
        select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'stageId', st."id", 'key', st."key", 'name', st."name", 'color', st."color",
          'category', st."category", 'outcome', st."outcome", 'probability', st."probability",
          'wipLimit', st."wip_limit", 'count', coalesce(n.n, 0),
          'overLimit', st."wip_limit" is not null and coalesce(n.n, 0) > st."wip_limit",
          'totals', coalesce(m.totals, '[]'::jsonb)
        ) order by st."rank" collate "C"), '[]'::jsonb)
        from "better_supabase"."pipeline_stages" st
        left join counts n on n.stage_id = st."id"
        left join sums m on m.stage_id = st."id"
        where st."pipeline_id" = pipeline_board.pipeline and st."archived_at" is null

    else

functions.name: pipeline_stats
functions.definition:
with window_rows as (
    select * from "better_supabase"."pipeline_stage_history" h
    where h."pipeline_id" = pipeline_stats.pipeline
      and h."entered_at" >= pipeline_stats.since and h."entered_at" < pipeline_stats.until
  ),
  per_stage as (
    select w."to_stage_id" as stage_id, count(*) as entered,
      avg(extract(epoch from (w."exited_at" - w."entered_at"))) filter (where w."exited_at" is not null) as avg_seconds
    from window_rows w group by w."to_stage_id"
  ),
  closed as (
    select count(*) filter (where w."outcome" = 'success') as won,
      count(*) filter (where w."outcome" = 'failure') as lost
    from window_rows w
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'won', closed.won,
    'lost', closed.lost,
    'winRate', case when closed.won + closed.lost = 0 then null else round(closed.won::numeric / (closed.won + closed.lost), 4) end,
    'stages', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('stageId', st."id", 'key', st."key", 'entered', coalesce(ps.entered, 0), 'averageSeconds', round(ps.avg_seconds)) order by st."rank" collate "C")
      from "better_supabase"."pipeline_stages" st left join per_stage ps on ps.stage_id = st."id"
      where st."pipeline_id" = pipeline_stats.pipeline
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  )
  from closed;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.place_acknowledgement_assignment(tenant uuid, subject_type text, subject_id text, principal_type text, principal_id text, due_in_days integer DEFAULT NULL::integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  v_row "better_supabase"."acknowledgement_assignments"%rowtype;
  v_existed boolean;
begin
  select exists (
    select 1 from "better_supabase"."acknowledgement_assignments" x
    where x."tenant_id" = place_acknowledgement_assignment.tenant
      and x."subject_type" = place_acknowledgement_assignment.subject_type
      and x."subject_id" = place_acknowledgement_assignment.subject_id
      and x."principal_type" = place_acknowledgement_assignment.principal_type
      and x."principal_id" = place_acknowledgement_assignment.principal_id
  ) into v_existed;
  insert into "better_supabase"."acknowledgement_assignments" ("tenant_id", "subject_type", "subject_id", "principal_type", "principal_id", "due_in_days")
  values (place_acknowledgement_assignment.tenant, place_acknowledgement_assignment.subject_type, place_acknowledgement_assignment.subject_id, place_acknowledgement_assignment.principal_type, place_acknowledgement_assignment.principal_id, place_acknowledgement_assignment.due_in_days)
  on conflict ("tenant_id", "subject_type", "subject_id", "principal_type", "principal_id")
  do update set "due_in_days" = excluded."due_in_days"
  returning * into v_row;
  if not v_existed then
    perform "better_supabase".emit_event('acknowledgement_assignment.created', jsonb_build_object('organizationId', v_row."tenant_id", 'subjectType', v_row."subject_type", 'subjectId', v_row."subject_id", 'assignmentId', v_row."id", 'principalType', v_row."principal_type", 'principalId', v_row."principal_id"), 'acknowledgement-assignments/' || v_row."id"::text, (v_row."tenant_id")::text, null, 'better-supabase/acknowledgements');
  perform better_supabase.audit_event(
    event_type => 'acknowledgement_assignment.created',
    category => 'data',
    target_type => 'acknowledgement_assignment',
    record_id => v_row."id"::text,
    summary => 'asked ' || v_row."principal_type" || ' ' || v_row."principal_id" || ' to acknowledge ' || v_row."subject_type" || ' ' || v_row."subject_id",
    tenant => (v_row."tenant_id")::uuid,
    metadata => jsonb_build_object('organizationId', v_row."tenant_id", 'subjectType', v_row."subject_type", 'subjectId', v_row."subject_id", 'assignmentId', v_row."id", 'principalType', v_row."principal_type", 'principalId', v_row."principal_id")
  );
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('id', v_row."id", 'organizationId', v_row."tenant_id", 'subjectType', v_row."subject_type", 'subjectId', v_row."subject_id", 'principalType', v_row."principal_type", 'principalId', v_row."principal_id", 'dueInDays', v_row."due_in_days", 'createdBy', v_row."created_by", 'createdAt', v_row."created_at");
end;
$function$

functions.definition:
#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  v_project "better_supabase"."work_projects"%rowtype;
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  select * into v_project from "better_supabase"."work_projects" x where x."id" = project_costs.project_id;
  if not found or not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_project."tenant_id", 'billable_time.read'), false)) then
    raise exception 'project not found' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'TASK_PROJECT_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  with spent as (
    select extract(epoch from x."ended_at" - x."started_at") as seconds, card.cost, card.currency,
      d."rate" as billed_rate, d."currency"::text as billed_currency, d."seconds" as billed_seconds
    from "better_supabase"."time_entries" x
    left join lateral (
      select c."cost_amount" as cost, c."currency"::text as currency
      from "better_supabase"."time_rates" c
      where c."tenant_id" = x."tenant_id"
        and (c."user_id" is null or c."user_id" = x."user_id")
        and (c."subject_type" is null or (c."subject_type" = x."subject_type" and c."subject_id" = x."subject_id"))
        and c."effective_from" <= (x."started_at" at time zone 'UTC')::date
      order by (c."subject_type" is not null) desc, (c."user_id" is not null) desc, c."effective_from" desc
      limit 1
    ) card on true
    left join "better_supabase"."time_invoice_entries" d on d."entry_id" = x."id"
    where x."tenant_id" = v_project."tenant_id"
      and x."ended_at" is not null
      and ((x."subject_type" = 'project' and x."subject_id" = v_project."id"::text) or (x."subject_type" = 'work_item' and x."subject_id" in (
        select y."id"::text from "better_supabase"."work_items" y where y."project_id" = v_project."id"
      )))
  ),
  totals as (
    select u.currency, sum(u.time_cost)::bigint as time_cost, sum(u.billed)::bigint as billed,
      sum(u.expenses)::bigint as expenses, sum(u.income)::bigint as income
    from (
      select s.currency, round(s.seconds / 3600.0 * s.cost)::bigint as time_cost, 0::bigint as billed, 0::bigint as expenses, 0::bigint as income
      from spent s where s.cost is not null
      union all
      select s.billed_currency, 0, round(s.billed_seconds / 3600.0 * s.billed_rate)::bigint, 0, 0
      from spent s where s.billed_rate is not null
      union all
      select q.currency, 0, 0, q.expenses, q.income from (select l."currency"::text as currency,
        coalesce(sum(l."debit" - l."credit") filter (where a."type" = 'expense'), 0)::bigint as expenses,
        coalesce(sum(l."credit" - l."debit") filter (where a."type" = 'income'), 0)::bigint as income
      from "better_supabase"."accounting_entry_lines" l
      join "better_supabase"."accounting_entries" n on n."id" = l."entry_id"
      join "better_supabase"."accounting_accounts" a on a."id" = l."account_id"
      where l."tenant_id" = v_project."tenant_id"
        and n."status" in ('posted', 'reversed')
        and l."dimensions" ->> 'project' = v_project."id"::text
      group by l."currency") q
    ) u
    group by u.currency
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'projectId', v_project."id",
    'organizationId', v_project."tenant_id",
    'hours', (select round(coalesce(sum(s.seconds), 0) / 3600.0, 2) from spent s),
    'uncostedHours', (select round(coalesce(sum(s.seconds) filter (where s.cost is null), 0) / 3600.0, 2) from spent s),
    'budgetAmount', v_project."budget_amount"::text,
    'budgetCurrency', v_project."budget_currency",
    'budgetHours', v_project."budget_hours",
    'totals', (
      select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'currency', t.currency,
          'timeCost', t.time_cost::text,
          'billed', t.billed::text,
          'expenses', t.expenses::text,
          'income', t.income::text,
          'margin', (t.billed + t.income - t.time_cost - t.expenses)::text
        ) order by t.currency), '[]'::jsonb)
      from totals t))
  into v_result;
  return v_result;
end;
