public_status_page
functions.definition:
declare
  v_page "better_supabase"."incident_status_pages"%rowtype;
  v_days integer := least(greatest(coalesce(public_status_page.days, 90), 1), 90);
  v_from timestamptz;
begin
  select * into v_page from "better_supabase"."incident_status_pages" x where x."slug" = public_status_page.slug and x."published";
  if not found then
    return null;
  end if;
  v_from := (current_date - (v_days - 1))::timestamp at time zone 'UTC';
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'slug', v_page."slug",
    'title', v_page."title",
    'description', v_page."description",
    'days', v_days,
    'status', (
      select coalesce((array['operational', 'maintenance', 'degraded', 'partial_outage', 'major_outage'])[max(array_position(array['operational', 'maintenance', 'degraded', 'partial_outage', 'major_outage'], sc."status"))], 'operational')
      from "better_supabase"."incident_status_components" sc
      where sc."tenant_id" = v_page."tenant_id" and sc."public"
    ),
    'components', (
      select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', pc."id",
        'name', pc."name",
        'description', pc."description",
        'group', pc."group_name",
        'status', pc."status",
        'uptimePercent', (
          select round(100 * (1 - coalesce(sum(extract(epoch from (
            least(coalesce(uh."ended_at", now()), now()) - greatest(uh."started_at", v_from)
          ))), 0) / greatest(extract(epoch from (now() - v_from)), 1))::numeric, 3)
          from "better_supabase"."incident_status_component_history" uh
          where uh."component_id" = pc."id"
            and uh."status" in ('partial_outage', 'major_outage')
            and coalesce(uh."ended_at", now()) > v_from
        ),
        'uptime', (
          select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('date', dd.d, 'status', coalesce(w.worst, 'operational'), 'downMinutes', coalesce(w.down, 0)) order by dd.d)
          from (select (current_date - n)::date as d from generate_series(0, v_days - 1) n) dd
          cross join lateral (
            select (array['operational', 'maintenance', 'degraded', 'partial_outage', 'major_outage'])[max(array_position(array['operational', 'maintenance', 'degraded', 'partial_outage', 'major_outage'], dh."status"))] as worst,
              (coalesce(sum(extract(epoch from (
                least(coalesce(dh."ended_at", now()), (dd.d + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'UTC')
                - greatest(dh."started_at", dd.d::timestamp at time zone 'UTC')
              ))) filter (where dh."status" in ('partial_outage', 'major_outage')), 0) / 60)::integer as down
            from "better_supabase"."incident_status_component_history" dh
            where dh."component_id" = pc."id"
              and dh."started_at" < (dd.d + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'UTC'
              and coalesce(dh."ended_at", now()) > dd.d::timestamp at time zone 'UTC'
          ) w
        )
      ) order by pc."position", pc."name"), '[]'::jsonb)
      from "better_supabase"."incident_status_components" pc
      where pc."tenant_id" = v_page."tenant_id" and pc."public"
    ),
    'incidents', (
      select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', pi0."id",
      'title', pi0."title",
      'severity', pi0."severity",
      'status', pi0."status",
      'startedAt', pi0."started_at",
      'resolvedAt', pi0."resolved_at",
      'components', (
        select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', pc."id", 'name', pc."name", 'impact', pi."impact") order by pc."position", pc."name"), '[]'::jsonb)
        from "better_supabase"."incident_impacts" pi join "better_supabase"."incident_status_components" pc on pc."id" = pi."component_id"
        where pi."incident_id" = pi0."id" and pc."public"
      ),
      'updates', (
        select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('status', pu."status", 'body', pu."body", 'createdAt', pu."created_at") order by pu."created_at" desc), '[]'::jsonb)
        from "better_supabase"."incident_updates" pu
        where pu."incident_id" = pi0."id" and pu."public"
      ),
      'postmortem', (
        select jsonb_build_object('summary', pp."summary", 'publishedAt', pp."published_at")
        from "better_supabase"."incident_postmortems" pp
        where pp."incident_id" = pi0."id" and pp."status" = 'published'
      )
    ) order by pi0."started_at" desc), '[]'::jsonb)
      from "better_supabase"."incidents" pi0
      where pi0."tenant_id" = v_page."tenant_id" and pi0."public"
        and (pi0."resolved_at" is null or pi0."resolved_at" >= v_from)
    )
  );
end;

  v_from := (current_date - (v_days - 1))::timestamp at time zone 'UTC';
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'slug', v_page."slug",
    'title', v_page."title",
    'description', v_page."description",
    'days', v_days,
    'status', (
      select coalesce((array['operational', 'maintenance', 'degraded', 'partial_outage', 'major_outage'])[max(array_position(array['operational', 'maintenance', 'degraded', 'partial_outage', 'major_outage'], sc."status"))], 'operational')
      from "better_supabase"."incident_status_components" sc
      where sc."tenant_id" = v_page."tenant_id" and sc."public"
    ),
    'components', (
      select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', pc."id",
        'name', pc."name",
        'description', pc."description",
        'group', pc."group_name",
        'status', pc."status",
        'uptimePercent', (
          select round(100 * (1 - coalesce(sum(extract(epoch from (
            least(coalesce(uh."ended_at", now()), now()) - greatest(uh."started_at", v_from)
          ))), 0) / greatest(extract(epoch from (now() - v_from)), 1))::numeric, 3)
          from "better_supabase"."incident_status_component_history" uh
          where uh."component_id" = pc."id"
            and uh."status" in ('partial_outage', 'major_outage')
            and coalesce(uh."ended_at", now()) > v_from
        ),
        'uptime', (
          select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('date', dd.d, 'status', coalesce(w.worst, 'operational'), 'downMinutes', coalesce(w.down, 0)) order by dd.d)
          from (select (current_date - n)::date as d from generate_series(0, v_days - 1) n) dd
          cross join lateral (
            select (array['operational', 'maintenance', 'degraded', 'partial_outage', 'major_outage'])[max(array_position(array['operational', 'maintenance', 'degraded', 'partial_outage', 'major_outage'], dh."status"))] as worst,
              (coalesce(sum(extract(epoch from (
                least(coalesce(dh."ended_at", now()), (dd.d + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'UTC')
                - greatest(dh."started_at", dd.d::timestamp at time zone 'UTC')
              ))) filter (where dh."status" in ('partial_outage', 'major_outage')), 0) / 60)::integer as down
            from "better_supabase"."incident_status_component_history" dh
            where dh."component_id" = pc."id"
              and dh."started_at" < (dd.d + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'UTC'
              and coalesce(dh."ended_at", now()) > dd.d::timestamp at time zone 'UTC'
          ) w
        )
      ) order by pc."position", pc."name"), '[]'::jsonb)
      from "better_supabase"."incident_status_components" pc
      where pc."tenant_id" = v_page."tenant_id" and pc."public"
    ),
    'incidents', (
      select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', pi0."id",
      'title', pi0."title",
      'severity', pi0."severity",
      'status', pi0."status",
      'startedAt', pi0."started_at",
      'resolvedAt', pi0."resolved_at",
      'components', (
        select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', pc."id", 'name', pc."name", 'impact', pi."impact") order by pc."position", pc."name"), '[]'::jsonb)
        from "better_supabase"."incident_impacts" pi join "better_supabase"."incident_status_components" pc on pc."id" = pi."component_id"
        where pi."incident_id" = pi0."id" and pc."public"
      ),
      'updates', (
        select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('status', pu."status", 'body', pu."body", 'createdAt', pu."created_at") order by pu."created_at" desc), '[]'::jsonb)
        from "better_supabase"."incident_updates" pu
        where pu."incident_id" = pi0."id" and pu."public"
      ),
      'postmortem', (
        select jsonb_build_object('summary', pp."summary", 'publishedAt', pp."published_at")
        from "better_supabase"."incident_postmortems" pp
        where pp."incident_id" = pi0."id" and pp."status" = 'published'
      )
    ) order by pi0."started_at" desc), '[]'::jsonb)
      from "better_supabase"."incidents" pi0
      where pi0."tenant_id" = v_page."tenant_id" and pi0."public"
        and (pi0."resolved_at" is null or pi0."resolved_at" >= v_from)
    )
  );
end;

    else false
  end)) then
    raise exception 'document not found' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND';

  select * into v_snapshot from "better_supabase"."document_snapshots" x where x."document_id" = v_doc."id";
  if v_snapshot."document_id" is not null and pull_document_updates.after_seq < v_snapshot."seq" then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'snapshot', replace(encode(v_snapshot."state", 'base64'), E'\n', ''),
      'snapshotSeq', v_snapshot."seq",
      'updates', "better_supabase"."document_updates_after"(v_doc."id", v_snapshot."seq")
    );
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('updates', "better_supabase"."document_updates_after"(v_doc."id", pull_document_updates.after_seq));
end;

  end if;
  select * into v_snapshot from "better_supabase"."document_snapshots" x where x."document_id" = v_doc."id";

$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.purge_ai_files(older_than interval DEFAULT '1 day'::interval, batch integer DEFAULT 500)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_removed jsonb;
begin
  with doomed as (
    select x."id" from "better_supabase"."ai_files" x
    where (x."status" = 'pending' and x."created_at" <= now() - coalesce(older_than, interval '1 day'))
      or x."expires_at" <= now()
      or (x."chat_id" is not null and not exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."ai_chats" ch where ch."id" = x."chat_id"))
    limit greatest(coalesce(batch, 500), 1)
  ),
  gone as (
    delete from "better_supabase"."ai_files" x using doomed where x."id" = doomed."id"
    returning x."bucket" as bucket, x."path" as path
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('bucket', gone.bucket, 'path', gone.path)), '[]'::jsonb) into v_removed from gone;
  return v_removed;
end;
$function$

 SECURITY DEFINER

          or (purge_webhook_deliveries.include_dead and v."status" = 'dead')
        )
      limit purge_webhook_deliveries.batch
    )
    returning 1
  )
  select count(*)::integer into v_purged from purged;
  return v_purged;

#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  v_doc "better_supabase"."documents"%rowtype;
  v_bytes bytea;
  v_seq bigint;
  v_since bigint;
begin
  if not (better_supabase.actor_may_write()) then
    raise exception 'This session is read-only' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'ACTOR_READ_ONLY';
  end if;

functions.definition:
#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  v_filters jsonb := coalesce(qualification_gaps.filters, '{}'::jsonb);
  v_holder text := nullif(v_filters ->> 'holderId', '');
  v_team text := nullif(v_filters ->> 'teamId', '');
  v_type_key text := nullif(v_filters ->> 'typeKey', '');
  v_status text := nullif(v_filters ->> 'status', '');
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', qualification_gaps.tenant, 'qualifications.read'), false)
    or (qualification_gaps.holder_type = 'member' and v_holder is not null and v_holder = (select auth.uid())::text and exists (select 1 from "public"."memberships" mm where mm."organization_id" = qualification_gaps.tenant and mm."user_id" = (select auth.uid())))) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to read qualifications' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'QUALIFICATION_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  if v_status is not null and v_status not in ('missing', 'expired', 'expiring') then
    raise exception 'status is missing, expired or expiring' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'QUALIFICATION_INVALID';
  end if;
  with holders as (
      select h.id, coalesce((select e."name" from "better_supabase"."employees" e where e."tenant_id" = qualification_gaps.tenant and e."user_id"::text = h.id limit 1), (select u.email::text from auth.users u where u.id::text = h.id), h.id) as title from (select ms."user_id"::text as id from "public"."memberships" ms where ms."organization_id" = qualification_gaps.tenant) h where qualification_gaps.holder_type = 'member'
      union all
      select h.id, coalesce((select c."name"::text from "better_supabase"."companies" c where c."id"::text = h.id), h.id) as title from (select cs."id"::text as id from "better_supabase"."companies" cs where cs."tenant_id" = qualification_gaps.tenant and cs."archived_at" is null and cs."merged_into" is null) h where qualification_gaps.holder_type = 'company'
      union all
      select h.id, coalesce((select a."name"::text from "better_supabase"."assets" a where a."id"::text = h.id), h.id) as title from (select s."id"::text as id from "better_supabase"."assets" s where s."tenant_id" = qualification_gaps.tenant and s."retired_at" is null) h where qualification_gaps.holder_type = 'asset'
  ), required as (
    select distinct h.id as holder_id, h.title, y."id" as type_id, y."key" as type_key, y."name" as type_name
    from holders h
    join "better_supabase"."qualification_types" y on y."tenant_id" = qualification_gaps.tenant and y."archived_at" is null and qualification_gaps.holder_type = any(y."holder_types")
      and (v_type_key is null or y."key" = v_type_key)
    join "better_supabase"."qualification_requirements" rq on rq."type_id" = y."id"
    where (v_holder is null or h.id = v_holder) and (v_team is null or (qualification_gaps.holder_type = 'member' and exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."team_members" tm where tm."team_id"::text = v_team and tm."user_id"::text = h.id)))
      and case rq."target_type"::text
        when 'holder' then rq."target_value" = h.id
        when 'role' then qualification_gaps.holder_type = 'member' and exists (select 1 from "public"."memberships" m2 where m2."organization_id" = qualification_gaps.tenant and m2."user_id"::text = h.id and (select r."key" from "better_supabase"."roles" r where r."id" = m2."role")::text = rq."target_value")
        when 'team' then qualification_gaps.holder_type = 'member' and exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."team_members" tq where tq."team_id"::text = rq."target_value" and tq."user_id"::text = h.id)
        when 'job_title' then qualification_gaps.holder_type = 'member' and exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."employees" eq where eq."tenant_id" = qualification_gaps.tenant and eq."user_id"::text = h.id and lower(eq."job_title") = lower(rq."target_value"))
        when 'asset_kind' then qualification_gaps.holder_type = 'asset' and exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."assets" aq where aq."id"::text = h.id and aq."kind"::text = rq."target_value")
        when 'segment' then qualification_gaps.holder_type = 'company' and exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."segment_members" sq where sq."segment_id"::text = rq."target_value" and sq."subject_id"::text = h.id)
        else false
      end
  ), rated as (
    select rq.*, s.valid_until from required rq
    left join lateral (
      select max(coalesce(x."expires_on", 'infinity'::date)) as valid_until
      from "better_supabase"."qualifications" x
      where x."type_id" = rq.type_id and x."holder_type" = qualification_gaps.holder_type and x."holder_id" = rq.holder_id
        and x."revoked_at" is null and x."granted_on" <= current_date
    ) s on true
  ), gaps as (
    select rt.*, case
      when rt.valid_until is null then 'missing'
      when rt.valid_until < current_date then 'expired'
      when rt.valid_until <= current_date + 30 then 'expiring'
    end as status
    from rated rt
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'holderType', qualification_gaps.holder_type,
    'holderId', g.holder_id,
    'holderTitle', g.title,
    'typeKey', g.type_key,
    'typeName', g.type_name,
    'status', g.status,
    'expiresOn', case when g.status = 'missing' then null else g.valid_until end
  ) order by g.title, g.holder_id, g.type_name), '[]'::jsonb)
  into v_result
  from gaps g
  where g.status is not null and (v_status is null or g.status = v_status);
  return v_result;
end;

begin
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', qualification_gaps.tenant, 'qualifications.read'), false)
    or (qualification_gaps.holder_type = 'member' and v_holder is not null and v_holder = (select auth.uid())::text and exists (select 1 from "public"."memberships" mm where mm."organization_id" = qualification_gaps.tenant and mm."user_id" = (select auth.uid())))) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to read qualifications' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'QUALIFICATION_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  if v_status is not null and v_status not in ('missing', 'expired', 'expiring') then
    raise exception 'status is missing, expired or expiring' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'QUALIFICATION_INVALID';
  end if;
  with holders as (
      select h.id, coalesce((select e."name" from "better_supabase"."employees" e where e."tenant_id" = qualification_gaps.tenant and e."user_id"::text = h.id limit 1), (select u.email::text from auth.users u where u.id::text = h.id), h.id) as title from (select ms."user_id"::text as id from "public"."memberships" ms where ms."organization_id" = qualification_gaps.tenant) h where qualification_gaps.holder_type = 'member'
      union all
      select h.id, coalesce((select c."name"::text from "better_supabase"."companies" c where c."id"::text = h.id), h.id) as title from (select cs."id"::text as id from "better_supabase"."companies" cs where cs."tenant_id" = qualification_gaps.tenant and cs."archived_at" is null and cs."merged_into" is null) h where qualification_gaps.holder_type = 'company'
      union all
      select h.id, coalesce((select a."name"::text from "better_supabase"."assets" a where a."id"::text = h.id), h.id) as title from (select s."id"::text as id from "better_supabase"."assets" s where s."tenant_id" = qualification_gaps.tenant and s."retired_at" is null) h where qualification_gaps.holder_type = 'asset'
  ), required as (
    select distinct h.id as holder_id, h.title, y."id" as type_id, y."key" as type_key, y."name" as type_name
    from holders h
    join "better_supabase"."qualification_types" y on y."tenant_id" = qualification_gaps.tenant and y."archived_at" is null and qualification_gaps.holder_type = any(y."holder_types")
      and (v_type_key is null or y."key" = v_type_key)
    join "better_supabase"."qualification_requirements" rq on rq."type_id" = y."id"
    where (v_holder is null or h.id = v_holder) and (v_team is null or (qualification_gaps.holder_type = 'member' and exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."team_members" tm where tm."team_id"::text = v_team and tm."user_id"::text = h.id)))
      and case rq."target_type"::text
        when 'holder' then rq."target_value" = h.id
        when 'role' then qualification_gaps.holder_type = 'member' and exists (select 1 from "public"."memberships" m2 where m2."organization_id" = qualification_gaps.tenant and m2."user_id"::text = h.id and (select r."key" from "better_supabase"."roles" r where r."id" = m2."role")::text = rq."target_value")
        when 'team' then qualification_gaps.holder_type = 'member' and exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."team_members" tq where tq."team_id"::text = rq."target_value" and tq."user_id"::text = h.id)
        when 'job_title' then qualification_gaps.holder_type = 'member' and exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."employees" eq where eq."tenant_id" = qualification_gaps.tenant and eq."user_id"::text = h.id and lower(eq."job_title") = lower(rq."target_value"))
        when 'asset_kind' then qualification_gaps.holder_type = 'asset' and exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."assets" aq where aq."id"::text = h.id and aq."kind"::text = rq."target_value")
        when 'segment' then qualification_gaps.holder_type = 'company' and exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."segment_members" sq where sq."segment_id"::text = rq."target_value" and sq."subject_id"::text = h.id)
        else false
      end
  ), rated as (
    select rq.*, s.valid_until from required rq
    left join lateral (
      select max(coalesce(x."expires_on", 'infinity'::date)) as valid_until
      from "better_supabase"."qualifications" x
      where x."type_id" = rq.type_id and x."holder_type" = qualification_gaps.holder_type and x."holder_id" = rq.holder_id
        and x."revoked_at" is null and x."granted_on" <= current_date
    ) s on true
  ), gaps as (
    select rt.*, case
      when rt.valid_until is null then 'missing'
      when rt.valid_until < current_date then 'expired'
      when rt.valid_until <= current_date + 30 then 'expiring'
    end as status
    from rated rt
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'holderType', qualification_gaps.holder_type,
    'holderId', g.holder_id,
    'holderTitle', g.title,
    'typeKey', g.type_key,
    'typeName', g.type_name,
    'status', g.status,
    'expiresOn', case when g.status = 'missing' then null else g.valid_until end
  ) order by g.title, g.holder_id, g.type_name), '[]'::jsonb)
  into v_result
  from gaps g
  where g.status is not null and (v_status is null or g.status = v_status);
  return v_result;
end;
$function$

functions.name: rebalance_ranks
functions.definition:
declare
  v_count integer := 0;
begin
  case rebalance_ranks.subject_type
    when 'deal' then
      with ordered as (
        select s."id" as row_id,
          row_number() over (partition by s."stage_id" order by s."rank" collate "C", s."id") as nth,
          count(*) over (partition by s."stage_id") as total
        from "better_supabase"."deals" s
        where s."tenant_id"::text = rebalance_ranks.tenant
          and (rebalance_ranks.rank_group is null or s."stage_id"::text = rebalance_ranks.rank_group)
      )
      update "better_supabase"."deals" t set "rank" = "better_supabase"."rank_key"(o.nth, o.total)
      from ordered o
      where t."id" = o.row_id;
      get diagnostics v_count = row_count;
    when 'work_item' then
      with ordered as (
        select s."id" as row_id,
          row_number() over (partition by s."stage_id" order by s."rank" collate "C", s."id") as nth,
          count(*) over (partition by s."stage_id") as total
        from "better_supabase"."work_items" s
        where s."tenant_id"::text = rebalance_ranks.tenant
          and (rebalance_ranks.rank_group is null or s."stage_id"::text = rebalance_ranks.rank_group)
      )
      update "better_supabase"."work_items" t set "rank" = "better_supabase"."rank_key"(o.nth, o.total)
      from ordered o
      where t."id" = o.row_id;
      get diagnostics v_count = row_count;
    when 'case' then
      with ordered as (
        select s."id" as row_id,
          row_number() over (partition by s."stage_id" order by s."rank" collate "C", s."id") as nth,
          count(*) over (partition by s."stage_id") as total
        from "better_supabase"."cases" s
        where s."tenant_id"::text = rebalance_ranks.tenant
          and (rebalance_ranks.rank_group is null or s."stage_id"::text = rebalance_ranks.rank_group)
      )
      update "better_supabase"."cases" t set "rank" = "better_supabase"."rank_key"(o.nth, o.total)
      from ordered o
      where t."id" = o.row_id;
      get diagnostics v_count = row_count;
    when 'application' then
      with ordered as (
        select s."id" as row_id,
          row_number() over (partition by s."stage_id" order by s."rank" collate "C", s."id") as nth,
          count(*) over (partition by s."stage_id") as total
        from "better_supabase"."applications" s
        where s."tenant_id"::text = rebalance_ranks.tenant
          and (rebalance_ranks.rank_group is null or s."stage_id"::text = rebalance_ranks.rank_group)
      )
      update "better_supabase"."applications" t set "rank" = "better_supabase"."rank_key"(o.nth, o.total)
      from ordered o
      where t."id" = o.row_id;
      get diagnostics v_count = row_count;
    when 'task' then
      with ordered as (
        select s."id" as row_id,
          row_number() over (partition by s."status" order by s."rank" collate "C", s."id") as nth,
          count(*) over (partition by s."status") as total

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.record_ai_batch(tenant uuid, provider text, reference jsonb, fields jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  v_row "better_supabase"."ai_batches"%rowtype;
  v_fields jsonb := coalesce(record_ai_batch.fields, '{}');
begin
  if not (better_supabase.actor_may_write()) then
    raise exception 'This session is read-only' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'ACTOR_READ_ONLY';
  end if;
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or (auth.uid() is not null and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', record_ai_batch.tenant, 'ai_keys.use'), false))) then
    raise exception 'you may not start batches here' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'AI_BATCH_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  insert into "better_supabase"."ai_batches" ("organization_id", "user_id", "provider", "reference", "status", "raw_status", "item_count", "counts", "metadata", "expires_at", "next_poll_at")
  values (
    record_ai_batch.tenant,
    case when coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') then (v_fields ->> 'user_id')::uuid else auth.uid() end,
    record_ai_batch.provider,
    record_ai_batch.reference,
    coalesce(v_fields ->> 'status', 'pending'),
    v_fields ->> 'raw_status',
    coalesce((v_fields ->> 'item_count')::integer, 0),
    coalesce(v_fields -> 'counts', '{}'),
    coalesce(v_fields -> 'metadata', '{}'),
    (v_fields ->> 'expires_at')::timestamptz,
    now() + interval '60 seconds'
  )
  returning * into v_row;
  return jsonb_build_object('id', v_row."id", 'organization_id', v_row."organization_id", 'user_id', v_row."user_id", 'provider', v_row."provider", 'reference', v_row."reference", 'status', v_row."status", 'raw_status', v_row."raw_status", 'item_count', v_row."item_count", 'counts', v_row."counts", 'error', v_row."error", 'metadata', v_row."metadata", 'results_saved', v_row."results_saved", 'polls', v_row."polls", 'next_poll_at', v_row."next_poll_at", 'expires_at', v_row."expires_at", 'completed_at', v_row."completed_at", 'created_at', v_row."created_at", 'updated_at', v_row."updated_at");
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.record_delivery(message uuid, channel text, external_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, status text DEFAULT 'sent'::text, error text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  v_row "better_supabase"."inbox_message_deliveries"%rowtype;
begin
  insert into "better_supabase"."inbox_message_deliveries" as d ("tenant_id", "message_id", "channel", "external_id", "status", "error", "attempts")
  select m."tenant_id", m."message_id", record_delivery.channel, record_delivery.external_id, coalesce(record_delivery.status, 'sent'), record_delivery.error, 1
  from "better_supabase"."inbox_message_details" m where m."message_id" = record_delivery.message
  on conflict ("message_id", "channel") do update set
    "external_id" = coalesce(excluded."external_id", d."external_id"),
    "status" = excluded."status",
    "error" = excluded."error",
    "attempts" = d."attempts" + 1
  returning * into v_row;
  if v_row."id" is null then
    raise exception 'message not found' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'MESSAGE_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  return to_jsonb(v_row);
end;
$function$

functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.record_push_tickets(delivery uuid, tickets jsonb)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_count integer;
begin
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin')) then
    raise exception 'only the service role reads push tickets' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'PUSH_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  if jsonb_typeof(record_push_tickets.tickets) <> 'array' or jsonb_array_length(record_push_tickets.tickets) > 1000 then
    raise exception 'pass at most 1000 tickets' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'PUSH_TOO_MANY';
  end if;
  insert into "better_supabase"."push_tickets" as x ("delivery_id", "token", "ticket_id", "status", "error")
  select record_push_tickets.delivery, e ->> 'token', e ->> 'id',
    case when e ->> 'id' is null then 'error' else 'pending' end,
    e ->> 'error'
  from jsonb_array_elements(record_push_tickets.tickets) e
  where e ->> 'token' is not null
  on conflict ("delivery_id", "token") do update set
    "ticket_id" = coalesce(excluded."ticket_id", x."ticket_id"),
    "status" = case when x."ticket_id" is not null then x."status" else excluded."status" end,
    "error" = case
      when x."ticket_id" is not null then x."error"
      when excluded."ticket_id" is not null then null
      else excluded."error"
    end;
  get diagnostics v_count = row_count;
  return v_count;
end;
$function$

functions.definition:
select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id', e.id, 'kind', n.seen, 'direction', e.direction,
    'type', e.other_type, 'subjectId', e.other_id,
    'data', e.data, 'createdAt', e.created_at
  ) order by n.seen, e.created_at, e.id), '[]'::jsonb)
  from (
    select r."id" as id, r."kind" as canonical, 'out' as direction,
      r."target_type" as other_type, r."target_id" as other_id, r."data" as data, r."created_at" as created_at
    from "better_supabase"."relations" r
    where r."tenant_id" = relations_of.tenant and r."source_type" = relations_of.subject_type and r."source_id" = relations_of.subject_id
    union all
    select r."id", r."kind", 'in', r."source_type", r."source_id", r."data", r."created_at"
    from "better_supabase"."relations" r
    where r."tenant_id" = relations_of.tenant and r."target_type" = relations_of.subject_type and r."target_id" = relations_of.subject_id
  ) e
  cross join lateral (
    select case when e.direction = 'in' and not k.both_ways then k.opposite else k.canonical end as seen
    from (values ('blocks', 'blocks', false, true, false, false, 'blocked_by'), ('blocked_by', 'blocks', true, true, false, false, 'blocks'), ('parent', 'parent', false, true, true, false, 'children'), ('children', 'parent', true, true, true, false, 'parent'), ('relates', 'relates', false, false, false, true, 'relates'), ('created_from', 'created_from', false, true, true, false, 'converted_to'), ('converted_to', 'created_from', true, true, true, false, 'created_from'), ('variant_of', 'variant_of', false, true, true, false, 'variants'), ('variants', 'variant_of', true, true, true, false, 'variant_of'), ('represents', 'represents', false, false, false, false, 'represented_by'), ('represented_by', 'represents', true, false, false, false, 'represents'), ('mitigated_by', 'mitigated_by', false, false, false, false, 'mitigates'), ('mitigates', 'mitigated_by', true, false, false, false, 'mitigated_by'), ('materialized_as', 'materialized_as', false, false, false, false, 'materializes'), ('materializes', 'materialized_as', true, false, false, false, 'materialized_as'), ('affects', 'affects', false, false, false, false, 'affected_by'), ('affected_by', 'affects', true, false, false, false, 'affects'), ('assesses', 'assesses', false, false, false, false, 'assessed_by'), ('assessed_by', 'assesses', true, false, false, false, 'assesses')) as k(name, canonical, inverted, acyclic, single, both_ways, opposite)

    from (values ('blocks', 'blocks', false, true, false, false, 'blocked_by'), ('blocked_by', 'blocks', true, true, false, false, 'blocks'), ('parent', 'parent', false, true, true, false, 'children'), ('children', 'parent', true, true, true, false, 'parent'), ('relates', 'relates', false, false, false, true, 'relates'), ('created_from', 'created_from', false, true, true, false, 'converted_to'), ('converted_to', 'created_from', true, true, true, false, 'created_from'), ('variant_of', 'variant_of', false, true, true, false, 'variants'), ('variants', 'variant_of', true, true, true, false, 'variant_of'), ('represents', 'represents', false, false, false, false, 'represented_by'), ('represented_by', 'represents', true, false, false, false, 'represents'), ('mitigated_by', 'mitigated_by', false, false, false, false, 'mitigates'), ('mitigates', 'mitigated_by', true, false, false, false, 'mitigated_by'), ('materialized_as', 'materialized_as', false, false, false, false, 'materializes'), ('materializes', 'materialized_as', true, false, false, false, 'materialized_as'), ('affects', 'affects', false, false, false, false, 'affected_by'), ('affected_by', 'affects', true, false, false, false, 'affects'), ('assesses', 'assesses', false, false, false, false, 'assessed_by'), ('assessed_by', 'assesses', true, false, false, false, 'assesses')) as k(name, canonical, inverted, acyclic, single, both_ways, opposite)
    where k.name = e.canonical
  ) n
  where relations_of.kind is null or n.seen = relations_of.kind
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.remind_approvals(after interval DEFAULT '1 day'::interval, max_requests integer DEFAULT 200)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_id uuid;
  v_count integer := 0;
begin
  for v_id in
    update "better_supabase"."approval_requests" r set "reminded_at" = now()
    where r."id" in (
      select x."id" from "better_supabase"."approval_requests" x
      where x."status" = 'pending'
        and (x."expires_at" is null or x."expires_at" > now())
        and x."created_at" <= now() - remind_approvals.after
        and (x."reminded_at" is null or x."reminded_at" <= now() - remind_approvals.after)
      order by x."created_at"
      limit greatest(coalesce(remind_approvals.max_requests, 200), 1)
      for update skip locked
    )
    returning r."id"
  loop
    perform "better_supabase"."approval_notify"(v_id, 'reminder');
    v_count := v_count + 1;
  end loop;
  return v_count;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.replace_equivalent_triggers(target regclass, module_trigger text, pattern text, replace_trigger boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  found record;
begin
  for found in
    select t.tgname as name, p.proname as fn
    from pg_catalog.pg_trigger t
    join pg_catalog.pg_proc p on p.oid = t.tgfoid
    where t.tgrelid = replace_equivalent_triggers.target
      and not t.tgisinternal
      and t.tgname <> replace_equivalent_triggers.module_trigger
      and p.proname ~* replace_equivalent_triggers.pattern
  loop
    if replace_trigger then
      execute format('drop trigger %I on %s', found.name, target);
    else
      raise warning '% already has trigger % (%), which does what % does. Pass replace_trigger => true to drop it.',
        target, found.name, found.fn, module_trigger;
    end if;
  end loop;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.represented_by_me(tenant uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  return (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', r."id", 'organizationId', r."tenant_id"::text, 'personId', r."source_id",
      'subjectType', r."target_type", 'subjectId', r."target_id",
      'role', r."data" ->> 'role', 'authority', r."data" ->> 'authority',
    'validFrom', r."data" ->> 'valid_from', 'validUntil', r."data" ->> 'valid_until'
    ) order by r."created_at", r."id"), '[]'::jsonb)
    from "better_supabase"."relations" r
    where r."tenant_id" = represented_by_me.tenant
      and r."kind" = 'represents' and r."source_type" = 'person'
      and (case when r."data" ->> 'valid_from' is null then true
      when pg_input_is_valid(r."data" ->> 'valid_from', 'date') then (r."data" ->> 'valid_from')::date <= current_date
      else false end) and (case when r."data" ->> 'valid_until' is null then true
      when pg_input_is_valid(r."data" ->> 'valid_until', 'date') then (r."data" ->> 'valid_until')::date >= current_date
      else false end)
      and ((represented_by_me.tenant)::text, ('person')::text, (r."source_id")::text) in (select g.tenant, g.party_type, g.party_id from better_supabase.portal_parties() g)
  );
end;
$function$

  if not (better_supabase.actor_may_write()) then
    raise exception 'This session is read-only' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'ACTOR_READ_ONLY';
  end if;
  if request_approval.policy is not null and not v_service then
    raise exception 'only the service role files a request under its own policy' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  if request_approval.requested_by is not null and not v_service and request_approval.requested_by is distinct from auth.uid() then
    raise exception 'only the service role files a request for another user' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  if request_approval.policy is not null then
    v_policy := "better_supabase"."approval_policy_tighten"(v_policy, request_approval.policy);

  if v_policy is null then

    when 'donation_fund' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."donation_funds" s where s."id" = (request_approval.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = request_approval.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', request_approval.tenant, 'donations.read'), false)
    when 'work_order' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_orders" s where s."id" = (request_approval.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = request_approval.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', request_approval.tenant, 'dispatch.read'), false)
    when 'shipment' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."shipments" s where s."id" = (request_approval.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = request_approval.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', request_approval.tenant, 'shipments.read'), false)
    when 'contract' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."contracts" s where s."id" = (request_approval.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = request_approval.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', request_approval.tenant, 'contracts.read'), false)
    when 'control' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."controls" s where s."id" = (request_approval.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = request_approval.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', request_approval.tenant, 'compliance.read'), false)
    when 'compliance_policy' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."compliance_policies" s where s."id" = (request_approval.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = request_approval.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', request_approval.tenant, 'compliance.read'), false)
    when 'qualification_type' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."qualification_types" s where s."id" = (request_approval.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = request_approval.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', request_approval.tenant, 'qualifications.read'), false)
    when 'risk' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."risks" s where s."id" = (request_approval.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = request_approval.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', request_approval.tenant, 'risks.read'), false)
    when 'case' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."cases" s where s."id" = (request_approval.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = request_approval.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', request_approval.tenant, 'cases.read'), false)
    when 'inspection' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."inspections" s where s."id" = (request_approval.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = request_approval.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', request_approval.tenant, 'inspections.read'), false)
    when 'inspection_program' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."inspection_programs" s where s."id" = (request_approval.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = request_approval.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', request_approval.tenant, 'inspections.read'), false)
    when 'inspection_finding' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."inspection_findings" s where s."id" = (request_approval.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = request_approval.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', request_approval.tenant, 'inspections.read'), false)

    when 'production_order' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."production_orders" s where s."id" = (request_approval.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = request_approval.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', request_approval.tenant, 'manufacturing.read'), false)
    when 'work_center' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_centers" s where s."id" = (request_approval.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = request_approval.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', request_approval.tenant, 'manufacturing.read'), false)
    when 'care_plan' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."care_plans" s where s."id" = (request_approval.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = request_approval.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', request_approval.tenant, 'care_plans.read'), false)
    when 'incident' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."incidents" s where s."id" = (request_approval.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = request_approval.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', request_approval.tenant, 'incidents.read'), false)
    when 'content_entry' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."content_entries" s where s."id" = (request_approval.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = request_approval.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', request_approval.tenant, 'content.read'), false)
    when 'document' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."documents" s where s."id" = (request_approval.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = request_approval.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', request_approval.tenant, 'documents.read'), false)
    when 'customer' then exists (select 1 from "public"."customers" s where s."id" = (request_approval.subject_id)::uuid and s."organization_id" = request_approval.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', request_approval.tenant, 'customers.read'), false)
    when 'drive_node' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" s where s."id" = (request_approval.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = request_approval.tenant and (coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', request_approval.tenant, 'drive.read'), false) and coalesce("better_supabase"."drive_node_readable"(s."id"), false)))
    when 'application' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."applications" s where s."id" = (request_approval.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = request_approval.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', request_approval.tenant, 'hiring.read'), false)
    when 'change_request' then exists (select 1 from "public"."change_requests" s where s."id" = (request_approval.subject_id)::uuid and s."organization_id" = request_approval.tenant)
    when 'project' then exists (select 1 from "public"."projects" s where s."id" = (request_approval.subject_id)::uuid and s."organization_id" = request_approval.tenant)
    when 'task' then exists (select 1 from "public"."tasks" s where s."id" = (request_approval.subject_id)::uuid and s."organization_id" = request_approval.tenant)
    else false
  end end))) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to request approval for this record' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  if not (coalesce(v_policy ->> 'mode', 'authorize') = 'confirm' or jsonb_array_length(coalesce(v_policy -> 'steps', '[]'::jsonb)) > 0) then
    raise exception 'no approval is required for this request' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'APPROVAL_NOT_REQUIRED';
  end if;
  if request_approval.fingerprint is not null and request_approval.fingerprint !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' then
    raise exception 'fingerprint must be a lowercase hex SHA-256' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'APPROVAL_FINGERPRINT_INVALID';
  end if;
  v_result := "better_supabase"."open_approval"(request_approval.tenant, request_approval.subject_type, request_approval.subject_id, request_approval.action, v_policy, request_approval.reason, request_approval.payload, coalesce(request_approval.requested_by, auth.uid()));
  if request_approval.fingerprint is not null then
    update "better_supabase"."approval_requests" x set "fingerprint" = request_approval.fingerprint
    where x."id" = (v_result ->> 'id')::uuid and x."status" = 'pending';
  end if;
  select * into v_req from "better_supabase"."approval_requests" x where x."id" = (v_result ->> 'id')::uuid;
  if found then
    return jsonb_build_object('id', v_req."id", 'organizationId', v_req."tenant_id", 'subjectType', v_req."subject_type", 'subjectId', v_req."subject_id", 'action', v_req."action", 'status', v_req."status", 'step', v_req."step", 'steps', v_req."policy" -> 'steps', 'requestedBy', v_req."requested_by", 'reason', v_req."reason", 'payload', v_req."payload", 'expiresAt', v_req."expires_at", 'decidedAt', v_req."decided_at", 'mode', coalesce(v_req."policy" ->> 'mode', 'authorize'), 'fingerprint', v_req."fingerprint", 'consumedAt', v_req."consumed_at", 'createdAt', v_req."created_at");
  end if;
  return v_result;
end;

declare

  if not (better_supabase.actor_may_write()) then
    raise exception 'This session is read-only' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'ACTOR_READ_ONLY';

    'principalId', v_run."principal_id",

functions.name: requirements_pass
functions.definition:
with horizon as (select current_date + greatest(coalesce(requirements_pass.horizon_days, 30), 0) as until),
  levels as (
    select x."variant_id" as variant, sum(x."available") as available, sum(x."incoming") as incoming,
      sum(x."reorder_point") as reorder_point
    from "better_supabase"."stock_levels" x where x."tenant_id" = requirements_pass.tenant
    group by 1
  ),
  backorders as (
    select x."variant_id" as variant, sum(x."backordered") as quantity
    from "better_supabase"."stock_allocations" x
    where x."tenant_id" = requirements_pass.tenant and x."status" = 'open' and x."backordered" > 0
    group by 1
  ),
  draft_needs as (
    select y."variant_id" as variant,
      sum("better_supabase"."production_quantity"(y."variant_id", y."quantity" * o."quantity" / x."quantity" * (1 + y."scrap_bps" / 10000.0))) as quantity
    from "better_supabase"."production_orders" o
    join "better_supabase"."boms" x on x."id" = o."bom_id"
    join "better_supabase"."bom_components" y on y."bom_id" = x."id"
    where o."tenant_id" = requirements_pass.tenant and o."status" = 'draft'
      and (o."due_on" is null or o."due_on" <= (select until from horizon))
    group by 1
  ),
  planned as (
    select o."variant_id" as variant, sum(o."quantity" - o."produced_quantity") as quantity
    from "better_supabase"."production_orders" o
    where o."tenant_id" = requirements_pass.tenant and o."status" in ('draft', 'released', 'in_progress')
      and (o."due_on" is null or o."due_on" <= (select until from horizon))
    group by 1
  ),
  extras as (
    select e.key::uuid as variant, e.value::numeric as quantity
    from jsonb_each_text(coalesce(requirements_pass.extra, '{}'::jsonb)) e
  ),
  variants as (
    select variant from levels union select variant from backorders union select variant from draft_needs
    union select variant from extras
  ),
  net as (
    select v.variant, coalesce(l.available, 0) as available, coalesce(l.incoming, 0) as incoming,
      coalesce(p.quantity, 0) as planned, l.reorder_point,
      coalesce(bo.quantity, 0) + coalesce(d.quantity, 0) + coalesce(e.quantity, 0) as demand,
      (select x."id" from "better_supabase"."boms" x where x."variant_id" = v.variant and x."status" = 'active') as bom
    from variants v
    left join levels l on l.variant = v.variant
    left join backorders bo on bo.variant = v.variant
    left join draft_needs d on d.variant = v.variant
    left join planned p on p.variant = v.variant
    left join extras e on e.variant = v.variant
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('variantId', n.variant, 'action', case when n.bom is null then 'purchase' else 'produce' end,
      'bomId', n.bom, 'quantity', "better_supabase"."production_quantity"(n.variant, coalesce(n.reorder_point, 0) - (n.available + n.incoming + n.planned - n.demand))::text,
      'available', n.available::text, 'incoming', n.incoming::text, 'planned', n.planned::text, 'demand', n.demand::text,
      'reorderPoint', n.reorder_point::text) order by n.variant), '[]'::jsonb)
  from net n
  where coalesce(n.reorder_point, 0) - (n.available + n.incoming + n.planned - n.demand) > 0;

    from "better_supabase"."production_orders" o
    where o."tenant_id" = requirements_pass.tenant and o."status" in ('draft', 'released', 'in_progress')
      and (o."due_on" is null or o."due_on" <= (select until from horizon))
    group by 1
  ),
  extras as (
    select e.key::uuid as variant, e.value::numeric as quantity
    from jsonb_each_text(coalesce(requirements_pass.extra, '{}'::jsonb)) e
  ),
  variants as (
    select variant from levels union select variant from backorders union select variant from draft_needs
    union select variant from extras
  ),
  net as (
    select v.variant, coalesce(l.available, 0) as available, coalesce(l.incoming, 0) as incoming,
      coalesce(p.quantity, 0) as planned, l.reorder_point,
      coalesce(bo.quantity, 0) + coalesce(d.quantity, 0) + coalesce(e.quantity, 0) as demand,
      (select x."id" from "better_supabase"."boms" x where x."variant_id" = v.variant and x."status" = 'active') as bom
    from variants v
    left join levels l on l.variant = v.variant
    left join backorders bo on bo.variant = v.variant
    left join draft_needs d on d.variant = v.variant
    left join planned p on p.variant = v.variant
    left join extras e on e.variant = v.variant
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('variantId', n.variant, 'action', case when n.bom is null then 'purchase' else 'produce' end,
      'bomId', n.bom, 'quantity', "better_supabase"."production_quantity"(n.variant, coalesce(n.reorder_point, 0) - (n.available + n.incoming + n.planned - n.demand))::text,
      'available', n.available::text, 'incoming', n.incoming::text, 'planned', n.planned::text, 'demand', n.demand::text,
      'reorderPoint', n.reorder_point::text) order by n.variant), '[]'::jsonb)
  from net n
  where coalesce(n.reorder_point, 0) - (n.available + n.incoming + n.planned - n.demand) > 0;
$function$

functions.name: save_document_version
functions.definition:
#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  v_doc "better_supabase"."documents"%rowtype;
begin
  select * into v_doc from "better_supabase"."documents" d where d."id" = save_document_version.document_id;
  if not found then
    raise exception 'document not found' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or (coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'documents.write'), false) and case v_doc."subject_type"
    when 'message' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."messages" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'conversation' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."conversations" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'channel' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."channels" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'messages.read'), false)

functions.definition:
declare
  v_id uuid;
begin
  if not (better_supabase.actor_may_write()) then
    raise exception 'This session is read-only' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'ACTOR_READ_ONLY';
  end if;
  if not (auth.role() = 'service_role' or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', save_reminder.tenant, 'reminders.manage'), false)) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to manage reminders' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'REMINDER_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  if not (auth.role() = 'service_role')
    and save_reminder.subject_type in ('message', 'conversation', 'channel', 'company', 'person', 'deal', 'course', 'post', 'activity', 'quote', 'work_item', 'employee', 'invoice', 'ledger_account', 'product', 'product_variant', 'order', 'calendar_event', 'booking', 'asset', 'asset_location', 'lease', 'expense_report', 'expense_line', 'donation_fund', 'work_order', 'shipment', 'contract', 'control', 'compliance_policy', 'qualification_type', 'risk', 'case', 'inspection', 'inspection_program', 'inspection_finding', 'form', 'production_order', 'work_center', 'care_plan', 'incident', 'content_entry', 'document', 'customer', 'drive_node', 'application', 'change_request', 'project', 'task')
    and not (case save_reminder.subject_type
    when 'message' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."messages" s where s."id" = (save_reminder.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = save_reminder.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', save_reminder.tenant, 'messages.read'), false)

functions.definition:
select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.item order by x.at desc), '[]'::jsonb)
  from (
    select s.starred_at as at, jsonb_build_object(
      'subjectType', s.subject_type,
      'subjectId', s.subject_id,
      'title', "better_supabase"."subject_title"(s.subject_type, s.subject_id),
      'url', "better_supabase"."subject_url"(s.subject_type, s.subject_id),
      'openedAt', s.opened_at,
      'starredAt', s.starred_at
    ) as item
    from "better_supabase"."search_user_state"() s
    where s.starred_at is not null
      and (search_favorites.types is null or s.subject_type = any (search_favorites.types))
      and "better_supabase"."can_subject"(s.subject_type, s.subject_id, 'read')
    order by s.starred_at desc
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(search_favorites.max_results, 10), 1), 100)
  ) x

functions.name: set_deal_contacts
functions.definition:
declare
  v_tenant uuid;
  v_deal uuid := set_deal_contacts.deal;
  v_item jsonb;
  v_count integer;
begin
  if not (better_supabase.actor_may_write()) then
    raise exception 'This session is read-only' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'ACTOR_READ_ONLY';
  end if;
  select x."tenant_id" into v_tenant from "better_supabase"."deals" x where x."id" = v_deal and ((auth.role() = 'service_role') or (coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', x."tenant_id", 'deals.write'), false) and (true or coalesce(x."owner_user_id" = auth.uid(), false)
      or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', x."tenant_id", 'deals.manage'), false)
      or exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."deal_members" mm where mm."deal_id" = x."id" and mm."user_id" = auth.uid()))));
  if v_tenant is null then
    raise exception 'no such deal you can edit' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'DEAL_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  if jsonb_typeof(coalesce(set_deal_contacts.contacts, '[]')) <> 'array' then
    raise exception 'contacts must be a list of { type, id }' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'DEAL_CONTACTS_INVALID';
  end if;
  for v_item in select value from jsonb_array_elements(set_deal_contacts.contacts) loop
    if not (case coalesce(v_item ->> 'type', 'person')
      when 'message' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."messages" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'conversation' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."conversations" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'channel' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."channels" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'company' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."companies" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'person' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."people" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'deal' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."deals" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'course' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."courses" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'post' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."posts" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'activity' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."activities" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'quote' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."quotes" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'work_item' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_items" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'employee' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."employees" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'invoice' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."invoices" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'ledger_account' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."ledger_accounts" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'product' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."products" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'product_variant' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."product_variants" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'order' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."orders" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'calendar_event' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."calendar_events" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'booking' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."bookings" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'asset' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."assets" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'asset_location' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."asset_locations" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'lease' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."leases" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'expense_report' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."expense_reports" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'expense_line' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."expense_lines" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'donation_fund' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."donation_funds" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'work_order' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_orders" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'shipment' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."shipments" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'contract' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."contracts" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'control' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."controls" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'compliance_policy' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."compliance_policies" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'qualification_type' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."qualification_types" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'risk' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."risks" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'case' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."cases" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'inspection' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."inspections" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'inspection_program' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."inspection_programs" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'inspection_finding' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."inspection_findings" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'form' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."forms" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'production_order' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."production_orders" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'work_center' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_centers" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'care_plan' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."care_plans" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'incident' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."incidents" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'content_entry' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."content_entries" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'document' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."documents" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'customer' then exists (select 1 from "public"."customers" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."organization_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'drive_node' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'application' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."applications" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'change_request' then exists (select 1 from "public"."change_requests" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."organization_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'project' then exists (select 1 from "public"."projects" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."organization_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'task' then exists (select 1 from "public"."tasks" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."organization_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      else false
    end and "better_supabase"."can_subject"(coalesce(v_item ->> 'type', 'person'), (v_item ->> 'id'), 'read')) then
      raise exception 'a contact is unknown or not readable in this organization' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'DEAL_CONTACT_FORBIDDEN';
    end if;
  end loop;
  if (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(set_deal_contacts.contacts) x where coalesce((x.value ->> 'primary')::boolean, false)) > 1 then
    raise exception 'a deal has one primary contact' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'DEAL_CONTACTS_INVALID';
  end if;
  delete from "better_supabase"."deal_contacts" x where x."deal_id" = v_deal;
  insert into "better_supabase"."deal_contacts" ("tenant_id", "deal_id", "contact_type", "contact_id", "role", "is_primary")
  select v_tenant, v_deal, coalesce(x.value ->> 'type', 'person'), x.value ->> 'id', x.value ->> 'role', coalesce((x.value ->> 'primary')::boolean, false)
  from jsonb_array_elements(set_deal_contacts.contacts) x
  on conflict do nothing;
  get diagnostics v_count = row_count;
  return v_count;
end;

      when 'task' then exists (select 1 from "public"."tasks" s where s."id" = ((v_item ->> 'id'))::uuid and s."organization_id"::text = v_tenant::text)

    end and "better_supabase"."can_subject"(coalesce(v_item ->> 'type', 'person'), (v_item ->> 'id'), 'read')) then
      raise exception 'a contact is unknown or not readable in this organization' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'DEAL_CONTACT_FORBIDDEN';
    end if;
  end loop;
  if (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(set_deal_contacts.contacts) x where coalesce((x.value ->> 'primary')::boolean, false)) > 1 then
    raise exception 'a deal has one primary contact' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'DEAL_CONTACTS_INVALID';
  end if;
  delete from "better_supabase"."deal_contacts" x where x."deal_id" = v_deal;
  insert into "better_supabase"."deal_contacts" ("tenant_id", "deal_id", "contact_type", "contact_id", "role", "is_primary")

  from jsonb_array_elements(set_deal_contacts.contacts) x
  on conflict do nothing;
  get diagnostics v_count = row_count;
  return v_count;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.set_deal_lines_recount(parent uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_list bigint;
  v_discount bigint;
  v_tax bigint;
begin
  select coalesce(sum(round(l."quantity" * l."unit_amount")), 0), coalesce(sum(round(round(l."quantity" * l."unit_amount") * l."discount_bps" / 10000.0)), 0), coalesce(sum(round((round(l."quantity" * l."unit_amount") - round(round(l."quantity" * l."unit_amount") * l."discount_bps" / 10000.0)) * l."tax_rate_bps" / 10000.0)), 0)
    into v_list, v_discount, v_tax
  from "better_supabase"."deal_lines" l where l."parent_id" = set_deal_lines_recount.parent;
  update "better_supabase"."deals" x set
    "list_total" = v_list,
    "discount_total" = v_discount,
    "subtotal" = v_list - v_discount,
    "tax_total" = v_tax,
    "total" = v_list - v_discount + v_tax,
    "amount" = case when x."amount_source" = 'line_items' then v_list - v_discount else x."amount" end
  where x."id" = set_deal_lines_recount.parent;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.set_knowledge_embeddings(document_id uuid, embeddings jsonb, model text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_remaining integer;
  v_items jsonb := case when jsonb_typeof(set_knowledge_embeddings.embeddings) = 'object' then set_knowledge_embeddings.embeddings -> 'items' else set_knowledge_embeddings.embeddings end;
begin
  update "better_supabase"."knowledge_chunks" t set
    "embedding" = (e.value ->> 'embedding')::extensions.vector(1536),
    "embedding_hash" = e.value ->> 'hash'
  from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(v_items, '[]')) e
  where t."document_id" = set_knowledge_embeddings.document_id and t."idx" = (e.value ->> 'idx')::integer
    and md5(t."content") = e.value ->> 'hash';
  select count(*)::integer into v_remaining from "better_supabase"."knowledge_chunks" t
  where t."document_id" = set_knowledge_embeddings.document_id and t."embedding" is null;
  update "better_supabase"."knowledge_documents" x set
    "status" = case when v_remaining = 0 then 'ready' else x."status" end,
    "embedding_model" = coalesce(set_knowledge_embeddings.model, x."embedding_model"),
    "updated_at" = now()
  where x."id" = set_knowledge_embeddings.document_id;
  return v_remaining;
end;
$function$

functions.name: set_time_rate
functions.definition:
#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  v_row "better_supabase"."time_rates"%rowtype;
begin
  if not (better_supabase.actor_may_write()) then
    raise exception 'This session is read-only' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'ACTOR_READ_ONLY';
  end if;
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', set_time_rate.tenant, 'billable_time.manage'), false)) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to change the rate card' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'BILLABLE_TIME_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  if set_time_rate.rate is null or set_time_rate.rate < 0 then
    raise exception 'a rate is 0 or more minor units per hour' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'TIME_RATE_INVALID';
  end if;
  if set_time_rate.currency is null or set_time_rate.currency !~ '^[A-Z]{3}$' then
    raise exception 'currency must be a three-letter currency code' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'TIME_RATE_INVALID';
  end if;
  if set_time_rate.cost_amount < 0 then
    raise exception 'a cost is 0 or more minor units per hour' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'TIME_RATE_INVALID';
  end if;
  if (set_time_rate.subject_type is null) <> (set_time_rate.subject_id is null) then
    raise exception 'name both subject_type and subject_id, or neither' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'TIME_RATE_INVALID';
  end if;
  if set_time_rate.subject_type is not null and not (case set_time_rate.subject_type
      when 'message' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."messages" s where s."id" = (set_time_rate.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = set_time_rate.tenant::text)
      when 'conversation' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."conversations" s where s."id" = (set_time_rate.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = set_time_rate.tenant::text)
      when 'channel' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."channels" s where s."id" = (set_time_rate.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = set_time_rate.tenant::text)
      when 'company' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."companies" s where s."id" = (set_time_rate.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = set_time_rate.tenant::text)
      when 'person' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."people" s where s."id" = (set_time_rate.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = set_time_rate.tenant::text)
      when 'deal' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."deals" s where s."id" = (set_time_rate.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = set_time_rate.tenant::text)
      when 'course' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."courses" s where s."id" = (set_time_rate.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = set_time_rate.tenant::text)
      when 'post' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."posts" s where s."id" = (set_time_rate.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = set_time_rate.tenant::text)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.shift_hours(tenant uuid, week_start date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
begin
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', shift_hours.tenant, 'shifts.manage'), false)) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to read planned hours' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'SHIFT_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  if shift_hours.week_start is null then
    raise exception 'week_start is required' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'SHIFT_INVALID';
  end if;
  return (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'userId', u.user_id,
      'shifts', u.assigned,
      'plannedHours', u.planned,
      'contractHours', u.contract,
      'differenceHours', u.planned - u.contract
    ) order by u.planned desc, u.user_id), '[]'::jsonb)
    from (
      select p.user_id, p.assigned, p.planned, (select k."hours_per_week" from "better_supabase"."employee_contracts" k
        join "better_supabase"."employees" e on e."id" = k."employee_id"
        where e."user_id" = p.user_id and k."tenant_id" = shift_hours.tenant
          and k."starts_on" <= shift_hours.week_start and (k."ends_on" is null or k."ends_on" >= shift_hours.week_start)
        order by k."starts_on" desc
        limit 1)::numeric as contract
      from (
        select y."user_id" as user_id, count(*)::integer as assigned, round((extract(epoch from sum(x."ends_at" - make_interval(mins => x."break_minutes") - x."starts_at")) / 3600)::numeric, 2) as planned
        from "better_supabase"."shift_assignments" y
        join "better_supabase"."shifts" x on x."id" = y."shift_id"
        where y."tenant_id" = shift_hours.tenant
          and y."status" = 'assigned'
          and x."status" <> 'canceled'
          and x."starts_at" >= (shift_hours.week_start)::timestamp at time zone 'UTC'
          and x."starts_at" < (shift_hours.week_start + 7)::timestamp at time zone 'UTC'
        group by y."user_id"
      ) p
    ) u
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.shifts_to_time_entries(tenant uuid, until timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  v_item record;
  v_count integer := 0;
begin
  for v_item in
    select y."id" as id, y."tenant_id" as tenant, y."user_id" as user_id, x."starts_at" as starts_at,
      greatest(x."ends_at" - make_interval(mins => x."break_minutes"), x."starts_at" + interval '1 minute') as ends_at,
      (select o."id" from "better_supabase"."employees" o where o."tenant_id" = y."tenant_id" and o."user_id" = y."user_id" limit 1) as employee_id
    from "better_supabase"."shift_assignments" y
    join "better_supabase"."shifts" x on x."id" = y."shift_id"
    where y."tenant_id" = shifts_to_time_entries.tenant
      and y."status" = 'assigned'
      and x."status" <> 'canceled'
      and x."ends_at" <= least(coalesce(shifts_to_time_entries.until, now()), now())
      and not exists (
        select 1 from "better_supabase"."time_entries" t
        where t."tenant_id" = y."tenant_id" and t."subject_type" = 'shift_assignment' and t."subject_id" = y."id"::text
      )
    order by x."starts_at"
  loop
    begin
      insert into "better_supabase"."time_entries" ("tenant_id", "user_id", "employee_id", "subject_type", "subject_id", "started_at", "ended_at")
      values (v_item.tenant, v_item.user_id, v_item.employee_id, 'shift_assignment', v_item.id::text, v_item.starts_at, v_item.ends_at);
      v_count := v_count + 1;
    exception when exclusion_violation or not_null_violation or sqlstate '55000' then
      null;
    end;
  end loop;
  return v_count;
end;
$function$
