      when 'risk' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."risks" s where s."id" = (start_sla_clocks.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'case' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."cases" s where s."id" = (start_sla_clocks.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'inspection' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."inspections" s where s."id" = (start_sla_clocks.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'inspection_program' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."inspection_programs" s where s."id" = (start_sla_clocks.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'inspection_finding' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."inspection_findings" s where s."id" = (start_sla_clocks.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'form' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."forms" s where s."id" = (start_sla_clocks.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'production_order' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."production_orders" s where s."id" = (start_sla_clocks.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'work_center' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_centers" s where s."id" = (start_sla_clocks.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'care_plan' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."care_plans" s where s."id" = (start_sla_clocks.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'incident' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."incidents" s where s."id" = (start_sla_clocks.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'content_entry' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."content_entries" s where s."id" = (start_sla_clocks.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'document' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."documents" s where s."id" = (start_sla_clocks.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'customer' then exists (select 1 from "public"."customers" s where s."id" = (start_sla_clocks.subject_id)::uuid and s."organization_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'drive_node' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" s where s."id" = (start_sla_clocks.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'application' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."applications" s where s."id" = (start_sla_clocks.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'change_request' then exists (select 1 from "public"."change_requests" s where s."id" = (start_sla_clocks.subject_id)::uuid and s."organization_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'project' then exists (select 1 from "public"."projects" s where s."id" = (start_sla_clocks.subject_id)::uuid and s."organization_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      when 'task' then exists (select 1 from "public"."tasks" s where s."id" = (start_sla_clocks.subject_id)::uuid and s."organization_id"::text = v_tenant::text)
      else false
    end and "better_supabase"."can_subject"(start_sla_clocks.subject_type, start_sla_clocks.subject_id, 'read'))) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to start clocks on this record' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'SLA_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  select * into v_policy from "better_supabase"."sla_policies" x
  where x."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant and x."subject_type" = start_sla_clocks.subject_type and x."archived_at" is null
    and (x."priority" = start_sla_clocks.priority or x."priority" is null)
  order by x."priority" nulls last
  limit 1;
  if v_policy."id" is null then
    return '[]'::jsonb;
  end if;
  foreach v_metric in array array['first_response', 'resolution'] loop
    v_minutes := case v_metric when 'first_response' then v_policy."first_response_minutes" else v_policy."resolution_minutes" end;
    if v_minutes is null then
      continue;
    end if;
    update "better_supabase"."sla_clocks" x set "policy_id" = v_policy."id",
      "due_at" = "better_supabase"."sla_due_at"(x."started_at", v_minutes, v_policy."business_hours") + make_interval(secs => x."paused_seconds")
    where x."subject_type" = start_sla_clocks.subject_type and x."subject_id" = start_sla_clocks.subject_id
      and x."metric" = v_metric and x."met_at" is null;
    if not found and not exists (
      select 1 from "better_supabase"."sla_clocks" x where x."subject_type" = start_sla_clocks.subject_type and x."subject_id" = start_sla_clocks.subject_id and x."metric" = v_metric
    ) then
      insert into "better_supabase"."sla_clocks" ("tenant_id", "subject_type", "subject_id", "policy_id", "metric", "started_at", "due_at")
      values (v_policy."tenant_id", start_sla_clocks.subject_type, start_sla_clocks.subject_id, v_policy."id", v_metric, now(),
        "better_supabase"."sla_due_at"(now(), v_minutes, v_policy."business_hours"));
    end if;
  end loop;
  return "better_supabase"."sla_clocks_of"(start_sla_clocks.subject_type, start_sla_clocks.subject_id);
end;

functions.definition:
declare
  v_tenant uuid;
begin
  if not (subject_access_log.subject_type = any ('{customer}'::text[])) then
    raise exception 'this subject type does not log reads' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'SUBJECT_READ_INVALID';
  end if;
  begin
  case subject_access_log.subject_type
    when 'customer' then
      select s."organization_id" into v_tenant from "public"."customers" s
      where s."id" = (subject_access_log.subject_id)::uuid and s."archived_at" is null;
    else
      v_tenant := null;
  end case;
  exception
    when invalid_text_representation then
      v_tenant := null;
  end;
  if v_tenant is null then
    raise exception 'subject not found' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'SUBJECT_READ_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin')
    or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_tenant, 'audit.read'), false)
    or exists (
      select 1 from "better_supabase"."subject_members" m
      where m."subject_type" = subject_access_log.subject_type
        and m."subject_id" = subject_access_log.subject_id
        and m."tenant_id" = v_tenant
        and m."role" = 'lead'
        and (m."user_id" = auth.uid() or (m."team_id" is not null and exists (
          select 1 from "better_supabase"."team_members" tm
          where tm."team_id" = m."team_id"
            and tm."user_id" = auth.uid())))
        and (m."starts_on" is null or m."starts_on" <= current_date)
        and (m."ends_on" is null or m."ends_on" >= current_date)
        and (m."ends_at" is null or m."ends_at" > now()))
    or ((v_tenant)::text, (subject_access_log.subject_type)::text, (subject_access_log.subject_id)::text) in (select g.tenant, g.party_type, g.party_id from better_supabase.portal_parties() g)
    or exists (
      select 1 from "better_supabase"."relations" r
      where r."kind" = 'represents' and r."source_type" = 'person'
        and r."tenant_id"::text = v_tenant::text
        and r."target_type" = subject_access_log.subject_type and r."target_id" = subject_access_log.subject_id
        and r."data" ->> 'authority' = 'act'
        and (case when r."data" ->> 'valid_from' is null then true
      when pg_input_is_valid(r."data" ->> 'valid_from', 'date') then (r."data" ->> 'valid_from')::date <= current_date
      else false end) and (case when r."data" ->> 'valid_until' is null then true
      when pg_input_is_valid(r."data" ->> 'valid_until', 'date') then (r."data" ->> 'valid_until')::date >= current_date
      else false end)
        and ((v_tenant)::text, ('person')::text, (r."source_id")::text) in (select g.tenant, g.party_type, g.party_id from better_supabase.portal_parties() g))) then
    raise exception 'you may not see who read this record' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'SUBJECT_READ_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  return (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(e.entry order by e.at desc), '[]'::jsonb)
    from (
      select jsonb_build_object(
      'id', l."id"::text,
      'actorId', l."actor_id",
      'actorName', (select coalesce(u.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'full_name', u.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'name', u.email::text) from auth.users u where u.id = l."actor_id"),
      'at', l."occurred_at",
      'purpose', l."metadata" ->> 'purpose',
      'emergency', coalesce((l."metadata" ->> 'emergency')::boolean, false),
      'block', l."metadata" ->> 'block',
      'function', l."metadata" ->> 'function') as entry, l."occurred_at" as at
      from "better_supabase"."audit_events" l
      where l."table_name" is null
        and l."record_id" = subject_access_log.subject_id
        and l."event_type" = 'subject.accessed'
        and l."organization_id" = v_tenant
        and l."metadata" ->> 'subjectType' = subject_access_log.subject_type
        and (subject_access_log.since is null or l."occurred_at" >= subject_access_log.since)
      order by l."occurred_at" desc
      limit least(greatest(coalesce(subject_access_log.max_rows, 100), 1), 500)
    ) e
  );
end;

      'at', l."occurred_at",
      'purpose', l."metadata" ->> 'purpose',
      'emergency', coalesce((l."metadata" ->> 'emergency')::boolean, false),

      'function', l."metadata" ->> 'function') as entry, l."occurred_at" as at
      from "better_supabase"."audit_events" l
      where l."table_name" is null
        and l."record_id" = subject_access_log.subject_id
        and l."event_type" = 'subject.accessed'
        and l."organization_id" = v_tenant
        and l."metadata" ->> 'subjectType' = subject_access_log.subject_type
        and (subject_access_log.since is null or l."occurred_at" >= subject_access_log.since)
      order by l."occurred_at" desc

declare
  v_ids uuid[];
begin
  if not (auth.role() = 'service_role' or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', subject_tags.tenant, 'tags.read'), false) or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', subject_tags.tenant, 'tags.manage'), false)) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to read tags' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'TAG_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;

    when 'work_center' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_centers" s where s."id" = (subject_tags.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = subject_tags.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', subject_tags.tenant, 'manufacturing.read'), false)
    when 'care_plan' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."care_plans" s where s."id" = (subject_tags.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = subject_tags.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', subject_tags.tenant, 'care_plans.read'), false)
    when 'incident' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."incidents" s where s."id" = (subject_tags.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = subject_tags.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', subject_tags.tenant, 'incidents.read'), false)
    when 'content_entry' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."content_entries" s where s."id" = (subject_tags.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = subject_tags.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', subject_tags.tenant, 'content.read'), false)
    when 'document' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."documents" s where s."id" = (subject_tags.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = subject_tags.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', subject_tags.tenant, 'documents.read'), false)
    when 'customer' then exists (select 1 from "public"."customers" s where s."id" = (subject_tags.subject_id)::uuid and s."organization_id" = subject_tags.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', subject_tags.tenant, 'customers.read'), false)
    when 'drive_node' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" s where s."id" = (subject_tags.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = subject_tags.tenant and (coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', subject_tags.tenant, 'drive.read'), false) and coalesce("better_supabase"."drive_node_readable"(s."id"), false)))
    when 'application' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."applications" s where s."id" = (subject_tags.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = subject_tags.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', subject_tags.tenant, 'hiring.read'), false)
    when 'change_request' then exists (select 1 from "public"."change_requests" s where s."id" = (subject_tags.subject_id)::uuid and s."organization_id" = subject_tags.tenant)
    when 'project' then exists (select 1 from "public"."projects" s where s."id" = (subject_tags.subject_id)::uuid and s."organization_id" = subject_tags.tenant)
    when 'task' then exists (select 1 from "public"."tasks" s where s."id" = (subject_tags.subject_id)::uuid and s."organization_id" = subject_tags.tenant)
    else false
  end end)) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to read this record''s tags' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'TAG_SUBJECT_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  select array_agg(g."tag_id") into v_ids from "better_supabase"."taggings" g

    from "better_supabase"."tags" t
    where t."tenant_id" = subject_tags.tenant
      and t."id" = any (v_ids)
  ), '[]'::jsonb);
end;

    when 'application' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."applications" s where s."id" = (v_doc."subject_id")::uuid and s."tenant_id" = v_doc."tenant_id") and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'hiring.read'), false)

    else false
  end) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', v_doc."tenant_id", 'documents.suggest'), false)))) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to suggest changes to this document' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'DOCUMENT_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  begin
    v_bytes := decode(suggest_document_change.payload, 'base64');
  exception when others then
    raise exception 'the update must be base64' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'DOCUMENT_UPDATE_INVALID';

  if v_bytes is null or length(v_bytes) = 0 then

  end if;
  if length(v_bytes) > 1048576 then
    raise exception 'an update can be at most 1048576 bytes' using errcode = '54000', hint = 'DOCUMENT_UPDATE_TOO_LARGE';
  end if;
  insert into "better_supabase"."document_suggestions" ("document_id", "tenant_id", "payload", "summary", "status", "created_by")

end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.sync_rule_fields(subject_type text, fields jsonb)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  v_count integer;
begin
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin')) then
    raise exception 'Only the service role syncs rule fields' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'AUTOMATION_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  if jsonb_typeof(fields) is distinct from 'array' then
    raise exception 'fields must be an array' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'AUTOMATION_FIELDS_INVALID';
  end if;
  insert into "better_supabase"."automation_fields" ("subject_type", "field_id", "label", "description", "type", "path", "column_type", "nullable", "options", "operators", "position")
  select sync_rule_fields.subject_type, x.value ->> 'id', coalesce(x.value ->> 'label', x.value ->> 'id'), x.value ->> 'description',
    x.value ->> 'type', coalesce(x.value ->> 'column', x.value ->> 'id'), coalesce(x.value ->> 'columnType', 'text'),
    coalesce((x.value ->> 'nullable')::boolean, true), x.value -> 'options', x.value -> 'operators', x.n::integer
  from jsonb_array_elements(fields) with ordinality x(value, n)
  on conflict ("subject_type", "field_id") do update set
    "label" = excluded."label",
    "description" = excluded."description",
    "type" = excluded."type",
    "path" = excluded."path",
    "column_type" = excluded."column_type",
    "nullable" = excluded."nullable",
    "options" = excluded."options",
    "operators" = excluded."operators",
    "position" = excluded."position",
    "updated_at" = now();
  delete from "better_supabase"."automation_fields" x
  where x."subject_type" = sync_rule_fields.subject_type
    and not exists (select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(fields) y where y.value ->> 'id' = x."field_id");
  select count(*) into v_count from "better_supabase"."automation_fields" x where x."subject_type" = sync_rule_fields.subject_type;
  return v_count;
exception when check_violation or not_null_violation then
  raise exception 'A rule field has an invalid id, type, column or column type' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'AUTOMATION_FIELDS_INVALID';
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.sync_workflow_steps(steps jsonb)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_count integer;
begin
  insert into "better_supabase"."workflow_step_library" ("name", "title", "description", "input_schema", "output_schema", "credential_kind", "operation")
  select e.key, coalesce(e.value ->> 'title', e.key), e.value ->> 'description',
    coalesce(e.value -> 'inputSchema', '{}'::jsonb), coalesce(e.value -> 'outputSchema', '{}'::jsonb), e.value ->> 'credentialKind',
    nullif(e.value ->> 'operation', '')
  from jsonb_each(coalesce(steps, '{}'::jsonb)) e
  on conflict ("name") do update set
    "title" = excluded."title",
    "description" = excluded."description",
    "input_schema" = excluded."input_schema",
    "output_schema" = excluded."output_schema",
    "credential_kind" = excluded."credential_kind",
    "operation" = excluded."operation",
    "updated_at" = now();
  delete from "better_supabase"."workflow_step_library" x
  where not exists (
    select 1 from jsonb_each(coalesce(steps, '{}'::jsonb)) e where e.key = x."name"
  );
  select count(*) into v_count from "better_supabase"."workflow_step_library";
  return v_count;
end;

    'key', x."key",
    'type', x."type",

    'isDefault', x."is_default",

    'forkedFrom', x."forked_from",
    'forkedFromVersion', x."forked_from_version",
    'publishedVersion', (select y."version" from "better_supabase"."template_versions" y where y."template_id" = x."id" and y."published_at" is not null order by y."version" desc limit 1),
    'upstreamVersion', case when x."forked_from" is not null then (select y."version" from "better_supabase"."template_versions" y where y."template_id" = x."forked_from" and y."published_at" is not null order by y."version" desc limit 1) end,
    'createdBy', x."created_by",
    'createdAt', x."created_at",
    'updatedAt', x."updated_at"
  ) || jsonb_build_object(
    'published', (select jsonb_build_object(
    'id', y."id",
    'template', y."template_id",
    'version', y."version",
    'hash', y."hash",
    'publishedAt', y."published_at",
    'createdBy', y."created_by",
    'createdAt', y."created_at",
    'body', y."body"
  ) from "better_supabase"."template_versions" y
      where y."template_id" = x."id" and y."published_at" is not null
      order by y."version" desc limit 1),
    'draft', (select jsonb_build_object(
    'id', y."id",
    'template', y."template_id",
    'version', y."version",
    'hash', y."hash",
    'publishedAt', y."published_at",
    'createdBy', y."created_by",
    'createdAt', y."created_at",
    'body', y."body"
  ) from "better_supabase"."template_versions" y
      where y."template_id" = x."id" and y."published_at" is null))
  from "better_supabase"."templates" x
  where x."id" = template_get.template_id

    'upstreamVersion', case when x."forked_from" is not null then (select y."version" from "better_supabase"."template_versions" y where y."template_id" = x."forked_from" and y."published_at" is not null order by y."version" desc limit 1) end,
    'createdBy', x."created_by",
    'createdAt', x."created_at",
    'updatedAt', x."updated_at"
  ) || jsonb_build_object(
    'published', (select jsonb_build_object(
    'id', y."id",
    'template', y."template_id",
    'version', y."version",
    'hash', y."hash",
    'publishedAt', y."published_at",
    'createdBy', y."created_by",
    'createdAt', y."created_at",
    'body', y."body"
  ) from "better_supabase"."template_versions" y
      where y."template_id" = x."id" and y."published_at" is not null
      order by y."version" desc limit 1),
    'draft', (select jsonb_build_object(
    'id', y."id",
    'template', y."template_id",
    'version', y."version",
    'hash', y."hash",
    'publishedAt', y."published_at",
    'createdBy', y."created_by",
    'createdAt', y."created_at",
    'body', y."body"
  ) from "better_supabase"."template_versions" y
      where y."template_id" = x."id" and y."published_at" is null))
  from "better_supabase"."templates" x
  where x."id" = template_get.template_id
$function$

functions.definition:
select to_jsonb(s) || jsonb_build_object(

      select 1 from "better_supabase"."messages" m
      where m."conversation_id" = s."conversation_id"
        and m."kind" = 'message' and m."sent_at" is not null
        and case when s."thread_id" is null then m."thread_id" is null
          else m."id" = s."thread_id" or m."thread_id" = s."thread_id" end
        and (m."sent_at" > s."through_at"
          or m."edited_at" > s."updated_at"
          or m."deleted_at" > s."updated_at")
    )
  )
  from "better_supabase"."thread_summaries" s
  where s."conversation_id" = coalesce(thread_summary.conversation,
      (select m."conversation_id" from "better_supabase"."messages" m where m."id" = thread_summary.thread))
    and s."thread_id" is not distinct from thread_summary.thread

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.time_rate(tenant uuid, user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, subject_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, subject_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, on_day date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', time_rate.tenant, 'billable_time.read'), false)) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to read the rate card' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'BILLABLE_TIME_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  return (
    select jsonb_build_object('id', c."id", 'organizationId', c."tenant_id", 'userId', c."user_id", 'subjectType', c."subject_type", 'subjectId', c."subject_id", 'rate', c."rate"::text, 'currency', c."currency", 'effectiveFrom', c."effective_from", 'cost', c."cost_amount"::text, 'createdBy', c."created_by", 'createdAt', c."created_at") from "better_supabase"."time_rates" c
    where c."tenant_id" = time_rate.tenant
      and (c."user_id" is null or c."user_id" = time_rate.user_id)
      and (c."subject_type" is null or (c."subject_type" = time_rate.subject_type and c."subject_id" = time_rate.subject_id))
      and c."effective_from" <= coalesce(time_rate.on_day, current_date)
    order by (c."subject_type" is not null) desc, (c."user_id" is not null) desc, c."effective_from" desc
    limit 1
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.trash(tenant uuid, subject_type text, subject_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_batch uuid := gen_random_uuid();
  v_count integer;
  v_id uuid;
begin
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or (coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', trash.tenant, 'trash.create'), false) and case trash.subject_type
    when 'message' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."messages" s where s."id" = (trash.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = trash.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', trash.tenant, 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'conversation' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."conversations" s where s."id" = (trash.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = trash.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', trash.tenant, 'messages.read'), false)
    when 'deal' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."deals" s where s."id" = (trash.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = trash.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', trash.tenant, 'deals.read'), false)
    when 'work_item' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_items" s where s."id" = (trash.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = trash.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', trash.tenant, 'tasks.read'), false)
    when 'risk' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."risks" s where s."id" = (trash.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = trash.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', trash.tenant, 'risks.read'), false)
    when 'case' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."cases" s where s."id" = (trash.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = trash.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', trash.tenant, 'cases.read'), false)
    when 'inspection_program' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."inspection_programs" s where s."id" = (trash.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = trash.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', trash.tenant, 'inspections.read'), false)
    when 'work_center' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."work_centers" s where s."id" = (trash.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = trash.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', trash.tenant, 'manufacturing.read'), false)
    when 'customer' then exists (select 1 from "public"."customers" s where s."id" = (trash.subject_id)::uuid and s."organization_id" = trash.tenant) and coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', trash.tenant, 'customers.read'), false)
    when 'drive_node' then exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."drive_nodes" s where s."id" = (trash.subject_id)::uuid and s."tenant_id" = trash.tenant and (coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', trash.tenant, 'drive.read'), false) and coalesce("better_supabase"."drive_node_readable"(s."id"), false)))
    when 'project' then exists (select 1 from "public"."projects" s where s."id" = (trash.subject_id)::uuid and s."organization_id" = trash.tenant)
    else false
  end and case trash.subject_type
    when 'message' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', trash.tenant, 'messages.send'), false)
    when 'conversation' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', trash.tenant, 'messages.send'), false)
    when 'deal' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', trash.tenant, 'deals.write'), false)
    when 'work_item' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', trash.tenant, 'tasks.write'), false)
    when 'risk' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', trash.tenant, 'risks.write'), false)
    when 'case' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', trash.tenant, 'cases.write'), false)
    when 'inspection_program' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', trash.tenant, 'inspections.manage'), false)
    when 'work_center' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', trash.tenant, 'manufacturing.manage'), false)
    when 'customer' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', trash.tenant, 'customers.write'), false)
    when 'drive_node' then coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', trash.tenant, 'drive.manage'), false)
    else true
  end)) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to trash this record' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'TRASH_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  declare
    v_hook regprocedure := to_regprocedure('"public"."before_trash"(uuid, text, text)');
  begin
    if v_hook is not null then
      execute format('select %s($1::uuid, $2::text, $3::text)', v_hook::oid::regproc)
        using trash.tenant, trash.subject_type, trash.subject_id;
    end if;
  end;
  v_count := "better_supabase"."trash_cascade"(trash.tenant, trash.subject_type, trash.subject_id, v_batch, 0, auth.uid());
  if v_count = 0 then
    raise exception 'no live record to trash' using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'TRASH_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  select i."id" into v_id from "better_supabase"."trash_items" i
    where i."subject_type" = trash.subject_type and i."subject_id" = trash.subject_id;
  declare
    v_hook regprocedure := to_regprocedure('"public"."after_trash"(uuid, uuid)');
  begin
    if v_hook is not null then
      execute format('select %s($1::uuid, $2::uuid)', v_hook::oid::regproc)
        using v_id, v_batch;
    end if;
  end;
  return jsonb_build_object('id', v_id, 'batchId', v_batch, 'count', v_count);
end;
$function$

functions.definition:
declare
  v_scope jsonb := coalesce(unbilled_time.scope, '{}'::jsonb);
begin
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', unbilled_time.tenant, 'billable_time.read'), false)) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to read billable time' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'BILLABLE_TIME_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  if unbilled_time.group_by not in ('subject', 'member', 'entry') then
    raise exception 'group_by is subject, member or entry' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'BILLABLE_TIME_GROUPING_INVALID';
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'lines', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('description', l.description, 'quantity', l.quantity, 'unitAmount', l.rate::text, 'currency', l.currency, 'amount', round(l.quantity * l.rate)::bigint::text, 'entryIds', l.entry_ids, 'subjectType', l.subject_type, 'subjectId', l.subject_id, 'userId', coalesce(l.member_text, l.user_text)) order by l.currency, l.first_at), '[]'::jsonb)
      from (
    select min(u.started_at) as first_at, u.currency, u.rate,
      round(sum(u.seconds) / 3600.0, 4) as quantity,
      jsonb_agg(u.id order by u.started_at, u.id) as entry_ids,
      case when unbilled_time.group_by = 'entry' then min(u.user_id::text) end as user_text,
      case when unbilled_time.group_by = 'member' then min(u.user_id::text) end as member_text,
      min(u.subject_type) as subject_type, min(u.subject_id) as subject_id,
      case
        when unbilled_time.group_by = 'entry' then coalesce(min(u.note), 'Time on ' || to_char(min(u.started_at) at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD'))
        when min(u.subject_type) is null then 'Time'
        else 'Time on ' || min(u.subject_type) || ' ' || min(u.subject_id)
      end as description
    from (
    select x."id" as id, x."user_id" as user_id, x."subject_type" as subject_type, x."subject_id" as subject_id,
      x."started_at" as started_at, x."note" as note, extract(epoch from x."ended_at" - x."started_at") as seconds,
      coalesce(x."rate", card.rate) as rate, coalesce(x."rate_currency", card.currency) as currency
    from "better_supabase"."time_entries" x
    left join lateral (
      select c."rate" as rate, c."currency"::text as currency
      from "better_supabase"."time_rates" c
      where c."tenant_id" = x."tenant_id"
        and (c."user_id" is null or c."user_id" = x."user_id")
        and (c."subject_type" is null or (c."subject_type" = x."subject_type" and c."subject_id" = x."subject_id"))
        and c."effective_from" <= (x."started_at" at time zone 'UTC')::date
      order by (c."subject_type" is not null) desc, (c."user_id" is not null) desc, c."effective_from" desc
      limit 1
    ) card on x."rate" is null
    where x."tenant_id" = unbilled_time.tenant
      and x."billable" and x."ended_at" is not null
      and not exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."time_invoice_entries" d where d."entry_id" = x."id")
      and (v_scope -> 'subject' is null or (x."subject_type" = v_scope -> 'subject' ->> 'type' and x."subject_id" = v_scope -> 'subject' ->> 'id'))
      and (v_scope ->> 'userId' is null or x."user_id" = (v_scope ->> 'userId')::uuid)
      and (v_scope ->> 'starts' is null or x."started_at" >= (v_scope ->> 'starts')::timestamptz)
      and (v_scope ->> 'ends' is null or x."started_at" < (v_scope ->> 'ends')::timestamptz)
      and (v_scope -> 'entryIds' is null or x."id"::text in (select jsonb_array_elements_text(v_scope -> 'entryIds')))) u
    where u.rate is not null
    group by u.currency, u.rate, u.subject_type, u.subject_id,
      case when unbilled_time.group_by in ('member', 'entry') then u.user_id end,
      case when unbilled_time.group_by = 'entry' then u.id end
    having round(sum(u.seconds) / 3600.0, 4) > 0) l),
    'totals', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('amount', t.amount::text, 'currency', t.currency) order by t.currency), '[]'::jsonb)
      from (select l.currency, sum(round(l.quantity * l.rate))::bigint as amount
        from (
    select min(u.started_at) as first_at, u.currency, u.rate,
      round(sum(u.seconds) / 3600.0, 4) as quantity,
      jsonb_agg(u.id order by u.started_at, u.id) as entry_ids,
      case when unbilled_time.group_by = 'entry' then min(u.user_id::text) end as user_text,
      case when unbilled_time.group_by = 'member' then min(u.user_id::text) end as member_text,
      min(u.subject_type) as subject_type, min(u.subject_id) as subject_id,
      case
        when unbilled_time.group_by = 'entry' then coalesce(min(u.note), 'Time on ' || to_char(min(u.started_at) at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD'))
        when min(u.subject_type) is null then 'Time'
        else 'Time on ' || min(u.subject_type) || ' ' || min(u.subject_id)
      end as description
    from (
    select x."id" as id, x."user_id" as user_id, x."subject_type" as subject_type, x."subject_id" as subject_id,
      x."started_at" as started_at, x."note" as note, extract(epoch from x."ended_at" - x."started_at") as seconds,
      coalesce(x."rate", card.rate) as rate, coalesce(x."rate_currency", card.currency) as currency
    from "better_supabase"."time_entries" x
    left join lateral (
      select c."rate" as rate, c."currency"::text as currency
      from "better_supabase"."time_rates" c
      where c."tenant_id" = x."tenant_id"
        and (c."user_id" is null or c."user_id" = x."user_id")
        and (c."subject_type" is null or (c."subject_type" = x."subject_type" and c."subject_id" = x."subject_id"))
        and c."effective_from" <= (x."started_at" at time zone 'UTC')::date

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'lines', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('description', l.description, 'quantity', l.quantity, 'unitAmount', l.rate::text, 'currency', l.currency, 'amount', round(l.quantity * l.rate)::bigint::text, 'entryIds', l.entry_ids, 'subjectType', l.subject_type, 'subjectId', l.subject_id, 'userId', coalesce(l.member_text, l.user_text)) order by l.currency, l.first_at), '[]'::jsonb)

      coalesce(x."rate", card.rate) as rate, coalesce(x."rate_currency", card.currency) as currency

      limit 1
    ) card on x."rate" is null
    where x."tenant_id" = unbilled_time.tenant
      and x."billable" and x."ended_at" is not null
      and not exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."time_invoice_entries" d where d."entry_id" = x."id")
      and (v_scope -> 'subject' is null or (x."subject_type" = v_scope -> 'subject' ->> 'type' and x."subject_id" = v_scope -> 'subject' ->> 'id'))
      and (v_scope ->> 'userId' is null or x."user_id" = (v_scope ->> 'userId')::uuid)

      case when unbilled_time.group_by in ('member', 'entry') then u.user_id end,
      case when unbilled_time.group_by = 'entry' then u.id end
    having round(sum(u.seconds) / 3600.0, 4) > 0) l),
    'totals', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('amount', t.amount::text, 'currency', t.currency) order by t.currency), '[]'::jsonb)
      from (select l.currency, sum(round(l.quantity * l.rate))::bigint as amount

        when min(u.subject_type) is null then 'Time'
        else 'Time on ' || min(u.subject_type) || ' ' || min(u.subject_id)
      end as description
    from (
    select x."id" as id, x."user_id" as user_id, x."subject_type" as subject_type, x."subject_id" as subject_id,

        and c."effective_from" <= (x."started_at" at time zone 'UTC')::date
      order by (c."subject_type" is not null) desc, (c."user_id" is not null) desc, c."effective_from" desc
      limit 1
    ) card on x."rate" is null
    where x."tenant_id" = unbilled_time.tenant
      and x."billable" and x."ended_at" is not null
      and not exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."time_invoice_entries" d where d."entry_id" = x."id")

declare

begin
  if not (better_supabase.actor_may_write()) then
    raise exception 'This session is read-only' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'ACTOR_READ_ONLY';
  end if;
  if not (auth.role() = 'service_role' or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', unlink.tenant, 'relations.manage'), false)) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to unlink records' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'RELATION_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;

  select k.canonical, k.inverted, k.acyclic, k.single, k.both_ways
    into v_kind, v_inverted, v_acyclic, v_single, v_symmetric
    from (values ('blocks', 'blocks', false, true, false, false, 'blocked_by'), ('blocked_by', 'blocks', true, true, false, false, 'blocks'), ('parent', 'parent', false, true, true, false, 'children'), ('children', 'parent', true, true, true, false, 'parent'), ('relates', 'relates', false, false, false, true, 'relates'), ('created_from', 'created_from', false, true, true, false, 'converted_to'), ('converted_to', 'created_from', true, true, true, false, 'created_from'), ('variant_of', 'variant_of', false, true, true, false, 'variants'), ('variants', 'variant_of', true, true, true, false, 'variant_of'), ('represents', 'represents', false, false, false, false, 'represented_by'), ('represented_by', 'represents', true, false, false, false, 'represents'), ('mitigated_by', 'mitigated_by', false, false, false, false, 'mitigates'), ('mitigates', 'mitigated_by', true, false, false, false, 'mitigated_by'), ('materialized_as', 'materialized_as', false, false, false, false, 'materializes'), ('materializes', 'materialized_as', true, false, false, false, 'materialized_as'), ('affects', 'affects', false, false, false, false, 'affected_by'), ('affected_by', 'affects', true, false, false, false, 'affects'), ('assesses', 'assesses', false, false, false, false, 'assessed_by'), ('assessed_by', 'assesses', true, false, false, false, 'assesses')) as k(name, canonical, inverted, acyclic, single, both_ways, opposite) where k.name = unlink.kind;
  if v_kind is null then
    raise exception 'unknown relation kind' using errcode = '22023', hint = 'RELATION_KIND_UNKNOWN';

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.unlink_mail_thread(thread uuid, subject_type text, subject_id text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not (better_supabase.actor_may_write()) then
    raise exception 'This session is read-only' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'ACTOR_READ_ONLY';
  end if;
  delete from "better_supabase"."mail_thread_subjects" s
  using "better_supabase"."mail_threads" x, "better_supabase"."mail_accounts" k
  where s."thread_id" = unlink_mail_thread.thread
    and s."subject_type" = unlink_mail_thread.subject_type and s."subject_id" = unlink_mail_thread.subject_id
    and x."id" = s."thread_id" and k."id" = x."account_id" and k."user_id" = auth.uid();
  return found;
end;

select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(k."conversation_id"::text, jsonb_build_object('unread', u.unread, 'mentions', u.mentions)), '{}'::jsonb)
  from "better_supabase"."conversation_members" k
  cross join lateral (
    select count(*) as unread,
      count(*) filter (where auth.uid() = any (m."mentions") or m."mention_scope" is not null) as mentions
    from "better_supabase"."messages" m
    where m."conversation_id" = k."conversation_id"
      and (m."thread_id" is null or m."broadcast")
      and m."sent_at" > coalesce(k."last_read_at", '-infinity'::timestamptz)
      and m."deleted_at" is null
      and m."author_id" is distinct from auth.uid()
  ) u
  where k."user_id" = auth.uid()
    and k."tenant_id" = unread_counts.tenant
    and not exists (select 1 from "better_supabase"."conversations" c where c."id" = k."conversation_id" and c."kind" = 'inbox')
    and u.unread > 0

functions.name: unreported_usage
functions.definition:
select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'organization_id', c."organization_id",
    'meter', c."meter",
    'day', c."day",
    'value', c."value",
    'reported_value', c."reported_value",
    'included', q.quota_limit,
    'unlimited', q.period is not null and q.quota_limit is null,
    'window_before', (
      select coalesce(sum(o."value"), 0)
      from "better_supabase"."usage_counters" o
      where o."organization_id" = c."organization_id" and o."meter" = c."meter"
        and o."day" < c."day"
        and o."day" >= w.since
    )
  ) order by c."day", c."meter"), '[]'::jsonb)
  from (
    select * from "better_supabase"."usage_counters" c
    where c."value" > c."reported_value"
      and c."meter" <> all (coalesce(unreported_usage.skip_meters, '{}'))
      and c."organization_id" <> all (coalesce(unreported_usage.skip_tenants, '{}'))
    order by c."day"
    limit max_rows
  ) c
  left join lateral "better_supabase"."usage_quota"(c."organization_id", c."meter") q on true
  cross join lateral (
    select "better_supabase"."usage_window_start"(c."organization_id", q.period, c."day") as since
  ) w

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.unreported_usage(max_rows integer DEFAULT 500, skip_meters text[] DEFAULT '{}'::text[], skip_tenants uuid[] DEFAULT '{}'::uuid[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'organization_id', c."organization_id",
    'meter', c."meter",
    'day', c."day",
    'value', c."value",
    'reported_value', c."reported_value",
    'included', q.quota_limit,
    'unlimited', q.period is not null and q.quota_limit is null,
    'window_before', (
      select coalesce(sum(o."value"), 0)
      from "better_supabase"."usage_counters" o
      where o."organization_id" = c."organization_id" and o."meter" = c."meter"
        and o."day" < c."day"
        and o."day" >= w.since
    )
  ) order by c."day", c."meter"), '[]'::jsonb)
  from (
    select * from "better_supabase"."usage_counters" c
    where c."value" > c."reported_value"
      and c."meter" <> all (coalesce(unreported_usage.skip_meters, '{}'))
      and c."organization_id" <> all (coalesce(unreported_usage.skip_tenants, '{}'))
    order by c."day"

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.unsuppress_notification_address(address text, channel text DEFAULT 'email'::text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  delete from "better_supabase"."notification_suppressions" s
  where s."channel" = coalesce(unsuppress_notification_address.channel, 'email')
    and s."address" = lower(btrim(unsuppress_notification_address.address));
  return found;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.update_ai_batch(id uuid, fields jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_row "better_supabase"."ai_batches"%rowtype;
  v_fields jsonb := coalesce(update_ai_batch.fields, '{}');
begin
  update "better_supabase"."ai_batches" x set
    "status" = coalesce(v_fields ->> 'status', x."status"),
    "raw_status" = coalesce(v_fields ->> 'raw_status', x."raw_status"),
    "counts" = coalesce(v_fields -> 'counts', x."counts"),
    "error" = case when v_fields ? 'error' then left(v_fields ->> 'error', 4000) else x."error" end,
    "expires_at" = coalesce((v_fields ->> 'expires_at')::timestamptz, x."expires_at"),
    "results_saved" = coalesce((v_fields ->> 'results_saved')::boolean, x."results_saved"),
    "next_poll_at" = case when v_fields ? 'next_poll_at' then (v_fields ->> 'next_poll_at')::timestamptz else x."next_poll_at" end,
    "completed_at" = case when coalesce(v_fields ->> 'status', x."status") <> 'pending' then coalesce(x."completed_at", now()) else null end,
    "updated_at" = now()
  where x."id" = update_ai_batch.id
  returning * into v_row;
  if not found then
    raise exception 'batch % not found', update_ai_batch.id using errcode = 'P0002', hint = 'AI_BATCH_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('id', v_row."id", 'organization_id', v_row."organization_id", 'user_id', v_row."user_id", 'provider', v_row."provider", 'reference', v_row."reference", 'status', v_row."status", 'raw_status', v_row."raw_status", 'item_count', v_row."item_count", 'counts', v_row."counts", 'error', v_row."error", 'metadata', v_row."metadata", 'results_saved', v_row."results_saved", 'polls', v_row."polls", 'next_poll_at', v_row."next_poll_at", 'expires_at', v_row."expires_at", 'completed_at', v_row."completed_at", 'created_at', v_row."created_at", 'updated_at', v_row."updated_at");
end;
$function$

functions.definition:
declare
  v_count integer;
  v_models jsonb := case jsonb_typeof(upsert_ai_models.models)
    when 'array' then upsert_ai_models.models
    when 'object' then coalesce(upsert_ai_models.models -> 'models', '[]'::jsonb)
    else '[]'::jsonb
  end;
begin
  if not coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') then
    raise exception 'Only the server records this' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'AI_CHAT_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  insert into "better_supabase"."ai_model_catalog" ("model_id", "provider", "name", "pricing", "capabilities", "plans", "enabled")
  select
    e ->> 'id',
    coalesce(e ->> 'provider', split_part(e ->> 'id', '/', 1)),
    coalesce(e ->> 'name', e ->> 'id'),
    coalesce(e -> 'pricing', '{}'::jsonb),
    coalesce(e -> 'capabilities', '{}'::jsonb),
    coalesce(array(select jsonb_array_elements_text(e -> 'plans')), '{}'::text[]),
    coalesce((e ->> 'enabled')::boolean, true)
  from jsonb_array_elements(v_models) e
  where nullif(e ->> 'id', '') is not null
  on conflict ("model_id") do update set
    "provider" = excluded."provider",
    "name" = excluded."name",
    "pricing" = excluded."pricing",
    "capabilities" = excluded."capabilities",
    "refreshed_at" = now();
  get diagnostics v_count = row_count;
  if upsert_ai_models.prune then
    delete from "better_supabase"."ai_model_catalog" x
    where x."model_id" not in (select e ->> 'id' from jsonb_array_elements(v_models) e where e ->> 'id' is not null);
  end if;
  return v_count;
end;

functions.name: verify_api_key
functions.definition:
declare
  found "better_supabase"."api_keys";
  started timestamptz;
  hits integer;
begin
  select * into found from "better_supabase"."api_keys" k where k."public_id" = verify_api_key.public_id;
  if found."id" is null
    or found."secret_hash" <> verify_api_key.secret_hash
    or (found."expires_at" is not null and found."expires_at" <= now())
    or (found."revoked_at" is not null and found."revoked_at" <= now())
    or (found."user_id" is not null and better_supabase.user_disabled(found."user_id"))
    or (found."user_id" is not null and exists (
      select 1 from auth.users u
      where u.id = found."user_id" and (u.banned_until > now() or u.deleted_at is not null)
    ))
    or (found."organization_id" is not null and better_supabase.tenant_disabled(found."organization_id"))
    or (found."user_id" is not null and found."organization_id" is not null
      and better_supabase.organization_member_role(found."organization_id", found."user_id") is null)
  then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'invalid');
  end if;
  if found."rate_limit" is not null then
    -- One update counts the hit and, for an allowed request, touches last_used_at.
    update "better_supabase"."api_keys" k set
      "window_start" = case when (k."window_start" is null or k."window_start" + interval '1 minute' <= now()) then now() else k."window_start" end,
      "window_hits" = case when (k."window_start" is null or k."window_start" + interval '1 minute' <= now()) then 1 else k."window_hits" + 1 end,
      "last_used_at" = case when case when (k."window_start" is null or k."window_start" + interval '1 minute' <= now()) then 1 else k."window_hits" + 1 end <= k."rate_limit" and (k."last_used_at" is null or k."last_used_at" + interval '60 seconds' <= now()) then now() else k."last_used_at" end
    where k."id" = found."id"
    returning k."window_start", k."window_hits" into started, hits;
    if hits > found."rate_limit" then
      return jsonb_build_object(
        'status', 'rate_limited',
        'retry_after', greatest(1, ceil(extract(epoch from started + interval '1 minute' - now()))::integer)
      );
    end if;
  elsif (found."last_used_at" is null or found."last_used_at" + interval '60 seconds' <= now()) then
    update "better_supabase"."api_keys" k set "last_used_at" = now() where k."id" = found."id";
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('status', 'ok', 'key', jsonb_build_object(
    'id', found."id",
    'organization_id', found."organization_id",
    'user_id', found."user_id",
    'name', found."name",
    'prefix', found."prefix",
    'public_id', found."public_id",
    'scopes', to_jsonb(found."scopes"),
    'kind', found."kind",
    'rate_limit', found."rate_limit",
    'expires_at', found."expires_at",
    'last_used_at', found."last_used_at",
    'revoked_at', found."revoked_at",
    'rotated_from', found."rotated_from",
    'created_by', found."created_by",
    'created_at', found."created_at",
    'state', case
      when found."revoked_at" is not null and found."revoked_at" <= now() then 'revoked'
      when found."expires_at" is not null and found."expires_at" <= now() then 'expired'
      when found."revoked_at" is not null then 'grace'
      else 'active'
    end
  ));
end;

functions.name: work_item_tree
functions.definition:
with recursive tree as (
    select x.*, 0 as depth from "better_supabase"."work_items" x where x."id" = work_item_tree.root
    union all
    select y.*, tree.depth + 1 from "better_supabase"."work_items" y join tree on y."parent_id" = tree."id"
    where tree.depth < 100 and y."archived_at" is null
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id', tree."id", 'parentId', tree."parent_id", 'identifier', tree."identifier", 'title', tree."title",
    'state', tree."state", 'startAt', tree."start_at", 'endAt', tree."end_at", 'dueAt', tree."due_at",
    'locked', tree."locked", 'depth', tree.depth,
    'progress', coalesce(tree."progress", (
      select case when count(*) filter (where ch."state" <> 'canceled') = 0 then
          case tree."state" when 'completed' then 100 else 0 end
        else round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where ch."state" = 'completed') / count(*) filter (where ch."state" <> 'canceled'))::integer end
      from "better_supabase"."work_items" ch where ch."parent_id" = tree."id" and ch."archived_at" is null))
  ) order by tree.depth, tree."rank" collate "C", tree."id"), '[]'::jsonb)
  from tree

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.workflow_claim_run_key(run_key text, stale_after interval DEFAULT '00:05:00'::interval)
 RETURNS TABLE(claimed boolean, run_id text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
begin
  return query
    insert into workflow.workflow_run_keys as k (key) values (run_key)
    on conflict (key) do update set claimed_at = now()
      where k.run_id is null and k.claimed_at < now() - coalesce(stale_after, interval '5 minutes')
    returning true, k.run_id::text;
  if not found then
    return query select false, k.run_id::text from workflow.workflow_run_keys k where k.key = run_key;
  end if;
end;
$function$

  where (workflow_definitions_list.tenant is null

    and (workflow_definitions_list.subject_type is null

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.yearly_giving_summary(tenant uuid, donor_type text, donor_id text, year integer DEFAULT NULL::integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  v_year integer := coalesce(yearly_giving_summary.year, extract(year from current_date)::integer);
begin
  if not (coalesce(nullif((select auth.jwt()) ->> 'role', ''), session_user::text) in ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin') or coalesce(better_supabase.can('tenant', yearly_giving_summary.tenant, 'donations.read'), false)) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to read donations' using errcode = '42501', hint = 'DONATIONS_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'year', v_year,
    'donorType', yearly_giving_summary.donor_type,
    'donorId', yearly_giving_summary.donor_id,
    'totals', (
      select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('currency', q.currency, 'amount', q.amount::text, 'gifts', q.gifts) order by q.currency), '[]'::jsonb)
      from (
        select g."currency" as currency, sum(g."amount") as amount, count(*) as gifts
        from "better_supabase"."donations" g
        where g."tenant_id" = yearly_giving_summary.tenant and g."donor_type" = yearly_giving_summary.donor_type
          and g."donor_id" = yearly_giving_summary.donor_id and g."status" = 'posted'
          and extract(year from g."received_on")::integer = v_year
        group by g."currency"
      ) q
    ),
    'funds', (
      select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('fundId', q.fund, 'name', coalesce(y."name", 'General'), 'currency', q.currency, 'amount', q.amount::text)
        order by coalesce(y."name", ''), q.currency), '[]'::jsonb)
      from (
        select g."fund_id" as fund, g."currency" as currency, sum(g."amount") as amount
        from "better_supabase"."donations" g
        where g."tenant_id" = yearly_giving_summary.tenant and g."donor_type" = yearly_giving_summary.donor_type
          and g."donor_id" = yearly_giving_summary.donor_id and g."status" = 'posted'
          and extract(year from g."received_on")::integer = v_year
        group by g."fund_id", g."currency"
      ) q
      left join "better_supabase"."donation_funds" y on y."id" = q.fund
    ),
    'receipts', (
      select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', x."id", 'organizationId', x."tenant_id", 'donorType', x."donor_type", 'donorId', x."donor_id", 'sequence', x."sequence"::text, 'number', x."number", 'kind', x."kind", 'year', x."year", 'amount', x."amount"::text, 'currency', x."currency", 'issuedAt', x."issued_at", 'voidedAt', x."voided_at", 'voidReason', x."void_reason") order by x."issued_at"), '[]'::jsonb)
      from "better_supabase"."donation_receipts" x
      where x."tenant_id" = yearly_giving_summary.tenant and x."donor_type" = yearly_giving_summary.donor_type
        and x."donor_id" = yearly_giving_summary.donor_id and x."year" = v_year
    )
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.import_customer(run uuid, item jsonb, subject_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_id uuid;
begin
  if subject_id is null then
    insert into public.customers (organization_id, name, kvk, status)
    values (
      (item ->> 'tenant')::uuid,
      item -> 'data' ->> 'name',
      item -> 'data' ->> 'kvk',
      coalesce(item -> 'data' ->> 'status', 'lead')
    )
    returning id into v_id;
  else
    update public.customers c
    set name = item -> 'data' ->> 'name',
        kvk = item -> 'data' ->> 'kvk',
        status = coalesce(item -> 'data' ->> 'status', c.status)
    where c.id = subject_id::uuid
    returning c.id into v_id;
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'subjectId', v_id::text,
    'updatedAt', (select c.updated_at from public.customers c where c.id = v_id)
  );
end;
$function$

functions.name: search_notes
functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_notes(query vector, k integer DEFAULT 10)
 RETURNS SETOF notes
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  previous_scan text := current_setting('hnsw.iterative_scan', true);
begin
  perform set_config('hnsw.iterative_scan', 'strict_order', true);
  return query select t.* from "public"."notes" t
  where t."embedding" is not null
  order by t."embedding" operator(extensions.<=>) query
  limit least(greatest(k, 1), 1000);
  perform set_config('hnsw.iterative_scan', coalesce(previous_scan, 'off'), true);
end;
$function$
